apps.name: Aidbase
apps.line: AI answers website questions and routes tickets and email to a team.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, ticket forms, Slack
cells.ai: Included quotas; OpenAI key adds its own bill

agents.math: One Standard plan covers one person and 100 human email conversations. AI use is left out of this price.
The same plan covers three people and 100 human email conversations. AI use is left out of this price.

facts.label: Current free offer
facts.value: Seven-day free trial on every plan; paid plan required afterward to continue using Aidbase.

facts.label: Legacy Free wording
facts.value: Email setup still describes a Free plan sending from an Aidbase alias, whereas current pricing says paid access is needed after trial.

facts.label: Ongoing free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable to the current new-customer offer, which publishes only a temporary trial.

facts.label: Trial length and end
facts.value: Seven days on all three plans; a paid plan is required to continue. If billing information is supplied, terms permit charging the selected subscription on the last trial day unless cancelled.

facts.label: Trial details not established
facts.value: Whether every current signup requires a card; separate trial quotas, feature exclusions and precise dashboard/history access after expiry.

facts.label: Standard / EUR
facts.value: EUR 29/month paid monthly; Pay yearly displays EUR 22/month. Our annual subscription calculation: EUR 22 × 12 = EUR 264/year.

facts.label: Pro / EUR
facts.value: EUR 39/month paid monthly; Pay yearly displays EUR 32/month. Our annual subscription calculation: EUR 32 × 12 = EUR 384/year.

facts.label: Expert / EUR
facts.value: EUR 199/month paid monthly; Pay yearly displays EUR 169/month. Our annual subscription calculation: EUR 169 × 12 = EUR 2,028/year.

facts.label: Dollar display variant
facts.value: Standard $29 monthly / $22 per month yearly; Pro $39 / $32; Expert $199 / $169. Our yearly totals: $264, $384 and $2,028 respectively.

facts.label: Currency and taxes unresolved
facts.value: Dollar ISO currency, currency eligibility rules, and whether advertised prices include VAT/sales tax not established.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Subscription tier with included workspace team members and resource allowances, rather than a published per-agent charge. AI chat messages, Smart suggestions and training characters have separate monthly quotas.

facts.label: Counting definitions
facts.value: Chat allowance counts messages delivered by the chatbot. Smart suggestions count AI suggestions when resolving tickets. Training allowance counts characters used for training per month.

facts.label: Minimum and commitment
facts.value: Smallest displayed paid purchase is one Standard subscription, including up to five team members. Monthly or annual advance billing; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled.

facts.label: Unspecified minimum extras
facts.value: Separate setup fee, mandatory add-ons, over-limit seat pricing and any additional negotiated contract minimum not established.

facts.label: Standard AI allowances
facts.value: 2,500 chatbot-delivered messages/month; 500 Smart suggestions/month; 2.5M training characters/month. Included in Standard, not separately priced per resolution.

facts.label: Pro AI allowances
facts.value: 10,000 chatbot-delivered messages/month; 2,500 Smart suggestions/month; 10M training characters/month.

facts.label: Expert AI allowances
facts.value: 100K chatbot-delivered messages/month; 50K Smart suggestions/month; 100M training characters/month.

facts.label: Bring your own OpenAI key
facts.value: Pricing says chatbot messages and Smart suggestions are unlimited when bringing an OpenAI key, across all three plans. An external provider bill remains outside the subscription calculation.

facts.label: Model and accounting details
facts.value: Current default/model catalogue, model-specific quota multipliers, token accounting and precise BYOK restrictions not established.

facts.label: 100 and 500 chatbot-message examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Standard base plus either 100 or 500 chatbot-delivered messages in one monthly quota period = EUR 29 with monthly billing, or EUR 22 monthly equivalent of EUR 264 prepaid/year.

facts.label: 100 and 500 suggestion examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Standard base plus 100 or 500 ticket Smart suggestions/month also stays EUR 29 monthly, or EUR 264/year with EUR 22 monthly equivalent.

facts.label: Quota overages and expiry
facts.value: Extra-message/suggestion/training prices, hard-stop behavior, auto-recharge, rollover, reset day and inactivity deletion schedule not established.

facts.label: External costs
facts.value: Existing mailbox/provider charges and BYOK OpenAI usage are outside the listed Aidbase subscription. Exact amounts depend on the selected external service and usage.

facts.label: Cancellation and refund
facts.value: Cancel renewal through account management or support. Terms allow a refund when cancellation and refund request occur within 48 hours of invoice date.

facts.label: Chatbot branding
facts.value: Removing the Powered by Aidbase chatbot branding starts on Pro; included on Expert, absent from Standard's comparison cell.

facts.label: Tickets and email branding
facts.value: Pro/Expert remove Powered by Aidbase from forms/tickets and Sent from Aidbase from email replies; Standard does not include these removal features.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service start/trial links lead to app.aidbase.ai; Standard is explicitly offered to individuals and solopreneurs. No Shopify or WordPress account is required for ordinary website use.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: knowledge-based AI customer support with human ticket/email handling and agent reply assistance. Overlaps shared inboxes, chatbots and searchable FAQ tools.

facts.label: Email channel
facts.value: Native send/receive email inbox. Verify a custom sender address and forward inbound mail from the existing provider. Current paid plans include a custom email domain.

facts.label: Website and web-app chat
facts.value: Native AI chatbot via website script or custom HTML/React component.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Native hosted and embedded forms with ticket viewing and customer comments; connect forms to a chatbot and an email inbox.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Documented connected AI bot in direct messages and public Slack channels when mentioned.

facts.label: Other customer channels
facts.value: Native WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, voice and Discord handling not established.

facts.label: Human inbox workflow
facts.value: Human support tickets and emails share an inbox; team collaboration and support personas are advertised. Ticket/email API documents status and priority updates and agent replies.

facts.label: Detailed coordination controls
facts.value: Exact agent-assignment rules, private notes, saved replies/macros, collision warnings, routing rules and business-hours settings not established.

facts.label: Form fields and notifications
facts.value: Custom ticket form builder; Pro/Expert include all field types, including hidden fields. Connected email templates accept ticket, user, status, priority, agent and comment variables.

facts.label: Standard account resources
facts.value: Two chatbots, two ticket forms, two email inboxes, five team members and five support personas.

facts.label: Pro account resources
facts.value: Five chatbots, five ticket forms, five email inboxes, 25 team members and 25 personas.

facts.label: Expert account resources
facts.value: Fifty chatbots, 50 ticket forms, 50 email inboxes, 100 team members and unlimited personas.

facts.label: Websites and brand isolation
facts.value: Permitted website/domain count, multi-brand permission isolation, extra-resource prices and separate-workspace entitlements not established.

facts.label: Customer-facing FAQ
facts.value: Native searchable/browsable FAQ collections inside the chatbot; categories can be created and reordered. All current paid plans show Connect FAQs.

facts.label: Full help-center details
facts.value: Standalone public article site, custom help-center domain, article-count cap, private article controls and article translation workflow not established.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Autonomous knowledge-trained customer answers; Smart suggestions for human ticket replies; learning from prior tickets is advertised.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs
facts.value: Website URLs, documents, video and authored FAQ collections. FAQ matches are prioritised over other knowledge when relevant.

facts.label: API source restrictions
facts.value: Knowledge API documents YouTube video sources and document MIME types application/pdf, application/msword, text/plain and text/csv.

facts.label: Size and refresh
facts.value: Standard/Pro/Expert publish 2.5M/10M/100M training characters per month. Docs explain manual training after editing sources/FAQs.

facts.label: Source review controls
facts.value: All paid tiers show access to the specific knowledge used in each chat reply, correcting knowledge for future replies and excluding knowledge from future replies.

facts.label: Knowledge details not established
facts.value: Guaranteed visitor-facing citations, automatic refresh cadence, per-file/page limits, stored source capacity, and mandatory human approval controls not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Connect a ticket form to a chatbot so customers with unanswered questions or who want a person can create a support ticket.

facts.label: Transcript and hours
facts.value: Automatic transfer of the complete bot transcript into an escalated ticket, live human takeover, after-hours schedules and response guarantees not established.

facts.label: Customer identity
facts.value: Chatbot supports userID, username, email, profileImageURL and referenceID; it can also collect name/email from visitors.

facts.label: Actions and safeguards
facts.value: Built-in order lookup, refunds, account changes, verified-identity enforcement and human approval for such actions not established.

facts.label: Shopify and WordPress
facts.value: Official guides install the hosted chatbot through Shopify theme code or a WordPress header-script plugin/custom HTML block.

facts.label: Slack and automation
facts.value: Slack bot connection plus Zapier and Make connections; automation guides use an Aidbase API key with selected permissions.

facts.label: Other relevant connections
facts.value: Native WooCommerce, Stripe customer/order lookup, Discord, Linear and GitHub support integrations not established.

facts.label: Public API
facts.value: Public JSON REST API, documented as beta, with Bearer API keys and permission scopes. Pro/Expert include API access; Standard's API cell is a dash.

facts.label: API capabilities and limits
facts.value: Knowledge, chatbot conversations, ticket forms/tickets and email inboxes/emails have references. Ticket/email write routes can reply, update status/priority and block records with appropriate scopes.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: Pro/Expert: HTTP POST with JSON for ticket creation/status/priority/comments, email sent/received/status/priority and chatbot user-data collection.

facts.label: Widget libraries
facts.value: CDN JavaScript/custom elements and React component routes for chatbot, create-ticket, ticket viewing and ticket tables.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the vendor-hosted edition researched.

facts.label: Widget text customization
facts.value: Visitor-facing chatbot labels, placeholder, FAQ/ticket buttons, privacy message and data-collection strings can be overridden; ticket form headline/button text are customizable.

facts.label: Languages by surface
facts.value: Complete agent-interface language list, maintained widget locale catalogue, named/countable AI answer languages and FAQ multilingual workflow not established.

facts.label: Required platforms
facts.value: Hosted account plus ability to embed website JavaScript or React components; no mandatory commerce/CMS platform. Shopify and WordPress setup are optional installation paths.

facts.label: Native apps
facts.value: Dedicated agent desktop/mobile applications and native customer iOS/Android SDKs not established.

facts.label: Failed-answer review and feedback
facts.value: All paid plans show reply-level source inspection, correction and exclusion; knowledge API exposes FAQ-item upvote/downvote totals.

facts.label: Operational reporting
facts.value: Current response-time reports, ticket-volume dashboards, satisfaction surveys, report exports and exact plan gates not established.

facts.label: Export access by plan
facts.value: Standard permits export of 30 days of data; Pro/Expert show unlimited export history range.

facts.label: Conversation text
facts.value: Pro+ API offers paginated lists and individual chatbot chats, tickets and emails with full conversation/message text and associated identifiers/metadata in JSON.

facts.label: Knowledge and FAQ data
facts.value: Pro+ Knowledge API lists knowledge records and FAQ items, including structured rich-text answers, categories and optional source URLs; FAQ item responses include vote totals.

facts.label: Attachments and export gaps
facts.value: Whole-account UI export format, dedicated customer/contact export, guaranteed complete attachment/original-document archive and import compatibility not established.

facts.label: Hosting and processing locations
facts.value: Security page names AWS S3, DynamoDB and Cognito. Processor list gives AWS locations US/Ireland/UK; OpenAI AI processing US; Amplitude analytics US; Stripe payments Ireland.

facts.label: EU-only claim versus legal scope
facts.value: Homepage says data is stored within EU borders; DPA permits US/other-location processing and processor list includes US/UK.

facts.label: Region choice and AI training use
facts.value: Customer-selected hosting region and a clear policy prohibiting training of general vendor/provider models on support content not established.

facts.label: Retention and deletion
facts.value: Privacy retains personal data as necessary for stated purposes/legal needs. DPA offers return or deletion at termination at the customer's election, with legal-retention and isolated-backup exceptions.

facts.label: Numeric history/deletion timing
facts.value: Plan-specific conversation retention, account inactivity deletion, post-trial retrieval window and backup purge days not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Aidbase; currently advertised hosted AI support platform with chatbot, ticket forms and email inboxes.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Highware Solutions, identified in the DPA as Highware GmbH, with a Baar, Switzerland address.

facts.label: Markets and buying restrictions
facts.value: Complete eligible-country list, country exclusions and currency-to-country mapping not established.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Commercial vendor-hosted service, installed on customer sites through embeds/libraries. Terms reserve the service's original software/features to Aidbase and its licensors.

facts.label: Vendor help channels
facts.value: Buyer support through an in-app ticket form; support@aidbase.ai in terms; public setup/reference docs. Privacy/security enquiries use privacy@aidbase.ai.

facts.label: Vendor service commitments
facts.value: Published human support hours/timezone, guaranteed response time and per-plan support SLA not established.

facts.label: Product check and lifecycle search
facts.value: Pricing, selected docs, about and legal/policy pages checked November 5, 2026; no completed acquisition or shutdown notice found in the official sources searched.

facts.label: Release freshness gap
facts.value: Latest reliably accessible dated release announcement not established: blog index and May 2025 update return HTTP 308 to /. Policy dates remain 2023.

apps.name: BetterDocs
apps.line: Builds a searchable customer help center for WordPress and Shopify.

free.text: Free WordPress plugin; Shopify free plan has 12 docs

cells.channels: Help center, Shopify chat, WhatsApp, Messenger
cells.ai: Own provider key; chatbot add-on is $69/year per site

agents.math: Does not provide a full email support inbox.
Does not provide a full email support inbox.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer / WordPress
facts.value: Free WordPress plugin, separate from Pro and the chatbot. No purchase required to install the core plugin.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer / Shopify
facts.value: Free plan displayed as $0/monthly; no card required on the vendor Shopify page.

facts.label: Free limits / WordPress features
facts.value: Core documentation, live search, table of contents, FAQ builder, Gutenberg/Elementor integration and current free MCP/AI-writing features. Multiple and internal knowledge bases and Instant Answer are Pro features.

facts.label: Free limits / WordPress quantities
facts.value: No current numeric cap for editors, documents, storage or site traffic was found in the checked core listing, pricing FAQ or free-versus-Pro guide.

facts.label: Free limits / Shopify
facts.value: 5 FAQs; 1 FAQ group; 12 docs; 3 doc categories; custom CSS; Instant Answers with WhatsApp and Messenger, feedback and live chat.

facts.label: Free limits / Shopify chat and data
facts.value: Free live-chat conversation, agent, storage and history quotas were not found.

facts.label: Trial / WordPress
facts.value: No time-limited Pro or chatbot trial was found; the free plugin and demos are the published try-before-buy routes.

facts.label: Trial / Shopify
facts.value: Pro has a 7-day free trial. Card requirement, exact post-trial charge trigger and data handling after trial were not established.

facts.label: Refund promise / WordPress
facts.value: Product page offers a 14-day no-questions-asked refund; vendor refund policy restricts refunds to unresolved unusable bugs and excludes change of mind or mistaken purchases.

facts.label: Paid plan / WordPress Starter
facts.value: Displayed promotional $52/year, with $69 crossed out; 1 active site; 1 year of updates and support.

facts.label: Paid plan / WordPress Innovator
facts.value: Displayed promotional $104/year, with $149 crossed out; unlimited active sites; 1 year of updates and support.

facts.label: Paid plan / WordPress Visionary
facts.value: Displayed promotional $194 one time, with $299 crossed out; unlimited active sites; lifetime updates and support.

facts.label: Optional bundle / WordPress
facts.value: Agency Bundle: displayed $25/month versus crossed-out $33, or $279 billed annually versus $399; Agency Bundle Lifetime $649 versus $999. Includes BetterDocs Pro among 10+ premium products.

facts.label: Paid add-on / WordPress AI Chatbot
facts.value: $8.99/monthly or $69/yearly per website; requires separately purchased BetterDocs Pro.

facts.label: Paid plan / Shopify Pro
facts.value: Vendor displays $9.99/monthly or $99.99/yearly; unlimited docs and FAQs, import/export, order tracking, analytics, priority support and FAQ groups on specific products/pages.

facts.label: Shopify regional display
facts.value: Fetched App Store page showed estimated INR 944.13/month or INR 9,449.78/year at its stated 1 INR = 0.0106 USD. It says billing uses the store currency and exchange rate on charge day.

facts.label: Currency and tax / WordPress
facts.value: WordPress and chatbot pages use the $ symbol; an explicit ISO currency and tax-inclusive/exclusive statement were not found.

facts.label: Billing unit / WordPress
facts.value: Site activation licence and duration of updates/support; chatbot is per website. No per-editor charge shown. Pro roles distinguish writing docs, editing settings and viewing analytics.

facts.label: Billing unit / Shopify
facts.value: App plan for an installed store; listing says recurring and usage-based charges are billed every 30 days. No published per-agent or per-conversation rate found.

facts.label: Minimum purchase / WordPress
facts.value: Free core has no licence payment. Minimum named paid Pro plan is Starter for one site billed yearly. AI Chatbot requires free core + Pro + add-on + a model-provider key.

facts.label: Minimum purchase / Shopify and unpublished extras
facts.value: Free or Pro app requires an existing Shopify store. Minimum staff count, mandatory setup fees and any special contract commitment beyond the shown billing period were not found.

facts.label: AI charges / WordPress writing
facts.value: Core AI writing uses the operator’s own provider key; advertised choices include OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, OpenRouter or an OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Sample knowledge-base generation is advertised without a key.

facts.label: AI charges / WordPress customer chatbot
facts.value: Paid chatbot licence plus Pro; setup requires a paid OpenAI account/key or Google Gemini key. Choice of embedding/chat model and retrieval settings affects provider usage.

facts.label: AI charges / Shopify
facts.value: Magic AI Autowrite requires the merchant’s own OpenAI key. Current App Store Free column includes AI Autowrite; vendor Shopify page instead puts Magic AI Autowrite in Pro.

facts.label: AI examples / 100 and 500
facts.value: No exact bill for 100 or 500 customer answers can be calculated. Known WordPress first-year licence subtotal is $52 Starter + $69 annual chatbot = $121; provider charges are additional.

facts.label: Renewal, cancellation and expiry / WordPress
facts.value: Vendor cancellation guide says cancellation stops automatic renewal. Expiry guide says the plugin continues working after licence expiry but loses automatic updates and premium support; no extra fee for not renewing.

facts.label: Overages and stopping rules
facts.value: A BetterDocs per-chat overage tariff, automatic credit recharge, provider-credit allowance, AI spend cap and Shopify inactivity-deletion threshold were not found.

facts.label: Branding / WordPress
facts.value: Official branding guide says branding can be removed for any package. Single-doc credit has a layout toggle; Pro Instant Answer has a separate Branding toggle.

facts.label: Branding / Shopify
facts.value: Instant Answers settings include a Show credits by BetterDocs toggle. No separate removal fee or plan gate appears in that guide.

facts.label: Buying access / WordPress
facts.value: Self-service install of the free plugin; Pro is a self-service licence purchase. A solo site owner can install and buy it. Requires WordPress with permission to install plugins.

facts.label: Buying access / Shopify
facts.value: Self-service Shopify app install; requires a Shopify account and a store. Free and Pro are separate from WordPress Pro.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: self-service help centre and FAQ builder. WordPress is the main advertised form; Shopify adds customer chat. Overlaps WordPress tools, ecommerce support and AI documentation.

facts.label: Customer channel / email
facts.value: WordPress Pro Instant Answer Ask form sends to a configured email address; Shopify feedback form collects messages and native chat can collect an email. A synchronized email support inbox is not established.

facts.label: Customer channel / website chat
facts.value: Shopify has native live chat, with replies from the app dashboard. WordPress Pro Instant Answer is article search/contact; AI Chatbot adds automated visitor chat separately.

facts.label: Customer channel / in-app chat
facts.value: WordPress Pro documents cross-domain Instant Answer embedding on external websites; native iOS/Android customer-chat SDKs were not found.

facts.label: Customer channel / WhatsApp
facts.value: Shopify Instant Answers can display a WhatsApp contact button; clicking takes the visitor to WhatsApp app or web to talk to the support team.

facts.label: Customer channel / Messenger
facts.value: Shopify lets the merchant enter a Messenger ID and expose a Messenger contact option in Instant Answers.

facts.label: Customer channel / Instagram
facts.value: A native Instagram support channel was not found in the checked edition feature pages and Shopify channel guides.

facts.label: Customer channel / SMS
facts.value: Native SMS sending/receiving and related tariffs were not found.

facts.label: Customer channel / voice
facts.value: A supported voice support channel and call rates were not found in the product guides.

facts.label: Customer channel / Slack
facts.value: A customer Slack conversation integration was not found.

facts.label: Customer channel / Discord
facts.value: A customer Discord support integration was not found.

facts.label: Customer channel / forms
facts.value: WordPress Pro Instant Answer has an Ask/message form with subject, support email and success text; Shopify Instant Answers has a customizable feedback form and Feedbacks list.

facts.label: Inbox workflow / Shopify
facts.value: Native chat list, filtering, rich-text reply editor, private messages for support representatives, resolved/unresolved status and customer information panel.

facts.label: Inbox workflow / missing controls
facts.value: Assignment rules, collision warnings, saved replies and business-hours routing were not found in the live-chat guide, plan pages or vendor terms.

facts.label: Sites and brands / WordPress
facts.value: Starter: 1 active site; Innovator and Visionary: unlimited active sites. Multiple separate knowledge bases within one site are a Pro feature. Multisite requires licence activation on each subdomain.

facts.label: Sites and brands / Shopify and chatbot
facts.value: Shopify app is installed for a store; AI Chatbot price is for 1 website. Published cross-store pooling or discounted multisite chatbot pricing was not found.

facts.label: Help centre / WordPress public content
facts.value: Public docs, categories/tags, live search, table of contents, shortcodes, Gutenberg blocks and Elementor widgets. It runs within the operator’s WordPress site/domain.

facts.label: Help centre / private and multiple
facts.value: Pro adds multiple knowledge bases and internal access restrictions by user role, document, category or knowledge base, with optional redirect for restricted visitors.

facts.label: Help centre / Shopify
facts.value: Free limits: 12 docs, 3 categories, 5 FAQs, 1 FAQ group. Pro advertises unlimited docs and FAQs, specific-page/product FAQ groups and documentation import/export.

facts.label: Article feedback and translation
facts.value: WordPress has reader reactions and feedback; Shopify has feedback forms and doc reactions. WordPress multilingual docs are supported through WPML.

facts.label: AI role / WordPress
facts.value: Core: writing/editing docs and FAQs, summaries and doc analysis, MCP access. Pro: AI Instant Answer finds docs and Content Intelligence surfaces gaps. Separate chatbot: autonomous visitor replies grounded in content.

facts.label: AI role / Shopify
facts.value: Magic AI Autowrite drafts or rewrites docs and FAQs in the merchant editor; a Keep and Save step lets the merchant retain the draft.

facts.label: AI knowledge / WordPress chatbot
facts.value: Knowledge base and selected Retrievable Post Types; site description; selectable embedding/chat models; Auto Sync on Publish; background processing. Main page says replies link their source.

facts.label: AI knowledge / limits and approval
facts.value: No hard source-character/document limit, guaranteed sync interval, citation-completeness policy or per-answer human approval setting was found for the chatbot.

facts.label: Human fallback / WordPress
facts.value: Main page says chatbot hands off to the configured support contact when it cannot answer. Visitors can download a TXT conversation transcript or send it to an email address. Pro Ask form can send to support email.

facts.label: Human fallback / Shopify
facts.value: Shopify native chat reaches staff in the app dashboard; WhatsApp/Messenger contact options provide alternative routes.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Shopify Pro order tracking shows status after the customer enters a tracking number. WordPress chatbot advertises WooCommerce/FluentCart catalog and shipping knowledge.

facts.label: Action identity and approval
facts.value: No published customer-identity check or approval flow for refunds/account changes found. WordPress MCP instead grants an administrator-approved assistant access to documentation management.

facts.label: Connections / platform and content
facts.value: WordPress with Elementor, Gutenberg and WPML; Shopify app; WordPress Pro GitHub/GitLab documentation sync; AI Chatbot product knowledge for WooCommerce and FluentCart.

facts.label: Connections / messaging and missing stack
facts.value: Shopify WhatsApp and Messenger contact links are documented. Stripe in the purchase guide is the vendor’s payment processor; native customer Stripe/Slack/Discord/Linear support integrations were not found.

facts.label: Developer access / WordPress
facts.value: Free MCP server on the operator’s domain; admin approval via OAuth, read/write doc/category/FAQ permissions, analytics reads, connected-app revocation and CLI token rotation. Pro offers Git sync and OpenAPI documentation generation.

facts.label: Developer access / undocumented routes
facts.value: No full public BetterDocs REST management API reference with rate limits, general outbound event-webhook contract or native mobile-chat SDK was found.

facts.label: Running WordPress / requirements
facts.value: Current free 4.9.5 source/listing: WordPress 6.4+ and PHP 7.4+; listing says tested up to WordPress 7.1.4. Older requirements article says WordPress 4.0+ and PHP 5.4+.

facts.label: Running WordPress / paid dependencies and maintenance
facts.value: Keep free core active for Pro; install licensed Pro and chatbot ZIPs as needed. Operator must maintain WordPress hosting, files/database, backups, mail delivery and upgrades.

facts.label: Running Shopify yourself
facts.value: Not applicable: this edition is installed as a Shopify app, not supplied as a self-hostable app package.

facts.label: Languages / interface and content
facts.value: WordPress listing has 16 available locales, including English (US), Arabic, Bengali (Bangladesh), Chinese (China), Dutch, Lao, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish variants, Turkish and Vietnamese. Shopify listing says English.

facts.label: Languages / translation and AI
facts.value: WordPress articles can be translated with WPML Multilingual CMS plus String Translation. Chatbot main page says replies in the site language; AI editor has a Translate action.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: WordPress edition requires a plugin-capable WordPress site and browser admin; storefront widgets run in the site. Shopify edition runs through Shopify Admin and its store.

facts.label: Reporting / WordPress Pro
facts.value: Views, unique readers, reactions, searches, zero-result queries, time ranges, doc/category performance, AI crawler traffic, author performance, feedback review/resolution and CSV feedback/link-health exports.

facts.label: Reporting / Shopify Pro
facts.value: Doc views, unique views, happy/neutral/sad reactions, leading docs/categories and date-filtered analytics.

facts.label: Export / WordPress content and settings
facts.value: Built-in export of docs, categories and knowledge bases to XML or CSV, with type/doc selection; settings export to JSON. Pro Git sync can push/pull Markdown documents.

facts.label: Export / WordPress chat and feedback
facts.value: Chatbot visitor transcript download is TXT or send-by-email. Advanced Analytics Feedback Inbox offers Export as CSV.

facts.label: Export / Shopify
facts.value: Docs and FAQs can each be exported to CSV from their respective tabs; current plan page places import/export in Pro.

facts.label: Export / unsupported completeness claims
facts.value: Bulk Shopify live-chat text/customer/feedback export, attachment binaries in article exports and a complete WordPress chatbot bulk export were not established.

facts.label: Data location / WordPress and external AI
facts.value: WordPress runs on the chosen site host. Main page says AI keys remain on the operator’s server and are stripped from exports; selected providers receive the requests needed for AI features.

facts.label: Data location / Shopify and training policy
facts.value: A Shopify hosting-region choice, full processor list and BetterDocs-specific AI-training-use promise were not found. WordPress vendor website policy does not establish retention/training terms for external AI requests.

facts.label: Retention / WordPress analytics
facts.value: Advanced Analytics has a configurable Data Retention setting in days plus IP-anonymization, cookieless counting and bot-exclusion controls.

facts.label: Retention / Shopify
facts.value: Policy allows personal-information report and erasure requests, subject to administrative/legal/security exceptions. Comments and metadata are retained indefinitely.

facts.label: Retention / gaps
facts.value: Exact Shopify chat/docs deletion deadlines, uninstall export window, backup purge timing and WordPress chatbot-log deletion controls were not established.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: BetterDocs; active WordPress knowledge-base plugin, with a separately offered BetterDocs FAQ Knowledge Base app for Shopify. No app-wide shutdown, sunset or acquisition notice found in the checked official sources.

facts.label: Security patch note
facts.value: BetterDocs Pro v4.3.2 fixed an issue where the AI Chatbot in Basic Mode could surface content-restricted docs to visitors who should not see them. The official changelog does not report a customer-data breach.

facts.label: Company and country / WordPress
facts.value: WPDeveloper, Inc. operates WPDeveloper.com; its published address is 124 Broadkill Rd #599, Milton, DE 19968, United States. BetterDocs is presented as a WPDeveloper product in the Startise family.

facts.label: Company / Shopify
facts.value: Storeware is the Shopify app developer; the BetterDocs Shopify page says Storeware and WPDeveloper are both brands of Startise. App listing gives a US developer address.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: A complete country eligibility or excluded-market list was not found.

facts.label: Edition and licence / free WordPress
facts.value: Self-hosted WordPress plugin; source header for version 4.9.5 states GPL-3.0+ (GPL version 3 or later).

facts.label: Edition / WordPress Pro and chatbot
facts.value: Pro is an additional downloadable plugin requiring the free plugin to stay active. AI Chatbot is another separately downloaded paid add-on requiring Pro.

facts.label: Commercial licence scope
facts.value: A component-specific source licence for the paid Pro and AI Chatbot packages was not established from the public pages. Vendor site terms include redistribution and resale restrictions.

facts.label: Hosted offer / Shopify
facts.value: Shopify app managed through Shopify Admin, with Free and Pro offers. No general standalone BetterDocs-hosted help-centre subscription was found.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: WordPress: docs, WordPress.org free-plugin support, live chat, priority support tickets and community route; vendor guide claims 24/7 availability. Shopify advertises regular support on Free and priority on Pro.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Free plugin 4.9.5 changelog dated 12/10/2026 (October 12 by its day/month sequence); docs index shows WordPress updates into October 2026. Proposed next review: 2026-12-05.

apps.name: BoldDesk
apps.line: Hosted help desk for email, chat, tickets, and customer self-service.

cells.ai: AI plans include monthly credits; extra credit packs

agents.math: 1 agent at $25 a month. Buying needs sales help, and the minimum order is unclear.
3 agents at $25 a month each. Buying needs sales help, and the minimum order is unclear.

facts.label: Free offer
facts.value: No permanent general free plan. Eligible startups and nonprofits can apply for one free year; a free trial is separate.

facts.label: Startup / current offer
facts.value: Free for 12 months; up to 5 agents and 1,000 AI credits/month; current ARR below USD 1 million, total funding below USD 10 million, new to BoldDesk.

facts.label: Startup / documentation discrepancy
facts.value: Current landing/pricing says 5 agents and monthly credits; live subscription guide describes a legacy-plan startup offer with 10 agents and 1,000 one-time credits; credit-allocation guide lists 10 agents.

facts.label: Nonprofit offer
facts.value: One free year; 10 agents, unlimited tickets, KB articles, and end users advertised. Registered nonprofit, budget below USD 1 million/year, qualifying mission and proof required.

facts.label: Promotional restrictions
facts.value: Startup/nonprofit offers cannot remove Powered by BoldDesk. Nonprofit program explicitly excludes custom domain; subscription guide excludes HIPAA from its legacy nonprofit offer.

facts.label: Other promotional quotas
facts.value: Exact promotional inbox/brand count, storage allowance, per-source training limits, and complete credit allocation after renewal were not published consistently in the checked program sources.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 15 days, no credit card required; extension can be requested from support. Trial receives 100 AI credits as a one-time, non-resetting allocation.

facts.label: Trial end and cleanup
facts.value: No permanent free fallback is promised. Exact immediate post-trial access/grace behavior was not established; inactive free/trial/community accounts may be scheduled for deletion after over six inactive months plus at least 30 days' notice.

facts.label: Human-only Enterprise
facts.value: USD 25/agent/month paid monthly, or USD 20/agent/month equivalent paid yearly at USD 240/agent/year. All help-desk features; no AI features/credits.

facts.label: Scale AI
facts.value: USD 116/month monthly, or USD 99/month equivalent billed USD 1,188/year; 500 subscription AI credits/month; unlimited human agents.

facts.label: Momentum AI
facts.value: USD 587/month monthly, or USD 499/month equivalent billed USD 5,988/year; 1,000 AI credits/month; unlimited human agents.

facts.label: Enterprise AI
facts.value: USD 1,175/month monthly, or USD 999/month equivalent billed USD 11,988/year; 2,500 AI credits/month; unlimited human agents.

facts.label: Currency and taxes
facts.value: USD; quoted fees exclude applicable taxes, levies, and duties.

facts.label: Human-only billing unit
facts.value: Named agent seat. Docs say no free light-agent/collaborator role; read-only access still needs an agent licence.

facts.label: AI billing unit
facts.value: Plan subscription plus shared AI credits used by AI Agents and AI Assist. Meter is AI processing/response complexity, not ticket resolution or human seats.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Current human-only paid seat minimum not clearly published. An indexed five-agent statement was absent from the current live subscription article; comparison calculator starts at 5 but is not an order minimum.

facts.label: Contract, setup and changes
facts.value: Monthly or annual subscription; pricing advertises zero setup fee, free onboarding/migration. AI upgrades prorated; downgrades at renewal. Auto-renewal until cancelled before term end.

facts.label: Cancellation and refund
facts.value: Cancel through billing/portal or written notice; access continues to paid-term end. Initial purchase has a 30-day money-back guarantee requested by email.

facts.label: Embedded API cancellation obligation
facts.value: API-embedded deployments must be removed within 30 days after term end; terms say failure can void cancellation and renew the subscription.

facts.label: AI credit packs
facts.value: Current price USD 40/1,000 credits; shared across AI features. Included monthly credits expire at cycle end; purchased credits carry forward while subscription remains active.

facts.label: Pack-price documentation conflict
facts.value: Current pricing/subscription guide gives USD 40/1,000; the purchase-management article still uses USD 20 for 1,000 in an example.

facts.label: Indicative credit consumption
facts.value: Pricing estimates simple work at 1–2 credits, one-skill/connected-system tasks at 3–5, multi-system workflows at 8–12. These are estimates, not fixed per-answer rates.

facts.label: Failed/unusable output accounting
facts.value: Credit guide says successfully generated responses consume credits, but also says failed or unusable responses consume credits whenever processing occurs.

facts.label: Model/provider charges
facts.value: Agent Builder lets admins choose enabled models and output-token limits. No public model-to-credit multiplier table or mandatory customer-owned LLM account found in checked pricing/docs/terms.

facts.label: AI example / 100 and 500 actual credits
facts.value: Our calculation: Scale AI includes 500 credits/month, so either 100 or 500 consumed credits adds USD 0 in packs. Base is USD 116 monthly cash, or USD 1,188/year upfront, USD 99/month equivalent.

facts.label: Illustrative response range
facts.value: Using pricing's approximate 1–2 credits for simple work: 100 such generations imply 100–200 credits; 500 imply 500–1,000 credits. For a fresh Scale allocation, packs cost USD 0 or USD 40 at the latter range's extremes.

facts.label: AI fair-use minimums
facts.value: After a 60-day onboarding period, rolling 90-day use is outside fair use if AI utilization is below 50%, or less than 40% of included credits is consumed while humans handle tickets.

facts.label: AI-plan routing and remedies
facts.value: AI plans cannot primarily serve as a human-only inbox/chat tool or bypass AI by default. Written notice, onboarding help and 30-day cure period precede remedies; provider can require a better-suited plan, including human-only.

facts.label: Credit depletion and recharge
facts.value: When included/offer/paid balances reach zero, AI pauses; humans and non-AI workflows continue. Optional Auto Recharge can buy packs; admins can disable it and configure usage notifications.

facts.label: Storage
facts.value: AI tiers: Scale 100 GB, Momentum 500 GB, Enterprise 1 TB attachment storage. Human-only Enterprise comparison lists 1 TB.

facts.label: External channel costs and late payment
facts.value: SMS/voice require integrations; third-party licences/usage costs are separate where required. Terms specify overdue interest up to 18% annually or the lower lawful maximum and possible suspension after notice.

facts.label: Portal attribution
facts.value: Remove Powered by BoldDesk from customer portal footer through General Settings; available on paid plans, excluded from startup/nonprofit offers.

facts.label: Chat attribution
facts.value: Same setting removes live-chat footer branding; offer accounts cannot remove it from portal/widgets.

facts.label: Outgoing email attribution
facts.value: General Settings removes outgoing footer's BoldDesk reference, including the documented delivered-using-BoldDesk text.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service 15-day trial and AI-plan signup; current docs direct new human-only Enterprise buyers to sales. Terms permit an individual aged 18 or over to contract.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted help desk with email tickets, chat/messaging, knowledge base, automation, reporting, and optional autonomous/agent-assist AI.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Email-to-ticket support on all current AI plans and human-only Enterprise; agent replies stay in the support workflow.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: Native widget on Momentum AI, Enterprise AI and human-only Enterprise; unlimited concurrent chat, messages and contacts advertised.

facts.label: In-app and mobile chat
facts.value: Web SDK/NPM and native iOS/Android customer Chat SDKs documented; SDK installation uses app/widget keys and brand URL.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Current pricing lists WhatsApp on Momentum AI, Enterprise AI and human-only Enterprise.

facts.label: Facebook and Instagram
facts.value: Native messaging-channel integration listed for Momentum AI, Enterprise AI and human-only Enterprise; individual integration entries in the official directory.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: SMS via integration on chat-capable AI plans and human-only Enterprise.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Voice/calls via integrations including Twilio, Aircall, Ringover, Exotel and Ozonetel; human-only plan lists phone support channel.

facts.label: Slack and Teams
facts.value: AI agents for internal support-agent questions in Slack/Teams are listed across AI plans. Slack integration page documents @BoldDesk questions in channels/threads and personal chats.

facts.label: Forms, KB widgets and other channels
facts.value: Web forms and embeddable self-help widgets available from Scale AI and human-only Enterprise. Telegram and LINE appear as additional messaging/integration options. Native Discord not established.

facts.label: Core inbox workflow
facts.value: Canned responses, tags, custom fields/views/status and workflow automation on all current offers; human-only includes full ticket split/merge/clone, private tickets, lock, notes and forwarding features.

facts.label: Routing and business hours
facts.value: Momentum AI adds automatic assignment, multiple SLAs/escalations and chat business hours; Enterprise AI adds agent shifts, approvals, time tracking and scheduled recurring tickets. Human-only includes these features.

facts.label: Chat collaboration
facts.value: Private conversation notes, tags, saved replies, history, chat views, routing and business hours on chat-capable plans.

facts.label: Brands and sites
facts.value: Enterprise AI and human-only Enterprise support multiple brands/help desks/knowledge bases; Scale/Momentum AI lack the multibrand feature in current comparison. Widgets are brand-based and multiple widgets per brand are documented.

facts.label: Multi-store context
facts.value: Shopify, WooCommerce and Stripe integrations support multiple stores/accounts and surface customer/order/payment context.

facts.label: Help center core
facts.value: Unlimited articles and public/private knowledge bases advertised; article hierarchy, comments, search/self-help widget, popular/recent/related articles and portal available across current offers.

facts.label: Advanced help content
facts.value: Momentum AI adds article feedback, versioning/restore, approval workflows, article expiry, multilingual KB and export. Enterprise AI adds multi-brand and contact-group-specific KB.

facts.label: Custom domain and branding
facts.value: Paid help center/portal can use custom domain and branding. FAQ documents tenant yourdomain.bolddesk.com mapped to support.yourcompanydomain.com; nonprofit offer excludes custom domains.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Support Agent responds/actions autonomously; Background Agent triages, predicts fields and analyzes sentiment; Assist Agent drafts, refines, summarizes and translates for staff.

facts.label: Review and publication
facts.value: Agent Builder saves drafts that can be tested before publication. November release adds human-in-the-loop approval of AI responses by designated reviewers, who can approve, reject or modify.

facts.label: Knowledge sources
facts.value: Product describes knowledge base, past tickets, websites, instructions and tools. AI 2.0 organizes sources in libraries; website ingestion supports sitemap, crawl or individual pages.

facts.label: Website limits and refresh
facts.value: Public HTTP(S) pages only; depth 1–10 and max URLs 1–100,000 documented. Include/exclude paths and scheduled resync with daily/monthly/yearly frequency, intervals, time zone and dates supported.

facts.label: Request attachments
facts.value: Agent Builder can allow file attachments: up to 20 files, 5 MB/file and 50 MB/request. Unsupported/oversized files are ignored.

facts.label: Citation and total knowledge limits
facts.value: An every-answer citation guarantee, total library/document/token allowance per plan, and refresh completion-time commitment not found in checked source/setup/pricing/terms pages.

facts.label: Customer-triggered human handoff
facts.value: Talk to a Person button for Live Chat; typed human request in Direct AI mode; configured workflow handoff in Workflow mode. Manual agent takeover supported.

facts.label: Transcript and outside-hours follow-up
facts.value: Workflow can email a group/agent the full transcript of an unanswered AI query and tell the customer a human will respond later. Chat configuration supports business hours/offline handling.

facts.label: AI custom actions
facts.value: API actions and MCP tools can look up orders, update subscriptions/addresses/records, reset access, issue refunds through connected systems, and trigger multi-step tasks. Per-action approval or autonomous execution described.

facts.label: Identity and permission boundary
facts.value: No universal customer identity-verification procedure or proof of end-user entitlement before each custom financial/account action found in checked tool/setup/pricing/terms sources.

facts.label: Human commerce actions
facts.value: Shopify/WooCommerce panels allow cancellation/refunds; Stripe panel supports refund/cancellation and pausing/resuming subscription payments.

facts.label: Commerce and billing integrations
facts.value: Shopify, WooCommerce and Stripe have specific official integrations for viewing customer/order/payment details and documented management actions.

facts.label: Work and automation connections
facts.value: Official directory lists Jira, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, HubSpot, Asana, Pipedrive, Slack, Teams, and Zapier. REST APIs/webhooks support custom connections.

facts.label: Remaining requested stack
facts.value: Native Discord, Linear, GitHub issue integration, and a specific Make connector not found in checked integration/pricing/developer sources.

facts.label: API access and identity
facts.value: REST API with x-api-key; API key belongs to a licensed named agent and updates are attributed to that key owner. Public docs at developer.bolddesk.com/api/.

facts.label: Webhooks and SDKs
facts.value: Configurable ticket webhooks with events/conditions/payload, optional authentication/signing, and failure logs. Web Chat SDK plus customer iOS/Android SDKs documented.

facts.label: Published rate limits
facts.value: Trial: 50 requests/minute and 1,000/hour. Enterprise entry in rate guide: 500/minute, 200/minute per listed high-use endpoint, 4,000/hour; rolling 60-minute window.

facts.label: New AI-plan rate mapping
facts.value: Exact Scale AI/Momentum AI/Enterprise AI API limits and all endpoint-specific SDK/channel limits not clearly mapped in current rate guide.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable: BoldDesk explicitly has no self-hosted/on-premises version.

facts.label: Portal and agent languages
facts.value: Vendor lists 42 supported language/locales; English US/UK, Arabic, Chinese Simplified/Traditional, French, German, Japanese, Spanish, Hindi, Tamil and others in the linked table. Hebrew supported in customer portal, not agent portal.

facts.label: Widget and AI language behavior
facts.value: Widget embed can include language code; Web SDK accepts locale. AI Assist can detect requester language and answer using relevant content in a different source language.

facts.label: Devices and dependencies
facts.value: Agent iOS/Android mobile apps on all AI tiers; browser help desk on desktop/mobile. Customer chat supports JS embed, iframe, Web SDK/NPM and native iOS/Android SDKs.

facts.label: Support reporting
facts.value: Support monitoring/traffic, SLA, worklogs and conversation reports on AI plans; Enterprise AI adds custom dashboards/scheduled reports. Human-only includes full reports, CSAT and team/agent performance.

facts.label: AI outcomes and review
facts.value: November release dashboard tracks response approvals, auto-resolved, sent replies, reopened tickets, deflected/assisted/escalated outcomes and AI resolution rate, with drill-down. Credit page tracks usage and balances.

facts.label: Ticket spreadsheet export
facts.value: CSV/Excel from agent ticket list, filtered fields/view, maximum 1,000 records/file. Includes description and last reply, not the full thread or attachments. Download link valid 2 days.

facts.label: Full conversation route
facts.value: REST API documents public-message and private/internal-note retrieval in JSON, with pagination/filter/order handling; custom processing needed for CSV/PDF.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: Spreadsheet export excludes attachments; download individual ticket attachments from Files tab. A complete supported bulk binary-attachment migration route was not established.

facts.label: Contacts and groups
facts.value: Contact export supports system/custom fields and Excel/CSV; maximum 5,000 contacts per export; filtered, queued delivery; 2-day link accessible to requester/CC.

facts.label: Articles
facts.value: CSV/Excel article export can include full article body by selecting Description. Export respects status/view/filters and role permission; 2-day download link.

facts.label: Reporting and feedback scope
facts.value: Current pricing FAQ allows report export up to 5,000 records/request; CSAT and article feedback reports/features exist. Complete response/comment/media coverage in a single exit archive not found.

facts.label: Hosting regions and choice
facts.value: Cloud infrastructure on GCP and Azure. Account chooses stored-data region at signup: US, EU (Netherlands), India or Australia. Security page says AI/other processing mainly in US.

facts.label: Subprocessors and AI
facts.value: Published list includes GCP hosting, Azure services, Azure Open AI in US for enabled AI, Postmark, AWS email, Stripe, Sentry, Avalara, CloudFront and PostHog.

facts.label: Data ownership and training scope
facts.value: Customer owns data; terms permit processing to provide services. CCPA customer-PII clause prohibits using that PII to train models made available to other customers. Usage data may support operation/improvement.

facts.label: AI retention and model detail
facts.value: Exact third-party AI retention days, full model/version-to-region mapping, and blanket no-training language covering every non-personal input/output not established in checked policy/terms/subprocessor pages.

facts.label: Active ticket history
facts.value: Current plans advertise unlimited tickets; human-only includes ticket history. No fixed active-history age cap found in checked pricing/terms.

facts.label: Ticket trash
facts.value: Restore guide permits restoration from Deleted Tickets within 30 days; Delete Forever cannot be recovered.

facts.label: Inactivity
facts.value: Free/trial/community accounts inactive over 6 months may be scheduled for deletion with at least 30 days' owner email notice.

facts.label: Termination and export deadline
facts.value: Export before term ends. After termination access ends; data deleted within commercially reasonable period, backups overwritten in ordinary course; some audit/transaction records retained as needed/law requires.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: BoldDesk, an active Syncfusion help-desk and AI customer-service platform. No app-wide shutdown or acquisition notice found; Classic AI is scheduled for sunset on 2026-11-15.

facts.label: Feature sunset
facts.value: Classic AI is scheduled to be discontinued on November 15, 2026. After that date, Classic AI agents and workflows that depend on it will stop working; this applies only to existing Classic AI customers, while new customers use AI 2.0.

facts.label: Legal owner and country
facts.value: Syncfusion, Inc., a Delaware corporation, principal place of business in Morrisville, North Carolina, United States.

facts.label: Markets and restrictions
facts.value: US export/sanctions restrictions apply, including restricted persons and comprehensively sanctioned countries/regions. Current subscription guide says base plan prices are consistent across regions and billed in USD.

facts.label: Hosting and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted cloud service only; no self-hosted or on-premises edition. Limited, non-exclusive subscription licence, not a public core-source licence.

facts.label: Current and legacy offers
facts.value: Current: Scale AI, Momentum AI, Enterprise AI; separate Enterprise Without AI / Help Desk plan. Legacy Scale, Momentum, and Enterprise remain for eligible existing subscribers, not new purchases.

facts.label: Vendor channels and hours
facts.value: SLA provides 24×5 ticket/email/chat support, phone escalation and conditional weekend/holiday help. Public support portal and email available; current subscription includes support.

facts.label: Response times and limits
facts.value: Standard: P1 1 business day, P2/P3 2 business days. Premium: P1 3 calendar hours, P2 12 calendar hours, P3 1 business day. Terms cap support fair use at 160 work hours/month.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; latest reviewed release November 2, 2026; terms effective October 30, 2026; DPA July 10, 2026. Suggested next review 2026-12-05.

apps.name: Botsonic
apps.line: Builds website chat agents that answer from your business content.

cells.ai: 1,000 messages/month on Starter; $25 per 2,000 more

agents.math: The Starter plan is $19 a month and includes 1 member.
$19 Starter plan + 2 extra members at $25 each = $69 a month. It is not stated whether extra members are billed yearly.

facts.label: Free offer and eligibility
facts.value: A 7-day trial is published. The billing guide says cancelling a paid plan switches that account to a Free Plan, but current pricing does not list an ongoing free tier for new accounts.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Numeric Free Plan message, character, bot, team, channel, and history limits were not published in the sources checked.

facts.label: Trial length and card
facts.value: 7 days; the help-center billing article says no credit card is required.

facts.label: After the trial
facts.value: The automatic post-trial state or charge trigger is not stated for Botsonic in the current pricing page, billing guide, or Terms checked.

facts.label: Starter plan
facts.value: $19 per month billed monthly, or $16 per month displayed when billed annually. Includes 1 team member, 1,000 messages/month, 1 chatbot, 10M uploaded characters, 3 Agentic Actions, GPT-4o mini, lead capture, and a sitemap up to 5,000 URLs.

facts.label: Professional plan
facts.value: $49 per month billed monthly, or $41 per month displayed when billed annually. Includes 2 team members, 3,000 messages/month, 2 chatbots, 50M uploaded characters, 5 Agentic Actions, GPT-4o and upcoming models, added integrations, email transcripts, and callback request.

facts.label: Advanced plan
facts.value: $299 per month billed monthly, or $249 per month displayed when billed annually. Includes 5 team members, 12,000 messages/month, 2 chatbots, 100M uploaded characters, 5 workflows, 10 Agentic Actions, unlimited sitemap size, auto-sync, training, optional one-month Slack channel, and API access.

facts.label: Enterprise plan
facts.value: Custom price and custom member, message, chatbot, and character allowances. Pricing page lists SSO/SAML, handoffs, API, priority support, and custom integrations.

facts.label: Currency code
facts.value: The price page shows $, but no currency code was published in pricing or Terms.

facts.label: Tax treatment
facts.value: Terms say subscription fees exclude taxes and the customer is responsible for applicable taxes.

facts.label: Main billing unit
facts.value: Plans include monthly message allowances and a fixed number of team members and chatbots per workspace. Extra team members, messages, bots, uploaded characters, branding removal, handoff, and API access are add-ons.

facts.label: Message counting rule
facts.value: The public pricing and billing pages call the allowance “messages” but do not define exactly which user and bot turns consume one message.

facts.label: Team member roles
facts.value: Shared workspaces support Admins and Editors; Editors can manage sources, inbox, sharing, and analytics. Team counts vary by plan.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and term
facts.value: Lowest self-serve option is one Starter member at $19 monthly or annual billing. Current pricing does not show a required paid setup add-on for Starter. Monthly subscriptions renew automatically until cancelled or paused.

facts.label: Older Advanced onboarding fee
facts.value: The older Plans and Billing guide says its Advanced AI Agents price excludes a required one-time $500 onboarding fee. Current pricing lists a training session but does not mention this fee.

facts.label: Included AI and model choices
facts.value: Message quotas include the AI feature. Starter lists GPT-4o mini; Professional adds GPT-4o and upcoming models; Advanced inherits Professional models and adds workflows. No separate model-provider fee is listed in current pricing.

facts.label: Model multipliers
facts.value: Current model-specific message multipliers were not published in the live price table or current settings guide. An older “What's Botsonic?” guide gives 1x/2x/10x for GPT-4o mini/GPT-4o/GPT-4, but its model list is stale relative to current pricing.

facts.label: AI message examples
facts.value: At 100 or 500 total monthly messages, Starter's included 1,000-message allowance covers that amount, so no message add-on is needed. If allowance is exhausted, the published add-on starts at 2,000 more messages for $25/month, prorated by remaining billing days.

facts.label: Extra charges
facts.value: Current add-ons: 2,000 messages $25/month; 20M uploaded characters $10/month; each extra team member $25/month; 3 extra bots $99/month; remove “Powered by Botsonic” from widget/iframe $49/month; Zendesk handoff $199/month; API access $49/month (free on Advanced/Enterprise).

facts.label: Exhaustion and add-on billing
facts.value: No pay-as-you-go plan. If messages run out early, the FAQ says customers can buy more and are charged a prorated amount for remaining days; add-ons can be removed later. Monthly subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled or paused.

facts.label: Self-serve refund
facts.value: For a direct self-serve purchase, Terms allow a full refund of the initial subscription fee within 7 days by emailing support; after that, fees are non-refundable except as law requires.

facts.label: Third-party and inactivity charges
facts.value: Botsonic requires external accounts for some integrations; no Botsonic fee schedule for Meta, Telegram, Slack, or other third-party services was found. Inactivity deletion and unused-message expiry were not specified in pricing, help docs, or Terms.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: A $49/month add-on removes Botsonic branding from the chatbot widget and iframe.

facts.label: Other branding surfaces
facts.value: Whether removal applies to email transcripts, integrations, or any separate public help center was not published in current pricing or the branding guide.

facts.label: Self-serve access for one person
facts.value: Starter, Professional, and Advanced have public monthly and annual checkout prices and a 7-day trial. Starter includes one team member, so one person fits its published seat count.

facts.label: Enterprise sales access
facts.value: The live pricing page lists custom Enterprise pricing and a Contact Sales route. The separate Botsonic demo page says it is no longer accepting new enterprise clients.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: customer-facing AI support chatbot/agent trained on a business's sources; also marketed for employee assistance and conversational commerce. It overlaps with chatbot builders, help desks, and ecommerce support.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Website chatbot is embedded using JavaScript or iframe. The embed guide requires adding allowed domains; multiple domains can be added.

facts.label: WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and Telegram
facts.value: These customer channels have official setup guides and are listed in current plan integrations. Setup uses the customer's Meta account/app or Telegram bot token.

facts.label: Slack and Google Chat
facts.value: Slack and Google Chat are listed from Professional. The Slack guide describes internal questions in DMs, public/private channels, and group chats; it is an employee-assistant route rather than a public customer inbox.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Professional offers outbound email transcripts and bot settings can direct a customer to a support email. An inbound shared support email inbox was not established.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: The homepage markets SMS alongside web and WhatsApp, but pricing and help pages checked did not establish its plan gate, setup, or charges.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: No Botsonic voice-support channel or plan inclusion was established in the current pricing and help pages checked.

facts.label: Inbox workflow
facts.value: Botsonic has a bot inbox for viewing chats, filtering positive/negative feedback, blocking an IP, adding an FAQ, and exporting chats. Shared workspace members can be Admins or Editors.

facts.label: Assignment, notes, saved replies, collision, rules, hours
facts.value: Assignment queues, private notes, collision detection, saved agent replies, routing rules, and business hours were not described in the inbox and workflow guides checked.

facts.label: Bots, members, and domains
facts.value: Starter: 1 bot/1 member; Professional: 2 bots/2 members; Advanced: 2 bots/5 members; Enterprise: custom. Each bot has its own knowledge sources. Multiple website domains can be allowlisted for an embed.

facts.label: Workspaces and separation
facts.value: A private workspace is the default; shared workspaces and collaborator access depend on plan. Bots can be moved between private/shared workspaces.

facts.label: Hosted help center
facts.value: Botsonic can train on help-center/knowledge-base pages and display chatbot answers, but no hosted article portal with public categories, article publishing, or article feedback was established in the help docs or pricing.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Autonomous customer-facing answers based on configured sources; Advanced and Enterprise add agentic workflows that can reason and execute tasks. Botsonic also markets internal employee assistance.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and limits
facts.value: Files (PDF, DOC, DOCX, TXT), public webpages/sitemaps, FAQs, Notion, and Google Docs/Sheets links are documented. Plan limits are 10M, 50M, and 100M uploaded characters for Starter, Professional, and Advanced; sitemap limits are 5,000 URLs on Starter/Professional and no limit on Advanced.

facts.label: Refresh and citations
facts.value: Advanced includes auto-sync. The help guide offers 1-, 2-, or 4-week sync intervals for website links. Bot/source references can be shown in chatbot answers through a setting.

facts.label: Approval of knowledge changes
facts.value: Knowledge sources can be edited, paused, or deleted; a global source-visibility setting controls whether sources are shown. Public docs do not establish a required human approval stage before trained-source changes go live.

facts.label: Human fallback routes
facts.value: Customers can be directed to a support email, request a callback on Professional, submit Freshdesk/Zendesk tickets, or use Zendesk live-agent handoff. Enterprise lists Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Salesforce handoff.

facts.label: Transcript and after-hours handling
facts.value: Zendesk live-agent replies are posted back into the chatbot interface; Freshdesk creates a ticket after collecting a name/email. Out-of-hours behavior and handoff transcript contents for all integrations were not specified in the checked guides.

facts.value: Zapier integration requires top-tier Unlimited; REST/JavaScript API available on paid plans for custom integrations.

facts.label: Other relevant stack links
facts.value: Native Stripe, Slack, Discord, Linear and GitHub connectors, and a separate WooCommerce order-data integration, were not established.

facts.label: REST and widget APIs
facts.value: Pro/Unlimited REST and JavaScript APIs; public REST docs v1.2 describe operator, visitor, chat and message access. API bearer token from Settings → API.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: REST documentation supports create/list/update/delete webhook subscriptions for visitor, chat and message events.

facts.label: Native mobile SDK
facts.value: Current mobile-install guide says no iOS/Android SDK yet; future SDK is described as an intention.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched hosted backend. Website plugins/code and operator apps connect to Chaport.

facts.label: Widget locales
facts.value: Language page claims 38 widget languages, but its current list has 39 entries, including separate Simplified/Traditional Chinese and Welsh.

facts.label: Agent interface and switching
facts.value: Operator app listed in English, German, Russian and Spanish. Widget automatically follows visitor language; fixed/site-specific override uses paid JavaScript API.

facts.label: Operator platforms
facts.value: Web, Windows, macOS, iOS and Android operator apps; pricing includes apps on all plans.

facts.label: Website dependencies
facts.value: Works through website JavaScript or optional CMS integration; no required Gmail/WordPress/Shopify platform for ordinary website chat. Native customer mobile SDK not currently documented as available.

facts.label: Human reports
facts.value: Free basic total served/missed chats for last 30 days; Pro adds per-operator and proactive reports plus Google Analytics; Unlimited advanced reports and on-demand exports.

facts.label: Response and bot definitions
facts.value: Response report: average first response, average all-message response, average time to close. Bot report: welcome messages sent, engaged chats and scenario completions.

facts.label: Individual chat export
facts.value: In-app JSON export includes chat and associated visitor information; pricing includes export/deletion on every plan.

facts.label: Account export
facts.value: Email request from the registered account address for all account personal data, including chats and visitor information; specify CSV or JSON.

facts.label: API messages and ratings
facts.value: Paid API retrieves visitor/chat records and chat events; transcript=true returns message events; chat schema includes numeric visitor rating.

facts.label: Articles, files and export completeness
facts.value: Bulk FAQ/article export, complete binary-attachment archive, rating comments and exact backup/data-return window not established.

facts.label: Report exports
facts.value: Unlimited on-demand reports available by request in CSV, JSON or XLS.

facts.label: Hosting and subprocessors
facts.value: Exact customer-data hosting country/cloud provider, selectable region and a named service-subprocessor list not established.

facts.label: Processing agreement
facts.value: GDPR page says a Data Processing Addendum is available by email request; no public complete DPA text established.

facts.label: AI/data-use commitment
facts.value: No specific customer-content AI-training prohibition, model-provider list or AI-provider retention setting established.

facts.label: Chat retention
facts.value: Free 60 days; Pro/Unlimited unlimited correspondence history.

facts.label: Configurable auto-deletion
facts.value: Paid accounts can ask support to auto-delete chats after a chosen number of inactive days. Chat/message deletion can also be restricted through support-activated settings.

facts.label: Account deletion
facts.value: Owner can permanently delete account and entire correspondence history via profile settings; process is irreversible. Account closing ends login access.

facts.label: Deletion deadlines and backups
facts.value: No exact service-data erasure/backup deadline or post-closure export-access period established. Privacy allows retention for legitimate business needs and isolated backups until deletion is possible.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Chaport; active customer messaging service with live chat, email/social integrations, rule-based chatbots and FAQ publishing.

facts.label: Product relationships
facts.value: Chatbots, knowledge base and FAQ bot are features of Chaport, principally on Unlimited; no separate rebranded product established.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Chaport Inc.; published address in Alhambra, California, USA. About page says founded in 2014 and 100% self-funded.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Service designated exclusively for business use; account registration requires age 13 or older. Complete permitted/excluded-country list not established.

facts.label: Editions and licensing
facts.value: Vendor-hosted service with web, desktop and mobile operator apps; website plugin/embed connects to Chaport. No buyer-run server edition or server-source licence established.

facts.label: Vendor help
facts.value: Public help center and vendor chat/email contact routes. Specific installation and hidden-settings guides invite support requests.

facts.label: Published support hours
facts.value: Support desk 1am to 8pm EDT, as stated by official support-hours guide.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Viber guide dated 2026-02-20; email feature announcement 2024-11-20; account export guide 2025-02-17. Proposed next review 2026-12-05.

apps.name: Chatbase
apps.line: AI support agents with a human help desk, chat, email, and voice.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, voice, messaging integrations
