apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found since January 2025.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Current pricing has no Free tier and terms explicitly say there is no free plan; workspace docs still describe free users and cancellation returning to Free.

facts.label: Current free quotas
facts.value: No reliable current free-plan seat, credit, storage or inactivity entitlement established.

facts.label: Trial and conversion
facts.value: 7 days for eligible direct customers; valid payment method required; one trial per customer/user/email. Converts to selected paid plan unless cancelled before expiry.

facts.label: Hobby price and allowances
facts.value: US$40/month paid monthly; US$32/month equivalent billed yearly. Includes 700 message credits/month, 200 test credits/month, 1 AI agent, 2 members, 5 Actions, 2 Procedures and 40 MB training content.

facts.label: Basic price and allowances
facts.value: US$150/month paid monthly; US$120/month equivalent billed yearly. Includes 4,000 message credits/month, 500 test credits/month, 1 AI agent, 3 members, 8 Actions, 4 Procedures and 40 MB training content.

facts.label: Business price and allowances
facts.value: US$500/month paid monthly; US$400/month equivalent billed yearly. Includes 15,000 message credits/month, 1,000 test credits/month, 1 AI agent, 5 members, 12 Actions, 6 Procedures and 40 MB training content.

facts.label: Enterprise and taxes
facts.value: Enterprise: custom quote, higher limits/flexible billing, custom roles, SSO, white-labeling, audit logs, priority support, success manager and SLAs. Fees exclude taxes.

facts.label: Charging units
facts.value: Base plan is per workspace; included member, AI-agent, training-size and Action/Procedure limits are distinct from model-request message credits.

facts.label: Human roles
facts.value: Owner/Member can manage resources; Support Associate can work in Helpdesk; Viewer has read-only access.

facts.label: Extra member slots
facts.value: Extra human-member slots exist, but no public unit price found in checked pricing or workspace billing docs.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and renewal
facts.value: Smallest published direct paid tier: one Hobby workspace with two included members. Monthly or annual cadence; recurring billing continues until cancelled.

facts.label: Unpublished minimum extras
facts.value: No general self-service setup fee, minimum seat purchase beyond plan capacity, or mandatory onboarding charge published in checked pricing/docs/terms.

facts.label: Definition of a message credit
facts.value: Each request to the AI model consumes its model multiplier. A visible response may require multiple requests when Actions run.

facts.label: 1-credit models
facts.value: 1 credit per model request: Auto, GPT-6 Luna, Claude 5.5 Haiku; additional 1-credit choices are listed in Build.

facts.label: 2-credit models
facts.value: 2 credits per model request: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.1 Terra, Claude 5.5 Sonnet and Gemini 3.8 Flash; Build lists other choices at this tier.

facts.label: 4- and 5-credit models
facts.value: GPT-5.5: 4 credits/request. Claude 5.5 Opus: 5 credits/request.

facts.label: Attachment processing charges
facts.value: Text-request credits plus image analysis per image and PDF analysis per page; Action execution may process the same attachments again.

facts.label: Voice charges
facts.value: Voice consumes 6 message credits/minute plus the chosen model credits for each AI response/request during the call.

facts.label: Drafts and test credits
facts.value: Every AI draft uses message credits. Tests use separate monthly test credits first, then message credits after confirmation when test credits are exhausted.

facts.label: External model bills and other AI helpers
facts.value: Listed hosted model requests are charged through Chatbase credits; no mandatory separate model-provider API-key bill published for normal hosted use. Separate credit rates for Backstage, AI Compose and translation not established.

facts.label: 100 / 500 request examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Hobby 100 requests fits included credits at 1/2/4/5 credits each; 500 requests needs 500/1,000/2,000/2,500 credits respectively.

facts.label: Reset and exhaustion
facts.value: Subscription credits renew at the start of each calendar month regardless of subscription date; unused subscription credits do not roll over. Agents stop replying when credits run out without available extra credits.

facts.label: Auto-recharge and add-ons
facts.value: Auto-recharge: US$40 per 1,000 non-expiring message credits when balance crosses a configured threshold. Extra AI agent: US$25/month. Extra training storage: US$25 per 10 MB/month.

facts.label: Cancellation outcome
facts.value: Docs say cancelling leaves access until period end then downgrades to Free; current terms say account remains without an active plan and cannot use the service until paid subscription resumes.

facts.label: Third-party channel bills
facts.value: Phone service needs an external Twilio account/number or SIP provider. WhatsApp docs direct extra billing to Meta and impose a 24-hour free-form reply window.

facts.label: Widget / iframe branding
facts.value: Remove Powered By Chatbase add-on: US$99/month; workspace docs explicitly cover widget and iframe.

facts.label: Email branding
facts.value: AI email and human Helpdesk email include a Powered by Chatbase footer removable with the white-label add-on.

facts.label: Custom domains / Help Page
facts.value: Enterprise-only custom-domain add-on covers embed script, iframe and agent link. Help Page also has a documented reverse-proxy route on your own site.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service paid plans and 7-day trial; Enterprise uses a demo/contact route. Hobby includes two workspace members, so a one-person workspace is within the listed capacity.

facts.label: Shopify buying route
facts.value: Optional Shopify Marketplace installation bills through Shopify, allows one AI agent and lacks the 7-day trial; direct Chatbase billing has a different add-on selection.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: customer-facing AI support agent, with native human Helpdesk, live chat, email, voice and messaging integrations; overlaps chatbots, help desks and ecommerce automation.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native Chat Bubble, inline iframe and Center Stage; Hobby includes website AI deployment; native human Helpdesk starts at Basic.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Web embed/iframe and native Swift iOS/macOS and Kotlin Android SDKs documented; mobile SDKs are beta/alpha.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native AI email replies and Helpdesk inboxes; authenticate a company domain with forwarding, DKIM and SPF.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Official Meta connection, Hobby+; can connect multiple numbers. Dedicated-number route and WhatsApp Business App coexistence route are distinct.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Official Instagram integration included from Hobby; supports AI replies and human takeover through Helpdesk where enabled.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Official Facebook Messenger integration included from Hobby; handoff action supports the channel.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: No native SMS channel or official SMS connector established in checked channel catalogue, pricing and Twilio guide.

facts.label: Voice / phone
facts.value: Voice and telephony included from Basic; Twilio or SIP for inbound phone calls. Basic has 10 concurrent calls; Business has 20.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Official paid Slack bot integration from Hobby; mention @chatbase in an installed channel to receive threaded answers.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No official native Discord customer channel or documented connector located.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Native create-ticket Action can collect a form in Chat Bubble/Help Page; subject/description always collected, custom required/optional fields supported.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Manual/automatic assignment, teams, statuses, internal notes, @mentions, saved-reply macros and customer attachments.

facts.label: Rules and working hours
facts.value: Triggers run on ticket create/update and can route work, set status, add notes and send emails/webhooks. Timezone-aware shifts and time off determine assignment eligibility.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: No explicit agent collision-warning behavior located in reviewed Helpdesk overview, scheduling/trigger docs and pricing matrix.

facts.label: Agents / websites / workspaces
facts.value: One AI agent included on each published self-service plan; extra agents US$25/month. Workspaces have separate agents, plan, members and billing.

facts.label: Separation and permissions
facts.value: Enterprise supports member access scoped to specific AI agents and custom roles; ordinary invitations default to entire workspace.

facts.label: Inboxes, brands and numbers
facts.value: Multiple Helpdesk email addresses and multiple WhatsApp numbers are documented; each imported Twilio number belongs to one AI agent at a time.

facts.label: Public help content
facts.value: Standalone hosted Help Page is an AI conversation experience with title, welcome text, logos, buttons and attachment/voice-to-text options.

facts.label: Article portal scope
facts.value: No native public article/category publishing system, article count entitlement, article translation workflow or article-helpfulness voting established.

facts.label: AI customer and staff roles
facts.value: Autonomous grounded customer replies, Action execution, Procedures and native voice; AI Draft Replies provide human-reviewed suggestions. Helpdesk AI Compose assists existing text.

facts.label: Backstage operations assistant
facts.value: Backstage manages the agent/configuration through natural language. Daily messages: Hobby 5, Basic 10, Business/Enterprise 100; rate limit 10 requests/60 seconds per user.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and size
facts.value: Files, websites/sitemaps, text snippets, Q&A, Notion and closed support tickets from Zendesk/Salesforce. Current self-service plans include 40 MB training content.

facts.label: Source update schedule
facts.value: Source additions/edits/deletions take effect within seconds, with sync status. Basic/Business/Enterprise include weekly auto-resync of websites, Notion and tickets; other plans use manual resync.

facts.label: Approval and grounded-answer controls
facts.value: Instructions can restrict answers to supplied knowledge; revise an answer to save a Q&A correction. Draft/publish/version controls stage instructions, Actions and channel settings.

facts.label: Customer source citations
facts.value: No universal citation toggle, supported citation format or guarantee that every answer cites its source established in checked Build, Data Sources, Channels and Best Practices docs.

facts.label: Native live handoff
facts.value: Chatbase Live Chat stops the AI and routes the existing conversation to Helpdesk; humans can reply, add notes and continue the thread.

facts.label: Asynchronous escalation and history
facts.value: Create-ticket Action targets Chatbase or connected help desks. Zendesk can receive full transcript/files or AI summary; other third-party platforms receive an AI-written summary.

facts.label: Out of hours
facts.value: Shift availability controls assignment; absent eligible staff, ticket waits unassigned unless routed to the next available shift.

facts.label: Actions and authenticated billing
facts.value: Custom Actions call external APIs, run client code or display Widgets. Stripe Actions retrieve invoices/subscriptions and change plans/billing information for an identified customer.

facts.label: Shopify order actions and approvals
facts.value: Shopify supports product/order/cart/account workflows. Official announcement documents exchange preparation followed by human approval in Chatbase Helpdesk.

facts.label: Shopify / Stripe
facts.value: Official Shopify integration included on Hobby+; Stripe is an advanced integration on Basic+. External merchant accounts/services required.

facts.label: Slack / email / automation
facts.value: Slack bot included from Hobby; company-domain email has native guides. Zapier included from Basic and authenticates with Chatbase API key plus an external Zapier account.

facts.label: Help-desk connections
facts.value: Basic+ advanced integrations include Zendesk, Freshdesk/Freshchat, Help Scout, Intercom, HubSpot, Zoho Desk, Salesforce, Gorgias and Odoo.

facts.label: Other relevant stack links
facts.value: No official ready-made WooCommerce, Linear or GitHub support-data synchronization connector established in checked channel catalogue, pricing and integration docs.

facts.label: API and limits
facts.value: REST API v2 starts at Basic; Bearer API key; 1,000 requests per 10-second sliding window per key, with limit headers and 429/Retry-After.

facts.label: Webhooks and browser access
facts.value: JavaScript widget controls/events and iframe postMessage API; webhooks for leads, collected data/forms and phone call summaries. Helpdesk trigger webhooks also documented.

facts.label: Mobile developer libraries
facts.value: Swift SDK for iOS/macOS and Kotlin SDK for Android; native UI, streaming, identity and client tools.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: Not applicable: no self-hosted core edition supplied under the reviewed service terms.

facts.label: Widget localization
facts.value: Chat Bubble menu/buttons support multiple configured languages, RTL options and browser- or page-language detection; unconfigured detected language falls back to default.

facts.label: AI and staff translation
facts.value: Models can answer multilingual queries; Helpdesk translates incoming customer messages into a chosen team language. It does not automatically translate staff replies, internal notes or system events.

facts.label: Operator language list
facts.value: No complete dashboard language list or unified supported-language matrix found across pricing, channel localization, translation and model docs.

facts.label: Devices and dependencies
facts.value: Hosted browser dashboard and web widget/iframe; WordPress/Shopify installation optional. iOS/macOS and Android SDKs target customer apps; Android requires API 24+, Java 11 and Kotlin Coroutines.

facts.label: Native operator apps
facts.value: No native operator desktop/iOS/Android Helpdesk app or complete supported-browser matrix established in checked docs.

facts.label: Analytics and definitions
facts.value: Basic analytics from Hobby; advanced analytics from Business. Chats show volume/feedback and resolution rate; topics, sentiment and Helpdesk reporting are documented.

facts.label: Reporting exports and human metrics
facts.value: Topic export CSV includes topic/subtopic and conversation counts. Ticket CSV includes first human response seconds, resolution seconds, reply counts and survey score.

facts.label: Conversation history out
facts.value: Dashboard conversation export: JSON, PDF or CSV. API v2 export includes full message history from all sources, with cursor pagination up to 20 conversations/page.

facts.label: Helpdesk tickets out
facts.value: Ticket CSV has metadata, requester/assignee, timestamps, response metrics, custom fields and survey score; it explicitly omits message text.

facts.label: Knowledge out
facts.value: Files export extracted TXT, not originals; snippets export MD; Q&A exports XLSX. Website, Notion and ticket-source export explicitly unavailable.

facts.label: Leads and collected data out
facts.value: Leads and collected-data submissions export CSV or PDF, with date filtering.

facts.label: Contacts, binaries and ratings
facts.value: No complete documented contact-export schema or guaranteed bundle of attachment binaries/feedback in every export format established.

facts.label: Storage and processing regions
facts.value: Privacy notice says personal data is processed/stored in the US; infrastructure uses AWS us-east-1, with Supabase and Vercel named.

facts.label: Model choice and training
facts.value: Privacy/pricing say customer data is not used to train AI models. Build says Mistral main inference runs in the EU, while other response steps can occur outside the EU.

facts.label: Subprocessor roster access
facts.value: Public policy links a subprocessor page, but the fetched page exposed only the Trust Center shell, not a readable complete roster.

facts.label: Deletion and backups
facts.value: Privacy notice promises deletion/return of processor-held customer data including backups within 30 days; DPA allows production deletion within 30 days plus a further 28 days for encrypted backups.

facts.label: Subscription end and inactivity
facts.value: Terms say ended paid/trial accounts have no active plan; absent deletion request, submissions/info may be retained to resume payment and may be deleted after more than one year inactive.

facts.label: Self-service deletion
facts.value: Workspace deletion deletes its agents; agent settings can delete an agent or all conversations irreversibly.

facts.label: History and export window
facts.value: No complete plan-by-plan conversation-history duration or guaranteed export grace period found.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Chatbase; active hosted AI support platform at chatbase.co, with Chatbase Helpdesk and Backstage included as product features.

facts.label: Current and older plan names
facts.value: Live pricing now lists Hobby, Basic, Business and Enterprise. Older indexed pricing/announcements use Standard and Pro.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Chatbase Inc.; headquartered in San Francisco, California, United States.

facts.label: Market restrictions
facts.value: No complete country eligibility list or regional self-service price schedule found in checked pricing, terms and privacy notice.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted cloud service; customers do not receive the underlying service software or source code.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public docs and support contact prompts; Enterprise lists priority support, success manager and SLAs. Billing questions can use billing@chatbase.co under terms.

facts.label: Support hours and SLA terms
facts.value: No public staffed-hour schedule or numerical response/uptime commitment for self-service tiers found. Enterprise SLA details require its order/quote.

facts.label: Freshness and next check
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; latest listed changelog entry 2026-10-30 adds drafts/version history; 2026-10-27 adds GPT-6.1 Terra. Proposed next review 2026-12-05 or sooner after pricing/model/policy changes.

facts.value: Essential 10 resolutions/month or 120/year; Growth 200/month or 2,400/year. Extra package: 50 resolutions for USD 49.50, equivalent to USD 0.99 each when fully used.

facts.label: Current billable outcome definition
facts.value: Counts when AI directly solves at least one question, completes a requested ticket creation, or successfully completes a Custom Skill fulfilling the request. Test/spam, irrelevant/incomplete replies, unsuccessful skills, and unanswered human-transfer chats do not count.

facts.label: Agent-side AI
facts.value: Essential: 5 reply suggestions and 5 AI text edits monthly per user. Growth: 50 suggestions and 100 edits monthly per user. Chat/ticket summaries, topics and tag suggestions start on Growth.

facts.label: Previous AI pricing

facts.label: Model choices and external AI bills
facts.value: Exact current selectable model list, model-specific price multipliers, bring-your-own-model-key billing and paid Copilot overage prices were not established.

facts.label: Current 100 / 500 AI-unit examples
facts.value: Our calculation, monthly plans: one user Essential USD 124 / 520; Growth USD 99 / 396. Three users Essential USD 174 / 570; Growth USD 297 / 594.

facts.label: Previous 100 / 500 AI-chat examples

facts.label: Current limit stopping conflict
facts.value: Subscription guide says AI stops new chats until capacity is added; the same guide's FAQ and contract say extra packages are added automatically.

facts.value: Unused resolutions do not carry to the next cycle; capacity resets and extra packages recur. Package reductions, fewer users, cheaper plans, and annual-to-monthly changes apply at renewal. Upgrades apply immediately and cancel pending downgrade schedules.

facts.label: Current cancellation and refunds
facts.value: Contact support chat or support@text.com to cancel; terms provide recurring renewal and a no-refund policy for unused periods.

facts.value: Valid chats above the package cost USD 0.05 each. Previous-product cancellation requires support chat or support@chatbot.com; subscription guide says access continues to cycle end. Upgrades are immediate with a remaining-period difference charge.

facts.label: Channel and developer extras

facts.label: Current widget branding

facts.label: Email/help-center branding and trial
facts.value: Exact vendor-attribution removal rules for current outgoing email, any separate public help-center surface, and trial white-label behavior were not established.

facts.label: Previous-product new-buyer eligibility
facts.value: Whether a new customer can still open a separate previous-product ChatBot subscription on the published legacy plans is not established.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: customer-facing AI support and sales automation. Current route is an integrated support platform; previous product is a chatbot builder connected to external human-support tools.

facts.label: Website and in-app chat

facts.label: Current email and ticket forms

facts.label: Current core inbox workflow
facts.value: All current plans: smart/manual assignment, transfers, internal notes, private canned replies, role permissions, ticket statuses/priorities, canned ticket replies and file sharing.

facts.label: Current Growth workflow
facts.value: Growth adds shared canned replies, chat supervision/team takeover, routing rules, working hours, ten teams, ten ticketing rules and 1,000 workflow executions.

facts.label: Previous workflow boundary
facts.value: Previous collaboration roles are Owner, Administrator and Editor for designing bots, subscription control and reviewing data. Human reply workflow comes from connected support products.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: A specific current warning against simultaneous human replies and its plan gate were not established.

facts.label: Current sites and brands
facts.value: Multiple websites are supported on all current plans; individual widgets have their own setup/code and connection status. Essential/Growth have 1/10 teams and 1/10 forwarding addresses.

facts.label: Previous bots and sites
facts.value: Previous plans allow multiple websites. Active bot limits: Starter 1, Team 5, Business unlimited; a bot is active when connected to a channel.

facts.label: Help-center boundary
facts.value: Current Knowledge sources and Articles feed AI, while the pricing “Self-service help center” row refers to vendor support documentation. An included customer-facing article publishing/search site, its custom domain and article limit were not established.

facts.label: Current AI role
facts.value: Autonomous customer answers, lead/contact collection, human transfer, ticket creation/update, discount sharing and configured Skills. Copilot, reply suggestions, text edits and higher-plan summaries assist humans separately.

facts.label: Previous AI role
facts.value: Visual conversation flows with rules/actions plus AI Assist answers drawn from a bot's AI Knowledge. The in-house AI Assist model can answer without a predicted exact user phrase.

facts.label: Current knowledge sources and size
facts.value: Public websites/single or nested pages, files and authored articles. AI Agent file types: PDF up to 200 pages, DOCX, PPTX, TXT, CSV, TSV and MD; 50 MB maximum per file.

facts.label: Current refresh and review
facts.value: Website auto-update can be configured from 5 to 365 days. Articles update in app. Knowledge Gaps lets a person answer recurring unanswered questions and choose Save and train, or Skip.

facts.label: Previous knowledge sources
facts.value: Previous AI Knowledge supports websites, authored text articles, KnowledgeBase help centers and Zendesk help centers; up to 5,000 knowledge sources.

facts.label: Citations and remaining limits
facts.value: Guaranteed customer-visible source citations, complete AI Agent source/page totals, and an exact previous-product automatic rescan schedule were not established.

facts.label: Current human fallback
facts.value: AI can transfer automatically to an available teammate or a specific team when it cannot answer or the visitor asks for a human. If none is available within 30 seconds, enabled fallback can create a ticket.

facts.label: Previous human fallback
facts.value: Transfer chat action requires active LiveChat integration, an accepting available human and automatic assignment. Success ends bot interaction; Failure can show an unavailable message or follow another flow/ticket integration.

facts.label: Current configured actions
facts.value: Default Skills collect details, create/update tickets, transfer chats, and share predefined discount codes. Playbook builds workspace-event Skills and conversational AI Agent Skills, with up to ten AI Agent Skills per Agent.

facts.label: Previous Shopify order lookup
facts.value: Show order status checks an order using the order ID and postal code collected in the chat, then can show statuses/tracking links or a failure path.

facts.label: Previous custom backend actions
facts.value: Webhooks can query a backend and return bot responses/attributes; vendor examples include existing-customer checks, account details and account activation.

facts.label: Current identity and high-impact actions
facts.value: A universal customer-identity verification protocol, mandatory approval step for refunds/account changes, and a confirmed built-in payment-refund action were not established.

facts.label: Current ecommerce/site connections
facts.value: Current guides support Shopify through Text and WooCommerce through the free AI Chatbot by Text WordPress integration, passing logged-in customer, cart and completed-order context. HTML/GTM/framework and WordPress/Webflow install routes are documented.

facts.label: Previous automation/help-desk connections
facts.value: Previous ChatBot lists Zapier, Slack, Messenger, HelpDesk.com, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Shopify and website integrations. Gmail is documented through Zapier.

facts.label: Current workflow connections
facts.value: Playbook supports triggers/actions for Text and third-party services, with Salesforce and Klaviyo named; a documented example posts a support summary to Slack.

facts.label: Other requested connections
facts.value: Exact current native Stripe, Linear, GitHub and Discord integrations, and their plan gates, were not established.

facts.label: Current API allowance conflict
facts.value: Main pricing comparison: Essential 10,000 API calls/month; Growth 20,000; Enterprise custom. Same page's FAQ: Essential starts at 20,000 and Enterprise 1,000,000+.

facts.label: Current MCP and developer docs
facts.value: Text MCP is included in the current offer; external assistants can retrieve archived chat transcripts and tags with the connected user's permissions. MCP server: https://mcp.text.com/ . The product links Text Platform developer documentation.

facts.label: Previous API and widget controls
facts.value: REST JSON API under api.chatbot.com, private Bearer developer token; webhooks; OpenWidget JavaScript API for widget controls and callbacks. Legacy pricing lists these tools across Starter/Team/Business.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable: no self-hosted server or plugin application edition established.

facts.label: Current customer languages
facts.value: Current AI Agent detects/responds in 48 languages according to pricing; settings allow all, one or multiple permitted languages. Widget translations and right-to-left support are listed; multilingual agent groups start on Growth.

facts.label: Agent interface and previous languages
facts.value: Complete current staff-interface locale list and an exact previous AI Assist/widget language list were not established.

facts.label: Current devices and installation
facts.value: Current staff interface: browser, plus macOS and Windows desktop apps listed in pricing. Customer widget installs through HTML, GTM, React, Vue or Angular, with WordPress/Shopify/Webflow paths.

facts.label: Previous platform needs
facts.value: Previous ChatBot uses its web dashboard and JavaScript customer widget, with LiveChat, Slack, Messenger and website-platform connections. Bots created after September 30, 2024 should use its newer widget generation according to the legacy-widget guide.

facts.label: Current reporting
facts.value: Current plans list chat/ticket metrics, breakdowns, visitor funnel and AI Agent sales; Growth adds agent activity/performance and chat-topic reporting. Enterprise has on-demand reporting.

facts.label: Previous reporting and review
facts.value: Previous Starter has chats/paid chats/messages/average messages/users. Team/Business/Enterprise add all legacy reports, including interaction popularity and busiest periods. Reports export CSV.

facts.label: Current transcript retrieval
facts.value: Current pricing lists visitor transcript download and email; Text MCP guide documents retrieving a full archived chat transcript subject to account permissions.

facts.label: Current report export
facts.value: Current Text raw-data exports include chat/ticket IDs, customer details, ratings, agents, timestamps and metrics. Chat export is limited to 100,000 records per part; report overview gives per-export ranges of two years for chats and six months for tickets.

facts.label: Previous visitor and report export
facts.value: Owner/Admin can email-export visitors/leads from the dashboard; previous Users API streams CSV user rows. Bot performance reports export as CSV.

facts.label: Previous conversation export
facts.value: Previous Archives API lists chats in pages of 40 and returns an individual chat as JSON, including message/response structures and attributes.

facts.label: Complete migration package
facts.value: A full self-service export of current customer profiles, AI articles/source originals, file attachments as binaries, bot configurations and a restorable complete workspace was not established.

facts.label: Assisted export route
facts.value: DPA provides standard assistance for verified written access/export/deletion requests within 30 days where data are stored and Text is technically capable. Significant custom processing/nonstandard formats can cost extra, disclosed in advance.

facts.label: Previous hosting location
facts.value: Legacy pricing FAQ says ChatBot stores customer information in a data center near Dublin, Ireland.

facts.label: Current hosting and region choice
facts.value: Exact current Text/ChatBot Agent primary data region, region-selection options and complete AI-provider/model allocation were not established.

facts.label: Subprocessor list access
facts.value: Linked list redirects to https://trust.text.com/subprocessors, but readable contents could not be obtained. Direct public requests returned HTTP 403; web fetch returned no readable lines.

facts.label: Current AI data use
facts.value: Text's AI Practices FAQ says Client Inputs/Outputs are not used to train/improve general-purpose AI models or third-party training datasets; “training” means per-client configuration/customization, not shared-model training.

facts.label: Previous AI knowledge isolation
facts.value: Previous AI Assist says a bot's training sources are not used for the global model, bots do not share Knowledge/Training phrases, and duplicated bots do not copy those contents.

facts.label: Current history and storage
facts.value: Essential conversation/file history access: 60 days; storage 2 GB + 50 MB/user. Growth/Enterprise history: unlimited; Growth storage 15 GB + 100 MB/user; Enterprise custom.

facts.label: Previous deletion controls
facts.value: Previous Business/Enterprise can configure automatic deletion from Archives and Visitors after a chosen period. Other previous plans can remove data manually; visitor deletion is irreversible.

facts.label: Contract deletion and backups
facts.value: DPA provides qualified 30-day assistance for verified written requests; backup copies can remain after termination for stated legal/compliance/evidentiary purposes under security measures. Privacy permits restricted retention until backup cycles overwrite data.

facts.label: Trial/inactivity retention and export window
facts.value: Numeric post-trial or inactive-account deletion timers, and an unconditional post-cancellation export window, were not established for either experience.

facts.label: Current identity and state
facts.value: ChatBot.com now markets Text's AI Agent with inbox, live chat, and tickets. New signup targets the Text App.

facts.label: Previous product and alias
facts.value: Previous ChatBot Visual Builder and AI Assist remain available in instructions for existing users. Former name: BotEngine; official rename announcement published November 22, 2018, effective November 26.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Contracting company: Text, Inc., principal office in Boston, Massachusetts, United States.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Terms restrict use from or on behalf of US-sanctioned countries/regions and restricted parties; examples name Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia, and Belarus. Minimum user age 16, with applicable consent requirements.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Both experiences are vendor-hosted proprietary services with embedded widgets and subscription use rights. Public developer references do not license the full service for self-hosting.

facts.label: Current vendor support
facts.value: Current pricing lists support by website/app chat, 24/7/365, and a self-service help center on every plan. Enterprise adds product expert, onboarding, training, engineering/security help and SLAs.

facts.label: Previous vendor support
facts.value: Previous ChatBot docs provide support@chatbot.com and website chat for subscription changes, account deletion and troubleshooting.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle
facts.value: Current offer checked November 5, 2026; edition-aware build guide updated August 19; latest resolution billing guide dated November 4; company news index includes October 20, 2026 announcement. No completed acquisition or whole-product shutdown notice found.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: Ongoing Free plan is listed at $0/month, separate from the marketing pages' unspecified “free trial” claims.

facts.label: Free limits / project
facts.value: Free includes 1 AI agent, 1 seat, 500,000 knowledge-base characters, and 200 AI credits each month.

facts.label: Free limits / chats and actions
facts.value: Pricing shows unlimited chats, 2 actions per AI agent, 1 workflow per AI agent, 25 monthly email credits, and limited widget customization.

facts.label: Free limits / files and sync
facts.value: Free plan knowledge-base file upload limit is 1 MB per file; automatic source sync and voice input are not included in the Free comparison column.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Trial length, card requirement, and post-trial outcome are unclear.

facts.label: Paid plan / Starter monthly
facts.value: Starter: $25/month; 1,750 AI credits, 2 agents, 2 seats, and 10 million knowledge-base characters.

facts.label: Paid plan / Starter annual
facts.value: Starter annual: $250 billed annually; page also displays $21/month as the annual equivalent.

facts.label: Paid plan / Growth monthly
facts.value: Growth: $75/month; 6,000 AI credits, 5 agents, 5 seats, and 30 million knowledge-base characters.

facts.label: Paid plan / Growth annual
facts.value: Growth annual: $750 billed annually; page also displays $63/month as the annual equivalent.

facts.label: Paid plan / Scale monthly
facts.value: Scale: $295/month; 35,000 AI credits, 7 agents, 10 seats, and 100 million knowledge-base characters.

facts.label: Paid plan / Scale annual
facts.value: Scale annual: $2,950 billed annually; page also displays $246/month as the annual equivalent.

facts.label: Currency code
facts.value: Pricing displays $ but does not name USD, CAD, or another ISO currency code.

facts.label: Taxes
facts.value: Listed plan and add-on prices exclude taxes, levies, and duties; buyer is responsible for them.

facts.label: Billing unit / subscription
facts.value: Subscription is shown per project or workspace, with plan quotas for seats, agents, characters, and monthly usage. Monthly and annual billing are offered.

facts.label: Billing unit / AI
facts.value: One AI-generated response consumes credits according to the selected model; ordinary non-AI chatbot messages do not consume AI credits.

facts.label: Billing unit / other quotas
facts.value: Seats, agents, knowledge-base characters, email recipients, voice-input minutes, and resync characters have separate allowances or add-on units.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and setup
facts.value: No setup fee, contract minimum, or paid-plan seat minimum is stated; paid plans include 2 or more seats.

facts.label: Mandatory add-ons
facts.value: No add-on is marked mandatory for a listed self-service plan. Extra seats, agents, credits, characters, custom domains, and branding removal are optional line items.

facts.label: AI charges / model range
facts.value: Current pricing lists 0.5 to 25 credits per AI response, depending on model. For example, GPT-6 Luna is 1 credit, GPT-6 Astra 25, Gemini 2.5 Flash 0.5, and GPT-6 Sol 5.

facts.label: AI charges / model choice
facts.value: Starter and higher list advanced models from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, xAI, DeepSeek, and Z.ai; plan comparison lists base models separately.

facts.label: AI charges / rate conflict
facts.value: Pricing and AI-credit documentation disagree on several model rates: the pricing page says Claude Opus 5.5 uses 14 credits while docs say 10; GPT-5.6 Terra 5 vs 10; GPT-5.6 Luna 2 vs 5; GPT 5.4 8 vs 4.

facts.label: AI provider charges
facts.value: A separate customer-facing model-provider invoice or BYOK rate is not published; model use is charged through Chatling credits.

facts.label: AI cost example / 100 replies
facts.value: Our calculation: 100 GPT-6 Luna AI replies use 100 credits; this fits Free's 200-credit monthly allowance, so the subscription total is $0/month.

facts.label: AI cost example / 500 replies
facts.value: Our calculation: 500 GPT-6 Luna replies use 500 credits; Starter at $25/month includes 1,750, leaving 1,250 credits for other AI replies.

facts.label: AI cost example / premium model
facts.value: Our calculation: 100 GPT-6 Astra replies use 2,500 credits. Starter's 1,750 leave a 750-credit shortfall; one 1,000-credit add-on raises the monthly total to $35/month, with 250 credits unused.

facts.label: AI usage reset and stop
facts.value: AI, email, voice, and resync usage reset monthly. When AI credits run out, the bot still accepts messages but displays “Insufficient AI credits” instead of an AI answer.

facts.label: Extra credits and other add-ons
facts.value: Extra AI credits cost $10/month per 1,000; extra knowledge characters $2/month per 1,000,000; agent $3/month; seat $10/month; remove branding $35/month; custom domain $10/month.

facts.label: Automatic recharge and expiry
facts.value: Automatic recharge, purchased-credit rollover, expiry, and an account inactivity deletion policy were not found.

facts.label: Channel provider charges
facts.value: Any third-party WhatsApp or messaging-provider usage charge is not quantified in Chatling pricing or channel setup docs.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: “Powered by Chatling” removal is an add-on at $35/month and is included in Scale.

facts.label: Custom domain
facts.value: Custom domain is listed at $10/month per domain; pricing describes it for widget and chatbot sharing links.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service signup is offered with an ongoing Free plan and paid plan checkout links. A solo account is feasible within the one-seat Free limit.

facts.label: Minimum age / account eligibility
facts.value: Terms say a user must be 13 or older; the Privacy Policy says users must be 18 or have a parent or guardian's consent.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: AI chatbot and agent for answering customer questions on websites and messaging channels, with a human live-chat inbox for handoff. It overlaps customer messaging and help-desk tools; its knowledge base is training content, not a public article help center.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native website widget supports floating, inline, and fullscreen deployment; live chat provides agent takeover.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native WhatsApp integration for AI Agents and AI Chatbots.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native Instagram Direct Messages integration for AI Agents.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Pricing page lists Messenger as a channel; current public docs index has no Messenger setup guide.

facts.label: Telegram
facts.value: Pricing and integration pages list Telegram as a channel.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Website widget can be embedded in a web app, but a separate customer mobile SDK or native in-app SDK is not documented.

facts.label: Email inbox
facts.value: Native inbound email support or email-to-ticket channel is not published.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Native SMS support channel is not published.

facts.label: Voice / phone
facts.value: Phone-call support channel is not published. Voice input is speech-to-text in chat, not a phone system.

facts.label: Slack and Discord
facts.value: Slack is listed as a business integration; no customer-support channel for Slack or Discord is published.

facts.label: Inbox workflow
facts.value: Human team can take over a conversation, assign priority, add internal notes, see teammate presence, use saved views, and send canned responses.

facts.label: Assignment and availability
facts.value: Teams, office hours, reply-time expectations, notifications, and human routing are documented. Growth adds round-robin routing; the pricing page does not expose all feature gates in a text-readable plan matrix.

facts.label: Rules and collision alerts
facts.value: Workflows can trigger on conversation or contact events; teammate-presence docs show who is viewing or typing. A separate collision warning that prevents duplicate replies was not established.

facts.label: Agents, sites, and brands
facts.value: Included agents/chatbots per project: Free 1, Starter 2, Growth 5, Scale 7. Extra agent is $3/month.

facts.label: Website/domain count
facts.value: No fixed number of allowed websites per project or a per-website price is stated; custom domains are separately priced per domain.

facts.label: Help center and articles
facts.value: No public article help center, custom help-center domain, or customer-facing article CMS is documented. The knowledge base stores source material for AI answers.

facts.label: Knowledge-base size
facts.value: Project character allowances are 500,000 Free, 10 million Starter, 30 million Growth, and 100 million Scale; extra characters cost $2/month per 1,000,000.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: AI Agent answers customers autonomously using configured knowledge and actions; human Copilot can draft replies, summarize chats, and search the knowledge base.

facts.label: AI feature tier
facts.value: Exact first plan for Copilot, transcript export, and some other comparison-table features is unclear from the public page text.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Knowledge base accepts websites and webpages, documents/files, text, and FAQs. Answers are generated from selected sources; wrong answers can be corrected by adding a fine-tuned FAQ answer.

facts.label: Sync and source capacity
facts.value: Starter includes weekly auto-sync; Growth and Scale include daily sync. Free does not include automatic sync in the pricing matrix. Per-plan total characters are listed under F21.

facts.label: Citations and approval
facts.value: Web widget can show source links for AI answers. No blanket approval queue before every autonomous answer is documented.

facts.label: File and source limits
facts.value: Pricing states a 1 MB per-file upload limit for Free; larger-plan per-file limits and a total source-count cap were not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: AI can hand a chat to a human; the conversation stays in the Chatling inbox with an AI summary, priority, notes, notifications, and routing options.

facts.label: Hours and offline replies
facts.value: Team availability and expected reply time can be set. A changelog says offline web-chat customers can receive an agent's email reply if they provided an email. Human support hours or response guarantees are not published.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Documented actions can collect leads, send email, make HTTP requests, book calendar appointments, edit Google Sheets, update HubSpot, or create Zendesk tickets/users.

facts.label: Identity checks and approvals
facts.value: Authentication of the customer before a sensitive action, refund approvals, and a universal action-approval queue were not established.

facts.label: Support and productivity integrations
facts.value: Official integration list includes Zapier, Google Sheets, HubSpot, Zendesk, Slack, Airtable, Zoho, and Cal.com.

facts.label: Website platforms
facts.value: Installation guides cover custom websites, WordPress, Google Tag Manager, Shopify, Squarespace, Wix, Webflow, Bubble, and PrestaShop.

facts.label: Other support stack links
facts.value: Zendesk action can create tickets and users; HubSpot action can find, create, and update CRM records; Slack is listed as an integration.

facts.label: API and web widget SDK
facts.value: Public v2 REST API supports chatbot, contact, conversation, message, knowledge-source, and usage endpoints; web widget SDK exposes configuration through window.chtlConfig.

facts.label: API limits
facts.value: API documentation states 300 requests per minute for each API key; excess returns HTTP 429.

facts.label: Webhooks and native SDKs
facts.value: Public signed webhooks and iOS/Android SDKs were not found in the pricing page or documentation index.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the documented vendor-hosted SaaS offer; no self-hosted package, deployment guide, or public source licence found.

facts.label: AI answer languages
facts.value: Pricing FAQ claims AI can understand and respond in more than 80 languages; API documentation exposes a supported-language endpoint.

facts.label: Widget interface languages
facts.value: Widget SDK lists locale codes including English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Hindi, Arabic, Portuguese, Chinese, and others.

facts.label: Agent dashboard language
facts.value: A complete list of agent dashboard interface languages was not found in pricing or the docs index.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Agent dashboard is a hosted web application; customer widget installs on a custom website or supported CMS.

facts.label: Native agent apps
facts.value: Native desktop and iOS/Android agent apps were not listed in pricing, integrations, or the docs index.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Starter lists basic analytics; Growth adds advanced analytics, including topics and sentiment. Changelog dates these analytics releases in November 2026.

facts.label: Conversation export by API
facts.value: API documents listing conversations, retrieving a conversation, and listing its messages, including message text and role. Pagination uses a cursor.

facts.label: Contact and knowledge export
facts.value: API docs include contact retrieval/listing and knowledge-base source listing.

facts.label: Built-in export and attachments
facts.value: Pricing lists an “Export data” feature, but its format, object coverage, plan gate, and attachment export behavior were not clear from the public comparison text.

facts.label: Account and bot deletion
facts.value: Account deletion is permanent and cancels owned subscriptions; deleting an agent/chatbot removes its contacts, conversations, and knowledge base.

facts.label: Data location
facts.value: Privacy Policy says servers are in the EU; EU data page lists DigitalOcean in the Netherlands and Pinecone in Ireland. The DPA says transfer to the United States is necessary to provide the service.

facts.label: Subprocessors and AI regions
facts.value: Published list names EU and US infrastructure, email, backup, payment, analytics and AI processors; AI provider locations include US and EU.

facts.label: AI training and internal use
facts.value: Terms say inputs, outputs, and sources are not used by the named OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google model providers to train models. Privacy allows internal research and technical development; terms do not make the same training promise for every newly listed model provider.

facts.label: Retention while account is open
facts.value: Privacy Policy says personal information is kept while needed and not longer than the user account, subject to legal retention and backup exceptions.

facts.label: Custom retention
facts.value: November 5 changelog says Scale users can set a number of days for conversations, messages, attachments, analysis, contacts, and exports to be deleted automatically.

facts.label: Cancellation and account deletion
facts.value: Terms say content is scheduled for deletion “shortly” after subscription end; exact days are not stated. Account deletion guide says access ends immediately and associated projects/data are permanently deleted.

facts.label: Uploaded document retention
facts.value: Pricing FAQ says uploaded documents are deleted once processed; terms say failed/unprocessed uploads are deleted within seven days.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Chatling; active hosted AI support product operated by Envision Labs Inc.

facts.label: Identity / lifecycle
facts.value: No shutdown, sunset, or completed acquisition notice found in the product changelog/blog or the operator's company site.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Envision Labs Inc., a corporation based in Vaughan, Ontario, Canada; Chatling is its trading name.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: No country eligibility or purchase restriction list found.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary SaaS documented for browser dashboard, website widget, and messaging integrations. No public self-hosted edition or source licence found.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Terms say Chatling support is via email in English. They promise no support level unless a separate contract or SLA states one.

facts.label: Vendor support hours
facts.value: Support hours and a public SLA response time are not published.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle
facts.value: Latest checked product release is custom retention dated November 5, 2026; blog page lists new articles through November 4, 2026. Company site currently lists Chatling.
