facts.value: Free is capped at five chats/month, but the exact counted event, reset day, warning behavior, and handling of the sixth chat were not established.

facts.label: Cancellation and refunds
facts.value: Cancel renewal in Billing; full account cancellation can be requested by email. Terms generally exclude partial-period/unused-time refunds, with stated exceptions for uncured material breach and certain suspensions/discontinuance.

facts.label: External dependencies
facts.value: Median screen sharing requires paid accounts in both products. Zapier/Help Scout integrations depend on external accounts; the outside subscription bill is not established here.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: A supported vendor-badge removal setting, first eligible plan, and extra removal fee were not found.

facts.label: Email branding
facts.value: Removal of Chatra branding from native support-email replies and transcript emails, including plan/fee, was not established.

facts.label: Buying access and solo fit
facts.value: Public self-service signup on the main site and plan page; form action points to https://app.chatra.io/ . Free explicitly allows one agent; paid plans are per agent.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website chat and asynchronous messaging with a shared email/social inbox and scripted FAQ/lead-capture bots.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native online/offline website widget on all plans; Free five chats/month, paid monthly chats unlimited.

facts.label: In-app web chat
facts.value: Website/web-app widget, frame mode, and optional @chatra/chatra npm wrapper for React/Angular/Vue and other web frameworks.

facts.label: Email inbox
facts.value: Essential/Pro native email helpdesk: create a mailbox, obtain a forwarding address, and forward the business support email to it; answer in Chatra.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Essential/Pro connected Messenger channel, excluded on Free in current comparison.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Essential/Pro connected Instagram DMs; requires an Instagram business/professional account connected to a Facebook business Page and appropriate permissions.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: A Chatra customer WhatsApp inbox channel was not established.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: A native Chatra SMS inbox/phone-number offer was not established.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: A native voice-call or telephone-support channel was not established.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Pro integration sends incoming-chat notifications and transcripts into chosen Slack channels.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: A named customer Discord inbox channel was not established.

facts.label: Contact and ticket forms
facts.value: Paid configurable contact-form bot collects visitor details and can require the form before receiving messages; standalone external ticket portal was not established.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: New chats enter the online agents' queue; replying takes ownership. If unanswered long enough, the conversation returns to the queue. Paid plans add private customer notes, saved replies, team chats, and group conversations.

facts.label: Rules, groups, and hours
facts.value: Essential/Pro include targeted messages/triggers; Pro adds agent groups and operating hours. Groups can route by code, triggers, manual assignment, or visitor choice.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: A dedicated simultaneous-reply warning or enforced reply lock was not established.

facts.label: Sites and stores
facts.value: All plans explicitly permit unlimited websites. Shopify guide allows connecting an additional store to the same Chatra account.

facts.label: Brand separation
facts.value: Pro groups can assign different agents to different websites; widget/group customization and routing have API controls.

facts.label: Tracked visitors
facts.value: On paid plans, real-time visitor list capacity is paid seats ×10 simultaneous visitors.

facts.label: Public help center
facts.value: No built-in Chatra article authoring/search/custom-domain help center, with article/translation/feedback limits, was established.

facts.label: Established automation role
facts.value: Fixed-choice FAQ scenarios and a contact/lead form bot, included on Essential/Pro. Owner writes messages and reply options; branches continue until completion or choosing an agent.

facts.label: Generative AI role
facts.value: No native Chatra generative answer agent, agent-drafting/summarizing model, or model-provider connection was established.

facts.label: AI knowledge
facts.value: Knowledge-grounded generative-AI source quotas, website/PDF ingestion, citations, and refresh schedules are not applicable to the established fixed-scenario bot.

facts.label: Bot-to-human handoff
facts.value: Leave the bot response blank for a visitor reply option: choosing it sends that selection into the chat and notifies agents so they can help.

facts.label: Offline fallback and history
facts.value: Offline/invisible mode accepts asynchronous messages. Agents can reply later; departing visitors can receive email replies if they supplied an address and see messages on returning.

facts.label: Customer context and outbound actions
facts.value: Shopify/WooCommerce integrations expose visitor cart information. REST API can send order-status/product-update messages to customers whose own accounts are bound to Chatra.

facts.label: Identity limits
facts.value: Docs warn client-supplied JavaScript data can be changed and is not reliable identity proof. Account binding uses a unique secret random clientId; public user ID/email must not be used as that secret.

facts.label: Shopify and WooCommerce
facts.value: Official installation routes for both. Shopify supports app installation or manual setup; WooCommerce uses a plugin plus the Chatra widget code.

facts.label: WordPress
facts.value: Official plugin installation; paste the account's widget code into plugin settings.

facts.label: Slack and Help Scout
facts.value: Pro: Slack notifications/transcripts; Help Scout auto-delivers transcripts/offline messages and customer context as conversations/notes in its mailbox.

facts.label: Zapier and Median
facts.value: Pro includes Zapier connection; Median screen sharing is marked on Essential/Pro and requires both products' paid accounts.

facts.label: Stripe, Linear, GitHub, Discord
facts.value: Named current native connections for these workflows were not found in the checked plan/integration/developer guides.

facts.label: JavaScript and libraries
facts.value: JS API on all plans; optional @chatra/chatra npm module supports website/web-app frameworks. Account binding/integration with existing users is Essential/Pro.

facts.label: REST and webhooks
facts.value: Pro REST endpoints send/get/edit/delete messages and get/update known visitors. Outgoing JSON webhooks include chatStarted, chatFragment, and chatTranscript.

facts.label: Rate limit
facts.value: REST requests limited to 60/minute/account; HTTP 429 and Retry-After communicate throttling.

facts.label: Running the service yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the hosted edition researched.

facts.label: Widget languages
facts.value: API documents eight language codes: en, de, fr, es, nl, pt, it, ru. locale/setLocale can replace strings, including translating an unsupported language.

facts.label: Agent/app language evidence
facts.value: Chatra's vendor listing names English, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil), and Russian as app languages. A separate up-to-date per-client agent-dashboard locale table was not found.

facts.label: Agent devices
facts.value: Current app page offers browser dashboard plus iOS and Android apps; public links lead to the Apple and Google stores.

facts.label: Customer platform needs
facts.value: Generic website code and supported CMS/store plugins; no mandatory Shopify, WordPress, Gmail, or desktop operating system for the hosted browser/widget route.

facts.label: Reports and definitions
facts.value: Pro reports show completed conversations/visitors, satisfaction, and average first response, filterable by agents/groups/channels; CSV download is documented.

facts.label: Ratings and event analytics
facts.value: Pro chat ratings allow thumbs up/down and comments after an agent replies. All plans list Google Analytics; guide documents chat/bot/form/rating events and GA4 setup conditions.

facts.label: Visitor/contact CSV
facts.value: Pro Data export tooltip says visitor emails and other data export as CSV. Help guide allows a date range/selected fields and filtering for marketing consent.

facts.label: Conversations and events
facts.value: Emailed chat transcripts are available on all plans. Pro chatTranscript webhook sends completed-chat message text and metadata; REST retrieves a known message by ID.

facts.label: Visitor API record
facts.value: Pro GET clients/:id returns a known visitor's profile, contact/notes, custom form/integration data, group, chat link, and visit context.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: Pro message/webhook schema includes a file object with original name, byte size, URL, image flag, and image/preview information where relevant.

facts.label: Feedback, reports, and assistance
facts.value: Pro reports download as CSV, including conversation/satisfaction/response-time views. GDPR guide offers support-assisted end-user export in computer-readable form.

facts.label: Full-history exit gaps
facts.value: Bulk historical transcript download, all attachment binaries, complete per-rating comment export schema, and a transferable Chatra-to-Brevo history/settings migration were not established.

facts.label: Hosting and international processing
facts.value: Privacy policy describes processing/transfers to the United States or EU. DPA permits processing worldwide where Chatra, affiliates, or subprocessors operate.

facts.label: Published subprocessors
facts.value: Public list names AWS, Meteor, Hetzner, Cloudflare, Uploadcare, Sendgrid, Postmark, Google, Amplitude, Facebook, LinkedIn, Disqus, Durango merchant services, and Stripe with stated purposes.

facts.label: Processor change notices
facts.value: DPA offers opted-in processor-change notices at least ten days ahead, with a procedure for reasonable data-protection objections.

facts.label: AI training scope
facts.value: A model-provider list or explicit AI-training-use/opt-out policy was not found.

facts.label: Stored history
facts.value: GDPR guide says conversations and personal data are stored for up to six years unless the account is deleted. Plan table offers complete conversation history on all plans.

facts.label: Account-deletion deadlines
facts.value: GDPR guide says all data is disposed of within 60 days after account deletion. DPA says delete or return on termination, normally no later than 90 days, with legal retention exceptions.

facts.label: Deletion controls
facts.value: Guide permits searching/deleting end-user conversations inside Chatra and accessing/updating/removing agent personal data. Account deletion can be requested from support; archived copies may remain for lawful/legitimate purposes.

facts.label: Access after termination and inactivity
facts.value: Terms warn termination deactivates/deletes the account or access and forfeits content. A guaranteed post-termination self-service export window, fixed inactive-Free deletion timer, and backup-specific purge period were not found.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Chatra, independent hosted customer-messaging app; part of Brevo, formerly Sendinblue. Service and support continue, but new features are released in Brevo Conversations only.

facts.label: Migration boundary
facts.value: Brevo Conversations is a separate destination. Official notice says Chatra conversations and settings cannot currently be transferred to it.

facts.label: Contracting company and country
facts.value: Roger Wilco LLC, United States; public contact address is Wilmington, Delaware. Brevo is the parent relationship stated in the lifecycle notice.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: No complete country eligibility/block list or regional calling availability was found. Terms describe business customers and permit refusal of service.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary service with an embedded website widget, browser dashboard, mobile apps, and installation plugins.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Chatra support continues by email after acquisition. Contact page publishes Monday–Friday, 3am–4pm EST, also shown as 09:00–22:00 CET.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026; lifecycle notice says no new Chatra features. Public terms updated July 2, 2021; privacy April 7, 2022; processor list June 30, 2021. Our next review suggestion: December 5, 2026.

apps.name: Chatway
apps.line: Shared email and website chat inbox with team and AI tools.

cells.ai: $0.50 per resolved conversation

agents.math: The Business plan covers 100 conversations a month and includes two seats.
$39 Business plan + $19 for one extra seat a month. It covers three agents.

apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found since January 2025.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: Free Forever is an ongoing offer; native AI can be added on all plans, including Free, with separate credits/charges.

facts.label: Free people and conversations
facts.value: One seat total; 50 conversations/month. Manual, API, MCP and webhook-handled conversations share the plan allowance.

facts.label: Free history, contacts and sites
facts.value: Thirty-day chat-history access and contact visibility; unlimited contact storage claimed, but only most recent 30 days viewable. Install on unlimited websites.

facts.label: Free included tools
facts.value: API, webhooks, MCP, FAQs, canned responses, contact form, basic widget customization, transcripts, analytics and iOS/Android operator apps.

facts.label: Free paid-feature boundaries
facts.value: No included automations, help center, private notes, live translation, deep ecommerce data sync, multiple inboxes/widgets or team routing.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Fourteen days of Plus features; public signup promotes no credit card required.

facts.label: Trial expiry details
facts.value: Exact automatic post-trial downgrade behavior, excess-agent handling and retention of premium configuration not established.

facts.label: Business price
facts.value: $39/month monthly or $31/month billed yearly; two seats and 200 conversations/month.

facts.label: Plus price
facts.value: $199/month monthly or $159/month billed yearly; ten seats and 1,000 conversations/month.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Custom price, seats/teams, conversation volume, permissions, audit logs, limits, security, onboarding and SLA/support.

facts.label: Additional-seat cadence
facts.value: Monthly extra seat $19. Static annual card says $16/year per seat; public pricing script renders $16/month when annually billed.

facts.label: Currency and taxes
facts.value: Current English prices show $, with no explicit currency code established; exact tax-inclusive/exclusive treatment also not established.

facts.label: Seat and usage billing
facts.value: Package includes owner among seats: Free 1, Business 2, Plus 10. Additional seats available on paid plans. Conversation usage counts team/API/MCP activity, not individual messages.

facts.label: Native versus external AI bills
facts.value: Native AI has its own resolved-conversation headline. Bring-your-own AI uses the plan's conversation allowance through API/webhooks/MCP and may incur external model/runner costs.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Lowest published paid base Business: two seats, $39 monthly or $372/year calculated. No mandatory AI add-on required for human support.

facts.label: Native AI rate and initial allowance
facts.value: Native AI Support Agent advertised at $0.50 per resolved conversation, available on all plans; starts with ten free AI conversations/credits.

facts.label: AI billing-unit disagreement
facts.value: Pricing says pay only on resolution; setup guide says one credit is used for every conversation handled by the AI agent.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: Our arithmetic: 100 × $0.50 = $50; 500 × $0.50 = $250 for billable resolved conversations as advertised. A Plus monthly base would give partial totals $249/$449.

facts.label: Conversation hard stop
facts.value: At plan cap, widget stays visible, but team/API replies to new conversations are blocked. Free 50; Business 200; Plus 1,000 conversations/month.

facts.label: Paid allowance reset
facts.value: Business/Plus offer reset anytime: recharge the current plan, start a new billing cycle, restore full conversation allowance.

facts.label: Renewal, cancellation and refunds
facts.value: Automatically renew monthly/yearly; cancellation/downgrade changes at billing-period end. Pricing offers full refund requested within 30 days; terms scope refund policy to payments processed by Chatway.

facts.label: AI wallet and inactivity unknowns
facts.value: Minimum credit purchase, expiry/carryover, automatic recharge, exact no-credit behavior, inactive-account deletion threshold and payment-grace period not established.

facts.label: External channel/model costs
facts.value: Meta handles WhatsApp messaging/template/usage fees directly. External AI models and workflow runners have their own charges.

facts.label: Widget vendor branding
facts.value: Paid users can remove Chatway widget branding with a toggle and Publish; Business is first paid plan in current pricing.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Outgoing visitor-email customization includes hiding Chatway branding, logo, sender, subject, fonts and colors. Exact first plan gate not stated in guide.

facts.label: Help-center brand removal
facts.value: Logo/colors/font/subdomain customizable; exact removal of Chatway vendor marks on the hosted help center not established.

facts.label: Self-service and solo access
facts.value: Public registration at https://go.chatway.app/register; Free supports one working owner. Paid standard plans are self-service; Enterprise is custom sales.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website chat and shared email/social support inbox, with native AI, developer-built AI, knowledge base and ecommerce context.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native widget installed with JavaScript or platform app; all plans, on unlimited websites, subject to conversation limits.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Paid integrated email: create unique @chatwaymail.com address or forward existing mailbox to it; replies handled in Chatway. Each received email becomes a conversation.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Paid/trial native integration, multiple numbers; eligible WhatsApp Business app coexistence or Meta Cloud API path.

facts.label: WhatsApp reply conditions
facts.value: Within 24 hours of last customer message, normal replies/templates; afterwards only approved templates. New outbound conversations require an approved template.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Paid Facebook Page inbox integration; receive messages and reply from Chatway.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Paid native Instagram direct-message inbox for business/professional accounts; unlimited connected Instagram accounts.

facts.label: Redirect channels versus inboxes
facts.value: Free social buttons can open WhatsApp, phone, SMS, Telegram, Discord and other destinations. Native SMS/voice/Telegram/Discord/Slack inbox channels not established.

facts.label: Human assignment and notes
facts.value: Assign chats manually; Business+ has inline private notes, mentions, tags, reminders and scheduled messages. Notes are invisible to visitors.

facts.label: Replies and search
facts.value: Canned responses and transcripts on all plans; search conversations by content/contact and filter using fields such as tag, agent, country and date.

facts.label: Workflow quantities
facts.value: Business includes two automations/workflows; Plus fifteen. Rule actions include greetings, tagging, notes, reminders, resolve/end and message sending.

facts.label: Routing and teams
facts.value: Plus/trial team routing, round-robin and load-based assignment; separate routing rules per inbox. Automated quick replies can route to a chosen team/agent, up to four choices.

facts.label: Human collision alerts
facts.value: Specific simultaneous-human typing/collision warning not established. Visitor typing display is a different feature.

facts.label: Websites and widgets
facts.value: All plans permit unlimited websites. Plus supports multiple independent widgets; terms cap Plus at fifty widgets/account under fair use; Enterprise may raise limit.

facts.label: Multiple inboxes
facts.value: Plus separate inboxes can select widgets/integrations and assigned agents; only assigned agents can view/respond in that inbox.

facts.label: Other quantities
facts.value: Business one help center; Plus multiple help centers. Multiple AI agents on Plus; single native agent setup on lower tiers. Instagram accounts unlimited; WhatsApp multiple numbers supported.

facts.label: FAQs versus help center
facts.value: Free includes FAQs in widget; Business+ public help center with articles/categories, widget article search and staff article sharing.

facts.label: Publishing and hosting
facts.value: Hosted URL yourhelpcentername.chatway.help; drafts/preview, publish/unpublish, categories, rich media, custom logo/colors/font and searchable articles.

facts.label: Content limits and localization
facts.value: Numeric article/storage cap, buyer-owned custom domain, private article permissions, native article translations and article feedback not established.

facts.label: Native AI role and channels
facts.value: Native AI Support Agent answers autonomously from connected knowledge on website, email, WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.

facts.label: External AI and fixed rules
facts.value: External AI through MCP can read/summarize, prepare drafts or send replies with granted permissions. Automations use rule triggers/actions separately.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Public web URLs and directly connected links, text/Q&A, CSV URL lists and bulk CSV Q&A. Sources can be rescanned, added, removed or deactivated.

facts.label: Ecommerce knowledge
facts.value: Selected Shopify and WordPress/WooCommerce content, products, orders/fulfillments and carts/checkout abandonments can be enabled as AI knowledge with per-data-type permission.

facts.label: Source freshness and citations
facts.value: Numeric source/page/character/file cap, automatic web refresh interval, source-citation guarantee and per-answer approval gate not established.

facts.label: Native human fallback
facts.value: Human can assign conversation to self or reassign to native AI; pricing says complex conversations can be escalated to the team. Agent schedule defaults 24/7 and supports timezone, daily hours and special dates.

facts.label: External AI handoff
facts.value: MCP handoff-to-human invokes built-in human handoff and stops further external-AI replies while handoff remains active.

facts.label: Store lookups and sharing
facts.value: AI can use authorized order/cart context; staff can share Shopify products/collections, existing coupons and order status in chat.

facts.label: Customer identity
facts.value: Shopify logged-in customers can be identified automatically. Custom-site visitor verification uses server-side secret and hashed user/email identifier to retrieve prior conversations.

facts.label: Account-changing AI actions
facts.value: Native autonomous refunds, order/account changes, arbitrary custom action tools and customer approval controls not established.

facts.label: Staff AI permissions
facts.value: MCP access scoped by selected widgets/channels, explicit read/write capabilities and role. Only owner/admin authorizes; resolve/reopen/assign and certain removals require confirmation.

facts.label: Shopify and WooCommerce
facts.value: Native paid deep ecommerce integration with customer email/order/cart context and AI source access; platform installation apps also available on Free.

facts.label: Automation services
facts.value: Webhook guide documents Zapier connection pattern; external runner can use API/MCP. Official AI-client index includes n8n workflows.

facts.label: Other developer-stack connectors
facts.value: Native Stripe customer context/refunds, Slack, Discord, Linear and GitHub issue connectors not established.

facts.label: API entitlement and keys
facts.value: REST API on all plans, including Free; owner/admin creates up to five active API keys. Requests use X-API-KEY; public reference covers contacts, conversations/messages, widgets and agents.

facts.label: Rate-limit discrepancy
facts.value: Help guide says 60 requests/minute per API key; current developer reference says 60/minute per account shared across keys, plus 30 resolves and 30 unresolves/minute.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: All plans; HTTPS POST event delivery with HMAC signature and timestamps, logs, retries and at-least-once semantics.

facts.label: Widget JS and MCP
facts.value: Documented window.$chatway methods/events; MCP uses OAuth and selected permissions. External AI available across plans, with plan conversation allowance.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to vendor-hosted backend researched here. Website integrations and self-run external-AI workers do not host Chatway itself.

facts.label: Widget translation
facts.value: English only enabled by default; paid users enable/edit other available widget languages and choose default fallback. Browser language selects among enabled locales.

facts.label: Live and AI languages
facts.value: Paid live translation in web/mobile can translate incoming and outgoing messages; native AI advertises multiple languages.

facts.label: Devices and dependencies
facts.value: Agent web app plus native iOS/Android apps on all plans. JavaScript embed supports arbitrary websites; WordPress/Shopify and other platform apps optional.

facts.label: Human reporting and surveys
facts.value: Analytics on all plans: widget interaction, resolved/unresolved chats and conversations per agent. Paid post-chat surveys support stars/numbers 1–5, configurable text or emoji responses.

facts.label: AI quality review/export
facts.value: Dedicated native-AI failed-answer report, detailed resolution-quality metric, report CSV and complete satisfaction-comment export not established.

facts.label: Contacts
facts.value: Self-service full/selected contact CSV: full name, email, phone if collected, location, last active and tags.

facts.label: Conversation transcripts
facts.value: Download a conversation as text or email transcript to self/visitor and up to five other addresses. Transcript listed on every plan.

facts.label: Programmatic messages
facts.value: Paid and Free API can list conversations/messages in JSON; messages newest first with pagination, maximum twenty/page.

facts.label: Exit completeness
facts.value: Bulk binary attachments, native article/source export, full survey/comment export and a complete account backup/migration bundle not established.

facts.label: Location and providers
facts.value: Privacy allows servers in various countries worldwide. GDPR page names AWS, Google, Facebook, Elastic Email, CloudFlare, Profitwell and Stripe among tools/providers.

facts.label: Region choice and DPA
facts.value: Exact primary hosting region, customer region selector and complete public subprocessor/DPA text not established; GDPR page says request DPA by email.

facts.label: Native AI data use
facts.value: Privacy says no visitor conversations/confidential User Data used to train public/shared AI models; third-party AI infrastructure processes limited data to deliver AI service under contractual obligations.

facts.label: External AI processing
facts.value: MCP grants connected service authorized access; external AI provider's own terms/privacy also apply.

facts.label: History and contact visibility
facts.value: Free last thirty days; paid unlimited chat history. Contact storage advertised unlimited, but Free only sees most recent thirty days.

facts.label: Retention controls
facts.value: Automatically delete inactive visitor contact details and chat history after six, nine or twelve months, or never; separate permanent-removal controls for deleted contacts/agents.

facts.label: Account deletion
facts.value: Profile/settings offers account deletion. Privacy says self-service for accounts not on paid plan, or request deletion of account/data by chat/email.

facts.label: Erasure timing and backups
facts.value: Exact post-closure export window, final erase deadline, backup-expiry period and numeric idle-account deletion threshold not established. GDPR page says daily backups.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Chatway; active hosted messaging platform with native AI Support Agent, external AI connections, ecommerce support and human inbox.

facts.label: Product relationships
facts.value: Chatway brand supplied by Poptin Ltd.; native AI Support Agent differs from bring-your-own AI over API/webhooks/MCP.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Poptin Ltd., Israeli limited company; terms publish VAT number 515584001. GDPR page also describes it as owner of Poptin Inc.

facts.label: Eligibility and restrictions
facts.value: Users must be 18 or older with contractual authority. One free account per domain; a second free account on the same domain needs written approval.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted SaaS, with website apps/plugins and mobile operator apps. No buyer-run backend edition or public server-source licence established.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public help center, website/help-center live chat, contact form. Developer support guide explicitly covers API/webhook/integration issues. Enterprise advertises tailored SLA/priority support and account manager.

facts.label: Staffed hours
facts.value: Exact human support days, hours, timezone and standard-plan response guarantee not established.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; new smart-routing announcement dated 2026-11-02; terms/privacy last updated 2026-10-06. Proposed next review 2026-12-05, earlier for billing conflicts.

facts.value: $ currency code and monthly-payment versus annual-prepayment rates not explicitly established in inspected pricing/terms.
