facts.value: Startups with 1 agent: 100 assistant replies within 300 credits gives headline base $19; 500 replies requires a published 1,000-credit/$20 top-up, total $39. Three agents: $57/$77 respectively.

facts.label: AI stops/expiry
facts.value: Plan credits reset at renewal, no rollover. Bought credits expire after 6 months, require active subscription and are non-refundable. No auto top-up; banner after 80%, no email alert. Exhaustion sends conversations to humans.

facts.label: Fair use
facts.value: Paid conversation volume called unlimited subject to fair use. Suggested messages/agent/month: Startups around 10,000; Business 20,000; Enterprise 50,000; includes inbound/outbound.

facts.label: Inactivity
facts.value: More than 6 months inactive: deletion scheduled, users emailed, 7-day grace period, then permanent deletion. Login resets inactivity.

facts.label: Channel extras and free stop
facts.value: Meta/Twilio provider charges separate; fixed numeric rates not established. Precise behavior at Hacker's 500-conversation threshold not established.

facts.label: Self-hosted widget branding
facts.value: Native custom-branding entitlement in Premium Support/Enterprise; not in Community product plan.

facts.label: Self-hosted email/help-center branding
facts.value: Paid self-hosted offering describes domain/logo/widget/email-template changes; specific help-center vendor-mark removal gate not independently established.

facts.label: Cloud branding removal
facts.value: Exact first Cloud plan and trial restrictions for widget, email and help-center vendor-mark removal not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Cloud self-service signup via https://app.chatwoot.com/app/auth/signup ; solo use supported by per-agent/free offer. Self-hosted download/deploy route; paid licence purchased from installation's Super Admin.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: omnichannel help desk/shared inbox, website chat, help center and AI support. Overlaps customer messaging and knowledge bases.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native inbox; Gmail/Microsoft/email setup documented. Cloud Startups+; Community supports email with operator configuration.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native widget; Hacker and paid Cloud, Community/self-hosted.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Website JavaScript SDK and React Native integration guide; Client APIs for custom end-user chat.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native connector via Meta quick/manual setup or Twilio. Cloud Startups+; self-hosted included, own integration configuration needed.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native business messaging via Instagram login or Facebook login.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Page inbox.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Integrations with Twilio and Bandwidth.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native inbox workflow over Twilio Voice/WhatsApp calling; Cloud Business+ or paid self-hosted.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Official integration lets staff reply from Slack threads using Chatwoot profiles and add private notes. Customer-facing Slack support can be built using API channels.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Native customer inbox connector not established.

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: Native live-chat pre-chat form documented; general standalone ticket-form product/plan not established.

facts.label: Collaboration
facts.value: Assignment; agent typing indicators to reduce collisions; private notes; canned responses.

facts.label: Automation/hours
facts.value: Cloud automation and teams start Business; Community includes automations. Per-inbox business hours and auto-responder documented.

facts.label: Cloud sites/brands
facts.value: Inboxes start at 20/account; guideline adds 5/8/10 per agent on Startups/Business/Enterprise. Support can increase allowance.

facts.label: Self-hosted sites
facts.value: Multiple website inboxes/account; operator provisions accounts/inboxes with API. Numerical edition caps not established.

facts.label: Help center
facts.value: Public articles/categories, custom domain, publish/preview; Cloud paid and self-hosted. Article/page-view caps advertised absent.

facts.label: Search/translation/feedback
facts.value: Multilingual portal described; search and article usefulness/feedback are not fully documented in retrieved setup guide.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Captain answers customers, drafts/summarizes/translates for agents, suggests FAQs, and supports tools/scenarios. Paid Cloud or paid self-hosted.

facts.label: Bring-your-own bot
facts.value: Open Agent Bot API works Cloud and self-hosted, including open-source platform; your code/model receives events and replies.

facts.label: AI knowledge
facts.value: Public webpages, PDFs and FAQs. Paid plans allow 2,000 documents/account across assistants; PDF max 10MB; each crawled page/PDF counts one document.

facts.label: Knowledge freshness
facts.value: Website refresh monthly Startups, weekly Business, daily Enterprise; manual refresh. PDFs not automatic; add Help Center URL explicitly.

facts.label: Citations/approval
facts.value: Used-document/conversation tracking and knowledge details available; guarantee of customer-facing citations on every response not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Captain hands off when it cannot help; customers/agents continue in same inbox. Audience/schedule exclusions stay Open for team.

facts.label: Custom actions
facts.value: Business/Enterprise Captain custom HTTPS tools can query orders, warranty or bookings and use configured request methods; up to 50 tools/assistant.

facts.label: Customer verification
facts.value: Optional required email verification with one-time code; verified-email parameter binds API lookup to checked address. Contact email alone is not verified.

facts.label: Shopify availability
facts.value: Order context integration documented, but official Shopify app new connections temporarily unavailable; contact support for custom-app setup.

facts.label: Integration conflicts
facts.value: Ecommerce marketing says packaged Shopify/WooCommerce not shipped; current Shopify guide exists. Catalog labels Stripe Q4 2026 and mentions refunds; Stripe feature page/release describe read-only available billing context.

facts.label: Slack/Linear
facts.value: Official Slack agent-reply integration; Linear can create/link issues from conversations, Cloud/self-hosted configuration.

facts.label: Other requested connections
facts.value: GitHub/WooCommerce catalog entries planned for Q4 2026, not proof shipped. Discord/automation-service connector availability not established; custom API/webhooks available.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: Public Application API and Client API on Cloud/self-hosted; Platform API self-hosted/managed only; widget SDK and webhooks.

facts.label: Runtime/install
facts.value: Self-hosting requires Linux, PostgreSQL, Redis, app/worker services and file storage. Docker Compose, Linux VM and Kubernetes guides. Minimum guidance 4GB RAM, 2 CPU cores.

facts.label: Maintenance
facts.value: Operator owns backups, restore testing, upgrades/migrations, mail/provider credentials and storage. Back up database, configuration and uploads.

facts.label: Paid dependencies
facts.value: Community lacks native Captain/voice/custom-branding entitlement; Premium/Enterprise add paid features. Captain model-provider key billed outside licence.

facts.label: Interface/widget languages
facts.value: Guide lists 30+ dashboard/widget languages; newer marketing says 50+. Examples: English, Spanish, French, German, Japanese and Arabic. Exact current list not established.

facts.label: Articles/AI languages
facts.value: Multilingual help-center portals; Captain replies in customer's language and generates FAQs in account language. Exact AI-language list not established.

facts.label: Devices
facts.value: Agent web browser and official iOS/Android apps; React Native customer widget guide and Client API custom chat.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Conversation/agent/inbox/team/CSAT reports; Captain handled/resolved/handoff/reopened trends and knowledge coverage.

facts.label: Contacts
facts.value: One-click contacts CSV export documented in official release; account APIs also support bulk data operations.

facts.label: Conversation text
facts.value: Application API lists conversations/messages in JSON; conversation message text retrievable with account access token.

facts.label: Articles/attachments/feedback
facts.value: Complete article/media export and attachment-binary migration procedure not established; portal API listing alone is insufficient. CSAT/report data paths exist, exact portable comment coverage unverified.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Cloud AWS US; self-host operator chooses infrastructure location. Region choice for Cloud not established.

facts.label: AI data policy
facts.value: Privacy says customer data not used to train generalized/non-personalized AI/ML; transfer to external AI only when user enables relevant integration.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Trust center subprocessor page returned no readable list.

facts.label: Cloud history
facts.value: Retention Hacker 30 days, Startups 1 year, Business 2 years, Enterprise 3 years/contract. Includes messages, attachments and events.

facts.label: Deletion details
facts.value: Privacy retains account data while active/as needed for services/legal purposes; deletion/contact route privacy@chatwoot.com. Exact backup deletion deadline not found. Self-hosted retention/backups operator-managed.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Chatwoot; active customer support platform. Captain is its AI assistant/copilot.

facts.label: Dated bot-integration note
facts.value: On 2025-04-22, Chatwoot said it sunsetted CSML due to low adoption and made Agent Bots the default way to add bots.

facts.label: Dated AI-version note
facts.value: On 2026-09-28, Chatwoot said Cloud accounts were already on the new Captain and that the next self-hosted release would remove Captain V1; old free-form instructions must be migrated.

facts.label: Status-page note
facts.value: On 2026-11-05, slow dashboard/API responses affected Chatwoot for 3 hours 18 minutes. The vendor reported no data loss, continued message delivery and resolution after rollback.

facts.label: Company
facts.value: Chatwoot Inc.; US connection supported by California governing law and US hosting, but incorporation/home-country fact not conclusively established.

facts.label: Regional eligibility
facts.value: Complete buying-country restrictions and regional channel offers not established. Provider rules apply to phone/SMS/WhatsApp.

facts.label: Cloud edition
facts.value: Vendor-hosted Chatwoot Cloud: Hacker, Startups, Business, Enterprise.

facts.label: Community licence
facts.value: Community/core code outside enterprise/ and third-party exceptions: MIT Expat. Repository https://github.com/chatwoot/chatwoot .

facts.label: Enterprise licence
facts.value: enterprise/: Chatwoot Enterprise License. Production requires valid subscription for correct seats; development/testing exception.

facts.label: Self-hosted editions
facts.value: Community Edition, Premium Support, Enterprise Edition. Captain and native voice not included in Community.

facts.label: SLA entitlement conflict
facts.value: Older purchase guide lists SLAs with Premium Support; current plan comparison reserves SLA policies for Enterprise.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Community Discord/GitHub; paid self-hosted priority email, Enterprise phone/dev office hours. Cloud/subscription support via Discord/email/in-app chat per terms.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Upstream latest listed release v4.19.1, October 24, 2026. Changelog also has November 3 update. Proposed next review 2026-12-04.

apps.name: Crisp
apps.line: Website chat, shared inbox, help center and AI.

cells.ai: Vendor estimate about $0.05–$0.10 per chat

agents.math: Uses 1 of the 2 free seats for website chat. Support email needs the Mini plan at $45 a month.
The Mini plan at $45 a month per workspace covers 3 of its 4 seats. The free plan has only 2 seats.

facts.label: Ongoing free plan
facts.value: Free is advertised as free forever, with live chat, shared inbox, contact form, chat SDKs, apps, and ecommerce integrations.

facts.label: Free seats, contacts, conversations
facts.value: Two operator seats; 100 customer profiles; zero sub-inboxes; unlimited conversations; no included AI credits.

facts.label: Free feature boundaries
facts.value: No native support-email channel, file sharing, canned replies, private notes, full-history access, knowledge base, or Hugo entitlement in the live Free table.

facts.label: Free history/storage specifics
facts.value: Exact Free history-access duration, storage volume, article allowance, and contact-cap stop behaviour were not specified in checked Free/pricing/limit/privacy pages.

facts.label: Trial and card
facts.value: Fourteen days; no card required; access to paid features for evaluation, subject to restrictions.

facts.label: After trial
facts.value: If no paid plan is selected, terms downgrade to Free at no charge. Premium-feature data is not lost solely by that downgrade, but access becomes unavailable.

facts.label: Mini price
facts.value: USD 45/workspace/month; four agents; 5,000 customer profiles; USD 5 monthly Hugo usage credits.

facts.label: Essentials price
facts.value: USD 95/workspace/month; ten agents; 50,000 profiles; two sub-inboxes; USD 25 monthly Hugo credits.

facts.label: Plus price
facts.value: USD 295/workspace/month; twenty included agents, USD 10/month per additional agent; 200,000 profiles; five sub-inboxes; USD 75 Hugo credits.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Quote-only for dedicated onboarding, tailored features/limits, training, and contractual SLA.

facts.label: Annual billing and taxes
facts.value: Yearly billing is available and prepaid for twelve months at renewal. Exact current annual plan invoice/discount was not published in pricing, yearly, upgrade, payment, or terms pages checked.

facts.label: Base billing unit
facts.value: Flat subscription per workspace; conversation count does not create a base-plan charge. Operator allowances, contact capacity, AI use, integrations, and channel usage can add costs.

facts.label: AI billing unit
facts.value: Hugo uses USD-valued, token-based credits. A Hugo conversation runs from the first AI-handled message until resolution, routing, or escalation; length/model/context affect consumption.

facts.label: Minimum ongoing purchase
facts.value: Lowest paid workspace is Mini at USD 45/month with four included agents; no need to buy four separate subscriptions for one/three workers.

facts.label: Payment commitments
facts.value: Paid plans require a valid payment method. Yearly mode prepays the year; ordinary unused-period refunds are excluded, subject to stated legal/material-feature remedies.

facts.label: Included AI credits
facts.value: Free USD 0; Mini USD 5; Essentials USD 25; Plus USD 75 Hugo usage credits per month. Credits reset monthly, currently the fourth of the month according to billing docs.

facts.label: AI estimates and rate table
facts.value: Vendor estimates around USD 0.05 to USD 0.10 for a full Hugo-handled conversation. Exact cost varies by tokens, history, language, tools, and model; no universal numeric per-model tariff found.

facts.label: External model billing
facts.value: Supported OpenAI GPT models are managed through Hugo; an external OpenAI API key cannot be connected. Model use consumes Crisp's Hugo credits.

facts.label: AI versus workflows
facts.value: Workflows do not consume Hugo usage credits merely by running. Legacy MagicReply is discussed separately in billing docs; its migration deadline has already passed.

facts.label: 100/500 AI conversation examples
facts.value: Our illustration using vendor's average: Mini with 100 Hugo conversations gives USD 45 to 50/month; with 500, USD 65 to 90/month, assuming pay-as-you-go enabled.

facts.label: Alternative Essentials examples
facts.value: Our illustration: Essentials at 100 Hugo conversations is USD 95/month; at 500, USD 95 to 120/month using the same vendor-average assumptions.

facts.label: AI stop and additional usage
facts.value: When included credits run out, Hugo stops and escalates to operators unless optional pay-as-you-go is enabled. An Owner can configure additional-usage limits; trial pay-as-you-go may be unavailable.

facts.label: Per-conversation AI budget
facts.value: Plus setup describes a per-conversation spending target and human/fallback routing; an AI step can take spend beyond that target before handoff.

facts.label: Contact/storage and quota extras
facts.value: Essentials and above can buy eligible custom limits; extra operators are publicly priced on Plus at USD 10/month. Other increases include contacts, translation, uploads, and some sub-inboxes.

facts.label: WhatsApp usage and currency
facts.value: Crisp bills WhatsApp Message Usage separately. Guide says first 1,000 service replies/number/month free, then per-message charges; templates have category/country rates; budget is entered in EUR.

facts.label: WhatsApp stopping rules
facts.value: Pay-as-you-go off blocks templates and, after the free service allowance, outgoing replies. At a spending limit outgoing use blocks; inbound messages continue. Alerts occur at 90%/100%.

facts.label: Cancellation and ordinary refunds
facts.value: Help guide cancels paid renewals by downgrading that workspace to Free. Terms say monthly termination takes effect immediately and the current month remains due/non-refundable.

facts.label: Annual cancellation timing
facts.value: Exact annual effective-cancellation date is unclear: terms say termination takes effect on the first day following renewal; help says switching to Free stops future renewals, while yearly guide says twelve-month prepayment.

facts.label: Chatbox and email branding
facts.value: Removing We run on Crisp requires a paid Plus workspace; trial does not remove it. It disappears after successful first payment, potentially up to two hours later.

facts.label: Help-center branding
facts.value: Essentials/Plus help center supports header/footer logos, appearance/custom domain; full vendor-mark removal on every help-center/portal surface was not explicitly settled by the dedicated branding guide.

facts.label: Buying access and solo use
facts.value: Public self-service signup/trial and ongoing Free plan; Free explicitly targets solo users and includes two operator seats.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website/app chat, shared support email and messaging inbox, knowledge base, workflows, ticket portal, and AI. Overlaps customer messaging and self-service help.

facts.label: Website and in-app chat
facts.value: Native website chat and Web/iOS/Android/React Native SDK routes; current plan table includes chat SDKs and widget on Free and above.

facts.label: Support email
facts.value: Shared inbound/outbound email starts on Mini; forward an existing support mailbox to Crisp and reply from the shared inbox. Custom outgoing email domain is included from Mini.

facts.label: Messenger and Telegram
facts.value: Native connected Facebook Messenger and Telegram channels are included from Mini according to the live plan-table markers.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Instagram DMs/stories are included from Essentials, not Mini/Free, per current pricing.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: WhatsApp Business Platform plugin requires Essentials or Plus, Owner access, Meta business administration, and a verifiable number; eligible Business app coexistence is documented.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Twilio SMS integration from Essentials connects one Twilio number. The Twilio plugin does not provide voice calling.

facts.label: Phone/voice
facts.value: Aircall integration on Essentials/Plus supports incoming/outgoing calls, call events, voicemail, contacts, and compatible SMS through the Crisp Inbox.

facts.label: Slack operator bridge
facts.value: Slack from Mini lets operators reply to incoming Crisp conversations from Slack.

facts.label: Discord operator bridge
facts.value: Discord integration starts on Essentials; forwards Crisp conversations into a chosen public Discord channel and lets operators reply there.

facts.label: Forms and customer portal
facts.value: Contact form is available on Free and above. Plus Ticket Center embeds an authenticated portal where customers create, browse, and reply to requests.

facts.label: Assignment and routing
facts.value: Routing/assignment guide requires Essentials or Plus; manual agent assignment, ordered rules, online-agent selection, stale/offline reassignment, and explicit fallback rules are documented.

facts.label: Notes, shortcuts, triage
facts.value: Private notes/mentions and canned replies start on Mini; inbox supports state/filter views and shared collaboration. Conversation reminders require Essentials in current table.

facts.label: Working hours
facts.value: Working-hours settings are included on all plans per table; Hugo can use configured office hours to set expectations on human escalation.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: No specific concurrent-agent reply-lock or collision-warning guarantee found after reading Inbox, routing, Free/Mini guides, and typing descriptions.

facts.label: Sites and brands
facts.value: Workspace billing is not per domain/subdomain. Multiple domains can use one workspace; separate workspaces have separate subscriptions and configuration.

facts.label: Connections and sub-inboxes
facts.value: Pricing generally allows one of each external channel except email unless higher limits are purchased. Sub-inboxes Free/Mini/Essentials/Plus: 0/0/2/5.

facts.label: Help center eligibility and features
facts.value: Essentials/Plus: public articles/categories, search, article feedback, custom domain, multilingual help center, chat/help SDK access; password/JWT protection is described.

facts.label: Publication and article limits
facts.value: Draft/published distinction and article version history are documented. Numeric article/category/storage ceiling was not published in the checked overview/pricing/limits pages.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Hugo automatically answers/escalates customer conversations. Agent-side Copilot, writing/translation, workflow automation, summaries, and AI-search functions are separate features with plan gates.

facts.label: AI plan differences
facts.value: Hugo customer agent starts on Mini. Essentials adds workflows/internal Copilot/writing and multilingual tools; Plus adds task automation, AI search/spam handling, and conversation summaries per table.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and sync
facts.value: Hugo accepts website pages, Crisp articles, TXT/PDF files, CSV Q&A, and manual Q&A. Crisp article publication changes sync automatically; external website refresh is manual.

facts.label: Knowledge capacity
facts.value: Training guide: Mini 1 domain/1 file; Essentials 3 domains/5 files; Plus 10 domains/100 files. Q&A CSV: at most 100 snippets/file; question 200 characters, answer 4,000.

facts.label: Mini training entitlement discrepancy
facts.value: Pricing table marks AI Knowledge training unavailable on Mini; current training guide specifies Mini domain/file limits and Mini setup actively teaches Q&A training.

facts.label: Knowledge citations/other caps
facts.value: No guaranteed customer-visible citation policy, numeric upload-size cap, or exact external-page refresh schedule found in the checked training/model/pricing/terms pages.

facts.label: Human fallback and history
facts.value: Hugo supports uncertainty/no-answer escalation, frustration/human-request escalation, routing rules, and manual takeover. Human replies interrupt Hugo and return the same conversation to human inboxes.

facts.label: After hours and credit exhaustion
facts.value: Hugo can announce configured human office hours; inbox/operator routing then applies. Without available AI credits, new conversations escalate to humans by default.

facts.label: Actions and integrations
facts.value: Plus task automation can retrieve account/order details and use connected tools; vendor names order tracking and supported refund/account actions as possible integration tasks.

facts.label: Verification and tool controls
facts.value: Customer-facing integrations can require identity verification; enable/disable individual tools and restrict availability to customers, Copilot, or both. Connections may be individual or shared.

facts.label: Portal customer identity
facts.value: Plus Ticket Center requires a logged-in application, verified customer email, and backend-generated HMAC-SHA256 signature; allowed domains can be configured.

facts.label: Store, CRM, payment and automation fit
facts.value: Shopify/WooCommerce integrations on all plans; Slack from Mini; HubSpot/Pipedrive/Zoho and Zapier/Make/n8n from Essentials; Stripe and Salesforce from Plus per current table.

facts.label: AI-linked developer tools
facts.value: Hugo integrations explicitly name Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Notion, Linear, PostHog, HubSpot, and Zapier. Own MCP integrations are supported.

facts.label: Other connections
facts.value: No current native GitHub customer-support integration or arbitrary customer Slack/Discord intake established in checked pricing/integration/inbox descriptions.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: Web SDK/npm, mobile SDK routes, REST API, realtime events, and plugin framework are documented; current pricing marks Developer APIs and Chat SDKs on all plans.

facts.label: Authentication and quotas
facts.value: REST API uses identifier/key authentication and tier/scopes. Development token is tied to a trusted workspace; production tokens have scoped daily quotas and can request increases.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched hosted Crisp service. SDK/plugin installation does not provide a self-hosted support server.

facts.label: Widget and app languages
facts.value: Widget supports 60+ languages. Desktop, Android, iOS, email, Knowledge Base, and Status each have different named locale lists.

facts.label: AI and help translations
facts.value: Knowledge Base supports added locales automatically translated from a reference language; Hugo can detect customer language or use fixed locale; Essentials+ LiveTranslate table says 50+ languages.

facts.label: Agent and customer platforms
facts.value: Official agent apps: web, Mac, Windows, iPhone, Android. Customer chat SDKs support web and mobile integration; existing site platform need not be Shopify/WordPress.

facts.label: Support reporting
facts.value: Essentials+ Analytics covers conversations, operator activity, first response/resolution, channels, ratings, knowledge searches, and more; many reports export CSV.

facts.label: AI evaluation/reporting
facts.value: Hugo analytics shows final-outcome funnels, escalation rate, topics, workflow heatmap, and review/download of associated conversations; Observability supports investigation.

facts.label: Contact CSV export
facts.value: Essentials and above can export contact profiles as CSV, generated in background with email notification. Public export limit: 500,000 contacts, ask support above it.

facts.label: Single-conversation transcript
facts.value: Manual or automatic email copy of a conversation is supported. Automatic transcript usually sends about an hour after last message when closed/stalled; recipient settings are configurable.

facts.label: Messages and attachments export
facts.value: No native dashboard conversation CSV currently; use REST API/custom integration or migration tool. API retrieves message batches with timestamp paging and lists files with names, types, URLs, and timestamps.

facts.label: Knowledge and feedback export
facts.value: Knowledge Base settings include Data Import & Export; API exposes helpdesk page-metadata routes and locale feedback (ratings/comments). Exact complete GUI export format/attachment coverage was not specified in the overview.

facts.label: Core hosting and backup location
facts.value: Privacy focuses on Amsterdam core infrastructure; subprocessor list places main data in Netherlands/Germany, encrypted AWS backups in Ireland, and Scaleway AI infrastructure in France.

facts.label: AI processing region and provider default
facts.value: Model guide supports global/default or EU processing where selected model allows. Subprocessor page says in-house EU AI is default and external providers off; model guide instead names an OpenAI automatic default.

facts.label: Processors and external flows
facts.value: Subprocessors include DigitalOcean, Vultr, AWS, Cloudflare, Stripe/PayPal, optional Firebase/Azure, Scaleway, and optional OpenAI/Gemini/Anthropic/Mistral.

facts.label: AI training-use policy and DPA
facts.value: Privacy says customer data is not used to train Crisp models; terms qualify this as except where expressly agreed in writing. Privacy says external LLM context is not used to train by default.

facts.label: Paid history and inactivity
facts.value: Mini and above advertise unlimited retention/full history. Privacy says account/customer data can be deleted after up to twelve months without engagement, with notice to reactivate.

facts.label: Deletion and cancellation conflict
facts.value: Deletion help says deleting a workspace cancels its active subscription. Terms explicitly say workspace deletion does not simultaneously terminate the customer subscription.

facts.label: Deletion timing/backups
facts.value: Account/workspace deletion is described as irreversible; privacy says closure need not delete immediately and gives legal-retention exceptions. No exact customer-data backup-purge deadline or guaranteed restoration/export grace period published.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Crisp; active hosted customer-support platform at crisp.chat. Hugo is its embedded AI core and is also presented by the vendor as a related standalone product.

facts.label: Lifecycle notice
facts.value: Crisp required all workspaces still using legacy MagicReply chatbots to complete migration to Hugo AI Agent by October 30, 2026. The guide says Hugo replaces the legacy MagicReply approach and existing Workflows remain available during migration.

facts.label: App shutdown/acquisition
facts.value: No official Crisp-wide shutdown, sunset, or acquisition notice found for crisp.chat in the checked sources.

facts.label: Dated API-compatibility note
facts.value: In October 2026 Crisp permanently removed the remaining legacy Helpdesk article, category and section REST API routes and directs integrations to the newer Helpdesk Tree routes.

facts.label: Legal company and country
facts.value: CRISP IM SAS, French company; SIREN 833085806; 2 Boulevard de Launay, 44100 Nantes, France.

facts.label: Registration restrictions
facts.value: Official troubleshooting guide lists IP-based creation restrictions including Ghana, Nigeria, Mauritius, and mainland China; VPN/proxy use can block new account/workspace creation.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted SaaS; website/app SDKs, plugins, and agent desktop/mobile apps. No self-hosted support-server edition or licence established.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public chat and support@crisp.chat; docs/developer help available. Enterprise offers tailored onboarding/training/SLA.

facts.label: Support hours/response SLA
facts.value: No complete support clock hours/time zone or numerical response/resolution guarantee found for each public plan in checked contact, pricing, terms, and help guides.

facts.label: Freshness evidence
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026; routing guide updated November 5; Free/Mini guides November 2; AI billing and Knowledge Base guides November 1; MagicReply deadline October 30 has passed.

facts.label: Next review
facts.value: Our proposed next review: December 5, 2026, earlier for billing/legacy changes. Definitive latest product release version and complete ownership history were not established.

apps.name: Dante AI
apps.line: Knowledge-trained website agents with human handoff and voice support.

cells.ai: Credit-based; model determines credit use

agents.math: The Advanced plan covers one human Inbox agent. The AI can be left unused.
The Advanced plan includes three working users. Human handoff is included, and AI generations are not used.

facts.label: Ongoing Free
facts.value: Free plan, USD 0 forever, no card and no stated expiry.

facts.label: Free agents, seats and knowledge
facts.value: One AI agent; one seat occupied by owner; 150,000 extracted knowledge characters; website embedding and basic appearance/instructions.

facts.label: Free AI and voice
facts.value: 100 monthly credits; GPT-4o Mini and default GPT-5.4 Nano cost one credit/turn. Browser voice available, capped at ten minutes/month, using five credits/minute from shared balance.

facts.label: Free visibility and absent paid features
facts.value: Own Sandbox transcripts visible; real external visitor transcripts/export require paid plan. Free Insights contains labelled samples. No live Human Handover, paid lead form, scheduled auto-sync or paid add-ons.

facts.label: Unlisted Free quantities
facts.value: Separate contact count, storage-byte quota, normal transcript age limit and maximum allowed website count not established.

facts.label: Evaluation and trial
facts.value: Private Sandbox on every plan. First five onboarding test messages are free; after that, or after onboarding finishes, test replies consume monthly credits.

facts.label: Paid-plan trial terms
facts.value: General time-limited paid-tier trial, duration, card requirement and automatic end-state not established.

facts.label: Starter price
facts.value: USD 40/month paid monthly; USD 400/year paid annually. Our calculation: 400 / 12 ≈ USD 33.33/month equivalent.

facts.label: Advanced price
facts.value: USD 120/month monthly; USD 1,200/year annually, equivalent to USD 100/month.

facts.label: Pro price
facts.value: USD 400/month monthly; USD 4,000/year annually. Our calculation: 4,000 / 12 ≈ USD 333.33/month equivalent.

facts.label: Currency, tax and custom quote
facts.value: Explicit US dollars; local sales tax excluded and calculated at checkout. Above-Pro/custom team offer is through sales, without public fixed price.

facts.label: Billing units
facts.value: Workspace subscription with included agents, seats, shared monthly credits and character capacity. A live visitor turn is one input plus one generated reply, costing 1–25 credits by model.

facts.label: Working users and roles
facts.value: Owner/Admin full access; Editor + deploy can publish; Member edits without publish rights; Viewer read-only; Inbox role reads and answers handover chats only. Every member/pending invite consumes a seat.

facts.label: Reset and rollover
facts.value: Free resets on first calendar day. Paid credits refill monthly on billing-day anniversary, including annual subscribers; unused base/recurring allowance does not roll over.

facts.label: Minimum and required upgrades
facts.value: Lowest public paid purchase one Starter workspace. Human Handover requires Advanced; it is not sold as a Free/Starter add-on. Extra seats are not sold separately.

facts.label: Model credit charges
facts.value: Default GPT-5.4 Nano/GPT-4o Mini one credit/reply; GPT-5.6 Luna five, Terra ten, Sol twenty-five. Other catalog models range 1–25 as shown in selector.

facts.label: Included balances and testing
facts.value: Free 100; Starter 2,000; Advanced 8,000; Pro 30,000 credits/month. Sandbox replies and side-by-side comparison replies spend the same credits after initial allowance.

facts.label: Voice credit price
facts.value: Browser and phone voice five credits/minute from shared workspace balance. Free voice limit ten minutes/month. Phone-number rental is extra on Advanced/Pro.

facts.label: 100/500 actual credits
facts.value: Our calculation: one-user Starter stays USD 40/month or USD 400/year for 100/500 consumed credits; three-user Advanced stays USD 120/month or USD 1,200/year.

facts.label: Extra recurring capacity
facts.value: USD 20/month per extra agent; USD 20/month per extra 1,000 credits. Paid base required. Add-ons bill monthly separately even with annual base.

facts.label: Auto-topup
facts.value: Off by default, available on paid plans. Owner saves card and enables it; hitting zero charges USD 20 for 1,000 credits. Per-cycle cap selectable from one to 50 charges.

facts.label: Low balance and zero
facts.value: If chosen model is unaffordable but at least one credit remains, published widget falls back to cheapest one-credit model. At zero AI replies stop; chat can open/welcome still shows and teammates can reply.

facts.label: Per-agent limits
facts.value: Starter+ per-device rolling-minute message limit and per-agent monthly credit cap, with zero meaning unlimited for those controls. Message input limited to 4,000 characters.

facts.label: Billing changes, failure and refunds
facts.value: Upgrades prorated after confirmed payment; downgrades/cancellation effective next renewal. Failed renewal makes dashboard read-only while live agents keep answering; final failed retries downgrade to Free without deleting data.

facts.label: Hibernation pause
facts.value: Optional USD 10/month hibernation keeps knowledge, chats, leads and settings but takes agent offline, sets credits to zero and disables paid features. Begins at next renewal.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: Advanced/Pro include workspace-wide removal of Powered by Dante badge. Starter can buy USD 50/month add-on; Free must upgrade first.

facts.label: Custom domains and email branding
facts.value: Custom widget domain configured by support on request, no plan includes it as a listed entitlement and no public fixed fee. Independent outgoing support-email branding/domain offer not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service Free and paid plans; no card needed to start Free. Starter is positioned for solo founders. Above-Pro/custom arrangements use sales.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: customer-support AI with knowledge retrieval, live-human website takeover, voice and lead capture; overlaps chatbots, customer messaging and knowledge search.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native floating launcher or inline script embed, on every plan. Hosted full-page chat link available when website cannot run scripts. Human takeover Advanced+.

facts.label: Support email
facts.value: Native two-way support mailbox, forwarding/sending-domain setup and email-to-Inbox handling not established. Chat history has an Email channel label and can email transcript copies.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Web applications can embed widget or use custom integration. Dedicated native iOS/Android customer SDK not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Integration docs describe Meta WhatsApp Business number/token validation; privacy lists opt-in WhatsApp Cloud API processing. Exact native plan gate, transport fees and handoff window not established.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Maintained native Instagram channel and plan/permission/handoff details not established.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Messenger support configuration and limits not established.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Native carrier-SMS channel and per-segment tariffs not established.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Browser realtime voice on every plan, Free capped at ten minutes. Advanced/Pro can rent one/three UK numbers for English inbound calls, rental billed separately.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Starter+ Zapier integration can connect Slack and send a message to an agent through a Zap. Chat history also recognises Slack channel.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Official comparison lists Discord among apps reachable through Starter+ Zapier. Maintained native Discord bot and human-takeover behavior not established.

facts.label: Forms and tickets
facts.value: Advanced+ native lead form, up to three fields; separate all-plan name/email fallback when Human Handover is off. Dedicated ticket number/queue/email lifecycle not established.

facts.label: Assignment and collision prevention
facts.value: Awaiting/Active/Resolved handover queue; Take it assigns conversation to the teammate, stops AI, and only that assignee can reply. Typing visitor shown in realtime.

facts.label: Other coordination and hours
facts.value: General private conversation notes, human saved replies, automatic working-hours routing, offline ticket conversion and global human-first default not established.

facts.label: Agents and users
facts.value: Free/Starter one agent; Advanced three; Pro ten. Seats one/two/three/five respectively; owner and pending invites count.

facts.label: Multiple sites and brands
facts.value: Embed code can be installed on multiple allowed hostnames; blank allowlist permits any website. Separate subdomains need entries; www/bare variants are added together.

facts.label: Voice number quantities and fee
facts.value: Advanced one, Pro up to three rented numbers. Rental amount shown in-product before confirmation, billed monthly in addition to base; release stops rental billing.

facts.label: Help center
facts.value: Public article CMS, article-search portal, article-count/translation/feedback limits and custom article-domain hosting not established.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Autonomous grounded website/voice answers; booking through connected calendars; lead capture; AI instruction refinement and reviewed answer suggestions; human takeover on Advanced+.

facts.label: Source types
facts.value: Public website/sitemap pages, files, pasted text, Q&A; Google Drive folder and Notion connections with plan-dependent scheduled re-sync.

facts.label: Knowledge/file limits
facts.value: Extracted text caps: Free 150K, Starter 25M, Advanced 50M, Pro 200M characters. Upload maximum 50 MB/file; large batches split into parts of up to 25 files.

facts.label: Update schedules
facts.value: Website/sitemap/Drive/Notion weekly on Starter, every three days on Advanced, daily on Pro; slower cadences selectable. Free one-off only.

facts.label: Customer citations and source privacy
facts.value: Live replies show source links only for crawled public website pages. Uploaded files/text/Q&A are not named or linked to visitors; private Sandbox can show all matched source types.

facts.label: Corrections and approval
facts.value: Q&A has priority for matching questions but can be reworded. Thumbs-down Revise answer saves retrained Q&A; Advanced Insights drafts suggestions that stay pending until reviewed/added.

facts.label: Live handover and history
facts.value: Human request or pill enters Awaiting, holding message shown, no competing AI answer to the handover request. Take it assigns and pauses AI across reloads.

facts.label: Without live handover/offline
facts.value: All-plan Offer to take contact details defaults on while handover is off: name/email saved with chat and a follow-up promise. It can be disabled. Scheduled offline queue/timeout behavior not established.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Starter+ connected Calendly/Cal.com/Google Calendar/Outlook tools can list availability and book a selected slot. Workspace connects providers; each agent uses one booking provider.

facts.label: Verified customer identity
facts.value: All-plan optional HMAC-SHA256 signed user ID from customer's backend; verified conversation bound to user ID across devices. Require verified identity can hide widget from logged-out visitors.

facts.label: Commerce/custom write actions
facts.value: Native order changes, payment refunds, Stripe subscription actions, arbitrary customer API-write tools and mandatory human-approval workflow not established on current platform.

facts.label: Calendar and automation
facts.value: Native scheduling providers above; Starter+ Zapier New lead trigger and Send a message action can connect Slack, CRMs, Sheets and other apps.

facts.label: Site platforms
facts.value: Publish guide has install guidance for WordPress, Wix, Squarespace, Shopify, gamma.site, Vercel, Google Sites and HTML pages; WordPress API key available every plan.

facts.label: Remaining named connectors
facts.value: Native Stripe commerce, WooCommerce orders, Linear issues and GitHub source/issue integration not established from current docs.

facts.label: Direct API and access
facts.value: Pro-only REST base agents.dante-ai.com/data-api/v1, Authorization Bearer dnt_ key. Key belongs to workspace, hashed at rest, never expires until revoked.

facts.label: API write limits
facts.value: Read-only default or separate write_customization scope for prompt/welcome; live changes still require publishing role. Billing, memberships, account/agent deletion, widget-key rotation require dashboard sign-in.

facts.label: Rate limits and webhooks
facts.value: Direct API limits: 60/key/minute, 600/workspace/minute, 120/calling-IP/minute, sliding windows; 429 above any. Zapier webhook JSON signed and retried up to three times if endpoint unreachable.

facts.label: Legacy/API libraries
facts.value: Earlier platform uses api-v2.dante-ai.com and x-api-key; current public docs mark its reference sign-in required. Dedicated native mobile/widget command SDK beyond embed and API not established.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to documented customer editions. Hosted widgets/APIs do not require the buyer to run Dante's server.

facts.label: AI response languages
facts.value: Agent instructions can request another language; docs explicitly show Japanese replies even to English input. Phone calls currently understood in English.

facts.label: UI and article locales
facts.value: Complete operator/widget locale lists, translation methods and per-plan language gates not established. Public article translation offer also not established.

facts.label: Devices and install needs
facts.value: Browser dashboard/widget, inline embed or hosted link. Responsive settings/Sandbox support phones/tablets. Terms require current browser (within one year), internet and JavaScript; API caller needs HTTPS capability.

facts.label: Native applications
facts.value: Native operator iOS/Android/desktop apps and dedicated customer native-mobile SDK not established.

facts.label: Basic reporting
facts.value: Starter+ conversation volume, median AI response time, top questions and trends; CSV export or browser Print/Save PDF. Free shows marked sample metrics.

facts.label: Outcomes, satisfaction and gaps
facts.value: Advanced+ assumed resolution, visitor CSAT/thumb feedback, knowledge gaps and 30-day top-question analysis. Voice insights on Advanced/Pro.

facts.label: Transcripts and conversation list
facts.value: Starter+ single-conversation JSON/CSV/email transcript; list export JSON/CSV/Markdown/HTML exports list rows only. Export messages CSV gives every matching conversation's messages, across filters.

facts.label: Leads and contacts
facts.value: Lead list exports whole/selected rows as CSV/JSON/PDF, with conversation linkage and captured fields. Workspace Contacts are separate read-only combined people records.

facts.label: Full archive gaps
facts.value: Complete original-file download archive, restorable workspace/settings backup, chat attachment package and standalone contact-record export not established.

facts.label: Hosting and regions
facts.value: Primary databases/file storage/compute on DigitalOcean London, United Kingdom; Cloudflare network/security. Mixpanel analytics EU residency.

facts.label: AI processing and training
facts.value: Selected OpenAI/Anthropic/Google provider receives chat plus relevant excerpts/history. OpenAI also handles embeddings/title/follow-up work regardless of selected answer provider. Privacy limits provider training where choice exists and says confirmation is ongoing.

facts.label: Voice and other subprocessors
facts.value: Deepgram transcription; ElevenLabs/OpenAI/Cartesia speech synthesis. Current infrastructure/payment/email list includes DigitalOcean, Cloudflare, Stripe, Amazon SES, Resend and retiring legacy Brevo path.

facts.label: Processing agreement
facts.value: Standard DPA applies to every plan at no extra charge for relevant personal-data processing; customer controller, Dante processor. Negotiated/countersigned agreement through contact.

facts.label: Active data and cancellation
facts.value: Chat transcripts/product events remain while account active or until deleted. Cancellation drops to Free at next renewal without data deletion; paid viewing/features then follow Free gates.

facts.label: Account and object deletion
facts.value: Profile account deletion immediately removes workspaces, agents, knowledge/files/extracted text, vectors and subscription records, and revokes sessions. Conversations/sources can be deleted individually.

facts.label: Backup and ephemeral deadlines
facts.value: Residual encrypted backups rotate out after an unspecified limited period; account-record retention, end-user upload expiry and anonymous sandbox cleanup periods are not numerically published.

facts.label: Identity and state
facts.value: Dante AI; active public offer for knowledge-trained AI agents, website text/voice, human handover and leads. Operated by Dante AI Inc.

facts.label: Earlier platform
facts.value: Current documentation distinguishes an earlier platform at app.dante-ai.com with its own codebase, provider list, API and Zapier app.

facts.label: Legal company and country
facts.value: Dante AI Inc., Delaware corporation, United States. Current terms choose California governing law.

facts.label: Regional calling restrictions
facts.value: Phone-number rental currently United Kingdom only; phone calls understood in English. Advanced permits one rented number, Pro up to three.

facts.label: General buying countries
facts.value: Complete supported/blocked-country list and country-specific non-phone offers not established.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Proprietary hosted service, widget and supported APIs. Terms grant limited non-exclusive use rights; customer retains its submitted content.

facts.label: Self-hosted customer edition
facts.value: Customer-operated server edition, downloadable server repository and source licence not established.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Human support on every plan including Free; hello@dante-ai.com, contact form, public docs. Pro offers onboarding call in comparison.

facts.label: Support hours and SLA
facts.value: Public staffed hours/timezone and guaranteed response/resolution time by self-service plan not established.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05 UTC; official News has updates dated November 5, 2026. Terms/privacy updated November 1, 2026; DPA October 2, 2026.
