facts.label: Shopify BRL price display
facts.value: Listing through the web reader showed Startup R$159.21 BRL/month, Scale R$543.51 BRL/month and Growth R$1,641.50 BRL/month as local estimates, at its stated 1 BRL = 0.1821 USD.

facts.label: Shopify INR price display
facts.value: A direct page read showed Startup ₹2,747.62 INR/month, Scale ₹9,379.80 INR/month and Growth ₹28,328.88 INR/month as estimates, at its stated 1 INR = 0.0106 USD.

facts.label: Billable support ticket
facts.value: A customer message creates a ticket; it becomes billable only when a human replies. Unlimited back-and-forth messages within that ticket still count once.

facts.label: Reopened tickets and cycle
facts.value: A unique ticket counts once within a 30-day billing cycle. Reopening in a later cycle makes it billable in that later cycle.

facts.label: Marketing contact unit
facts.value: One unique phone number targeted in a month is one marketing contact, even when it receives several messages that month.

facts.label: Minimum and setup fees
facts.value: Lowest primary advertised bundle is Startup USD 29/month; five members included. WhatsApp API setup is advertised at zero setup cost; one API number is included.

facts.label: Cancellation and refunds
facts.value: Cancel at any time; cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid term. Terms say purchases are non-refundable.

facts.label: Manual AI helper allowance and rate
facts.value: Primary pricing: 10,000 free tokens renewed with each monthly billing cycle; after that, AI Assistant shows USD 1 per 100,000 tokens at an 80% discount from USD 5.

facts.label: Conflicting AI bundle
facts.value: Alternate grid includes 1M/10M/20M tokens on Startup/Scale/Growth, then $5/$4/$3 per 100K respectively, alongside both AI Chatbot and Assistant.

facts.label: Autonomous AI Agent billing
facts.value: Shopify listing labels AI Agent with 10K free tokens/month. Exact deduction rules, excess rate and whether its balance/rate is shared with the manual Assistant remain unresolved.

facts.label: AI examples in the actual unit
facts.value: Our calculation: 100 or 500 total helper tokens in a fresh cycle fall within the canonical 10,000-token allowance; additional helper usage charge USD 0, base USD 29/month under primary pricing.

facts.label: AI examples beyond free quota
facts.value: Our calculation using the displayed helper offer: 110,000 total tokens = 10,000 free + one 100,000 paid unit, USD 1 extra; 510,000 total = free + five units, USD 5 extra. Primary base plus usage: USD 30/34 monthly.

facts.label: Support overages
facts.value: Startup USD 10 per extra 100 tickets; Scale USD 8 per extra 100; Growth USD 5 per extra 100. Pricing says service continues when the allowance is exceeded.

facts.label: Marketing overages
facts.value: Startup USD 10 per extra 1,000 contacts; Scale USD 5 per extra 1,000; Growth USD 3 per extra 1,000.

facts.label: Extra WhatsApp number
facts.value: First API number included; each additional number USD 25/month; bulk discounts require a quote.

facts.label: Back in Stock add-on
facts.value: Primary pricing: Startup USD 10, Scale USD 20, Growth USD 30 per month for each enabled WhatsApp API number / Shopify store. Alternate grid says $10/$10/included.

facts.label: External WhatsApp charges
facts.value: Meta charges vary by message category and destination country. Cloud API accounts pay Meta directly; Gupshup accounts fund a prepaid wallet. Gupshup adds service charges which DelightChat says it refunds.

facts.label: Stops, expiry and inactivity gaps
facts.value: No numeric AI spending cap, automatic recharge rule, paid-token expiry, ticket-overage block rounding or inactivity deletion schedule found.

facts.label: Widget and help branding removal
facts.value: Permission to remove DelightChat vendor marks, first eligible plan, surcharge and trial restrictions are not established.

facts.label: Email branding removal
facts.value: Custom brand/team signatures and own-domain sending exist. Removal rules for any vendor-added email mark are not established.

facts.label: Buying access and solo use
facts.value: Public self-service signup and optional demo/onboarding; Startup includes five team members and does not publish a larger team minimum. Signup route: https://app.delightchat.io/signup.

facts.label: Host and account prerequisites
facts.value: Documented onboarding connects a Shopify store; widget setup requires that store/app integration. Whether a new non-Shopify business can buy and use the full email/helpdesk product independently is not established.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: ecommerce shared inbox/helpdesk, website self-service and AI support, with a substantial WhatsApp marketing product.

facts.label: Email channel
facts.value: Native connected email inbox on published paid plans; forward the support mailbox to DelightChat and authenticate own-domain sending with DNS records.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: Native store live chat in the Self-Service Widget on published paid plans; installed Shopify app and theme app embed required by setup docs.

facts.label: WhatsApp channel
facts.value: Official WhatsApp Business API support and outbound templates/broadcasts; paid plan, Meta business verification and number setup required.

facts.label: Instagram channel
facts.value: Business/Creator account connected to a Facebook Page; native DMs and comments with message-access permissions. Guide excludes Reels comments and Instagram ad-post comments.

facts.label: Facebook channel
facts.value: Native Page Messenger and post/comment handling; select permissions, Page, brand and enabled features, then save.

facts.label: Forms and callbacks
facts.value: Self-Service Widget contains a contact form; documented widget deep links include a callback-request page.

facts.label: Other customer channels
facts.value: Native SMS, voice telephony, Slack/Discord customer channels and customer-facing iOS/Android in-app chat SDKs were not established.

facts.label: Collaboration
facts.value: Ticket assignment, private team comments, saved Fast Replies, tags, snoozing/follow-up reminders and visibility of who is viewing/replying are documented.

facts.label: Rules and hours
facts.value: Rules can send replies, assign tickets and apply tags; brand business hours configure availability and timing.

facts.label: Roles and channel permissions
facts.value: Admin and Agent roles; admins manage team/channel access and choose Agent feature permissions. New teammates initially receive existing channels; subsequently added channels require explicit agent access.

facts.label: Startup resource allowance
facts.value: Five team members, three support channels and one Shopify store included.

facts.label: Scale resource allowance
facts.value: Canonical pricing and Shopify listing include 20 members, 10 channels and three stores; alternate help grid lists only 10 agents.

facts.label: Growth resource allowance
facts.value: Fifty members, 25 support channels and explicitly unlimited Shopify stores.

facts.label: Brands and additional resources
facts.value: Channels, signatures and widget settings can belong to separate brands/stores. Numeric brand/domain caps and current canonical prices for extra members/channels are not established.

facts.label: Public help content
facts.value: Store widget supports customer-facing Help Center articles, article search and View All. Up to five articles can be featured on the widget home; remaining articles stay searchable.

facts.label: Help-center limits and domains
facts.value: Total article allowance, standalone hosted portal, custom help domain, private help content and article voting/feedback controls were not established.

facts.label: AI helper role
facts.value: Manual GPT Assistant drafts context-aware replies, rewrites text and offers voice-note transcription. Rewrite/Generate require a paid plan or active trial.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: AI Agent automatically answers incoming Live Chat, Instagram DMs, Facebook Messenger and WhatsApp messages; settings are enabled and saved per channel.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and scope
facts.value: Approved question/answer FAQs, Shopify products and orders, business details and recent conversation context. URL import reads one supplied page rather than crawling a whole website.

facts.label: Import and answer limits
facts.value: CSV import: up to 5 MB or 1,000 entries, Question/Answer header columns; empty pairs skipped. New saved FAQ answers have a 4,000-character limit.

facts.label: Approval and updates
facts.value: Imported FAQs wait for Review & Approve; manually saved FAQs are live immediately. Product and order data sync weekly after setup; product data can also be synced manually.

facts.label: Citations and other source limits
facts.value: Customer-visible source citations, a supported general file library, website recrawl schedule and total FAQ storage limit are not established.

facts.label: AI handoff and history
facts.value: Escalate requests for a person, unsupported/out-of-scope issues and manual-review cases to a chosen user, team or unassigned inbox; add an internal explanation and optional customer handoff message.

facts.label: Guards and no-response handling
facts.value: Up to ten custom handoff rules per channel, 200 characters each. No-response wait minimum five minutes; configure assignment/unassigned follow-up after clarification, or close after an answered query.

facts.label: Manual takeover and outside hours
facts.value: Humans can take over or return a ticket to AI; returning it applies on the next customer message. Chat availability follows business hours; offline customers can leave a message.

facts.label: AI lookups and action boundary
facts.value: Agent can answer product/order/tracking/policy questions. It cannot create/cancel/edit orders, issue refunds, start returns/exchanges, apply discounts, update orders, tag conversations or trigger workflows.

facts.label: Inventory disclosures
facts.value: Exact inventory counts and location-wise availability are off by default and require an admin opt-in, connected Shopify store and enabled product scope; multiple Shopify Markets unsupported.

facts.label: Human Shopify actions
facts.value: Inbox Edit and Refund buttons redirect a human to Shopify to complete the action.

facts.label: Customer identity and approval
facts.value: Exact order-lookup identity checks, abuse controls and approval requirements for disclosing order information are not fully established.

facts.label: Shopify and Shopify Flow
facts.value: Native store data integration and DelightChat action in Shopify Flow. Flow can trigger WhatsApp messages from store events.

facts.label: Zapier and Make
facts.value: Official WhatsApp Marketing API guide documents integration through Zapier Webhooks and Make, formerly Integromat.

facts.label: Other requested connections
facts.value: Native WooCommerce, Stripe, Slack, Discord, Linear and GitHub connections were not established in the checked current product/docs sources.

facts.label: Public marketing API
facts.value: Documented REST endpoint POST https://api.delightchat.io/api/v1/public/message; X-API-KEY authentication; one request/second; sends configured WhatsApp templates using External API Trigger automations.

facts.label: Widget software controls
facts.value: Browser API dcwidget.open(), openLiveChat(), openContactUs(), openRequestCallback(), openTrackOrders(), openFAQs(); documented fragment links open the same screens.

facts.label: General API and outgoing events
facts.value: Full inbox/contact/article CRUD API, outgoing event webhooks, API token scopes and general API plan gates are not established.

facts.label: Self-hosted operations
facts.value: Not applicable to a published vendor-hosted helpdesk offer; no documented server deployment to operate.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: June 2, 2025 release claims 11 languages: Hindi, French, Spanish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), German, Italian, Indonesian, Turkish, Arabic, Russian and English.

facts.label: AI answer language
facts.value: Agent defaults to the customer's language with a fallback; settings can force every reply to a selected language. Manual Assistant release claims all customer languages.

facts.label: Customer surface translations
facts.value: CSAT message, collection page, rating names and thank-you text are manually editable/translatable; one account-wide setup, no automatic customer-language selection. Widget chat labels are editable.

facts.label: Agent devices
facts.value: Hosted browser inbox plus Android and iOS agent apps; official guides link Google Play com.delightchat and Apple app ID 1577703156.

facts.label: Store setup and maintenance dependency
facts.value: Connect Shopify, enable Self Serve Widget under theme App embeds, save in Shopify, verify integration, then enable and save widget sections in DelightChat.

facts.label: Support reports
facts.value: Ticket Summary, All Tickets, Agent Performance, Support Channels, Tag Metrics and Customer Feedback; created/closed/reopened/one-touch tickets, message counts, median first response/resolution times and CSAT.

facts.label: CSAT surveys
facts.value: Manual or automatic on ticket close, configurable delay and selected channels; five emoji ratings plus customer comments. Supports email and message channels, not social comment threads/off-platform tickets.

facts.label: AI review
facts.value: Humans can give thumbs-up/down feedback with a note; unanswered AI queries are captured for AI Knowledge Base review with conversation context.

facts.label: Conversation export
facts.value: Admin Reporting > Conversation Export supports channel/date-range requests, background preparation and download history; any date range is accepted and large ranges are split, skipping already requested periods.

facts.label: Export format and content
facts.value: June 8 announcement specifies downloadable CSV containing back-and-forth customer/team message content for a chosen channel/period. Later self-service announcements do not restate the complete schema or file format.

facts.label: Metrics and feedback export
facts.value: All Tickets can email a ticket-metrics CSV; Customer Feedback can email CSAT results as CSV.

facts.label: Other exit objects
facts.value: Full customer/contact export, original attachment binaries, public articles and AI FAQ library export formats were not established.

facts.label: Hosting and subprocessors
facts.value: Privacy policy says servers are in the United States, identifies AWS cloud computing and describes international transfers. It also names Google Analytics, advertising services and Sentry.

facts.label: AI use and region controls
facts.value: AI model provider, message use for provider training, opt-out, retention by AI provider, selectable hosting region and a public DPA were not established.

facts.label: Post-account retention
facts.value: Privacy policy says no stated purpose requires personal information longer than three months after account termination, subject to legal requirements; backups can remain isolated until deletion is possible.

facts.label: Deletion and access requests
facts.value: Policy allows account deletion/access/correction requests through support@delight.chat and says requests are addressed within 30 days.

facts.label: Export download window
facts.value: Completed conversation exports have a 30-day download window and expiry countdown; after expiry contact support for a re-run.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: DelightChat; hosted customer support and WhatsApp marketing product; active.

facts.label: Store listing alias
facts.value: The vendor's Shopify listing is named DC: WhatsApp Marketing + API, developed by DelightChat.

facts.label: Company and home country
facts.value: Saasberry Apps, Inc., doing business as DelightChat; published address 2093 Philadelphia Pike #1051, Claymont, DE 19703, United States.

facts.label: Store developer address
facts.value: Shopify listing publishes a DelightChat developer address at Gopal Krishna Complex, 45/3 Residency Road, MG Road, Bengaluru, KA 560025, India.

facts.label: Buying restrictions and markets
facts.value: Terms require users to be at least 18 and state the service is not tailored for HIPAA/FISMA-regulated use; use governed by those rules is excluded. No complete supported-buyer-country list found.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted web service, Shopify app integration and agent mobile apps. Terms reserve proprietary rights and grant a limited service-use licence.

facts.label: Startup vendor support
facts.value: Email and WhatsApp; published response target within 24 working hours; onboarding call included.

facts.label: Scale vendor support
facts.value: Email and WhatsApp; published response target within eight working hours; onboarding included.

facts.label: Growth vendor support
facts.value: Email, WhatsApp and call support; target within four working hours; dedicated account manager and onboarding advertised.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026; latest observed update November 2, 2026 groups inbox channels by brand. Our next review target December 4, 2026.

apps.name: Desk365
apps.line: Email ticketing and customer support with a portal and Teams app.

free.text: Free for up to 3 agents and 50 tickets/month

cells.channels: Email, Teams, web forms, customer portal
cells.ai: 100 monthly credits on Plus; extra 1,000 cost $50

agents.math: 1 agent at $16 a month. 100 tickets is more than the free plan's 50-ticket limit.
3 agents at $16 a month each. One account handles 100 tickets.

apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found since January 1, 2025.

facts.label: Permanent free plan
facts.value: Lifetime Free plan, no expiry, automatically begins when a trial ends without upgrading; 50 tickets/month.

facts.label: Free seats and ticket allowance
facts.value: Up to three working agents and 50 tickets per month.

facts.label: Free included tasks
facts.value: Email/shared inbox, Microsoft Teams ticketing, customer portal, web forms/widget, knowledge base, basic workflow automation and Microsoft Entra sign-on are advertised.

facts.label: Other free limits
facts.value: Numeric limits for addresses, brands/sites, articles, storage, retained history and API access were not established. Custom fields/forms/roles/reports are described as restricted on Free.

facts.label: Trial length and card
facts.value: 21 days with paid-plan features; no credit card required. AI setup guide states 100 trial AI credits.

facts.label: Trial ending
facts.value: Without buying a paid plan the account moves automatically to Free. Paid-only features/data may be removed and not automatically recoverable after downgrading.

facts.label: Standard — USD
facts.value: USD 16/agent/month billed monthly; USD 12/agent/month billed annually.

facts.label: Plus — USD
facts.value: USD 28/agent/month billed monthly; USD 22/agent/month billed annually.

facts.label: Premium — USD
facts.value: USD 39/agent/month billed monthly; USD 32/agent/month billed annually.

facts.label: Standard — EUR
facts.value: EUR 16/agent/month monthly; EUR 12/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Plus — EUR
facts.value: EUR 25/agent/month monthly; EUR 20/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Premium — EUR
facts.value: EUR 36/agent/month monthly; EUR 30/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Standard — GBP
facts.value: GBP 14/agent/month monthly; GBP 11/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Plus — GBP
facts.value: GBP 22/agent/month monthly; GBP 18/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Premium — GBP
facts.value: GBP 32/agent/month monthly; GBP 26/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Standard — AUD
facts.value: AUD 26/agent/month monthly; AUD 19/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Plus — AUD
facts.value: AUD 42/agent/month monthly; AUD 33/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Premium — AUD
facts.value: AUD 58/agent/month monthly; AUD 48/agent/month annual billing.

facts.label: Payment, tax and term
facts.value: Subscription fees normally charged in advance for the full term; VAT/sales/service taxes excluded and added as applicable. Major cards accepted; annual subscriptions can also use ACH/wire and purchase-order processes.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Paid agents are staff actively working tickets; submitting customers/employees are not paid agent seats and are unlimited on all plans according to the FAQ.

facts.label: Other meters
facts.value: Free is limited by tickets created per month; paid plans publish attachment-storage allowances and API rate limits; AI Agent has a separate account credit meter.

facts.label: Minimum and setup
facts.value: Pricing says no setup fees; one-agent paid totals can be calculated from the per-agent rate, but an explicit minimum paid-seat quantity or minimum invoice amount was not found.

facts.label: Renewal, cancellation and seat changes
facts.value: Paid subscriptions auto-renew. Cancel through Plan & Billing before renewal; ordinary cancellation takes effect at term end. Additions are prorated immediately; reductions apply at the next billing cycle.

facts.label: AI Copilot price and eligibility
facts.value: AI Copilot included in Plus/Premium at no extra fee; not listed for Standard. AI Agent add-on eligible only on Plus/Premium unless Desk365 expressly enables another plan in writing.

facts.label: Included and paid AI credits
facts.value: Plus 100 free credits/month; Premium 200. Published 1,000-credit packs: USD 50, EUR 45, GBP 40 or AUD 75, using the matching currency selector.

facts.label: Credit consumption
facts.value: Variable consumption depends on input/response length, conversation complexity and features. Setup guide gives a maximum five credits per AI response; exact per-model weights/formula not published.

facts.label: Actual-credit cost examples
facts.value: Our calculation, fresh Plus cycle: 100 total consumed credits need no purchase; 500 total leave 400 beyond the included 100, requiring one advertised 1,000-credit USD 50 pack if no paid balance exists.

facts.label: Answer-volume comparability
facts.value: Exact AI totals for 100 or 500 answers/resolutions cannot be derived from a fixed public credit-to-answer conversion.

facts.label: Free hard stop
facts.value: Vendor's Free-plan description says no additional tickets can be submitted once 50 tickets are created that month; upgrade required.

facts.label: Paid storage and extra-charge gaps
facts.value: Standard 200 GB, Plus 500 GB, Premium 1 TB attachment storage. Additional storage price, numeric paid ticket ceiling, storage hard-stop behavior and general usage overage prices were not found.

facts.label: Paid-credit expiry and loss of eligibility
facts.value: Purchased AI credits do not expire while an active Plus/Premium subscription remains eligible; unused credits become unusable immediately on loss of eligibility, including downgrade, cancellation, non-renewal or non-payment.

facts.label: AI hard stops and recharge
facts.value: Credit purchase is documented after successful payment; configurable auto-recharge, negative balances, zero-credit fallback and a universal hard spending cap were not established.

facts.label: Portal/widget attribution
facts.value: Own logo, colors, title/login options and custom portal domain are documented. Whether every Desk365 attribution mark can be removed, first eligible plan and trial restrictions remain unresolved.

facts.label: Outgoing email attribution
facts.value: Brand and personal signatures are editable; group signatures require Premium. Removal rules for any vendor-added email mark were not established.

facts.label: Buying route and solo access
facts.value: Public self-service 21-day trial; optional demo. Free tier is advertised for solopreneurs and supports up to three agents. Trial link goes to apps.desk365.io.

facts.label: Microsoft dependency boundary
facts.value: Support portal can permit email/password, Microsoft Entra single sign-on or either. Microsoft-only authentication is configurable rather than the only published login route.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: customer-support ticketing/shared inbox and internal service desk, with Microsoft Teams, public help content and optional autonomous AI.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email-to-ticket workflow; default support@tenant.desk365.io address or verified custom support addresses using forwarding and send authorization.

facts.label: Customer portal and web forms/widget
facts.value: Native ticket submission, status tracking and help-article search through Support Portal; embedded iframe forms and a popup ticket widget for websites/intranets.

facts.label: Website/in-app chat boundary
facts.value: AI Agent chat embeds on internal/external websites and in Support Portal on Plus/Premium. Human real-time website chat and native customer mobile SDKs are not established.

facts.label: Microsoft Teams
facts.value: Native Support Bot for requesters and Agent Bot/portal for agents; messages/tickets, replies, notes, attachments and notifications inside Teams.

facts.label: Other customer channels
facts.value: Native WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, SMS, telephone service, Slack and Discord channels were not established in current pricing/channel docs.

facts.label: Shared-inbox basics
facts.value: Ticket assignment/groups, private and public notes, canned replies, filters, bulk actions and creation/update workflow rules on Standard and above.

facts.label: Collision handling
facts.value: Standard/Plus/Premium show alerts when multiple agents respond to the same ticket; notifications appear above the reply editor.

facts.label: Assignment and business hours gates
facts.value: Standard: creation/update rules, SLA reminders/escalations, one business-hours and holiday configuration. Plus/Premium: time-based rules, round robin/load-based routing and multiple business-hours/holiday lists.

facts.label: Brands, addresses and companies
facts.value: Multiple custom support emails can route to groups; branded knowledge content can be segmented by product/company. Paid plans list unlimited contacts and companies.

facts.label: Numeric site/brand limits
facts.value: Exact maximum domains, portals, brands, support addresses, web widgets and deployed AI Agents per account, plus extra-instance prices, were not established.

facts.label: Help center and article limits
facts.value: Standard/Plus/Premium: unlimited articles, public/private knowledge base, categories/folders/sections, search, attachments, article versioning/restore and useful/not-useful feedback.

facts.label: Custom help domain
facts.value: Custom Support Portal domain on Standard/Plus/Premium; add and verify DNS CNAME and obtain SSL. Default pattern is https://tenant.desk365.io/support/.

facts.label: Article publishing and translation
facts.value: Articles support drafts before publication and brand/company-restricted content. Language settings translate system interface strings, not article bodies/custom field labels/notifications automatically.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: Buildable AI Agents answer from assigned knowledge on website, Support Portal and Microsoft Teams; escalation can create support tickets.

facts.label: Copilot role and human review
facts.value: Plus/Premium Copilot drafts/rephrases/corrects/translates replies, summarizes tickets and generates draft KB articles; agents review/replace text and publish articles themselves.

facts.label: Teams AI availability discrepancy
facts.value: AI product FAQ says Teams deployment is coming soon; current setup guide and October release say it is live on Plus/Premium.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources and size
facts.value: Desk365 knowledge-base categories, websites, uploaded files and Q&A; files include PDF, TXT, MD, DOC and DOCX, maximum 50 MB per file in setup guide.

facts.label: Website/source updates
facts.value: Website setup uses starting URL, configured page limit and include/exclude patterns; Sync manually re-crawls updated website content. KB categories have a sync setup step.

facts.label: Approval, citations and sensitive knowledge
facts.value: Agents can be tested before deployment; permissions control source additions/deletions. Customer-visible source citations, mandatory approval of every imported item and precise total source caps were not established.

facts.label: AI-to-human fallback
facts.value: Enable escalation to create a ticket. AI fills subject/description in a configured channel form; contact reviews, edits and submits it, and can switch the selected form.

facts.label: History and off-hours limits
facts.value: Teams ticket updates/replies continue in the same Teams experience; full transcript automatically transferred to an escalated ticket, off-hours queue destination and response-time guarantee were not fully established.

facts.label: Customer actions and identity
facts.value: AI can draft/create support tickets after contact review. Teams sign-in/admin consent identifies contacts, and Allowed Domains restrict access; portal AI can be all visitors, signed-in users or selected companies.

facts.label: External operational actions
facts.value: AI order lookup/refunds/account changes/custom-tool execution and associated approval/identity-verification rules were not established.

facts.label: Microsoft and work-tool connections
facts.value: Native Teams; Microsoft Entra sign-on on paid plans and directory sync Plus/Premium; Intune asset sync Premium. Power Automate connector supports Asana, Microsoft Planner and Azure DevOps workflows.

facts.label: API-based reporting and issue tracking
facts.value: Jira and Power BI are listed as using API; Power Automate and Microsoft 365 Copilot connector listed across paid plans.

facts.label: Other requested stack connections
facts.value: Native Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Slack, Discord, Linear and GitHub customer/workflow integrations were not established.

facts.label: API and authentication
facts.value: API v3 on each tenant's subdomain, documentation path /apis/api-docs.html and request path /apis/v3/; API key in Authorization header. Standard 100 calls/hour; Plus/Premium 50 calls/minute.

facts.label: API pagination wording discrepancy
facts.value: Guide heading says up to 10,000 tickets per call, but detailed body specifies 30/50/100 tickets per call and 10,000 tickets per hour.

facts.label: Outgoing webhooks and widget libraries
facts.value: Paid-plan workflow rules can trigger GET/POST webhooks with selected ticket data/placeholders. Web forms provide iframe snippets; ticket/AI widgets provide embed configuration.

facts.label: Running the server yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the published hosted service; no self-hosted installation/runtime/licence offer established.

facts.label: Interface language counts
facts.value: Pricing/FAQ advertise 30 languages generally. Current language guide specifies 20 Agent Portal options and 34 Support Portal/Support Bot options.

facts.label: Customer language surfaces
facts.value: Portal/Support Bot support 34 locales; documented examples include English US/UK, French, German, Spanish Spain/LATAM, Portuguese Portugal/Brazil, Chinese Simplified, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew and Persian.

facts.label: AI language scope
facts.value: Manual Draft with AI translates into 30 languages; Copilot has a configurable default output language. Autonomous Agent's complete supported-language list and quality guarantees were not found.

facts.label: Agent devices
facts.value: Browser Agent Portal, Teams agent experiences and published Mobile View for iOS/Android across paid plans. Native standalone Windows/macOS/iOS/Android app download routes were not established.

facts.label: Required host/platform setup
facts.value: Website forms/widgets embed into a website or intranet; no Shopify/WordPress/Gmail host requirement established. Teams apps require Teams access, app permissions and applicable Microsoft/Entra configuration.

facts.label: Ticket and productivity reporting
facts.value: Paid plans provide ticket trends, productivity, agent/group/contact/company dashboards and report export. Productivity includes response, completion and SLA timing; CSV downloads documented.

facts.label: Surveys
facts.value: Plus/Premium offer CSAT, star ratings and NPS; trigger on resolved/closed tickets and analyze/download current and previous responses.

facts.label: AI reporting and review metrics
facts.value: Agent dashboard reports responses, confident/unconfident responses, escalation, resolution rate and usage; credit history includes conversation-level consumption and chat history from the last seven days.

facts.label: Ticket CSV export
facts.value: Standard/Plus/Premium: export selected ticket/contact/custom fields and time entries as CSV; date/status/view filters apply. Export active All Tickets and Archived Tickets separately for full coverage.

facts.label: Conversation text and attachments via API
facts.value: API v3 retrieves original description, contact/agent replies, public/private notes, HTML/plain bodies and attachment metadata including name, size, type and URL.

facts.label: Contacts, companies and articles
facts.value: Paid comparison includes contact/company export; API guide documents retrieval of KB categories/folders/articles and metadata. Exact standalone contact/company file schema and one-click article archive were not established.

facts.label: Feedback and scheduled export
facts.value: Survey reports download current/previous responses as CSV on Plus/Premium. Scheduled ticket export is Plus/Premium; ordinary ticket export is available across paid plans.

facts.label: Export security and completeness gaps
facts.value: Since October release, export downloads require a logged-in Agent/Support Portal user. Full attachment bundle, AI repository export and article-feedback export were not found.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: AWS data centers in US and EU; customers can choose data-center location. Teams bots are hosted on Microsoft Azure.

facts.label: DPA and named subprocessors
facts.value: Public DPA; subprocessor list dated February 14, 2026 names AWS, Azure, Stripe, Open AI and Pinecone, for infrastructure, Teams bots, billing, AI and vector search.

facts.label: AI provider training and retention
facts.value: Specific no-training promise, opt-out, model/provider retention periods and precise AI processing-region controls were not established.

facts.label: Free inactivity and cancellation
facts.value: Free accounts with no new tickets for three continuous months are automatically deleted without notice. Admin-email cancellation of Free results in immediate deactivation/deletion and content removal.

facts.label: Paid downgrade and deletion rights
facts.value: Paid cancellation ends at term end and moves account to Free; paid-only data/features may be removed and not restored. Privacy rights requests go through organization admin or help@desk365.io.

facts.label: DPA deletion timing and backups
facts.value: DPA section 9 says delete Company Personal Data copies within ten business days after cessation of relevant processing services. Terms allow residual backup/archive copies without a numeric purge duration.

facts.label: Archive versus deletion; export history
facts.value: Closed/inactive tickets archive after 120 days by default, configurable 15–120 days. Export history exposes the past seven days.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Desk365, active hosted helpdesk; current October 2026 release published October 31 and updated November 2, 2026.

facts.label: Legal owner and country
facts.value: Kani Technologies Inc., incorporated in California, USA, with principal offices in Union City, CA 94587.

facts.label: Eligibility and regional buying
facts.value: Human registration, age of majority and legal capacity required. Account country is associated with the signup location; no complete purchasable-country list established.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted cloud service with web portals, widgets and Teams applications; proprietary limited, non-exclusive, revocable, non-transferable access licence.

facts.label: Vendor help
facts.value: Paid comparison lists 24×7 email support, public help center and migration assistance; Plus/Premium add customer success manager.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. October release, published October 31 and updated November 2, launches Teams AI Agent and safer portal-only export downloads. Our next review target December 4, 2026.

apps.name: Deskpro
apps.line: Multi-channel ticketing and a help center for customer support teams.

cells.ai: Provider usage credits or your own AI account

agents.math: A five-agent minimum at $39 each. Only one agent works, and four seats go unused.
A five-agent minimum at $39 each. Three agents work, and two seats go unused.

facts.label: Free offer
facts.value: No ongoing free production plan published in current Cloud/Private pricing. Public free offer is a 14-day evaluation.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable to a separate ongoing free tier; trial conditions are recorded under F08.

facts.label: Trial duration and payment card
facts.value: Cloud trial: 14 days, no credit card required. Current signup says contact Deskpro for a Private trial; older getting-started article describes 14 days for both editions.

facts.label: Trial limits and expiry
facts.value: Agreement says trial access ends at expiry without payment details and data may be permanently lost. Metered-service trial evaluation can require sales to add Service Credit.

facts.label: Cloud Team
facts.value: $39 per agent/month; minimum 5 paid agents. Includes shared inbox/channels, Help Center, fixed chatbot flows, apps, mobile apps, reporting and Standard Support.

facts.label: Cloud Professional
facts.value: $59 per agent/month; minimum 10 paid agents. Adds Deskpro AI/AI chatbot, Lite Agents, branding removal, expanded brands, advanced voice and Professional Support.

facts.label: Cloud Enterprise
facts.value: $99 per agent/month; minimum 25 paid agents. Adds enterprise services, account manager, sandbox and other listed enterprise capabilities.

facts.label: Current cadence and currency
facts.value: Cloud page states /agent/month without a clear monthly-payment versus annual-payment selector. Older billing doc identifies USD/GBP/EUR by billing country and US-dollar headlines, but current regional currency schedules and annual invoice totals were not established.

facts.label: Old versus current Cloud rates
facts.value: Older billing article starts US$29/agent/month paid annually; old invoice screenshot shows Team $29 annual/$39 monthly and Professional $59 annual/$69 monthly. Current page shows $39/$59/$99 with new seat minimums and no cadence split.

facts.label: Private Team
facts.value: Quote required; 10 agent licences included, maximum 50; DPC, infrastructure support, Apache Tika and 1 staging licence.

facts.label: Private Professional
facts.value: Quote required; 20 agent licences included, maximum 100; Private AI, DPC, infrastructure support and 3 staging licences.

facts.label: Private Enterprise
facts.value: Quote required; 35 agent licences included, unlimited maximum agent capacity; clustering/non-DPC deployment, Private AI and unlimited staging licences.

facts.label: Private Enterprise VPC
facts.value: Quote required; 50 agent licences included, unlimited maximum agent capacity; Deskpro managed service, DPC, clustering, Private AI and unlimited staging licences.

facts.label: Taxes and regional discounts
facts.value: Current agreement makes applicable taxes/duties payable in addition to fees. Older Cloud terms expressly exclude taxes. Current pricing offers volume, nonprofit and educational discounts through contact.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Working-agent seats; one person per account, no account sharing. Current Customer Agreement says added seats are time-adjusted to next renewal; seat reductions affect next renewal without unused-seat refund.

facts.label: Lite Agents
facts.value: Professional includes 50; Enterprise includes 1,000, including Private VPC. Lite Agents can view permitted tickets/add notes/tasks but cannot directly answer users; Team excludes them.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and contract
facts.value: Cloud minimums: Team 5, Professional 10, Enterprise 25. Private included-agent entry packages: 10/20/35/50. Subscription term is specified in the order; no perpetual current licence.

facts.label: AI feature entitlement
facts.value: Generative Deskpro AI/AI chatbot/data sources start at Professional in Cloud and Private tables; Team has a non-generative chatbot/bot-flow offer.

facts.label: Deskpro-managed AI charges
facts.value: Cloud managed connection uses purchased Service Credit and passes OpenAI usage cost through with no added fee, according to May 20, 2025 announcement.

facts.label: Bring-your-own and private AI costs
facts.value: Connect own provider account, or Private deployments can use supported self-hosted models/Bedrock. External provider tokens or private model compute/storage remain separate.

facts.label: AI cost example boundary
facts.value: Exact base plus 100/500 billable AI answers cannot be calculated: usage is provider/model/token based, not a fixed published answer or resolution price.

facts.label: Credits and automatic spending
facts.value: Service Credit funds managed AI, Voice and WhatsApp. Optional Low Balance Top Up automatically replenishes when configured threshold is hit; credit payments are non-refundable under agreement.

facts.label: Voice/channel usage
facts.value: Voice page advertises $0.01 per call charged by Deskpro, with Twilio usage paid separately. Numbers, SMS/WhatsApp and other external services can also generate usage/credit costs.

facts.label: Storage, bandwidth and overages
facts.value: Current agreement permits Cloud storage/bandwidth limitations; numeric current storage caps, overage rates and hard-stop rules not found in current pricing/agreement.

facts.label: Renewal and cancellation
facts.value: Agreement permits charging a card 10 days before licence expiry unless auto-renewal is disabled in billing dashboard; no refund/credit for early termination. Private software stops functioning on expired licence.

facts.label: Help Center attribution
facts.value: Remove Powered by Deskpro starts at Professional; Team explicitly excludes it on both current edition tables. Logo/colors/templates can be customized separately.

facts.label: Chat widget and outgoing email attribution
facts.value: Whether the paid removal feature removes every widget/email vendor mark, and any trial exception, were not clearly established.

facts.label: Buying route and solo eligibility
facts.value: Public Cloud 14-day signup at start.deskpro.com/start, with work email; current pricing also offers tours/contact sales. Private trial requires contacting the vendor. Minimum paid Cloud Team is 5 agents.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: multi-channel support ticketing/shared inbox with customer help content, community feedback, agent assistance and chatbot AI; also used for IT, HR and internal operations.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email ticketing on all current tiers; custom email addresses using Deskpro, SMTP or linked Gmail/Outlook; forwarding route also documented.

facts.label: Website / web-app chat
facts.value: Native live chat through Deskpro Messenger on Cloud and Private; all tiers list chat. Includes multi-chat, transfers, previews and conversation history.

facts.label: Contact forms and portal
facts.value: Native customer Help Center/ticket submission plus dynamic forms embeddable on other web pages; all current plans list forms.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Supported integration converts inbound WhatsApp messages to tickets and sends agent replies back. All tiers list the channel; Service Credit can be required.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Supported inbound/outbound messaging; messages to a designated number create support tickets; automated acknowledgement can include ticket reference.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Integrated inbound/outbound calls, tickets, recordings, voicemail and IVR; advanced monitoring/routing controls are promoted with Professional/Voice Premium scope.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Supported ticket submission/forms/status/replies inside Slack; /deskpro ai can answer from supplied knowledge when AI is enabled.

facts.label: Microsoft Teams
facts.value: Supported ticket creation from chats/channels, structured requests, status updates and replies; appears on all current plan tables.

facts.label: Facebook / Instagram
facts.value: Social channel table describes Facebook/Instagram support; release 2026.2 confirms Instagram comment deletion from tickets.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Native Discord customer-ticket channel not established.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Assignment/teams/queues, private agent notes, mentions, snippets, ticket history, drafts and collision detection/ticket locking.

facts.label: Rules and business hours
facts.value: Triggers, escalations, macros, follow-ups, round robin/least-utilized routing, work shifts, SLAs and auto-replies; shared-inbox page says no plan-based automation count limit.

facts.label: Help Center / brand allowances
facts.value: Current Cloud and Private Team: 3 multi-brand Help Centers; Professional: 10; Enterprise and Private Enterprise VPC: unlimited.

facts.label: Mailboxes, sites and separation
facts.value: Shared-inbox page says no limit on email accounts/aliases. Brands can have own Help Center content/logo/custom domain and department-specific workflows. Separate maximum website/widget/phone-number counts not published.

facts.label: Workspaces and shared agents
facts.value: Professional allows one agent licence shared across 3 workspaces/accounts; Enterprise unlimited. Team excludes this shared-agent entitlement; all tables list workspace navigation feature.

facts.label: Knowledge/help content
facts.value: Searchable KB, multi-page guides, News, downloadable files and Community; public/internal/usergroup-restricted content, article suggestions during ticket creation, comments and helpfulness ratings.

facts.label: Custom domain and translation
facts.value: Brand configuration supports custom domain, unique content and templates; KB supports publishing articles in multiple languages.

facts.label: Content capacity
facts.value: Numerical maximum article/guide/news/community-topic/file-storage allowance and extra content-capacity price not established in checked current sources.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Agent summaries/drafts/tone/grammar/article drafting; automatic intent/sentiment triage; knowledge-grounded chatbot and fixed branch-based Chatflows.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and selection
facts.value: Help Center content, website sources and PDFs; newer release news also supports snippets as AI knowledge. Administrators choose AI connections/sources for the feature/chatbot.

facts.label: Source refresh and review
facts.value: Web-source guide describes page counts, crawl logs/status, next crawl time and viewing captured content. Exact universal refresh cadence, page/PDF/size caps and guaranteed answer citations were not established.

facts.label: Human review / guardrails
facts.value: Assisted drafts are reviewed/sent by agents; chatbot replies are automatic within selected flow. Cloud pricing marks AI Guardrails SOON, while Private Enterprise/VPC table lists it.

facts.label: Human fallback and history
facts.value: AI chatbot can route answered-but-unhelpful or unanswered questions to configured next steps, including human support. Live chat transfers/escalations become tickets with conversation history; missed chat tickets support follow-up.

facts.label: Customer lookup / agent actions
facts.value: Shopify/WooCommerce apps expose customer/order information and edits; Chatflows can collect names/emails/phones and support account lookups.

facts.label: Autonomous writes and verification
facts.value: A named autonomous refund/change-account tool, mandatory end-customer verification and compulsory per-write approval were not established.

facts.label: Commerce integration subset
facts.value: Official Shopify app: customers, orders/fulfillment, order/customer edits and preferences. WooCommerce: customer/order views, edits and order notes.

facts.label: Developer/team integrations
facts.value: GitHub issue creation/linking/views; Linear issue creation/linking/edits/comments; Slack/Teams workflows; Zapier listed for automation.

facts.label: Public API
facts.value: REST/JSON API v2 and custom apps available across current plans. Official reference documents agent-linked keys, permissions/tags, pagination and date-versioned routes.

facts.label: API limits and current permissions
facts.value: Reference supports per-key hourly/daily limits plus a Cloud global anti-abuse limit, returning HTTP 429; exact current numeric global ceiling not stated. Release 2026.5 enforces key tag restrictions and says default keys can no longer delete records.

facts.label: Webhooks and browser widget
facts.value: Webhook actions can run through triggers/escalations/SLAs/macros with chosen HTTP method/custom data. Messenger documented embed exposes DESKPRO_MESSENGER_OPTIONS and a loader script.

facts.label: Private setup and stack
facts.value: DPC manages containerized Deskpro instances, nginx proxy and services. Documented paths: supported Linux script, VMware/Hyper-V/VirtualBox VM image, or cloud marketplace. MySQL/Elasticsearch/S3 can be external.

facts.label: Exact current runtime and sizing
facts.value: A complete current CPU/RAM/disk sizing table and exact application/runtime/database version matrix were not verified.

facts.label: Backups and upgrades
facts.value: Customer Agreement makes self-hosted backups/customer infrastructure the buyer's responsibility. DPC guide describes optional daily backups including an attachments toggle, manual backups and pre-upgrade backups.

facts.label: Maintenance and paid dependencies
facts.value: Current Private packages include DPC/infrastructure support; clustering/non-DPC deployment listed on Enterprise/VPC. AI access starts at Professional with separate provider/private model costs.

facts.label: Interface languages
facts.value: March 2023 release article explicitly lists Arabic, French, German, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Portuguese PT, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish for agent/Help Center; additional customer locales include Bulgarian, simplified Chinese, Danish, Dutch, Greek, Polish and Slovenian.

facts.label: Content, widget and AI language scope
facts.value: KB supports multiple article languages; Messenger example has language ID/locale. Release 2026.3 improves non-English search/AI replies/summaries. Current complete per-surface locale lists not established.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Browser-based agent/customer access; native Android/iOS agent apps, free to download with a paid/evaluation helpdesk. Server requirements apply only to Private/operator deployment.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Built-in/custom reports with DPQL builder, dashboards, SLAs, ticket/agent/time metrics, scheduled report sharing and satisfaction feedback; Data Export appears on all current tiers.

facts.label: AI review and content feedback
facts.value: AI usage guide describes Admin > AI Setup & Logs > AI Logs and per-feature permissions. KB supports views/comments/helpfulness ratings; AI chatbot flow distinguishes helpful/unhelpful/no answer.

facts.label: Tickets / conversation export
facts.value: Official guide documents report export to CSV/PDF, about 2,500-ticket batches and about 55-field report limit; recommends API for larger outputs. Separate message-report guide can include ticket message text.

facts.label: Customer export
facts.value: User-report example exports user ID/name/email/organization, optionally address and phone, through Stat Builder.

facts.label: Attachments / complete Cloud export
facts.value: Exact current bulk attachment-download procedure, attachment contents of a Cloud export and a complete self-service Cloud database backup were not verified.

facts.label: Articles and community data portability
facts.value: Bulk article translations, Community topics/votes/comments and satisfaction-feedback export formats were not established from checked current sources.

facts.label: Cloud region choice
facts.value: Team/Professional: US, EU or UK standard region choice. Enterprise current pricing promotes a paid global data-center upgrade across 22 AWS regions.

facts.label: Region exceptions and private processing
facts.value: Hosting policy: Voice currently US-hosted; third-party channels/apps, billing, support/admin and monitoring data may leave chosen core region. Private deployment location is operator-selected.

facts.label: AI provider / training policy
facts.value: AI page says Deskpro does not use customer data to train public AI models. Supports own provider, Deskpro-managed connection and Private models/Bedrock over PrivateLink.

facts.label: Published subprocessors and privacy scope
facts.value: Processor list names AWS, Twilio, Google, SparkPost, Cloudflare, Pusher, Linode, Elasticsearch, Hetzner, SendGrid, New Relic and PostHog with scoped functions/locations.

facts.label: Cloud backups / deletion
facts.value: Security page: account backups retained 60 days after leaving; primary data deleted immediately on request; encrypted offsite copies rotate out every 60 days; primary recovery window 35 days.

facts.label: Export window and account lifecycle
facts.value: Current agreement allows account/data deletion on termination and says trial data may be lost at expiry. DPA provides return/delete at completion but no fixed current self-service export window.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Deskpro remains an active support platform. Current deployments are Deskpro Cloud and Deskpro Private; Deskpro Horizon is its current generation.

facts.label: Deskpro Legacy v5 end of life
facts.value: Deskpro Legacy, formerly Deskpro v5, reached end of life on 2025-06-30. Technical support, product support, documentation, security updates, and patches ended.

facts.label: Current owner and country
facts.value: Current Customer Agreement names Deskpro, Inc., a Delaware corporation, including affiliates. About page calls Austin, Texas its global headquarters and lists a London office.

facts.label: Older contracting page
facts.value: Separate Terms of Service, dated September 3, 2025, names Deskpro Ltd, UK company number 04249340, for Cloud service. Current trial links to the newer Customer Agreement naming Deskpro, Inc.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Business use; privacy policy says products are not offered for personal/family/household use. Customer Agreement restricts prohibited exports, embargoed countries and listed prohibited parties.

facts.label: Hosting editions
facts.value: Deskpro Cloud is vendor-hosted. Deskpro Private can run on-premises, in a private/sovereign cloud or VPC; Enterprise VPC includes a Deskpro managed-service offer.

facts.label: Exact self-hosted licence
facts.value: Proprietary, limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable subscription licence under Customer Agreement sections 2.4 and 6. Licence expires unless renewed; software automatically ceases functioning, and copies must be removed.

facts.label: Installation and attribution rights
facts.value: Default self-hosted licence permits one live accessible installation at a unique URL, unless additional licences/appropriate plan allow more. Test installations are plan-limited and non-public. Attribution stays unless appropriate upgrade removes it.

facts.label: Team / Professional support
facts.value: Support terms: web/email/chat in business hours. Team initial response targets N/A; Professional severity 1/2/3 targets 4 business hours / 1 business day / 2 business days.

facts.label: Enterprise support
facts.value: Terms list web/email/chat/phone and 24×7 coverage; severity 1/2/3 initial targets 1 hour / 4 business hours / 1 business day. Pricing marks Support SLA a paid add-on.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Research checked November 4 to 5, 2026 UTC. Latest listed application release: 2026.5, October 5, 2026. Controller news lists DPC 2.27, April 15, 2026. Our proposed next review: 2026-12-05.

apps.name: Desku
apps.line: Shared inbox for email, live chat, social messages, and help content.

free.text: Free for 2 agents, 1 inbox, 1 chat widget

cells.channels: Email, website chat, social and ecommerce channels
cells.ai: BYOK or $59/month for up to 5M tokens

agents.math: The free plan has two agents and unlimited conversations, subject to fair use and 200 profiles.
One Growth workspace covers three agents and 100 conversations a month.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Free Forever, displayed $0/month. Separate paid plans have time-limited trials.

facts.label: Free included counts
facts.value: Two agents, two hundred customer profiles, one shared inbox, one chat widget, one condition-based chatbot and one knowledge base.

facts.label: Free core capabilities
facts.value: Plan table explicitly marks email, custom email domain, live chat, full conversation history, transcript access, notes, files, canned replies, working hours, portal and unlimited conversations for Free.

facts.label: Free content/AI boundaries
facts.value: One KB with articles/categories/search/customization/feedback; no-code bot, AI-generated answers and templates marked included. AI knowledge training begins Growth in the table; exact Free AI token allowance is not given.

facts.label: Trial period and payment conflict
facts.value: Homepage advertises fourteen days with no credit card; pricing FAQ says paid plans require payment verification with a refundable $1, and site footer says paid signup requires a card and billing begins after fourteen days.

facts.label: Trial end state
facts.value: Pricing says choose paid continuation or cancel to Free; remove/reduce features beyond Free limits. Trial includes add-ons, but post-trial add-on conversion/charge-selection details are not fully described.

facts.label: Growth price
facts.value: Displayed $39/month monthly or $390/year annual. Card includes six agents, 5,000 profiles, five shared inboxes, one widget/bot and Eva/BYOK features.

facts.label: Growth capacity conflict
facts.value: Growth plan card says six agents; pricing FAQ describes Growth as up to five agents.

facts.label: Advance price and capacity
facts.value: Displayed $79/month monthly or $790/year annual; twelve agents, 50,000 profiles, unlimited shared inboxes, two widgets/two bots, social/ecommerce features.

facts.label: Business price and capacity
facts.value: Displayed $179/month monthly or $1,790/year annual; twenty-five agents, 200,000 profiles, unlimited inboxes, two widgets/two bots and ten advanced rules; more agents can be purchased.

facts.label: Annual discount discrepancy
facts.value: Toggle says two months free and annual totals equal ten monthly fees; FAQ calls that effectively ten percent off.

facts.label: Currency and tax
facts.value: Prices display $. ISO currency code was not established in pricing/markup, docs or terms. Terms explicitly exclude applicable taxes/duties/government charges.

facts.label: Billing units
facts.value: Flat prepaid workspace/plan with bundled agents/profiles/inboxes; only Business can add agent seats at $10/agent/month. Copilot is separately $29/seat/month.

facts.label: Counting definitions
facts.value: Exact profile identity-merging/reset rules, viewer/admin seat treatment and plan-specific fair-use conversation thresholds were not found.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Ongoing Free requires no paid purchase; lowest paid plan is one Growth bundle at $39/month or $390/year. No numeric minimum team or mandatory paid setup fee is published for it.

facts.label: Renewal and plan changes
facts.value: Subscriptions renew at current rates unless cancelled/auto-renew disabled beforehand; cancellation stops future renewal, with access through paid term. Upgrades immediate/prorated; downgrades next billing period.

facts.label: Managed Eva tokens
facts.value: Eva AI token add-on $59/month includes up to five million tokens/month; FAQ describes capacities from five million up to fifty million, without all higher bundle prices.

facts.label: BYOK and provider charges
facts.value: Paid cards advertise unlimited Eva use with the buyer's own key; official comparison says usage billing then comes from that provider rather than Desku. No managed-token overage fee is published.

facts.label: Copilot charge and gate ambiguity
facts.value: Copilot is $29/seat/month with unlimited BYOK usage; Advance/Business cards say eligible, while matrix marks agent-assist from Growth. Exact earliest purchasable Copilot entitlement is not reconciled.

facts.label: AI at 100 and 500 answers
facts.value: Exact totals cannot be computed. Known monthly managed-token component: Growth $39 + Eva token pack $59 = $98/month, if eligible and actual token use stays within five million/month.

facts.label: Exhaustion and extra capacity
facts.value: At the managed AI token limit, FAQ says Eva stops being effective until next cycle or add-on purchase; rest of service keeps working. Customer-profile limits trigger upgrade notification near capacity.

facts.label: Other add-ons
facts.value: Live visitor basic tracking includes first 250/month; paid from $9/month for 10k to 100k visitors. Business extra agents $10 each/month. Journey history is in Advance/Business, distinct from current-page tracking.

facts.label: Refunds and late payment
facts.value: Terms and pricing say subscription fees are non-refundable except law; cancellation leaves paid-period access. Failed payment can lead to retries, restriction/suspension or termination, with outstanding fees still owed.

facts.label: Branding eligibility conflict
facts.value: Advance card advertises White Label & CNAME, as does Business; widget comparison's White Labelling row is checked only for Business. KB custom domain row includes Advance/Business.

facts.label: Surface rules not published
facts.value: Complete widget/help-center/outgoing-email vendor-credit removal rules, first qualifying plan, fee and trial exception were not established beyond the conflicting plan labels.

facts.label: Solo access
facts.value: Self-service Free and paid fourteen-day trial routes. Free includes two agents; paid Growth is a flat bundle, with no sales-required solo minimum displayed. Enterprise custom needs use sales.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted shared help desk/inbox, live chat, social customer messaging, knowledge base and AI/no-code support automation for SMBs, ecommerce and SaaS.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Shared email included in all plan-table columns; default Desku mailbox, SMTP/IMAP, business Google Workspace OAuth, Outlook/Hotmail beta and bulk email-account configuration documented.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: Native customizable widget in Free and paid tiers; one widget Free/Growth, two Advance/Business. Copy generated code into head/body; offline messages can follow business/agent hours.

facts.label: In-app chat and SDK
facts.value: Pricing lists Chat SDKs for Advance/Business; public docs advertise a JavaScript object for user updates/messenger control.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Matrix lists one Facebook page on Advance and three on Business; dashboard has Messenger/comment channel reporting.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: One Instagram account on Advance, three on Business; dashboard documents DM/comment categories where supported.

facts.label: WhatsApp Business
facts.value: Business includes WhatsApp Business API connection. Guide requires admin, Meta Developer account, Facebook Business Portfolio and a verified WhatsApp number; messages arrive in the shared inbox.

facts.label: Telegram
facts.value: Business matrix includes one connected Telegram account for receiving/replying within the inbox.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Advance/Business integration row describes agent ticket/update notifications, and replies only if supported.

facts.label: Voice/calls
facts.value: Aircall is marked Advance/Business in matrix; description says calls/voicemails alongside conversations where supported.

facts.label: SMS and Discord
facts.value: No native customer SMS or Discord channel, setup or fee schedule was established.

facts.label: Ticket forms and portal
facts.value: Customer portal and chatbot custom input fields are marked all plans; ticket/form configuration and contact management are described by dashboard documentation.

facts.label: Core collaboration
facts.value: All plan columns include triage, working hours, notes, canned responses, files and complete conversation history; Advance/Business add round-robin and CSAT.

facts.label: Business hours and routing
facts.value: Configure business days/hours plus individual agent hours; those drive SLA/live-chat behavior. Widget can route to agent/department or use balanced distribution.

facts.label: Automation and collision
facts.value: Growth/Advance have limited ticket automation; Business card lists ten advanced rules, SLA and ticket collision. Bot conditional flows are one Growth, three Advance, ten Business.

facts.label: Inboxes, widgets and products
facts.value: Free one inbox/widget/bot; Growth five inboxes and one widget/bot; Advance/Business unlimited inboxes with two widgets/two bots. Knowledge bases one/one/one/Multiple.

facts.label: Store connection capacities
facts.value: Matrix lists Shopify/WooCommerce one store in Free, blank Growth and three Advance/Business; Ecwid/Shopline one Free/Growth and three Advance/Business.

facts.label: Help center features
facts.value: One KB included Free/Growth/Advance; Business Multiple. All columns include articles/categories, customization, search and article feedback; Growth+ multilingual content/AI/SEO; Advance+ custom domain.

facts.label: Knowledge-base limits
facts.value: Exact article/storage quotas, supported help-article language list, custom-domain setup details and separate-domain-per-brand capacity were not fully published in checked accessible sources.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Eva autonomously answers inside a published chatbot flow; no-code condition bots, AI drafting/writing, summarization/classification and Copilot agent assistance are also described.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and file limits
facts.value: Public URLs, live published English Desku articles in a collection, private snippets, PDF/TXT/CSV up to five MB, custom answers, ecommerce product content and external data connectors.

facts.label: Conversation learning/review
facts.value: Admin enables selected agents' closed-conversation snippets; choose immediate use or pending review. Agents can improve an answer; authorized reviewers edit/approve/reject; Eva Content shows source, language, use count and status.

facts.label: Sync and citation unknowns
facts.value: A fixed source resync schedule, total source/character quota and required citation format for every generated answer were not found.

facts.label: Human handoff
facts.value: Eva node has a human-support switch with Talk to agent; customer can ask for a person. Context-based/manual department selection routes via the department's agent-assignment rule.

facts.label: Offline behavior and history
