facts.value: Documentation-chatbot solution advertises Discord deployment; no detailed Discord installation/plan/fee guide found in the checked integration/bot material.

facts.label: Customer channel / SMS
facts.value: Older subscription documentation lists an SMS Notifications add-on, measured in messages, for alerts/updates.

facts.label: Customer channel / voice
facts.value: Self-hosted documentation lists optional LiveKit/voice-agent worker, requiring speech recognition, language model and text-to-speech.

facts.label: Customer channel / WhatsApp
facts.value: No direct supported customer-channel guide, current plan gate or price found.

facts.label: Customer channel / Instagram
facts.value: No direct supported customer-channel guide, current plan gate or price found.

facts.label: Customer channel / Messenger
facts.value: No direct supported customer-channel guide, current plan gate or price found.

facts.label: Customer channel / ticket forms
facts.value: In-app help readers can submit native support tickets; Premium lists support tickets. Hosted forms are separately quota-limited from Hobby upward.

facts.label: Native ticket workflow
facts.value: Assignment to a Docsie user, staff replies in Activity, Open/Pending/Closed status, close/reopen behavior, originating page/deployment and requester details are documented.

facts.label: Pending status definition
facts.value: The same ticket guide defines Pending as awaiting the customer in its dashboard table and as awaiting team action in its detailed view explanation.

facts.label: Other inbox coordination
facts.value: Private notes, saved replies, collision warnings, customer-email rules and business-hours routing are not established by the checked ticket, chatbot or plan docs.

facts.label: Sites, products and brands
facts.value: Free/Hobby/Starter: 1 workspace, 2 portals and 2 custom domains. Premium and higher: unlimited workspaces, portals and domains; custom branding from Premium.

facts.label: Extra-resource limits
facts.value: No public add-one-portal/domain rate or numeric support-inbox/phone-number allowance found; current plans use bundles and custom Enterprise terms.

facts.label: Help center, versions and publication
facts.value: Published portals serve selected shelves/books/versions/languages and expose search, feedback, optional AI assistant and dark mode. Version control and 100+ content languages are listed for all hosted plans.

facts.label: Custom domain and SSL
facts.value: Custom-domain setup verifies DNS and links a domain to the correct deployment; Docsie automatically provisions/renews SSL through AWS.

facts.label: Private content and permissions
facts.value: Deployments can use password or advanced JWT protection and an authorization fallback URL. Publishing guide says advanced security cannot be disabled after enabling it.

facts.label: Feedback and translation
facts.value: Portal features include feedback collection; analytics records ratings/NPS and written feedback. Readers can use language/version pickers; automated translation has separate quotas and credit costs.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Authoring assistant edits/generates content; Video/PDF/website imports create docs; RAG search and customer chatbot answer from documentation; MCP can run permitted content workflows.

facts.label: AI knowledge and scope
facts.value: Customer chatbot guide chooses a workspace as its data source; Docsie supports video/files/websites and a structured deployment JSON/RAG route for documentation retrieval.

facts.label: Review, refresh and source limitations
facts.value: Authoring/publishing supports draft/review then release and portal refresh. No complete source-size limits, automatic refresh schedule or per-answer citation guarantee found for customer chatbot answers.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: AI solution pages claim smart routing/human handoff; concrete ticket guide gives a human contact route from in-app help with page/deployment context.

facts.label: Handoff history and hours
facts.value: No explicit bot-to-ticket transcript payload, automatic escalation threshold, no-agent behavior or customer-support business-hours schedule found.

facts.label: AI actions and authorization
facts.value: MCP can read/export and, with separate permission packs, edit/publish docs and change publishing/access settings. OAuth is workspace-scoped; create/edit/publish permissions are off by default.

facts.label: Developer and support connections
facts.value: Business lists Confluence/GitHub/GitLab connectors plus Slack, Jira, HubSpot, Salesforce and Zendesk. Zendesk guide surfaces Docsie articles inside support tickets.

facts.label: Automation and other builder stack
facts.value: Webhooks support Slack/Mattermost/Teams/custom targets; MCP connects supported AI tools. A Zapier guide says its app is private at present.

facts.label: Public API and gates
facts.value: Public Docsie Partner API schema covers articles/books, exports, files and users; pricing lists 500 calls on Free/Hobby/Starter, 50K Premium, 100K Business/Organization and 500K Enterprise.

facts.label: Webhooks and MCP
facts.value: Webhooks from Premium: publishing/job/workflow events, HMAC-SHA256 signature, 10-second response timeout, up to five retries. MCP available on every plan, Free included.

facts.label: Self-host requirements
facts.value: Kubernetes, persistent storage, Helm 3, kubectl and compatible application/converter images; chart includes PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO and App Search/Elasticsearch. Local/hosted AI endpoints configured separately.

facts.label: Sizing, upgrades and release limits
facts.value: Sizing guide offers 4 CPU cores/16 GiB as an initial basic test target with search, not a validated minimum; model capacity is additional. Back up data/keys before upgrades; rollback does not undo DB migrations.

facts.label: Content, portal and translation languages
facts.value: Pricing says 100+ languages for documentation; AI guide lists Spanish, French, German, Japanese, Arabic and Portuguese among supported translation languages. Portal language/version pickers are configurable.

facts.label: Operator and AI-answer language scope
facts.value: Docsie documents an Interface language picker distinct from generated-document output language; no complete operator UI/widget/AI-answer language matrix found.

facts.label: Platform and devices
facts.value: Hosted editing/portals are web-based; published content can be embedded on an existing site. Self-hosted app requires Kubernetes; Business+ offline-reader builds are separate deployment artifacts.

facts.label: Native customer/agent apps
facts.value: No dedicated Docsie support-agent mobile/desktop client or native iOS/Android help SDK established in the checked docs.

facts.label: Reports and export definitions
facts.value: Analytics covers visits, country sessions, page views, search keywords/searched articles, feedback and NPS-over-time, with CSV exports. Business adds broken-link/missing-translation reports.

facts.label: AI/ticket-report gaps
facts.value: No complete ticket response-time report definition, autonomous-resolution attribution, analytics retention period or customer-bot failed-answer export found.

facts.label: Article and bulk exports
facts.value: Book export supports DOCX, PDF, Markdown and additional Docsie JSON; shelf export can select books with a chosen version and language.

facts.label: Feedback/report export
facts.value: Web analytics guide explicitly supports CSV downloads of keywords, searched articles, page views, visits/countries and collected feedback.

facts.label: Migration completeness and ticket exports
facts.value: No documented full support-ticket transcript/contact export, attachment bundle/revision-preserving migration schema or all-object restore guarantee found.

facts.label: Hosting and regions
facts.value: Hosted service uses AWS; privacy policy says personal data from outside Canada is transferred to and processed in Canada. Enterprise/self-hosted can use chosen infrastructure.

facts.label: AI providers and paid-content policy
facts.value: Security/privacy name OpenAI, Anthropic, Jina AI, Mistral AI and Groq. Paid content is not used for shared-model training; MSA describes business API opt-outs and generally up to 30-day provider abuse-monitoring retention.

facts.label: Free-content training conflict
facts.value: Privacy policy updated November 3, 2026 says no Customer Content training on any plan; August security page says Free Community uploads/outputs may train shared Docsie/Dokuta models.

facts.label: DPA and processor specifics
facts.value: Security page offers DPA on request. No full public DPA, complete per-service subprocessor/region mapping or fixed provider/model routing found in checked sources.

facts.label: Deletion process
facts.value: Account removal is documented under Personal/Dangerous settings, with confirmation and an emailed OTP; privacy rights include contacting Docsie for deletion/access/portability.

facts.label: Retention and export window
facts.value: Privacy retains personal data as needed for legal/service purposes; exact hosted content/ticket retention, post-cancellation export grace, backup overwrite and inactivity-deletion intervals not published in checked sources.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Docsie, docsie.io; currently offered documentation, customer knowledge-base and training platform with AI workflows, hosted plans and a self-hosted distribution.

facts.label: Shutdown, sunset, acquisition and names
facts.value: No shutdown, sunset, acquisition or mandatory migration notice found in checked official sources. Dokuta is named as part of Docsie AI; no separate replacement product identity established.

facts.label: Self-hosted licence change
facts.value: The self-hosted repository licence effective 2026-09-08 permits personal and commercial use within 10 workspace users and 25 named portal users, and says it supersedes older terms in the distribution.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Docsie Inc., Delaware, US; services delivered by Canadian subsidiary Likalo Limited. Self-hosted licence names Likalo LLC as grantor.

facts.label: Markets and regional arrangements
facts.value: No complete country buying-restriction list or country-specific hosted price table found; current pricing explicitly uses USD.

facts.label: Hosted versus offline-reader editions
facts.value: Hosted workspace and published portals; Business/Organization include air-gapped documentation builds, while Enterprise offers a customer-owned instance/cloud/hybrid/air-gapped deployment.

facts.label: Exact self-hosted licence
facts.value: Proprietary Docsie Self-Hosted Application License, Free Tier, effective September 8, 2026; no open-source licence to application/images. Deployment scripts/charts may be copied/modified to operate a properly licensed copy.

facts.label: Vendor support and named support plans
facts.value: Pricing lists support tickets from Premium and dedicated training at Enterprise. Published Support Plan separately lists Basic free, Standard USD 2,500/year and Premium starting USD 6,000/year.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle evidence
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05: current hosted pricing, privacy policy last updated November 3, 2026, self-host licence effective September 8, 2026 and preview v0.2.0-preview.5 release notes.

facts.label: Next review
facts.value: Our suggested next review: 2026-12-05, earlier if pricing, licence/image distribution or free-content training terms change.

apps.name: Drag
apps.line: Turns Gmail into a shared support inbox with chat and AI agents.

cells.ai: 50 credits per AI resolution; $0.01 per extra credit

agents.math: 1 seat at $16 a month, with one support email and 100 conversations.
3 seats at $16 a month each, with one support email and 100 conversations.

apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found since January 1, 2025.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: No permanent free plan. Seven-day trial only, then a paid plan.

facts.label: Free limits
facts.value: Not applicable to an ongoing free tier. Trial limits are recorded separately.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Seven days, no card; all Pro features, including API/MCP, with 1,000 AI credits per seat.

facts.label: After the trial
facts.value: Exact expired-trial UI access, history availability and trial-specific deletion/reactivation deadlines were not established.

facts.label: Starter
facts.value: USD 16/user/month with monthly payment; USD 12/user/month billed yearly. No seat minimum or published user ceiling.

facts.label: Plus
facts.value: USD 22/user/month monthly; USD 18/user/month yearly. Includes 1,000 monthly AI credits per paid seat.

facts.label: Pro
facts.value: USD 30/user/month monthly; USD 24/user/month yearly. Includes 2,000 monthly AI credits per paid seat.

facts.label: Payment cadence and taxes
facts.value: Monthly fees are charged every thirty days in advance; annual fees every year in advance. The buyer is responsible for applicable taxes/duties/fees.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Per working user seat for the service; a team-wide AI credit pool for native AI actions. External MCP clients use their own AI plan, not Drag credits.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: One seat; monthly or annual billing. No mandatory setup fee or AI purchase established for basic paid email/human chat. Google mailbox/domain costs remain separate.

facts.label: Credit allowances
facts.value: Starter: no included AI balance, manual Copilot available with bought credits. Plus: 1,000 credits/seat/month. Pro: 2,000/seat/month. Credits are pooled across the team.

facts.label: Classification and knowledge-search units
facts.value: Tag an email: 0.1 credit, USD 0.001. Help Center AI answer: 0.5 credit, USD 0.005. Chat translation: 1 credit/message, USD 0.01.

facts.label: Staff assistance and chat units
facts.value: Reply draft, thread summary or board triage: 2.5 credits each, USD 0.025. Website AI answer: 5 credits, USD 0.05. Copilot question/task including its actions: 10 credits, USD 0.10.

facts.label: Autonomous resolution unit
facts.value: Pro Agent: 50 credits, USD 0.50, for a conversation it finishes end to end with the customer's question answered and no team member taking part.

facts.label: External AI cost
facts.value: Connecting an external assistant through Drag MCP does not spend Drag AI credits. The assistant's own plan/usage costs remain external.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: Our calculation, Pro and only qualifying autonomous resolutions: 100/500 monthly resolutions need USD 30/230 extra credits for one seat, or USD 0/190 for three seats.

facts.label: Credit reset and expiry
facts.value: Included credits reset on the first of each calendar month without rollover. Bought credits do not expire and are used after included credits.

facts.label: Low balance and controls
facts.value: Email sync/sending remain available at zero credits; AI tagging keeps running. Drafts/new Varley questions pause; Help Center search falls back to articles without its AI summary.

facts.label: Purchase minimum and other overages
facts.value: Starter/top-up text says from USD 10, but the pack section also says no minimum. A smaller-than-USD-10 purchase route and ordinary inbox/conversation/storage overage tariff were not established.

facts.label: Renewal and cancellation
facts.value: Monthly/annual charges renew automatically in advance. Cancellation is requested through the linked cancellation form; access lasts through the paid period. Paid service/AI credits are non-refundable except charges made after the cancellation request.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: Pro can remove the Powered by Drag chat mark. Starter/Plus retain it; logo, color, name and greeting customization exist on all plans.

facts.label: Help Center branding
facts.value: Custom logo/colors on all plans; custom domain and vendor-badge removal on Pro.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Complete removal of every Drag mark/footer from outgoing emails and the first qualifying plan were not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service trial at https://app.dragapp.com/signup, Google sign-in, and paid plans without seat minimums. One working owner can buy one seat.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared inbox and email workflow boards, with task collaboration, WhatsApp, website chat, public help content and support AI. Overlaps team productivity and knowledge bases.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native Gmail/Google Workspace shared accounts, aliases and Google Groups on all paid plans.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native widget and shared Live chat board on every paid plan; pricing marks the feature Early Access. Human chat has no per-chat fee.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: The same script can run in a web product on the configured website. A native customer iOS/Android SDK or authenticated-user signing scheme was not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native shared WhatsApp Business conversations on Pro; connects a business number and puts conversations on boards. Free-text replies use the 24-hour window; approved templates are documented outside it.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: A named Instagram inbox, setup requirements and current plan gate were not established.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: A native Facebook Messenger customer channel was not established.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: No ready-made SMS customer channel, number offer, carrier tariff or entitlement established.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: No native customer phone/calling channel or included phone-minute plan established.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Slack alerts via Zapier are documented; a native bidirectional Slack customer queue was not established.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No named ready-made Discord customer-support connector established.

facts.label: Ticket/contact forms
facts.value: A standalone native ticket-form builder was not established. Live chat explicitly has no pre-chat form or button-driven chatbot flows.

facts.label: Core collaboration
facts.value: All paid plans: assignments, internal notes/team chat, @mentions, shared drafts, templates, tasks/checklists, activity visibility and collision detection.

facts.label: Rules and routing
facts.value: Starter: up to ten rules. Plus/Pro: unlimited rules. Auto-responder starts on Plus; round-robin/load balancing and reply-based automations are Pro.

facts.label: Business hours and SLAs
facts.value: Pro provides business hours, SLA rules and associated escalation/routing controls.

facts.label: Sites, brands and inboxes
facts.value: Multiple real/shared accounts, Google Groups and boards are documented. Every plan has no user ceiling. Numeric account/board/site/Help Center/brand limits and extra-unit prices were not established.

facts.label: Public help content
facts.value: Native public Help Center with article/category search, drafts/publishing, rich text/images/embeds, brand customization and imports. AI search starts on Plus; custom domain/badge removal on Pro.

facts.label: Article limits and feedback
facts.value: Numeric article/storage/site limits, native article-translation management and article-rating/feedback quotas were not established.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Varley Copilot answers staff and proposes actions; Assists draft/classify/summarize; Intelligence retrieves context; Pro Agents can resolve autonomously. Website AI answers are a separately priced chat surface.

facts.label: Staff/Agent knowledge
facts.value: Intelligence lists Gmail/WhatsApp history, Help Center articles, Notion, Confluence, Drive, websites and files. Pricing gives Plus links/FAQs and Pro links/FAQs/files.

facts.label: Chat knowledge and review
facts.value: Website AI answers only from Help Center articles explicitly enabled for AI. Staff see which article supplied an answer; disabled AI sources can remain publicly readable.

facts.label: Freshness, citations and caps
facts.value: Intelligence claims continuous source sync and source citations; the Help Center shares knowledge with Gmail drafts. Fixed resync SLA, total source/context limits and native AI-file maximum size were not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Chat hands over when a visitor requests a person, confidence is below the selected level or the configured answer limit is reached. Staff take over in the same chat with history; AI stays out after a person replies.

facts.label: Away and follow-up
facts.value: If an identified visitor leaves, staff replies can reach them by email with a link to resume the chat for thirty days. Pro adds business hours, online status and an away message collecting email.

facts.label: Actions and approval
facts.value: Copilot proposes changes and waits for approval, with up to fifty cards in one approved step. Pro Agent can act autonomously inside its configured brief, including connected refund/order/ticket workflows; its published example issues a Stripe refund.

facts.label: Customer verification
facts.value: Website chat can join contact history after the visitor supplies an email. A verified-email/cryptographically signed customer identity scheme or universal authorization step for sensitive Agent actions was not established.

facts.label: Google and workflow integrations
facts.value: Native Gmail, Google Groups, Calendar, Drive and WhatsApp. Zapier is included in the plan comparison; the directory documents Slack alerts, Stripe events and CRM/ticket automation through Zapier.

facts.label: Commerce and development tools
facts.value: Intelligence/Agents name Stripe, Shopify, Linear, Jira, HubSpot, Salesforce and Zendesk as connected action systems.

facts.label: Other requested connections
facts.value: Dedicated WooCommerce, GitHub, Discord and Make connectors and their current gates were not established.

facts.label: REST API
facts.value: Pro only. API-key authentication in the Authorization header; base https://app.dragapp.com/v2/. JSON endpoints cover boards, columns, cards, comments, tags and email sequences.

facts.label: Rate limits and libraries
facts.value: REST documents HTTP 429 and exponential backoff but no numeric request quota in the checked public reference. Official REST SDKs/CLI are labelled Coming soon.

facts.label: MCP
facts.value: Pro: hosted MCP endpoint or optional local Node adapter. Tools inherit existing Drag permissions; documentation warns that the API key grants full workspace access.

facts.label: Widget and webhooks
facts.value: Website script is public. A general outgoing webhook event catalogue, signing/retry contract and webhook quotas were not established.

facts.label: Running Drag yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the core shared-inbox service: no self-hosted backend edition established.

facts.label: Optional local bridge operation
facts.value: Official MIT adapter package requires Node.js 18 or newer, a Drag API key/Pro access and an MCP client. Hosted connection is an alternative.

facts.label: Agent and article languages
facts.value: A complete agent-interface locale list and native linked-article translation workflow were not established. Help Center search demonstrates cross-language retrieval, such as Spanish queries matching English articles.

facts.label: Chat and AI language support
facts.value: Live chat can translate messages in both directions for one AI credit per translated message. No complete supported-language list or language-by-language guarantee established.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Chrome/Gmail extension, standalone web app without an extension, macOS download, iPhone and Android apps. Desktop page labels Windows download Coming soon.

facts.label: Operational reports
facts.value: Reports cover cards, activity, tags/SLAs, users, first/average response and resolution times. Reporting windows: Starter three months; Plus six; Pro twelve. CSV export on Plus/Pro.

facts.label: AI review
facts.value: Agent traces are searchable/timestamped and show classification, retrieval, actions and sends. Copilot proposals can be rejected; the AI page says failed steps stop rather than silently proceeding.

facts.label: Satisfaction and quality scores
facts.value: A native CSAT survey/report, comprehensive AI-quality scoring system and full ratings export were not established.

facts.label: Conversation text
facts.value: Pro MCP documents get_thread returning an individual email's full HTML body and get_whatsapp_conversation returning a card's ordered WhatsApp message history.

facts.label: Board metadata and notes
facts.value: Pro REST can read board/column/card metadata and retrieve a comment by ID as JSON. MCP also reads cards/comments.

facts.label: Contacts
facts.value: Pro MCP can search contacts and retrieve their conversations. A documented complete customer/contact CSV/JSON export, including all fields and bulk enumeration, was not found.

facts.label: Articles
facts.value: Pro MCP lists articles and retrieves full article content through get_article. A native bulk article export format/media package was not established.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: A documented complete bulk binary-attachment export with conversation/article associations was not established.

facts.label: Reports and feedback
facts.value: Plus/Pro can download reports as CSV. Complete CSAT/AI-rating datasets and an export of every autonomous action/audit event were not established.

facts.label: Hosting location
facts.value: Security says customer data is hosted on AWS in Virginia, United States; privacy says servers/central database are in the US. No buyer-selectable region established.

facts.label: Current DPA/subprocessors
facts.value: Current Trust Center contents, including the linked DPA and current subprocessor details, could not be read: HTTP 403.

facts.label: Native AI training and retention
facts.value: Terms disclose processing through AI subprocessors and limit use of content to providing the service or legal requirements. A specific native-model training policy, provider retention period and model-region choice were not established.

facts.label: Cancellation and email history
facts.value: Access continues for the remaining paid month/year after cancellation. Gmail remains the source mailbox and the security page says Drag does not store email content on its own servers.

facts.label: Inactivity
facts.value: After six months without logging in, Drag reserves the right to disable or terminate the account and may reassign its username.

facts.label: Deletion and export timing
facts.value: Privacy provides access/rectification/deletion requests through access@dragapp.com. Exact deletion completion, backup purge and post-termination export windows were not established.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Drag, also styled DragApp, active Gmail-centered shared inbox. Varley names its integrated AI across Copilot, Agents, Intelligence and Assists.

facts.label: Company and markets
facts.value: DragApp.com Ltd, incorporated in England and Wales, United Kingdom; registered number 10835737. No complete buying-country or WhatsApp-number coverage list established.

facts.label: Main edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted service with Chrome extension, web and mobile/desktop clients. No self-hosted Drag backend edition established.

facts.label: Optional MCP adapter
facts.value: The official @dragapp/mcp-server adapter is MIT-licensed and can run locally; it connects to the hosted Drag workspace.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: All plans: email and knowledge-base support. Plus/Pro add in-app chat/live-call support and onboarding; Pro adds priority support. API docs list support@dragapp.com.

facts.label: Freshness and changes
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04; AI credit tariff explicitly dated 2026-11-04; terms 2026-10-13 and privacy 2026-09-03. Our suggested next review: 2026-12-04.

facts.label: AI at 100 and 500 answers
facts.value: Exact costs cannot be calculated from answer counts alone. Known Echo base AI licence fee is 0; optional one-site AI Pro $55/year. Provider tokens, context, indexing/storage and model choice remain variable.

facts.label: Renewal and expiry
facts.value: Annual licences auto-renew unless cancelled. Add-ons keep existing features after expiry but lose updates/support; compatibility may later change. Lifetime means product lifetime.

facts.label: Provider stops and extras
facts.value: AI setup documents insufficient provider credits and provider rate-limit errors; those are managed in the provider account. No Echo auto-recharge/credit-pack tariff or inactivity-deletion threshold found.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: Widget colours/text and KB templates can be customized. An explicit all-surfaces vendor-credit removal policy or first eligible tier was not found.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Free WordPress.org install; self-service paid bundles and individual add-on purchase pages. A solo owner can use the free plugin or a one-site licence.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: WordPress self-service help centre/docs/FAQ with optional grounded AI chat/search and paid customization, access and export modules.

facts.label: Customer channel / email
facts.value: AI human handoff displays a contact form and sends the AI conversation with the request; Help Dialog integration also offers a contact form.

facts.label: Customer channel / website chat
facts.value: Free optional AI Chat widget provides automated answers; Preview/Public modes and per-page placement are documented.

facts.label: Customer channel / in-app web surfaces
facts.value: WordPress blocks/shortcodes place KB/search on pages; Help Dialog integration can place contact/FAQ widgets on admin pages.

facts.label: Customer channel / WhatsApp
facts.value: Native WhatsApp support messaging integration not found.

facts.label: Customer channel / Instagram
facts.value: Native Instagram customer messaging channel not found.

facts.value: Native Messenger support channel not found.

facts.value: Native Discord support conversation integration not found.

facts.value: Contact form available through Help Dialog integration and documented AI handoff; handoff can include transcript.

facts.label: Inbox workflow
facts.value: Not applicable to a native shared inbox. Core is article/FAQ knowledge software; content editing/access roles do not supply ticket assignment, agent notes or collision detection.

facts.label: Sites and knowledge bases
facts.value: Free core supports unlimited websites/articles. Paid module licences have named site counts; Multiple KBs supplies unlimited separate KBs within licensed sites.

facts.label: Multisite and staging
facts.value: Each multisite sub-site needs its own module key activation. Recognized local/test/staging sites do not consume the production licence count, subject to licence FAQ configuration rules.

facts.label: Public help centre
facts.value: Articles, FAQs, live search, tags/categories, navigation/TOC, glossary and quizzes run within operator’s WordPress site/domain.

facts.label: Private knowledge and access limits
facts.value: Access Manager restricts categories/articles by WordPress user/role/group. Its page says downloadable media links are not protected, WPML is not supported by Access Manager, and direct database-reading third-party plugins can bypass controls.

facts.label: Feedback and search upgrades
facts.value: Ratings module adds five-star or like/dislike modes and optional written feedback stored as WordPress comments; Advanced Search adds filters/search analytics.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Core: visitor answers, Ask AI search and basic content/tag/readability analysis. AI Pro: richer source ingestion, gap analysis, quiz/glossary generation and smart search.

facts.label: AI sources and privacy boundary
facts.value: Core uses public KB articles. Pro adds pages/public posts/CPTs, PDFs and internal AI Notes. Training docs exclude private articles/posts and say Access Manager does not protect AI training data.

facts.label: AI sync and review
facts.value: Training collections support selecting records, explicit sync and optional validation that checks missing/orphaned provider files. Chat has Preview before Public and selectable collection per location.

facts.label: Source/citation limits
facts.value: A hard documented source-size allowance, guaranteed auto-refresh schedule, every-answer citation promise and per-answer approval gate were not established.

facts.label: Human fallback behavior
facts.value: Dedicated handoff guide: negative-feedback or human/support keywords expose contact form; submitted request includes conversation.

facts.label: Handoff eligibility/status conflict
facts.value: AI Technical Details lists handoff as Pro and elsewhere calls live-agent handover coming soon. AI Features page puts Human Handoff under a section introduced as free; dedicated setup guide describes it as available.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Authenticated order/refund/account-changing tools, customer identity checks and transactional approval flows were not found.

facts.label: Connections
facts.value: WPML/Polylang for KB translation; Elementor and other WordPress builders; Help Dialog contact/FAQ widget; PDFs/files/external URLs via Links Editor.

facts.label: Relevant stack gaps
facts.value: Native Shopify app, Stripe customer-data integration and Slack/Discord/Linear/GitHub support workflows were not established.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: Documented WordPress custom article hooks and blocks/shortcodes; versioned AI source declares epkb-admin/v1 and epkb-public/v1 REST namespaces.

facts.label: API/webhook gaps
facts.value: No complete public management API reference, event-webhook contract, rate table or native mobile SDK found in checked developer/setup/module pages.

facts.label: Runtime and installation
facts.value: Current core 17.311.1: WordPress 5.3+, PHP 5.6+; readme tested up to 7.1, listing says 7.1.4. WordPress plugin install and setup wizard/block/shortcode paths.

facts.label: Operator responsibilities
facts.value: Operator maintains WordPress host, files/database backups, updates, mail delivery and model-provider access. Paid key enables module updates/support.

facts.label: Languages
facts.value: Listing has 18 available plugin locales; vendor supports frontend label translation, WPML/Polylang and RTL admin/frontend styling. Exact AI-answer language list not established.

facts.label: Platform and devices
facts.value: Browser-managed WordPress plugin with responsive web KB/widget. Echo FAQ says WordPress.com Business required; WordPress.com’s current plugin guide says all paid plans allow plugins.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Core views/basic search counts; paid Ratings feedback analytics and Advanced Search popular/empty queries; AI Pro content gaps and daily activity emails.

facts.label: Article XML export
facts.value: Separate Import/Export add-on: XML includes articles/meta, categories/meta, tags, author mapping and attachment references. Media downloads during import from reachable source URLs.

facts.label: Article CSV export
facts.value: Import/Export CSV contains title, body, categories without hierarchy, and tags.

facts.label: Configuration and backup
facts.value: KB configuration can be exported/imported independently; cross-KB synchronization needs Multiple KBs. Full backup also needs WordPress files/database and custom module tables.

facts.label: Exit gaps
facts.value: Complete AI chat/customer exports, analytics/feedback dump formats and remote provider-store export/deletion coverage were not established.

facts.label: Local and provider data
facts.value: Articles/configuration use WordPress database structures; AI sends selected content to the chosen provider’s training/vector store and processes requests there.

facts.label: Vendor account data
facts.value: Echo privacy policy says customer/account information is stored in US data centres, with limited cases in Canada.

facts.label: AI policy gaps
facts.value: A complete named AI subprocessors list, region choice and product-specific no-training promise were not found in checked setup/terms/privacy pages.

facts.label: Local deletion evidence
facts.value: Uninstall source performs full KB deletion only when a specific delete-all-data transient is set; otherwise its unconditional cleanup is narrower. AI messages source contains an age-based conversation deletion function.

facts.label: Retention unknowns and requests
facts.value: Fixed installed chat retention, backup purge/provider-file deletion deadlines and inactivity export window were not established. Echo policy allows account-data correction/deletion requests and says EEA rights requests receive response within 30 days.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Echo Knowledge Base; active WordPress plugin. Package header also uses Knowledge Base for Documents and FAQs; current listing uses Documentation, FAQs, Chat & Smart Search. No actual closure, sunset or acquisition notice found.

facts.label: Operator and country
facts.value: Echo Plugins; privacy policy describes a software company headquartered in Vancouver, Canada. Policy also gives a US postal contact address.

facts.label: Legal entity and restrictions
facts.value: Full incorporated legal name/registration number and a complete country purchase eligibility/exclusion list were not established.

facts.label: Core edition and exact licence
facts.value: Self-hosted WordPress plugin; versioned 17.311.1 source/readme state GPL version 2 or later (GPL-2.0-or-later).

facts.label: Commercial modules
facts.value: Paid add-ons are separately installed WordPress components. Active annual or product-lifetime key governs updates/support. A component-specific public software licence for commercial packages was not found in checked sales/terms pages.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Technical support page: 7am–4pm PST, Monday–Friday, often weekends. Free core support available; add-ons require active key. Docs FAQ also advertises seven-day help within a day.

facts.label: Freshness and next check
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; free stable 17.311.1 released October 17, 2026. Proposed next review 2026-12-05.

facts.label: Enterprise and tax
facts.value: Enterprise: custom quote. Published prices exclude applicable VAT, GST and similar taxes.

facts.label: Base billing unit
facts.value: Per working user. All four user-based plans include unlimited tickets. Added users are charged pro rata, then at the full rate next cycle.

facts.label: Read-only role and entitlement
facts.value: Read-only users cannot reply, leave notes or change tickets. Pricing includes 2 on Professional and unlimited on Enterprise; guide requires 4 or more than 4 paid users, depending on section.

facts.label: Minimum seats and payment term
facts.value: Calculator accepts a minimum of one agent. Monthly and annual subscription options exist; annual payment is in advance.

facts.label: Setup and compulsory extras
facts.value: No compulsory setup fee or mandatory AI purchase found for a basic Essential email account.

facts.label: Autonomous AI rate and currencies
facts.value: AI Agent access included in every plan; usage is 0.99 per billable outcome in each of USD, EUR and GBP calculator currencies.

facts.label: AI Agent counted outcome
facts.value: One charge/ticket. A completed action counts immediately; a reply counts after 72 hours without customer reply, further human reply or another ticket from the same shopper.

facts.label: Chatbot counted outcome
facts.value: Chat begins/ends with chatbot, no human transfer or follow-up ticket; AI checks answer sufficiency; no other ticket from that shopper on any channel within 24 hours.

facts.label: AI Assist subscription
facts.value: Per agent/month: USD/EUR 39 monthly or 30 annual equivalent; GBP 32 monthly or 27 annual equivalent.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: At the USD pay-as-you-go rate, 100/500 actual billable outcomes cost USD 99/495 extra. Monthly Essential totals: one user USD 154/550; three users USD 264/660.

facts.label: AI billing and Outcome packs
facts.value: Outcomes billed at month end. Optional prepaid packs refresh monthly on monthly plans, or arrive for the year upfront on annual plans; excess outcomes still bill monthly at 0.99.

facts.label: AI budget stopping rule
facts.value: No monthly outcome limit by default. Buyer can set a limit that pauses automations; already-sent replies can still become billable after their 72-hour window.

facts.label: Translation subscription
facts.value: Per agent/month: USD/EUR 21 monthly or 19 annual equivalent; GBP 18 monthly or 16 annual equivalent.

facts.label: WhatsApp extra fees
facts.value: Guide quotes $50/month per connected number on all plans, plus provider fees after a claimed first 1,000 free messages/month.

facts.label: Talk fees and automatic tier changes
facts.value: $10/month line rental plus bundles: 500 minutes $29; 1,000 $49; 2,000 $79; 3,000 $109. Crossing a tier automatically bills the next tier.

facts.label: Cancellation and refunds
facts.value: At least 14 days' written notice before next billing date to avoid the next charge. Later notice can trigger another billing period. Paid fees, including advance payments, are not refunded on buyer cancellation/downgrade.

facts.label: 30-day eDesk Guarantee
facts.value: Pricing promises a workload-reduction guarantee; indexed FAQ limits it to the first base-subscription period after going live, with setup, channel connection and active use required.

facts.label: Fair use and other unpublished limits
facts.value: Terms subject unlimited offers to fair use, giving standard examples of 100 users and 100 sales channels, with possible excess charges. Numeric ticket/storage/history caps and inactivity-deletion timing not found.

facts.label: Chatbot branding
facts.value: Product-page plan block markets chatbot branding removal under Growth. Exact controls, ordinary live-chat coverage and trial exceptions not established.

facts.label: Help-center and email branding
facts.value: Help-center HTML/CSS/logo can be customized; outgoing channel/company signatures exist. Explicit permission and first plan for removing all vendor branding remain unestablished.

facts.label: Buying access

facts.label: Email

facts.label: Website and web-app chat
facts.value: Native browser widget, associated with a channel; live human chat and optional chatbot.

facts.label: WhatsApp

facts.label: WhatsApp outbound/template rules
facts.value: New setup guide supports proactive templates; pricing guide says business-initiated conversations are not supported.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Business account connected to Facebook Business Page; DMs, mentions and post comments enter eDesk. Comments checked every 15 minutes.

facts.label: Facebook/Messenger
facts.value: Facebook Business Page direct messages, wall posts, comments and paid-ad interactions.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native eDesk Talk add-on; separate Aircall integration also documented.

facts.label: SMS

facts.label: Slack and Discord customer channels
facts.value: No documented incoming Slack or Discord customer-support channel found.

facts.label: Contact/ticket forms
facts.value: Widget can show an offline contact form. Knowledge-base eDesk layout can expose a ticket-submission form linked to a selected channel.

facts.label: Ownership, notes and saved replies
facts.value: One ticket owner at a time; manual/bulk/rule assignment; private notes and mentions; reusable templates and snippets.

facts.label: Collision handling
facts.value: Smart Inbox documents collision detection when agents work through tickets.

facts.label: Rules, hours and SLA timers
facts.value: Rules/templates across current plans; pricing gates auto-responder/SLA timers to Growth+. Chat has agent online hours and configurable offline form behavior.

facts.label: Connected stores/marketplaces
facts.value: Essential 1; Growth 5; Professional 10; Enterprise unlimited, subject to terms' fair-use rules.

facts.label: Extra stores
facts.value: Per extra store/month: USD 25 monthly or 23 annual equivalent; EUR 25/21; GBP 21/17.

facts.label: Brands, websites and numbers
facts.value: Enterprise markets multibrand workflows. A chat widget can run on multiple websites when its Allowed Domains field is blank. Talk allows one number/account.

facts.label: Help articles and search
facts.value: Hosted knowledge-base libraries, categories/subcategories, draft/published articles, keyword/AI-assisted search and optional password protection.

facts.label: Domain, styling and translations
facts.value: Default library URL https://edesk-support.com/<library>/; custom domain supported through DNS; HTML/CSS/logo customization. Each library has a language; no built-in article translation tool in the guide.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: AI Agent handles customer tickets using procedures, policies, knowledge and order context; chatbot handles browser conversations through a flow builder.

facts.label: Agent AI role
facts.value: Separate AI Assist adds draft replies, summaries, composition, classification, sentiment and suggested templates.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources and limits
facts.value: Website/library imports, individual pages, eDesk knowledge base, authored text, PDF and SKU files; product feeds for Shopify, Magento, BigCommerce and Shopware. Website import: 10,000 pages; PDF/SKU files: 10MB.

facts.label: Knowledge refresh and publication
facts.value: Website/product-feed libraries sync every 24 hours and on demand. Individual-page imports can be refreshed manually; source articles can be unpublished to exclude them from AI.

facts.label: Grounding and approval
facts.value: AI Agent 3.0 claims source-grounded facts and automated QA. Admins/team leads choose content, procedures and exclusions; human delay/interception is configurable.

facts.label: AI Agent fallback
facts.value: Low-confidence, sensitive or excluded queries pass to the human team in the existing ticket. Human reply can cancel a scheduled automatic reply.

facts.label: Chatbot/offline fallback
facts.value: Flow nodes can transfer to an agent or create a ticket, with different actions inside/outside configured hours. Offline widget can show a contact form or be hidden.

facts.label: Human ecommerce actions
facts.value: Connected Shopify supports partial/full item refunds, cancellations and replacement orders inside eDesk, subject to agent permissions.

facts.label: Autonomous actions and controls
facts.value: Procedures can accept/refuse returns or cancellations and trigger configured refunds/return labels. Conditions, routing and gates can require information, confirmation or human escalation.

facts.label: Customer verification/custom action scope
facts.value: No universal authenticated-customer rule or complete public matrix of AI refund/action permissions found.

facts.label: Ecommerce connections
facts.value: Native Shopify and WooCommerce connections bring customer/order context into tickets; marketplace directory includes Amazon/eBay and others.

facts.label: Email, shipping and voice connections

facts.label: Developer-tool connections
facts.value: Native Stripe, Slack, Discord, Linear, GitHub, Zapier or Make integration setup not established in checked official directory/guides.

facts.label: API limits

facts.label: Webhooks and customer libraries
facts.value: No general outbound webhook reference or native iOS/Android customer chat SDK established. Generic widget code and Shopify widget-ID installation are documented.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched hosted help desk.

facts.label: Agent interface and support translation
facts.value: Agents choose a preferred UI/message language and languages they understand. Translation add-on translates incoming/reply text; live-chat guide claims over 100 languages.

facts.label: Widget and article languages
facts.value: Widget has configurable preset-message language; knowledge-base language is set per library, with no article translation tool in the guide.

facts.label: Browser/platform needs
facts.value: Hosted browser account; email/store access as applicable. Generic HTML widget, Shopify app embed and WordPress/WooCommerce installation routes documented. Talk recommends Chrome.

facts.label: Agent mobile/desktop applications
facts.value: Product /app/ page describes ticket/order/review insights. Current native iOS/Android download links, desktop clients and full mobile ticket/chat handling were not established.

facts.label: Reports and plan gates
facts.value: Performance reporting Growth+; custom dashboards Professional+ on current pricing. CSV report extracts Professional/Enterprise in docs.

facts.label: CSAT availability and behavior
facts.value: Pricing cards/table show Growth+, but pricing description and CSAT guide say Professional+; guide also names legacy Performance+. Surveys cover resolved email/live-chat tickets.

facts.label: AI review
facts.value: AI Insights tracks automated conversations, billable outcomes, costs and helper use. AI Agent guide lists knowledge/procedure gaps and activity logs.

facts.label: Contacts out
facts.value: Enterprise API has paginated List Contacts. Cursor pagination reaches the complete list; page-based access stops at 10,000.

facts.label: Conversation text and attachments
facts.value: Read Ticket can return grouped message IDs; Read Message returns body and attachment metadata/links.

facts.label: Reports and feedback extracts
facts.value: Professional/Enterprise produce CSV extracts for tickets, chats, chatbot Q&A, agents, channels, AI automations, feedback and more. Download links expire after 30 days; reports can be regenerated.

facts.label: Complete exit package
facts.value: One-click full account export, help-article export, attachment completeness and cancellation grace/export window not established.

facts.label: Hosting/subprocessors
facts.value: DPA names Amazon Web Services EMEA Sarl for cloud hosting. Privacy notice describes UK/EEA processing and possible supplier transfers outside those areas.

facts.label: Region choice and provider coverage
facts.value: Exact production/backup regions, customer-selectable residency and a complete current AI-provider/subprocessor list not established.

facts.label: AI data use
facts.value: AI FAQ says its OpenAI implementation does not retain submitted data on OpenAI servers or allow learning from queries. Terms allow eDesk to store/use AI outputs to improve its AI technologies.

facts.label: Customer-level erasure
facts.value: Admin can start permanent customer erasure. Personal details, message content, AI suggestions and attachments are removed/redacted; ticket/order shells and nonpersonal metrics remain.

facts.label: Termination and retention timing
facts.value: DPA provides deletion/return on written direction at termination, subject to legal retention. Notice gives purpose-based retention rather than a fixed account-history period.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: eDesk; active vendor-hosted ecommerce help desk.

facts.label: Earlier name and related products
facts.value: Founded as xSellco; rebranded to eDesk in 2021. Repricer and Feedback belong to the same product family.

facts.label: Legal company and home country
facts.value: xSellco Limited; incorporated in Ireland; registered office in Dublin.

facts.label: Offices, currencies and regional access
facts.value: Contact page calls New York its global headquarters and lists Dublin, London, Cork and Derry. Calculator publishes USD, EUR and GBP rates.

facts.label: Calling restrictions
facts.value: eDesk Talk supplies US/Canada numbers only; one number/account; international calls possible; no number porting in the checked guide.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Hosted subscription service under a proprietary SaaS licence. Store integrations connect to eDesk; no self-hosted help-desk edition established.

facts.label: Buyer support
facts.value: Published 24/7 email/chat/phone contact and knowledge base; support@edesk.com. Professional adds assisted onboarding; Enterprise dedicated account manager.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. AI Agent 3.0 labelled Autumn 2026; public updates include Facebook Promoted Posts. Our suggested next review: December 4, 2026.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Paid channel included in current omnichannel list.

facts.label: SMS/text
facts.value: Paid channel through a Twilio SMS-capable number; replies are sent back from Enchant.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Paid call-center channel through a voice-capable Twilio number; incoming/outgoing calls become shared-inbox work.

facts.label: Slack and Discord customer intake
facts.value: Slack integration sends activity notifications; no two-way customer Slack intake or dedicated Discord support channel found.

facts.label: Ticket/contact forms
facts.value: Messenger can collect a message when no agent is available; public KB can enable a contact form routing to its associated inbox.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Assignment, private notes, canned responses and collision indicators; paid offers workflow automation.

facts.label: Automation and service targets
facts.value: Event-based rules can route, assign, label, move, change status or trash tickets; time-based conditions can implement response/escalation targets.

facts.label: Business-hours scheduling
facts.value: Complete business-hours/holiday calendar and timer-pausing policy not found in the checked workflow and Messenger guides.

facts.label: Sites, brands and inbox separation
facts.value: Free: 3 Messengers, 3 KBs and multiple inboxes. Paid: multiple brands/channels/inboxes, with no numeric paid Messenger/KB cap established.

facts.label: Commerce and phone unit limits
facts.value: Shopify and WooCommerce integrations explicitly allow unlimited connected stores; voice integration says no limit to phone-number connections.

facts.label: Public/private knowledge content
facts.value: Native KB can be public or internal, associated with an inbox, with an optional form and embedded Messenger.

facts.label: Search, domains and customization
facts.value: Messenger searches KB articles. KB supports custom domains with CNAME to supplied .enchanthq.com address and automatically managed SSL.

facts.label: Article limits and feedback
facts.value: Numerical article/storage limits and native article-rating/translation-workflow specifications not found in checked KB docs.

facts.label: Staff AI roles
facts.value: Writer drafting, translation, summaries, automatically prepared drafts and label/canned-response suggestions; Starter and Standard differ in feature access.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: AI Agent beta answers and closes customer conversations; published Agent guide restricts it to live chat, not email/other channels.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Per-inbox knowledge-base public articles, past customer conversations and website sources; multiple KB sources can be configured.

facts.label: Website refresh and cap
facts.value: Website source automatically recrawls weekly; maximum 1,000 pages per crawler, with base URLs confined to one subdomain.

facts.label: Citations and approval controls
facts.value: Drafts can be edited/rejected before sending; comprehensive source citations, KB sync frequency and approval queue for learned conversation insights not established.

facts.label: Human fallback and history
facts.value: AI Agent hands off when unable to resolve; customer can request a person. If nobody is online, it takes a message.

facts.label: Async AI availability
facts.value: Agent guide says live chat only; newer-looking Messenger mode guide says AI Agent can auto-assign to asynchronous messaging chats.

facts.label: Customer context and actions
facts.value: Shopify/WooCommerce show customer details and recent orders matched by email; no documented autonomous refund/account-changing AI tool or verification/approval system found.

facts.label: Commerce connections
facts.value: Built-in Shopify and WooCommerce customer sidebar integrations, no additional Enchant integration charge in their guides.

facts.label: Slack notifications
facts.value: Built-in Slack app can send selected events, including replies or satisfaction ratings, to channels with a link back to the ticket.

facts.label: Automation connection
facts.value: Zapier supports creating Enchant customers/tickets and triggering outside actions on ticket creation.

facts.label: Other named stack connections
facts.value: No dedicated Stripe, Linear, GitHub or Discord connector found in the official current integration list.

facts.label: REST API and limits
facts.value: Public JSON REST API with account-wide 100 credits/minute and secondary burst limit of 6 requests/second.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: JSON HTTP POST event notifications signed with Enchant-Signature, SHA256 HMAC using a shared secret.

facts.label: Messenger developer access
facts.value: JavaScript API via enchant variable; identify/clearIdentity, configuration, open/close and availability callbacks.

facts.label: Self-host operation
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched offer: Enchant API docs describe a fully hosted service.

facts.label: Customer-facing languages
facts.value: Messenger supports 20+ languages; KB and satisfaction interfaces use the associated inbox's language, documented as 20 built-in languages.

facts.label: AI languages
facts.value: AI Summarize accepts conversations in any language but currently produces English summaries; AI writing can use inbox-specific spelling preferences.

facts.label: Agent interface locale list
facts.value: Complete supported agent-interface locales and full AI translation-language list not found in checked guides.

facts.label: Devices and platform requirements
facts.value: Responsive web app on desktop/tablet/phone; iOS install through Safari; Android options include Chrome install and Google Play.

facts.label: Operational reporting
facts.value: Paid includes full reporting; docs index lists Ticket, Performance, Team, Happiness and AI reports. Free includes basic reporting.

facts.label: Customer satisfaction
facts.value: Three-point Great/Okay/Not Good ratings on email replies; optional freeform comments; responses can be rated within 15 days.

facts.label: AI reporting
facts.value: Shows feature usage, assisted resolutions, user activity and estimated time saved. Assisted resolution requires an AI feature used during ticket lifetime.

facts.label: Customers and ticket text
facts.value: API lists customer/contact records and tickets in JSON; embedding messages provides replies and private-note body text.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: App downloads individual files, with Download all for more than four attachments; API documents attachment metadata rather than a binary download response.

facts.label: Reporting export
facts.value: Report exports in CSV or Excel; generated file link is emailed to the requesting user's profile email.

facts.label: Articles, ratings and full migration-out
facts.value: A complete KB article export, raw satisfaction-comment export and full portable account archive not found in checked docs/API.

facts.label: Hosting and regional choice
facts.value: Security page says AWS cloud hosting; privacy says Canadian operations and possible onward transfers worldwide. Exact AWS region/customer region selector not published.

facts.label: AI data training boundaries
facts.value: AI docs say training data is used only for models serving that account, not other teams/shared models; agreements prevent third-party model training.

facts.label: Processing agreements and providers
facts.value: Account owner can review/accept a DPA inside account Legal settings; public privacy lists provider categories and Stripe billing.

facts.label: Ticket trash and archive
facts.value: Trashed tickets automatically deleted after 30 days; admin can permanently delete earlier. Closed tickets archive after configurable delay, default one month.

facts.label: Account closure and export window
facts.value: Closure immediately removes access/stops billing and schedules permanent deletion; no exact account deletion or backup purge deadline published.

facts.label: Ordinary retention
facts.value: Paid pricing promises Full Data Retention; privacy retains information while active/as needed, with legal/tax/dispute exceptions.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Enchant; actively marketed hosted support platform operated by Senvee Inc.

facts.label: Shutdown, sunset or acquisition notices
facts.value: No relevant official notice found in the checked About, product and blog pages or initial official-domain notice search.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Senvee Inc; operates out of Canada. Terms apply Canadian and Ontario law.

facts.label: Buying and phone-market restrictions
facts.value: No complete buyer-country eligibility list or supported calling/SMS country matrix found.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Fully hosted web service with limited proprietary use rights; Messenger embed, hosted knowledge bases and mobile/browser access.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Email and live chat support, including Free accounts; can be contacted at any time. No staffed-hours/time-zone or guaranteed response target found.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Research checked 2026-11-05; current pricing and detailed AI Agent/Campaigns beta docs visible. Our suggested next review: 2027-02-05.

facts.label: Dated current release
facts.value: No current numbered product release/date or dated lifecycle transition found in checked product, About, blog and help center.
