facts.label: New-account free offer
facts.value: New accounts get a temporary 14-day trial rather than an ongoing Free plan. Existing legacy Free users return to that legacy plan after trial.

facts.label: Trial allowance
facts.value: One chatbot and a one-time allowance of 200 message credits; no card. Main chatbot features/integrations can be tried, excluding Reseller white-labelling and scheduled automation.

facts.label: Legacy Free and other trial limits
facts.value: Complete current grandfathered Free quotas, trial seats, training storage/page quota and history retention guarantees were not established.

facts.label: Trial ending
facts.value: After 14 days, a new user's bot goes offline and no testing credits remain until upgrade; dashboard, settings, previous chats and Contacts remain accessible.

facts.label: Essential
facts.value: USD 39/month, or USD 396 billed annually, displayed as USD 33/month equivalent. Two bots, 2,000 credits/month, 12M training characters/bot, 2,500 crawl pages/bot and three team members.

facts.label: Business
facts.value: USD 89/month, or USD 900 billed annually, USD 75/month equivalent. Five bots, 5,000 credits/month, 15M characters/bot, 5,000 crawl pages/bot and five members.

facts.label: Premium
facts.value: USD 199/month, or USD 1,980 billed annually, USD 165/month equivalent. Ten bots, 10,000 credits/month, 20M characters/bot, 7,500 pages/bot and ten members.

facts.label: Reseller
facts.value: USD 399/month, or USD 3,996 billed annually, USD 333/month equivalent. Thirty bots, 30,000 credits/month, 25M characters/bot, 10,000 pages/bot and thirty members.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Quote only; custom bots, credits, training/page limits, security review, SLA and dedicated success manager. Voice included in the comparison.

facts.label: Older official price conflict
facts.value: Current annual Essential/Business/Premium/Reseller totals are 396/900/1,980/3,996 USD; an official pricing-comparison blog still gives 390/890/1,990/3,990 USD and an unqualified Free plan.

facts.label: Tax treatment
facts.value: Whether advertised USD amounts include or exclude VAT/sales tax was not established.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Plan subscription with included bots, members, training limits and a shared monthly message-credit allowance; text replies consume credits at the model's rate, and voice consumes credits by elapsed time.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Cheapest current ongoing paid plan is one Essential account: USD 39 for monthly billing or USD 396 for a year. It includes three members; no extra chatbot/model subscription is listed as mandatory.

facts.label: One-credit text models
facts.value: Current pricing lists GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 mini, GPT-5.6 Luna, GPT-6 Luna, Claude 4.5 Haiku, Gemini 3.6 Flash and Gemini 3.8 Flash at one credit per AI response; GPT-6 Luna is default.

facts.label: Five-credit text models
facts.value: GPT-4o, GPT-4.1, GPT-5.2 and Gemini 3.1 Pro use five credits per AI reply.

facts.label: Ten-credit text models
facts.value: GPT-5.6 Terra, GPT-6 Sol, Claude 4.5 Sonnet and Claude 5 Sonnet use ten credits per AI reply.

facts.label: Voice metering
facts.value: Website voice uses 50 credits/minute, calculated by the second; pricing labels its real-time model GPT 2.1. Preview Speaking Style and test calls use the same rate. Changing text model does not change voice rate/model.

facts.label: Other AI cost detail
facts.value: Extra metering for internet search, attachments, enrichment, action calls, failed replies, translation, draft regeneration and external model keys was not fully established.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Essential's base USD 39/month or 396/year covers 100 or 500 consumed credits in a month. For 100/500 replies, monthly totals are USD 39/39 at one credit, 39/49 at five credits, and 39/69 at ten credits.

facts.label: Credit allocation and stops
facts.value: Credits are shared across bots. An owner can allocate a bot-specific credit amount; guide says the bot stops after consuming that allocation until the limit is raised.

facts.label: Reset and automatic charging unknowns
facts.value: Exact monthly reset day, unused-credit rollover/expiry, annual add-on credit release timing, account-zero behavior and automatic recharge/overage defaults were not established.

facts.label: Extra capacity prices
facts.value: One extra bot: USD 10/month or 100/year. Extra 1,000 message credits: 10/month or 100/year. Extra 5M training characters: 10/month or 100/year.

facts.label: Usage safeguards
facts.value: Configurable text-message rate limit and custom limit message. Voice allows maximum call length 1 to 10 minutes and daily calls per browser within 24 hours.

facts.label: Cancellation, plan changes and refunds
facts.value: Cancel anytime; refund policy keeps access to period end but gives no unused-time pro-rata refund. Exceptional product-failure refunds require support opportunity and request within 30 days, at vendor discretion.

facts.label: Widget attribution
facts.value: Premium/Reseller include hiding Powered by FastBots. Remove Branding add-on is USD 29/month or 290/year on eligible plans.

facts.label: Add-on eligibility and other surfaces
facts.value: Exact eligible lower plans for the branding add-on, trial attribution-removal rights and vendor-footer removal on outgoing email were not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service signup at app.fastbots.ai, 14-day trial and paid plan selection; Enterprise uses sales. Terms require age 18+ and legal contracting capacity.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: knowledge-trained customer support AI with lead capture, website voice, selected business actions, and higher-plan human chat/email handling.

facts.label: Website/in-app surface
facts.value: Native hosted web widget and shareable bot URL. Can be embedded on custom HTML and supported site platforms; API can power a custom app interface.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native Email Replies on Business+; train one bot and connect multiple mailboxes. Per-mailbox auto-send or human approval; humans can edit drafts, attach files and start outbound threads.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native inbound WhatsApp Business connection on Essential+ after trial. Setup requires a new/unused suitable number and Meta business account; existing app number/coexistence and old phone history are not supported by this documented flow.

facts.label: WhatsApp fees/window
facts.value: FastBots' integration page says it only replies to customer-started messages within the rolling 24-hour service window and incurs no extra Meta charge for that described inbound scope.

facts.label: Messenger and Instagram
facts.value: Native Messenger and Instagram direct-message connections are included from Essential. Instagram connection handles incoming DMs, not posts, story mentions or feed publishing.

facts.label: Slack and Telegram
facts.value: Native Slack bot can answer channel mentions/threads and private messages after an account Integrations Key connection; Telegram uses a BotFather token and saves chats in Chat History.

facts.label: SMS and voice boundary
facts.value: No native two-way SMS channel according to the official DM use-case FAQ; sending an SMS is possible through a connected Zapier MCP/provider action. Voice is browser voice in the website widget, not an established phone-call channel.

facts.label: Discord and ticket forms
facts.value: Native Discord deployment and a structured ticket form that creates a tracked help-desk ticket without a separately configured action were not established.

facts.label: Live Chat workflow
facts.value: Business+: Unclaimed/Claimed queues, team-member claim, full AI history, manual replies, Leave to return to Unclaimed and End to close. Configure timezone, staffed hours, fallback threshold, notification/messages and claim timeout.

facts.label: Email workflow and limits
facts.value: Email supports pending AI drafts, human edit/approval, multiple reviewers and complete threads. Vendor explicitly says it lacks traditional help-desk SLA tracking, macros library and internal notes between agents.

facts.label: Team permissions
facts.value: Existing FastBots accounts can be added as bot collaborators; page-by-page permission toggles can restrict access, and removal is immediate.

facts.label: Bots, sites and domains
facts.value: Essential/Business/Premium/Reseller include 2/5/10/30 bots and 3/5/10/30 members. Extra bot costs 10/month or 100/year. Domain allowlist can authorize multiple embedding sites for a bot.

facts.label: Reseller brands/custom domain
facts.value: Reseller includes up to five brands, branded client-login platform, custom domain and custom Powered by text. Separately listed custom-domain add-on: USD 49/month or 490/year for embeds/share links.

facts.label: Help-center boundary
facts.value: Public article publishing/search CMS, article quotas, public/private knowledge-center access control and customer help-center custom-domain rights were not established as a bundled product.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Autonomous trained answers from chosen sources; optional general model knowledge and live web search. Agent actions through Zapier MCP; Business+ email draft/auto-send, web human fallback and website voice.

facts.label: Training sources
facts.value: Website/sitemap content, uploaded PDF/Word/TXT/CSV/XLS, pasted text, Q&A, Google Sheets and YouTube links. Freshdesk has a documented selected-document URL training path.

facts.label: Selection and freshness
facts.value: Select/deselect discovered website pages, add chosen URLs for indexing and see Pending/Indexed states. Business+ Auto Retrain revisits selected pages daily/weekly/monthly; one-off manual retraining is documented.

facts.label: Answer sources and citations
facts.value: Default is Uploaded Information. Source settings can combine uploaded content, model knowledge and web search. Knowledge-base page says replies can link to source pages, often anchors, without promising precise paragraph citations.

facts.label: Training limits not specified
facts.value: Per-upload training file-size/page limits, Google Sheets refresh interval and fully current source-settings support across newer models were not established.

facts.label: Knowledge review and visitor files
facts.value: Business+ Knowledge Assistant/Q&A can surface unanswered questions for a person to add a saved/indexed answer. Website visitor files can be limited to five/message and 10 MB/file and later opened/downloaded from History.

facts.label: Website fallback and hours
facts.value: Business+ offers Live Chat after configured unanswered-response threshold during availability hours. Visitor can submit contact details; agent claims the chat and sees full history. Outside staffed hours no Live Chat offer is shown.

facts.label: Voice-to-human route
facts.value: During website voice, visitor can choose Continue with the team by text while the call remains open; voice ends and the same conversation moves to human text Live Chat.

facts.label: DM handoff conflict
facts.value: WhatsApp setup and dedicated integration page say human handoff into FastBots is not yet supported; the general WhatsApp/Messenger use-case page says Business+ can take over DMs in the same channel/thread.

facts.label: Connected actions
facts.value: Zapier MCP can expose selected app actions during a conversation: booking, contacts/CRM updates, email, spreadsheets and support tickets. Actions are chosen and can be enabled/disabled, then guided through bot instructions.

facts.label: Shopify actions and boundary
facts.value: Official Shopify page describes OAuth live catalog/cart/order lookup, inline profile/billing-address updates from Essential+, but no checkout, discount application, order modification, fulfillment changes or refunds.

facts.label: Customer identity and approvals
facts.value: Exact customer verification protocol for Shopify order/profile access, action-level approval requirements and a universal authenticated end-user identity scheme were not established.

facts.label: Site/commerce connections
facts.value: Shopify supports documented script installation plus a separately described native data connection. WooCommerce explicitly supports widget embedding/trained content rather than native live cart/order/inventory access. WordPress has a FastBots widget plugin.

facts.label: Zapier/Make and CRM handoff
facts.value: Documented Make trigger for generated leads and Send message to a bot action, authenticated with account Integrations Key. Example destinations include Google Sheets and Gmail. Contacts supports created/updated webhooks.

facts.label: WhatsApp automation conflict
facts.value: WhatsApp setup guide says Zapier/Make triggers currently work only for website chat; current WhatsApp integration page says after-chat WhatsApp event workflows and live Zapier MCP actions are available.

facts.label: Other requested native connections
facts.value: Native Stripe customer-account/refund actions, Linear, GitHub and Discord connectors and their plan gates were not established.

facts.label: Public Chat API
facts.value: Documented POST https://app.fastbots.ai/api/public/chat, header X-BOT-API-KEY, JSON message, optional chatId to continue context. Response contains success, chatId and answer message.

facts.label: MCP read-only review connection
facts.value: https://app.fastbots.ai/mcp uses OAuth and can read authorized bot configuration, full indexed source content, redacted history and Q&A. It cannot edit bots/training, delete bots or run tests.

facts.label: Website-building MCP connection
facts.value: Separate https://app.fastbots.ai/mcp/website guides allow approved private website-bot creation/training/appearance work for integration-created bots; dashboard-created bots are read-only in that integration. Tests use FastBots credits.

facts.label: Developer limits and gates
facts.value: Exact direct API plan gate, rate limits, webhook signing/retry policy and a general widget-control/native mobile SDK reference were not established.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to this hosted service.

facts.label: Customer languages and translation
facts.value: Website/pricing describes around 95 chat languages. Business+ Chat Translation can translate selected history and email automatically translated new conversations. Voice can match visitor language or a chosen language.

facts.label: Interface locale list
facts.value: Complete staff-interface locales, fixed voice-language list and separately audited widget-translation coverage were not established.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Browser dashboard, embedded website widget and hosted link; browser microphone permission for two-way voice. WordPress plugin, Shopify theme script and generic HTML installation paths exist.

facts.label: Mobile shortcuts
facts.value: Official iPhone and Android guides add the bot's direct URL to the home screen; iPhone guide says it opens in a Safari tab.

facts.label: Reports and answer review
facts.value: Essential lists monthly bot performance reports. Business+ Knowledge Assistant flags unknowns; Q&A can link a missed question to its chat for manual correction. History and optional staff MCP support review.

facts.label: Detailed support metrics
facts.value: Exact CSAT survey/report availability, first-response/resolution-time report definitions and report CSV export structure were not established.

facts.label: Conversation export
facts.value: Individual or date-filtered selected chats export as PDF; History includes written text and voice transcripts, not voice audio recordings.

facts.label: Contacts and attachments
facts.value: Contacts can be searched/filtered then exported; profile includes history, status, tags and notes. Visitor-uploaded files can be opened/downloaded individually from a conversation in History.

facts.label: Assisted data access
facts.value: DPA says requested End User data is supplied within 72 hours through a request via the account support page, with results notified by email.

facts.label: Complete migration gap
facts.value: Complete self-service source-document/Q&A/configuration export, structured contact export format and bulk binary attachment package were not established.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: DPA says primary customer-data hosting/storage/processing is AWS US East, United States. No current EU/EEA data-residency option; subprocessors can process elsewhere.

facts.label: Named subprocessors
facts.value: DPA lists AWS hosting/storage/email; Supabase authentication; Pinecone vectors; Firecrawl ingestion; OpenAI/Anthropic/Google AI; Stripe payments; Muse.ai video; Meta Pixel, PostHog and Clarity analytics; Rewardful referral tracking; Fast Funnels website software.

facts.label: AI training and retention scope
facts.value: DPA explicitly labels OpenAI and Anthropic AI processing as no storing or training on Customer Data. Homepage FAQ says private uploaded data sent via OpenAI API is not used to train its model.

facts.label: Retention and deletion
facts.value: Privacy keeps personal information as needed/account exists, with legal/accounting and other exceptions; users can request deletion. DPA says complete deletion can take up to 60 days and protects isolated backup exceptions.

facts.label: Bot deletion versus pause
facts.value: Deleting a bot is irreversible and deletes its uploaded data according to the guide. Taking it Offline keeps training, chats/settings but shows a Leave a Message form; leads save to Contacts.

facts.label: Numeric history and lifecycle timers
facts.value: Per-plan conversation retention days, temporary attachment expiry, inactivity purge, backup rotation age and a guaranteed post-cancellation export window were not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: FastBots, also styled FastBots.ai; currently offered hosted business AI chatbots, human web handoff, email assistance and connected actions.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Operated by Fast Funnels Ltd trading as FastBots, company number 14091159, with a London, United Kingdom address. Terms use England and Wales law/courts.

facts.label: Markets and buying restrictions
facts.value: A complete supported-country list or country-specific exclusion schedule was not established.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Our classification: commercial vendor-hosted platform, with website script/plugin installation and API integrations. Reseller branding is a branded hosted platform, not an established self-hosted server edition.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public AI support bot, email/support form and help/training center. Business/Premium/Reseller list priority support; Enterprise lists SLA and dedicated success manager.

facts.label: Support hours and SLA values
facts.value: Precise staffed hours/timezone and numeric standard/Enterprise support response SLA were not established.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026. Official blog index includes November 3 posts; MCP review announcement dated September 17; help docs updated for voice/new trial. No completed acquisition or whole-platform sunset found.

facts.label: Extras and resource stops
facts.value: Customizations charged extra; WhatsApp uses Twilio and phone integrations use external services. Numeric ticket/storage overages, hard stops and AI-credit expiry/recharge not found.

facts.label: Portal customization
facts.value: Client-portal customization and custom-domain mapping marked for displayed plans; CSS customization from SME, custom JS at Enterprise in self-hosted cards.

facts.label: Vendor-brand removal
facts.value: An older release mentions Whitelabel plugin, but current widget/help-center/email removal entitlement and price were not established.

facts.label: Solo buying access
facts.value: Self-service order links, free Freelancer for two agents, downloadable Community and paid Cloud/self-hosted offers; one-agent Startup/SME entries shown.

facts.label: Type and scope
facts.value: Customer-support ticketing, shared inbox, knowledge base and omnichannel/AI options. ServiceDesk adds IT assets, problems, change and release management.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Email ticketing, outbound mail and multiple shared inboxes marked in Freelancer/Startup/SME/Enterprise self-hosted and all Cloud plans.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Self-hosted SME/Enterprise mark Tawk/Intercom chat integration; Elea advertises a native web widget with bots/live-agent handoff.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: No supported native customer mobile/in-app chat SDK established in checked product, developer or AI documentation.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Startup and above advertise WhatsApp integration; incoming messages become tickets and agents reply from Faveo. Plugin page names Twilio for multiple Business numbers.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: SME/Enterprise self-hosted and Cloud matrix mark Instagram; Elea omnichannel pages also name it.

facts.label: Messenger/Facebook
facts.value: Elea bot explicitly supports Facebook Messenger; core pricing marks Facebook channel from SME.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Self-hosted SME/Enterprise matrix marks SMS; plugin catalogue lists SMS.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Telephony plugin connects Knowlarity, Exotel and 3CX, creates call tickets and attaches recordings. Self-hosted recurring matrix places Telephony Service at Enterprise.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Plugin catalogue lists Slack, but current self-hosted and Cloud comparison rows mark it excluded across their displayed plans.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No specific official Discord connector/customer inbox established.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Embeddable contact form and solution articles included in all displayed Helpdesk plans; native ticket form management and web-form counts published.

facts.label: Assignment, notes and saved replies
facts.value: Internal notes, canned responses, tags and workflows across displayed Helpdesk plans; auto-assignment from Startup; round-robin/skill routing from SME.

facts.label: Collision, rules and hours
facts.value: Freelancer card advertises Collision Detection; multiple business hours, SLAs, reminders/escalations and creation/event workflows shown in comparison.

facts.label: Sites, brands and domains
facts.value: Paid self-hosted EULA is one installed instance/server; commercial price can also depend on registered domains. Enterprise Pro includes one staging licence.

facts.label: Inbox, product and phone quotas
facts.value: Multiple shared inboxes and multi-number WhatsApp supported; exact inbox/brand/site/number caps and extra-unit prices not found.

facts.label: Knowledge base
facts.value: Searchable public/private articles, categories, metadata, interlinked articles, versions and comments; included in displayed paid/Freelancer plan matrices.

facts.label: Knowledge-base language and feedback
facts.value: Article views/search/user feedback analytics and AI-assisted article generation; product page advertises automatic translation into 50+ languages.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Elea autonomous agent, visual-flow bots, and agent assistance for draft replies, summaries, sentiment, ticket-to-article generation, search and translation.

facts.label: AI plan entitlement
facts.value: Self-hosted recurring Enterprise marks AI included; Cloud Enterprise card advertises Elea/chatbot while its comparison marks the AI rows excluded in every Cloud plan.

facts.label: AI knowledge and training controls
facts.value: AI agent learns from KB/prior interactions; bot page names approved articles/FAQs/KB/flows. Bot guide documents train/retrain, unanswered/answered queries and unhelpful-response review.

facts.label: AI source limits and citations
facts.value: No numeric source capacity, refresh cadence, exact citation behavior or mandatory per-answer approval control established.

facts.label: Human handoff and context
facts.value: AI agent page says admins can retain complete chat history and transfer to live agents; bot guide offers configurable error fallback and inactivity actions.

facts.label: Customer actions and API control
facts.value: Bot API library can fetch information, create tickets/register users, update records and send notifications; admins control approved integrations.

facts.label: Identity and action approval
facts.value: No complete customer-verification/authorization protocol or obligatory human approval for sensitive AI actions established.

facts.label: Relevant connections
facts.value: Email, Twilio WhatsApp, Tawk/Intercom chat and Knowlarity/Exotel/3CX calling; Azure/Microsoft Entra ID/LDAP/SSO options by plan.

facts.label: Developer/custom connection route
facts.value: External API, events, webhooks, plugin creation and Elea's API library support custom system integration.

facts.label: Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Linear and GitHub
facts.value: No specific supported Helpdesk connector for this subset established in checked catalogue and developer index.

facts.label: Public API
facts.value: Developer portal documents external API v3, OAuth Bearer authentication and JSON resources; pricing marks API access across displayed Helpdesk tiers.

facts.label: Webhooks and quotas
facts.value: Ticket create/comment/reply/status webhook events documented with ticket/user/thread fields, including internal-note flag in comments.

facts.label: Self-host requirements
facts.value: Current install guide: 4vCPU, 8GiB RAM, 40GiB storage; PHP 8.4.x, MySQL 8/MariaDB 10.6, Redis, Supervisor and Apache/Nginx/IIS.

facts.label: Runtime version drift
facts.value: Commercial pricing FAQ says PHP 8.2; current installation docs say PHP 8.4.x; Community README says PHP 8.1+.

facts.label: Maintenance, modules and backups
facts.value: Self-hosters operate queues/Redis, upgrades, mail, storage, backups and PHP patching; paid perpetual maintenance is optional but needed for new updates/support.

facts.label: Community freshness
facts.value: Latest Community GitHub release listed is v2.0.3, published 31 October 2023; README lists it as security-supported.

facts.label: Interface and help-center languages
facts.value: Multiple portal languages marked on displayed plans; custom language from SME; KB product advertises 50+ language automatic article translation.

facts.label: Widget and AI languages
facts.value: Elea advertises multilingual responses and configurable language detection/default; full language list and per-language quality/limits not established.

facts.label: Devices and platform dependencies
facts.value: Browser-based server application; Android and iOS agent apps advertised in pricing FAQ, with mobile access marked in plan comparison.

facts.label: Reports and quality review
facts.value: Ticket-volume, resolution/unresolved trends, agent/group performance, CSAT and TAT reporting; bot guide lists unanswered and unhelpful responses for review.

facts.label: Reports and data exports
facts.value: Comparison marks Data export across displayed tiers. Ticket Volume export guide describes PDF charts; TAT guide describes ZIP containing XLSX, with filters/columns.

facts.label: Full self-hosted data exit
facts.value: Official backup/restore guides cover database plus filesystem backups; database restored from SQL with the application files.

facts.label: Contacts, transcript text, notes and attachments
facts.value: No single documented portable export or object-by-object inclusion guarantee established for full contacts, all private notes, message threads and attachment binaries.

facts.label: Articles, revisions and feedback export
facts.value: KB API documents search/category/article access; no complete verified bulk export of article bodies/revisions/translations or individual feedback records established.

facts.label: Cloud data location conflict
facts.value: Pricing/Cloud FAQ says San Francisco, USA; Data Hosting policy table puts database/files/backups in EU data centres; GDPR page names Europe providers.

facts.label: Processors and data policy
facts.value: Published hosting list names Hetzner Finland/Germany and Contabo Germany; DPA available on request. Community README discloses configurable Bugsnag error reporting.

facts.label: Deletion timing conflict
facts.value: Privacy policy says all data deleted 14 days after termination, subject to law; SaaS deletion policy starts deletion after 90 days, or 270 days after an unconverted trial.

facts.label: Retention and export access
facts.value: Active-account data retained as needed; legal/financial exceptions apply. No assured post-cancellation login/export window or per-object history duration established.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Faveo Helpdesk, developed by Ladybird Web Solution; active commercial/self-hosted/cloud product with a separate Community repository.

facts.label: Owner and country
facts.value: Ladybird Web Solution Pvt Ltd; published company address in Bangalore, Karnataka, India.

facts.label: Regional purchase and currency
facts.value: Separate international dollar-symbol and India rupee offers; no complete buying-country restriction list found.

facts.label: Community software licence
facts.value: Public Community repository LICENSE is Open Software License 3.0, OSL-3.0.

facts.label: Commercial edition and source access
facts.value: Freelancer and paid self-hosted/Cloud editions use Faveo's EULA; Enterprise Pro advertises source access and one staging licence.

facts.label: Community licence/seat ambiguity
facts.value: EULA describes a no-cost Community version with one Support Rep under a non-transferable licence; public repository distributes Community under OSL-3.0.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Paid recurring self-hosted Startup+ and displayed Cloud plans mark 20/7 email/phone/chat support; Freelancer matrix excludes those channels.

facts.label: Security response and support limits
facts.value: Community README asks for vulnerability reports to support@faveohelpdesk.com and promises response within 48 hours.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; commercial site has current 2026 pages/security advisory; Community latest listed release is 2023-10-31. Next review by 2027-02-05.

apps.name: Featurebase
apps.line: Shared support inbox with chat, email, help center, and feedback boards.

free.text: Free forever; 1 seat, unlimited chats, 50 help articles

cells.ai: $0.49 per Fibi resolution; Copilot add-on per seat

agents.math: One full seat. Unlimited support conversations and web chat are included.
3 full seats at $37 a month each, for chat and support email, before tax.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: A continuing Free plan is advertised at $0 forever. It is distinct from the 10-day paid-plan trial.

facts.label: Free plan limits
facts.value: Free includes one full seat, no Lite seats, unlimited support conversations and end users, 50 Help Center articles, one feedback board, and one roadmap.

facts.label: Free plan support features
facts.value: Free includes live chat/Messenger, Inbox and ticketing, Help Center, and the mobile app. The published Growth plan adds the email channel and Fibi AI; the Free plan feature summary does not list either.

facts.label: Free plan feedback and usage
facts.value: Free includes one feedback board and one roadmap. Paid-plan-only Fibi and Copilot are not listed as Free features. Product tours and surveys have usage-based allowances on paid plans; they are not support conversation limits.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Trial is 10 days, does not require a credit card to start, and does not auto-convert. When it ends, the user can select a paid plan, ask for an extension, or choose Free. Data and settings remain until a paid plan is selected; if no payment is made, paid features pause.

facts.label: Free price
facts.value: Free: $0 forever, one full seat.

facts.label: Growth price
facts.value: Growth: $29 per full seat/month when billed yearly, or $37 per full seat/month when billed monthly. Yearly billing is charged in advance for the annual term.

facts.label: Professional price
facts.value: Professional: $59 per full seat/month when billed yearly, or $75 per full seat/month when billed monthly. The plan includes 20 Lite seats.

facts.label: Enterprise price
facts.value: Enterprise: $99 per full seat/month when billed yearly, or $129 per full seat/month when billed monthly. The plan includes 50 Lite seats; sales demo is the public buying path.

facts.label: Taxes and payment methods
facts.value: Terms say applicable taxes are additional. Current pricing help says all plans accept credit/debit cards and Enterprise can pay by bank transfer; Stripe is the stated processor.

facts.label: Billing unit: seats
facts.value: Each dashboard teammate needs a seat. Full seats have paid-plan access; Lite seats are free but limited, and are included only on Professional (20) and Enterprise (50). End users do not need seats.

facts.label: Billing unit: support and AI
facts.value: Support conversations and end users are unlimited by plan. Fibi is billed per resolved conversation; Copilot unlimited usage is billed per teammate; AI translations are billed by characters beyond the shared allowance.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and term
facts.value: Standard paid plans have no published minimum or maximum seat quantity. Monthly and annual subscriptions are available; annual subscriptions are billed upfront for 12 months and renew unless cancelled.

facts.label: Enterprise minimum and setup charges
facts.value: SAML SSO and SCIM have a five-seat minimum on the current Enterprise feature comparison. No setup fee is stated on the pricing or Terms pages checked.

facts.label: Fibi AI charges
facts.value: Fibi AI Agent is available on paid plans at $0.49 per resolution. It is charged at most once per conversation; handoffs are free, and a later customer return can reverse the initial charge. No charge accrues while Fibi is off.

facts.label: Copilot AI charges
facts.value: Each teammate on a paid plan gets up to 10 Copilot conversations/month included. Follow-up questions within a Copilot conversation count as one. Unlimited Copilot is $25 per teammate/month on monthly billing or $19 per teammate/month billed annually.

facts.label: AI translation charges
facts.value: Professional and higher include automatic AI translations. The workspace shares 250,000 free translated characters each month, then pays $0.04 per additional 1,000 characters. Applies to Inbox, Help Center, and feedback translations together.

facts.label: Model choice and multipliers
facts.value: Official AI policy names OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Cerebras, and Google Gemini as providers, but no public customer-selectable model list, plan-specific model multiplier, or model surcharge was found in pricing, AI setup, or the AI policy.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: See “Cost examples: our calculations” below for Growth base subscription plus 100 and 500 billable Fibi resolutions.

facts.label: Fibi usage caps and stopping
facts.value: Billing settings support soft and hard Fibi caps. A hard cap pauses Fibi for the rest of the period; the published interface cap is 2,000 resolutions unless Featurebase raises it. Featurebase says the final usage may be slightly above/below the cap because conversation outcomes can change.

facts.label: Outbound email charges
facts.value: Outbound/Updates email includes 5,000 free emails/month, then tiered rates shown as $: $0.00300/email for 5,001–10,000; $0.00250 for 10,001–50,000; $0.00200 for 50,001–100,000; $0.00160 for 100,001–500,000; $0.00100 above 500,000. Support emails and inbox notifications are free.

facts.label: Product tour and survey charges
facts.value: First 500 Outbound Messages/month are free, shared by Product Tours and Surveys. Beyond that, tiers are $0.0400/message for 501–1,000; $0.0250 for 1,001–2,000; $0.0140 for 2,001–10,000; $0.0100 for 10,001–50,000; $0.0070 for 50,001–100,000; $0.0055 for 100,001–250,000; and $0.0045 above 250,000.

facts.label: Translation overages
facts.value: Translation overage is $0.04 per 1,000 characters after the shared 250,000-character monthly free allowance. Usage is billed monthly; Featurebase may charge early when usage-based charges exceed $100.

facts.label: Other extra charges
facts.value: Removing “Powered by Featurebase” branding is a $69/month add-on. No mandatory setup or onboarding fee is shown for Growth or Professional.

facts.label: Branding
facts.value: Customer portals/widgets can use a logo, colors, and theme. The “Powered by Featurebase” mark can be removed for $69/month; current pricing comparison lists this on Professional and Enterprise.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service signup is available. An individual can start on the Free plan or a 10-day paid-plan trial without a credit card. Enterprise purchase is directed to a demo/sales route.

facts.label: Early-stage offer
facts.value: Featurebase advertises an 86% startup discount and one year of Fibi AI free for eligible startups: founded less than two years ago, fewer than six employees, and under $3M raised. The offer grants Professional features and requires an application.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Shared support inbox with web Messenger, email, tickets, AI support, help center, reporting, and feedback/roadmap tools. It fits a solo builder or small software team needing both customer support and product feedback. The feedback and roadmap module overlaps the feedback directory; this record covers the support offer.

facts.label: Website and in-app chat
facts.value: Native Featurebase Messenger provides live chat, help articles, updates, and customer conversations on a website or web app through its JavaScript SDK. Live chat is included in Free and paid plans.

facts.label: Support email
facts.value: Email support channel is listed on Growth and higher. Users can route customer email into the Inbox by forwarding; sending replies from a new workspace needs Featurebase approval. Support email and inbox notifications are not charged as outbound marketing emails.

facts.label: Slack support
facts.value: Slack is a native customer-support channel on Professional and Enterprise. The changelog describes Slack messages entering the shared Inbox, with assignment, priority, tags, SLAs, internal notes, and ticket escalation.

facts.label: WhatsApp support
facts.value: The plan card lists WhatsApp under Professional, but the full pricing comparison marks WhatsApp “coming soon”; the support roadmap lists a WhatsApp support integration as queued. Current purchasable status is unresolved.

facts.label: Discord support
facts.value: The plan card lists Discord under Professional, but the full pricing comparison marks Discord “coming soon”; the roadmap lists Discord support as in progress. Current purchasable status is unresolved.

facts.label: Microsoft Teams support
facts.value: The Enterprise card lists a Microsoft Teams channel, but the full pricing comparison marks it “coming soon”; the roadmap lists Teams support as committed and queued. Current purchasable status is unresolved.

facts.label: Other named channels
facts.value: Instagram, Facebook Messenger, SMS, and voice are not listed as support channels in the pricing page, official channel setup docs, or integration overview checked. Their availability was not published in those sources.

facts.label: Inbox workflow
facts.value: Inbox supports assignment to teammates/teams, snoozing, internal notes, tags, priority, closing/reopening, macros, and conversation search. Workflows automate routing, tagging, snoozing, priorities, notes, SLAs, ticket conversion, and Fibi steps.

facts.label: Assignment and SLAs
facts.value: Round-robin assignment is listed on Professional and Enterprise. Workload management documentation describes balanced assignment; the latest changelog says advanced workload controls are Enterprise. SLAs are configured through Workflows and respect office hours.

facts.label: Sites and brands
facts.value: One workspace can serve multiple sites/brands; Enterprise advertises a multi-brand workspace and can create up to 100 Help Centers. The public docs do not state the maximum number of brands or websites separate from that Help Center cap.

facts.label: Help Center articles and search
facts.value: Free includes up to 50 Help Center articles; paid plans include unlimited articles. The customer-facing Help Center supports public articles, search, tabs/collections, versions, and an embeddable Messenger help view.

facts.label: Help Center access, language, and domains
facts.value: Professional and above list private and multilingual Help Centers. Article-level visibility can be restricted to team members or user segments; a full portal can require login. Custom domains are documented for Help Center, ticket portal, and feedback portal; exact current plan tier for each custom-domain surface is not stated in the newest setup guide.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Fibi is an autonomous customer-facing support agent for Messenger and email; it can answer, ask follow-ups, hand off to people, and run configured Workflows. Copilot and AI replies help human teammates draft or summarize. Help Center Ask AI is a separate self-service search surface.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Fibi uses Featurebase Help Center articles, Updates, feedback portal, roadmap, and other workspace context. Extra sources can be uploaded files, website URLs, and Q&A snippets; custom sources remain private.

facts.label: AI citations and approval
facts.value: Fibi email replies can include the supporting source inline when that source is public. The setup docs let admins edit source content and custom answers; no universal human approval requirement before every AI reply was found.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Fibi hands conversations to the team by default when a customer asks for a person or it cannot resolve an issue. The handoff remains in the support conversation/Inbox; admins can turn handoff off, which leaves Fibi in bot-only mode.

facts.label: Customer actions and identity
facts.value: Fibi custom actions can call customer-configured APIs for order tracking, account insights, trial extensions, discounts, invoices, or payment information. Authenticated Messenger users can pass email/userId/userName/userType; docs recommend checking userType=customer with identity verification.

facts.label: Connections
facts.value: Official integration guides list Slack, HubSpot, Salesforce, Linear, Jira, GitHub, ClickUp, Azure DevOps, Zapier, Segment, and Cursor. Slack is a customer-support channel; the other named guides mainly describe feedback/CRM/engineering workflows.

facts.label: Commerce integrations
facts.value: The official integration overview and selected setup pages checked did not establish native Shopify, WooCommerce, or Stripe customer-support integrations.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: REST API supports reading/writing conversations, tickets, contacts, reports, help articles, feedback, and training data. API, MCP, and webhooks are listed from Growth up. Universal JavaScript install and a Messenger JS API are documented.

facts.label: Developer limits
facts.value: API rate limits are 3,000 requests/minute per workspace and 2,000/minute per API key or connection; some endpoints have lower limits. A workspace can create up to 10 webhooks; webhook deliveries retry up to three times and stop/pause after documented failure thresholds.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: Not applicable: the documented product is a hosted SaaS, with no self-hosted package or install/upgrade/backup instructions found in the pricing, installation, developer, or Terms pages checked.

facts.label: Customer and agent languages
facts.value: Public portal localization supports many named locales, including English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, and others; its layout supports named right-to-left languages. AI Inbox translation supports workspace-configured languages and 40+ translation languages.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: A complete list of languages for the agent dashboard was not published in the localization, Inbox translation, pricing, or overview pages checked.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: The admin is browser-based; Featurebase also publishes iOS and Android support-agent apps. Customer-facing Messenger uses a JavaScript SDK for websites/web apps. The portal can be embedded in native mobile apps through a WebView; no WordPress, Shopify, or other host platform is required.

facts.label: Desktop app
facts.value: A native agent desktop download was not listed in the mobile-app, pricing, or installation pages checked; the documented admin path is browser-based.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Reports cover support conversations, teammate handling, response intervals, ratings/CSAT, and Fibi answer/resolution/handoff performance. CSV exports and report metrics are documented; Fibi report template is available.

facts.label: Data export: conversations and reports
facts.value: A teammate can download one visible conversation/ticket transcript as .txt; it includes title, start time, participants, and visible messages, but not internal notes or ticket attributes. Report exports are CSV: chart/drill-in up to 10,000 rows and dataset export up to 100,000 rows.

facts.label: Data export: workspace exit
facts.value: Data can be exported during a subscription through in-product functions. After termination, a customer can request export by email within 30 days. DPA says return/export is completed within 30 days of request.

facts.label: Data location
facts.value: Terms and DPA say customer data is hosted primarily in the EU/EEA. Privacy and subprocessor pages show that ancillary providers and processing can be outside the EEA, including U.S.-located service providers. No customer-selectable hosting region was published.

facts.label: AI providers and training use
facts.value: AI policy names OpenAI, Anthropic, Groq, Cerebras, and Google Gemini. It says customer data sent for core functions, enabled AI features, or abuse prevention is not used to train AI models; providers may retain it as needed for abuse monitoring, safety, or law.

facts.label: Retention and deletion
facts.value: DPA says customer content is retained for the agreement term, deleted from active systems within 90 days after termination, and backups roll off within 365 days; a legal hold may extend retention. Terms allow a 30-day post-termination export request window.

facts.label: Company-side retention
facts.value: Privacy policy's general table lists active account data for account duration plus 30 days, deleted account data for 90 days, support tickets for two years after resolution, and payment records for seven years.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Featurebase is the current product name for a hosted customer support and product feedback platform. CORDNET OÜ operates it. Current service is active. No prior product name or parent product was identified in the official About, Terms, or Privacy pages.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Legal operator is CORDNET OÜ, an Estonian company with its registered address in Harju County, Estonia; the About page says its home base is Tallinn, Estonia.

facts.label: Market restrictions
facts.value: Terms require compliance with Estonian, EU, U.S., and other applicable export and sanctions laws and prohibit use for restricted countries, entities, or persons. A complete country-by-country sales or service availability list was not published in the Terms or pricing pages checked.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: The published offer is a vendor-hosted web service with a JavaScript SDK and mobile apps. No self-hosted distribution or public software licence was found in the pricing, installation, Terms, or developer pages checked. Featurebase reserves ownership of its platform and software in its Terms.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public help documentation and live chat/email support are available. Terms promise reasonable support for paid plans but do not publish a support-hours schedule or response-time guarantee.

facts.label: Support hours
facts.value: Public support hours and a contractual response-time SLA were not published in the Terms, pricing guide, installation overview, or support docs checked.

facts.label: Freshness and release status
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-06. Featurebase's official changelog has current product updates through 2026-10-28, and current self-service plans remain published. Suggested next review: within 90 days or sooner if pricing/channels change.

facts.label: Acquisition, shutdown, and newsroom check
facts.value: Official Featurebase blog was searched with “acquired” and “acquisition” alongside Featurebase/CORDNET; no acquisition notice was returned. A dedicated newsroom/press link was not found in the site navigation; direct /newsroom and /press routes were not accessible through the web source tool. No shutdown or sunset notice was found in the official blog, changelog, Terms, or Privacy page searched.

facts.label: Ongoing Free offer

facts.label: Free people and channels

facts.label: Free usage and AI storage

facts.label: Other Free limits
facts.value: Numeric contact/article/attachment-storage caps and exact message-counter/reset definition not found in checked current pricing/docs.

facts.label: Trial wording
facts.value: Older signup guide describes a 14-day trial; current pricing offers Free forever and does not specify a separate paid trial.

facts.label: Card and automatic charge
facts.value: Free asks for no card and will not charge automatically; paid starts only when chosen.

facts.label: Published paid amount
facts.value: Do more: $29 per active human per month; monthly, cancel anytime.

facts.label: Currency and regional settlement
facts.value: Exact ISO currency code for the public $29 amount is not clearly established.

facts.label: Annual offer
facts.value: Current price page offers monthly Do more only; general terms also describe annual subscriptions without a current annual amount.

facts.label: Taxes
facts.value: Fees exclude applicable taxes/levies/duties; customer responsible.

facts.label: Billable person
facts.value: Active means permission to reply to customers, not number of days logged in or replies actually sent.

facts.label: Seats and permissions

facts.label: Minimum paid purchase

facts.label: Setup/dependencies

facts.label: AI charges and allowance

facts.label: AI counting detail
facts.value: Whether AI messages consume Free's sent-message quota, exact model-specific caps/multipliers and limit-exhaustion behavior are not defined in checked sources.

facts.label: 100/500 AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: paid base stays $29/month for one responder or $87/month for three, with no advertised additional per-resolution fee at either 100 or 500 resolutions.

facts.label: Free AI examples
facts.value: Exact free total for 100 or 500 AI answers/resolutions cannot be guaranteed from the 100-sent-message cap.

facts.label: Renewal and cancellation
facts.value: Paid subscriptions renew automatically under terms; cancellation takes effect at next renewal/end of paid period; no refund obligation for fees already paid.

facts.label: Overages, hard stops and inactivity
facts.value: No Free message-exhaustion stop rule, automatic upgrade/recharge, excess training-storage price or inactive-account deletion schedule found.

facts.label: Non-payment
facts.value: Accounts 30+ days delinquent may lose data; suspension can continue subscription charges. Terms allow 1% monthly compounding interest, subject to legal limits, and possible reconnection fees.

facts.label: Outgoing email attribution
facts.value: Free adds Sent via Fernand; paid removes it at $29 per active human/month.

facts.label: Widget/KB removal scope
facts.value: Paid lists No branding generally, but exact Free widget/KB attribution placement and per-surface removal controls are not fully specified.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service ongoing Free account; optional monthly Do more upgrade. Solo founders explicitly intended.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted support inbox with email, live chat, help center, AI and developer/customer-context connections.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native on Free and paid, including own domain. Incoming messages forward to Fernand; TXT/CNAME setup authenticates channel delivery.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native real-time chat widget on Free/paid; supports conversation history, KB and contact forms.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Same JavaScript widget can be embedded inside a web product; authenticated users can access prior email/chat conversations.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Paid Slack Connect integration: customer threads become conversations, with native replies, assignments, notes and rules.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: No current native WhatsApp channel established in checked product, pricing and channel/integration docs.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: No dedicated Instagram customer messaging channel established in checked sources.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: No dedicated Meta Messenger customer channel established in checked sources.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: No native customer SMS channel established in checked pricing/channel docs.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: No native calling channel, phone-number plan or minute tariff established.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No dedicated Discord customer-support intake documented in checked current channel sources.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Native widget contact form plus documented headless contact-form use; requests join shared inbox.

facts.label: Assignment and notes
facts.value: Shared inbox assignment, private notes, tagging, snooze and round-robin routing through rules and smart snippets.

facts.label: Drafts and saved replies
facts.value: Shared drafts can be routed to a colleague/everyone for review; snippets insert canned replies or trigger other actions.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: Explicit collision-warning or send-lock behavior not established in the checked shared-draft, widget and workflow documentation.

facts.label: Rules and business hours
facts.value: Rule conditions include message/channel/language, paid-customer status and business hours; configured daily time ranges can include multiple periods per day.

facts.label: Free sites/inboxes
facts.value: Free publishes maximum 5 inboxes and custom domain; widget can be placed on app, marketing site or other JavaScript-capable property.

facts.label: Paid resources
facts.value: Paid publishes unlimited seats and sent messages, custom domain and 50 MB AI training; numeric paid inbox/KB/brand cap not stated.

facts.label: Help center and organization
facts.value: Native searchable help content, Notion-like editor, articles in multiple collections and unlimited subcollections.

facts.label: Domains and visibility
facts.value: Custom KB domains with managed HTTPS; documented default customer subdomain is organization.fernand.help.

facts.label: Articles, translations and feedback
facts.value: API exposes article HTML/metadata and KB article satisfaction aggregates; no complete article-count cap or manual article translation/versioning workflow found.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: AI chat agent answers in the live-chat widget using configured training; off by default, enabled in Chat settings.

facts.label: Staff AI roles
facts.value: Training informs smart completions, rule-created drafts and KB article generation; semantic triage matches support intent for routing.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs/sync
facts.value: Website/page/site import, PDF/Word/text files, manual Q&A and pasted text; optional auto-sync of help articles and past replies.

facts.label: Training limit conflict
facts.value: Current pricing: Free 10 MB, paid 50 MB. AI training guide states total 10 MB and says all imported sources count toward that total.

facts.label: Citations and update controls
facts.value: Sources can be deleted/replaced and sync enabled; no fixed sync interval, systematic answer citations or approval queue for learned replies established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: AI Agent offers a human escape route and routes complex questions to the team; same widget can handle human chat/forms.

facts.label: History and identity
facts.value: Server-generated HMAC-SHA256 email signature verifies logged-in widget users; prior chat/email conversations appear in Messages view.

facts.label: Agent-executed customer actions
facts.value: Custom-data buttons/forms call endpoints on the same host as the data endpoint; only agents with Execute role can invoke actions.

facts.label: Commerce actions and approvals
facts.value: Dodo Payments update explicitly requests write permissions for refunds/subscriptions; no complete autonomous AI action approval/verification policy established.

facts.label: Billing/customer context
facts.value: Free includes Stripe, Paddle, Polar, Lemon Squeezy and others; Stripe links email-matched subscriptions/payment history to inbox and AI context.

facts.label: GitHub and Linear
facts.value: Free includes issue creation/linking from conversations and status synchronization; agents can follow up when engineering changes the issue.

facts.label: Slack and custom systems
facts.value: Slack Connect requires paid; HTTP endpoint custom data and action buttons support business-specific connections.

facts.label: Shopify, WooCommerce, Discord/Zapier
facts.value: No dedicated connector for these named services established in checked official pricing, integration/help indexes and API entry docs.

facts.label: API availability
facts.value: API is included on Free; API keys in Settings → Integrations authenticate via X-Api-Key header.

facts.label: API limits
facts.value: Default read limits: 20 GET requests/minute; writes: 5 PUT/POST/PATCH/DELETE requests/minute; some endpoints differ; excess returns HTTP 429.

facts.label: Webhooks and widget libraries
facts.value: Rules/snippets can send conversation details to webhooks; JavaScript widget uses Fernand initialization and documented loader.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: Not applicable: native service is hosted SaaS, including when used headlessly through the API.

facts.label: Widget languages
facts.value: English default plus French, German, Dutch, Italian, Spanish, Portuguese, Polish, Swedish, Danish and Turkish translations.

facts.label: Help center language
facts.value: KB settings support default language or browser detection; complete supported KB/agent-interface and AI-output language lists not established.

facts.label: Devices and platform
facts.value: Web app with installable PWA for iOS via Safari and Android via Chrome, including browser push notifications.

facts.label: Conversation reporting
facts.value: API metrics by date/channel/source/agent and filtered date range/tag/custom intervals; UI docs describe workload/reporting trends.

facts.label: Article feedback and AI data reporting
facts.value: Article stats include top 20 article results and satisfaction aggregates; AI usage stats describe vector-store bytes/content counts and processing status.

facts.label: CSAT and failed-AI reviews
facts.value: Native conversation-reply CSAT survey specification and systematic failed-AI-answer review not found in checked reporting/AI/pricing docs.

facts.label: Conversations and PDF
facts.value: API supports conversation access and PDF export containing messages, notes and events, limited to up to 100 entries.

facts.label: Message text/private notes
facts.value: Message API returns JSON timeline of HTML messages, notes and events; before timestamp paginates older entries, default 20 and maximum 100 per request.

facts.label: Attachments/raw email
facts.value: Message schema supplies attachment download URLs and original .eml download URL where available.

facts.label: Contacts
facts.value: Contact detail API includes billing metadata; search returns only trusted contacts, maximum 99 matches, without a complete paginated contact-dump guarantee.

facts.label: Articles
facts.value: Individual article API returns full HTML and metadata; visibility distinguishes public, chat-only and authenticated chat.

facts.label: Contractual data file
facts.value: On non-breach termination, terms offer a Customer Data file within 30 days if requested at termination.

facts.label: Geographic wording
facts.value: Public FAQ says only European servers; terms expressly permit processing, transfer and storage in the USA/other countries outside the EU.

facts.label: AI provider/training
facts.value: AI guide names OpenAI; says Fernand does not train/fine-tune models on supplied data, but imported content may be temporarily processed as answer context.

facts.label: Processing agreement
facts.value: Public DPA requires documented instructions, confidentiality/security, consent for subprocessors and deletion/return at service end.

facts.label: Ordinary history
facts.value: Official Front-alternative page advertises unlimited history and conversations.

facts.label: Termination/default deletion
facts.value: Terms may delete after 30 days following termination; may irretrievably delete data at 30+ days delinquent, with breach exceptions.

facts.label: Deletion schedules
facts.value: Privacy gives purpose-based retention and erasure rights but no fixed active-history purge, backup erasure or Free inactivity schedule.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Fernand, operated by Fernand SAS; active hosted customer-support platform for software founders and small teams.

facts.label: Shutdown, sunset or acquisition notices
facts.value: No relevant notice found in the initial official-domain lifecycle search, About, Imprint and current update pages.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Fernand SAS, incorporated in France; 128 rue la Boétie, 75008 Paris; commercial register 915163968.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Service intended for internal business purposes and users age 18+; sanctions/export screening may block access. Complete prohibited-country list not published.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted SaaS with non-exclusive, non-transferable rights for internal business use; API/headless use remains hosted by Fernand.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Email support@getfernand.com and dashboard support/contact form; dedicated support page promises reply within one business day.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; latest homepage-linked update Dodo Payments integration dated 2026-10-27; terms/privacy modified 2026-09-30. Our next review: 2027-02-05.
