Fin is an AI agent; human inbox pricing is separate.

status.label: New owner
status.text: Company renamed Fin (2026-05-12); Salesforce completed acquisition 2026-09-10

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: No general ongoing free Fin support-agent plan listed. Trial and qualifying Early Stage promotional usage are temporary/conditional.

facts.label: Startup promotional limits
facts.value: Early Stage: 300 Fin outcomes/month in year 1, 150 in year 2, 75 in year 3; 15 sales qualifications/month. Paired Intercom offer starts at US$65/month and includes 6 Advanced, 6 Copilot and 20 Lite seats.

facts.label: Startup eligibility cutoff wording
facts.value: Pricing hero says under US$10M raised and 15 employees or fewer; detailed startup eligibility says up to US$10M and fewer than 15 employees.

facts.label: Fin trial
facts.value: 14 days; no card required; FAQ says unlimited outcomes and no trial seat minimum/maximum. To continue, choose a plan and add payment details.

facts.label: Existing-helpdesk Fin price
facts.value: US$49/month minimum includes 50 outcomes; additional support outcomes US$0.99 each. Unlimited Fin teammates; no extra setup/integration/platform charges stated for this offer.

facts.label: Annual billing and tax
facts.value: No separate public annual-payment price or annual discount for the US$49 external-helpdesk Fin plan established. Fees exclude tax; order/contract controls billing terms.

facts.label: Fin with Intercom Helpdesk
facts.value: Fin support outcomes from US$0.99 plus separately paid human-helpdesk Full seats. Fin pricing currently advertises US$19/seat/month; linked helpdesk page marks a new-customer promotion.

facts.label: Optional Pro and Copilot
facts.value: Pro from US$100/workspace/month; detailed Pro guide: US$0.20 per counted conversation with 500-conversation minimum. Copilot unlimited: US$35/teammate/month paid monthly or US$29 equivalent paid annually.

facts.label: Support outcome unit
facts.value: Billable support outcomes are a successful Resolution or a completed Procedure intentionally configured to end in handoff to a human/workflow. At most one charge per conversation.

facts.label: Confirmed and assumed resolutions
facts.value: Confirmed: customer indicates the answer helped. Assumed: customer receives an actual answer and does not request further help for 24 hours.

facts.label: Reopened conversation
facts.value: If customer returns to the same resolved conversation for more help, the resolution is deducted/not charged, including across billing periods.

facts.label: Non-billable escalation/abandonment
facts.value: Explicit request for a person, default frustration escalation, workspace-level escalation, Procedure failure, or no response to a clarifying question are documented non-billable cases.

facts.label: Human teammate joining
facts.value: A teammate joining after Fin answered does not by itself reverse a billable resolution if customer had not requested more help. A request for more help/person makes it unresolved.

facts.label: Minimum and dependencies
facts.value: Published Fin for existing-helpdesk minimum is US$49/month with 50 included outcomes; existing helpdesk/system remains separately licensed. No extra Fin-seat, setup or integration fee.

facts.label: Platform-specific prerequisites
facts.value: Zendesk live-agent handoff requires its Sunshine connection in addition to Zendesk API/OAuth; generic handoff can require your own JavaScript/API.

facts.label: AI billing and model choice
facts.value: Fin support uses outcome billing, not message credits, model-request multipliers or customer-supplied token rates. Current model suite includes Apex 2.0 and models for retrieval, Procedures and escalation.

facts.label: Voice pricing and fair use
facts.value: Fin Voice via Sales: US$1.99 per voice outcome. AI product terms state average 7-minute call length and up to 100 concurrent calls as fair-use limits.

facts.label: Other role billing
facts.value: Startup page distinguishes US$0.99 support/disqualification-style outcomes from US$9.99 sales qualifications beyond included qualifications. External-helpdesk billing doc says Fin for Sales is not available there.

facts.label: Operator credit inclusion conflict
facts.value: Live pricing/Pro guide give 6,000 included Operator credits for monthly plans; usage-limits guide still describes 2,000. Additional credits US$0.01 each.

facts.label: Fin Agent API price status
facts.value: Developer guide says API conversations are outcome-billed, but pricing is being finalized and subject to change. It treats an answered API conversation as a resolution.

facts.label: 100 / 500 outcome examples
facts.value: Our calculation: existing-helpdesk Fin bill = US$49 + max(0, outcomes − 50) × US$0.99. 100 outcomes = US$98.50; 500 = US$494.50.

facts.label: Vendor example arithmetic conflict
facts.value: Vendor guide prints US$99.50 for 100 outcomes despite published US$49 base + 50 extra outcomes × US$0.99 = US$98.50.

facts.label: Allowance expiry and cycle
facts.value: 50 included monthly outcomes do not carry over; outcomes billed on normal billing date. Usage reflects conversations starting in that billing period.

facts.label: Outcome alerts and hard limits
facts.value: Alerts email billing contacts at 50%, 80%, 100% of configured threshold. Hard limit disables Fin for new conversations; generic guide says in-progress ones hand off on the next customer response.

facts.label: HubSpot hard-limit caveat
facts.value: HubSpot-specific guide says limit applies only to new conversations and cannot cap spend mid-conversation; pause the channel to stop Fin.

facts.label: Operator / Pro exposure
facts.value: Monthly Pro guide says Operator continues after included 6,000 credits with US$0.01/credit automatic overages unless a limit is set; contracts default to their inclusion as a stopping limit.

facts.label: Stopping and channel extras
facts.value: Cancel monthly subscription effective period-end; no subscription pause option. SMS/WhatsApp/phone and some outbound channels add usage charges depending on platform/provider.

facts.label: Messenger branding
facts.value: Fin Messenger name/avatar/style can be customized. Guide gives Settings > Workspace > General > Intercom Attribution Message toggle to remove Powered by Fin.

facts.label: AI disclosure
facts.value: AI Agent label/intro disclosure can be configured; AI terms require informing users and marking generated output.

facts.label: External email/footer branding
facts.value: No universal email or help-center vendor-brand removal entitlement established for external-helpdesk Fin routes.

facts.label: Without Intercom Helpdesk
facts.value: Yes: Fin works with Zendesk, Salesforce, Freshdesk/Freshchat and HubSpot; generic platforms can use Fin Messenger with URL, JavaScript or API handoff.

facts.label: Without a human inbox
facts.value: Generic Messenger setup includes an informational mode that ends the chat without human escalation. Fin does not thereby supply a human inbox.

facts.label: Signup and solo access
facts.value: 14-day trial/self-service route for listed integrations; other/custom platforms use Sales. No trial seat minimum/maximum and no extra Fin teammate seat fee on the existing-helpdesk offer.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: autonomous customer-support agent with grounded answers, business actions and human escalation; overlaps help desks, live chat, voice and ecommerce automation.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Fin Messenger for generic platforms, Fin Messenger with third-party helpdesk handoff, and supported existing-helpdesk messengers.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Fin Messenger supports web apps and mobile iOS/Android/React Native install routes; Fin Agent API supports a custom UI once approved.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: External helpdesk email tickets/cases supported for Zendesk, Salesforce, Freshdesk and HubSpot; Fin with Intercom also supports email.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Fin supports WhatsApp through the official WhatsApp Business API and supported helpdesk channels.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Fin supports Instagram direct messages/social messaging through supported platform connections.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Fin supports Facebook Messenger through supported social/helpdesk deployments.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: SMS supported through telephony/provider/helpdesk channel setup.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Fin Voice supports telephone conversations via supported telephony systems, with human transfer. Sales-led voice pricing starts US$1.99/voice outcome.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Direct customer conversation channel is documented for Fin with Intercom; FAQ explicitly excludes Slack conversations on external-helpdesk Fin for Platforms.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Fin social channel page explicitly offers native-threaded Discord answers using team name/avatar.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Works through supported helpdesk form-to-conversation flows or generic URL/API ticket handoff. HubSpot form must create an inbox conversation and collect email.

facts.label: Standalone human inbox
facts.value: Not applicable to Fin for Platforms: its Analyze conversation view is read-only; humans answer in their connected helpdesk.

facts.label: Fin routing / automation
facts.value: Fin Workflows configure target audiences, greeting, Let Fin handle, data collection and handoff. Generic handoff supports URL, JavaScript, data connector or no human follow-up.

facts.label: Multiple agents / brands
facts.value: FAQ says one Fin AI agent with multiple targeted paths; Zendesk/Salesforce brand data can sync so Fin selects the right brand for chat/email.

facts.label: Sites and workspace limits
facts.value: Multiple trusted domains/subdomains and brand styles are configurable. No comprehensive numerical site/brand/inbox/number limits or per-brand tariff found for Fin for Platforms.

facts.label: Help content surfaces
facts.value: Fin trains on existing public/private knowledge; Fin Messenger Help space can show/search synced Zendesk or Salesforce articles. Original help center can stay on its existing provider.

facts.label: Help space privacy caveat
facts.value: Messenger Help space does not support audience rules yet; guide says enabled Fin articles are visible there.

facts.label: Publishing limits / translations
facts.value: No separate Fin-only public help-center custom-domain tariff, article-count limit, article translation workflow or article-feedback entitlement established.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Autonomous grounded answers, clarification, Procedures, external actions, routing and human escalation; Fin differs from human-facing Copilot and operations-facing Operator.

facts.label: Knowledge sources
facts.value: Internal articles, snippets, public websites, documents/PDFs and app-source imports including Zendesk, Salesforce, Freshdesk, Guru, Notion and Confluence.

facts.label: Documented source limits
facts.value: FAQ: up to 10 external sources, up to 3,000 URLs per source, potentially fewer depending on site structure/duplicates; no cap on number of articles referenced per answer stated there.

facts.label: Sync schedule conflict
facts.value: General FAQ says Zendesk/Salesforce articles update every 24 hours; current Zendesk-specific importer guide says every hour. Public website sync is weekly with manual resync available.

facts.label: Source citations and debugging
facts.value: Salesforce sync guide discusses customer article citations, public URL mapping and Open in Help Center. Fin debugger shows up to 10 relevant source items for an answer.

facts.label: Approval and releases
facts.value: Fin training supports Publish to Fin Main or saving content changes to a release for testing; content availability/audience controls remain editable.

facts.label: Native connector handoff
facts.value: Fin passes context to agents in the existing helpdesk. Zendesk supports creating a ticket with summary/data or a live-agent handoff with its Sunshine connection.

facts.label: Generic fallback choices
facts.value: No escalation, URL redirect, JavaScript to another widget/email client, or Data connector ticket creation. Email collection/verification can precede ticket creation.

facts.label: Out-of-hours behavior
facts.value: Messenger reply expectations can show office-hour availability. Exact human response time and complete after-hours handling depend on configured workflow/helpdesk.

facts.label: Business actions
facts.value: Data connectors support read/write API calls for refunds, subscription/account updates and order/billing queries. Shopify, Stripe and WooCommerce have named official connector pages.

facts.label: Identity and authentication
facts.value: Live Data connectors require JWT or email-OTP user authentication; workspace tokens can use text/HTTP/user auth and multiple distinct header keys.

facts.label: Approval controls
facts.value: Procedures can include deterministic checks and cross-team approvals; exact approval requirements are configured rather than universal.

facts.label: Helpdesk connections
facts.value: Native documented connectors: Zendesk, Salesforce Service Cloud, Freshdesk/Freshchat and HubSpot; generic/custom platforms over API, URL or JavaScript handoff.

facts.label: Ecommerce and billing
facts.value: Official Shopify, Stripe and WooCommerce API Data connector routes; Shopify/Stripe pages also describe MCP templates currently limited to US-hosted Intercom workspaces.

facts.label: Developer stack and automation
facts.value: Official directory lists GitHub, Linear, custom MCP, REST API, Zapier and Slack routes.

facts.label: Agent API versus old FAQ
facts.value: Live developer guide describes approved Fin Agent API access on API v2.14+; general FAQ still calls Fin over API coming soon and says API-created conversations cannot use Fin.

facts.label: Agent API developer access
facts.value: Request access in workspace settings. Supported orchestration includes capabilities, ask, reply, Procedure run, escalate and start; status/reply events delivered by webhooks.

facts.label: Data API / model API boundary
facts.value: Fin for Platforms can create OAuth tokens for existing conversation data API, limited by authorizing teammate permissions. Fin API Platform requires annual spend US$250,000+ and access request.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: Not applicable: reviewed Fin is a hosted service; custom front-end/API or webhook hosting is not self-hosting the Fin core/models.

facts.label: Customer answers and Messenger UI
facts.value: Fin supports 45+ customer languages; Messenger configurable for up to 45 UI languages, falling back to base language then workspace default when exact variant unavailable.

facts.label: Content and staff translation
facts.value: Fin can sync localized content; customer-answer translation and human-facing Copilot/AI Inbox translation are distinct features.

facts.label: Operator UI locale matrix
facts.value: No complete Fin-only operator interface language matrix established in checked FAQs, training and Messenger language guides.

facts.label: Platforms and devices
facts.value: Browser-administered hosted agent; website/web-app Messenger and iOS/Android/React Native customer integrations; external-helpdesk accounts/API permissions per connection.

facts.label: Native operator apps / browser matrix
facts.value: No standalone Fin-for-Platforms native operator app or exhaustive browser/OS support matrix established in checked setup/API docs.

facts.label: Metrics and billable outcomes
facts.value: Fin reports involved/answered/resolved/escalated/pending conversations and automation rate. Automation rate excludes Procedure handoffs, even though a Procedure handoff can be billable.

facts.label: Analysis / CSAT scope
facts.value: Basic/custom reports with CSV drill-in; Pro adds CX Score, Topics, Trends, Recommendations, Monitors/Scorecards and Operator. Fin CSAT supported on named Messenger/API routes, not Zendesk tickets; HubSpot guide excludes its email/ticket CSAT.

facts.label: Conversation metadata export
facts.value: Custom Report chart drill-in can select columns and export CSV; Zendesk guide describes user-email export when customers supplied it.

facts.label: Full conversation text
facts.value: HubSpot guide: portal exports only initial message; full threads require API. Fin for Platforms OAuth tokens can read conversation data subject to teammate access.

facts.label: Knowledge, contacts, attachments and feedback
facts.value: No complete Fin-only bulk export/archive format covering training articles/snippets, all contacts, attachment binaries and standalone feedback found in checked docs.

facts.label: Operator conversations
facts.value: Operator FAQ explicitly says export/download of Operator conversations is not currently supported.

facts.label: Default and regional hosting
facts.value: Fin workspaces default to US. Contract customers can provision US/EU/Australia workspaces; changing region requires a new workspace and manual transfer/settings recreation.

facts.label: Own-model training
facts.value: Fin says models train on deidentified past Fin interactions. BAA customers, EU/AU regionally hosted workspaces and previously opted-out customers are excluded; opt-out route is published.

facts.label: Third-party models/processors
facts.value: AI terms restrict third-party AI providers from training/improving their services with customer data. Public subprocessor list names AWS, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Microsoft and speech providers with region-specific sections.

facts.label: Cancel and access
facts.value: Cancelling non-contracted monthly plan preserves access to billing-period end; afterward data is unavailable until resubscription. Cancellation alone is not immediate data deletion.

facts.label: Workspace deletion
facts.value: Self-service workspace deletion is irreversible and completed within 14 days; it cancels non-contracted subscription. Active annual contracts need support to delete.

facts.label: Contractual retention / backups
facts.value: DPA: written deletion request completed within max 30 days; absent request, automatic system deletion 180 days after agreement termination/expiry; backup deletion 14 days after live deletion, with legal-retention exceptions.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Fin AI Agent at fin.ai; active customer-support/customer-agent product. Company formerly called Intercom is now branded Fin; Intercom Helpdesk retains its product name.

facts.label: Acquisition notice
facts.value: Official announcement dated 2026-09-10 says Salesforce completed its acquisition of Fin, formerly Intercom; Fin continues serving customers and developing its agent.

facts.label: Operator and legal entities
facts.value: Salesforce is Fin's parent following the completed 2026-09-10 acquisition. Current linked service terms name Intercom, Inc. (US/Delaware) for customers shipping to US/Brazil, and Intercom R&D Unlimited Company (Ireland) elsewhere.

facts.label: Markets
facts.value: Terms permit a person or entity to be the customer; service is for commercial/professional use. No complete purchasing-country eligibility or regional Fin price table found.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary hosted SaaS: Fin with an external helpdesk, Fin with Intercom Helpdesk, and separately gated API offerings. No self-hosted core distribution established.

facts.label: Support access
facts.value: Fin help docs provide Community Forum and support routes; Messenger/contact Sales available, with team@intercom.com in deletion/support instructions.

facts.label: Standalone support hours
facts.value: Linked support policy specifies Essential/Advanced/Expert helpdesk tiers, with 24/7 mechanisms and non-guaranteed targets. No equally explicit standalone Fin-for-Platforms staffing schedule established.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; Fin blog has a new Pendo integration entry dated today, Fin 4 announcement dated 2026-10-07, and acquisition close dated 2026-09-10. Proposed review 2026-12-05.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Free WordPress plugin is an ongoing offer, separate from the annually paid Pro licence.

facts.label: Free usage limits
facts.value: Free includes unlimited support agents, tickets and attachments; default local WordPress file storage is included.

facts.label: Free workflow and integration boundaries
facts.value: Free has web inbox, internal notes, basic personal/product reports, customer portal, REST API, FluentCRM/Fluent Forms and ticket importer. Email piping, saved replies, workflows, collision detection and built-in AI assistance are Pro.

facts.label: Other free quotas
facts.value: No published fixed cap was found for free storage bytes, history age or article count; site/server limits are not specified as a vendor allowance.

facts.label: Trial and refund distinction
facts.value: A time-limited Pro trial, trial-card rule and trial-data expiry were not published in the checked pricing/docs/terms. Free core can be used to evaluate portal ticketing.

facts.label: Agency paid plan

facts.label: 50 Sites paid plan
facts.value: Fifty domains; advertised first-year $319/year beside $399 regular; annual billing. Five hundred business-email piping addresses, unlimited parsing, one year updates/support.

facts.label: Currency and tax
facts.value: Pricing displays $, but an explicit ISO currency code and tax-inclusion rule for these offers were not established.

facts.label: Renewal invoice
facts.value: The discount is explicitly first-year only. Exact future renewal amount, price protection and ordinary auto-renewal/cancellation mechanics were not established in the checked product-specific sources.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Annual domain-activation licence with email-piping address allocation; agents and support tickets are unlimited. AI API usage is billed by the selected provider.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and dependency
facts.value: Cheapest paid tier is one Single Site licence, billed annually. Pro requires active Free core and licence activation; hosted email piping requires an active Pro licence.

facts.label: Licence expiry scope
facts.value: Docs require a valid licence for Pro activation/updates and getting email-piping details. A complete feature-by-feature behavior after licence expiry was not established.

facts.label: Built-in AI charges
facts.value: Pro required for ticket AI writing/summary/sentiment and AI audit. Choose OpenAI, Google Gemini or Anthropic Claude using the buyer's own API key; provider bills usage directly, with no additional Fluent Support AI usage fee beyond Pro.

facts.label: MCP AI cost route
facts.value: MCP access works in Free or Pro with the free FluentHub companion plugin. External AI client/provider/infrastructure bills are separate.

facts.label: AI operational limits
facts.value: AI Ticket Audit processes up to 200 tickets per run and up to 100 tickets per user/hour; unchanged already-audited tickets are skipped.

facts.label: AI at 100 and 500 units
facts.value: No exact cost for 100/500 generated answers or audits can be calculated without model, tokens and context. Known base: Pro first-year $103 for built-in tools, or Free licence $0 for MCP access, plus external AI cost.

facts.label: Refund policy
facts.value: Full refund within 14 days of original purchase when the products cannot be made to work; parent purchase terms explicitly exclude subscription renewals from refunds.

facts.label: Resource extras and stopping rules
facts.value: Licence includes unlimited agents/tickets/email parsing, but piping address/domain allocations differ. Detailed over-allocation behavior, extra-address prices and automatic recharge rules were not found.

facts.label: Email automation safeguard
facts.value: For tickets originating by email, automatic confirmations/workflow replies are limited per customer to ten total and two with the same subject within three hours; human-written replies are not held back.

facts.label: Brand styling
facts.value: Gutenberg portal customization, form-label edits and inbox email templates/from-name/agent signature controls are documented.

facts.label: Email signature behavior
facts.value: Pricing says a signature is added after agent replies; detailed notification docs say it appears only where the agent.signature smartcode is placed and is not appended automatically.

facts.label: Branding removal by surface
facts.value: An explicit remove-vendor-credit entitlement/fee for portal and outgoing email was not found; no native chat-widget surface was established.

facts.label: Solo access
facts.value: Free download/install and direct paid purchase routes. WordPress is required; one person can operate it. Paid site licensing allows unlimited agents rather than requiring a minimum team.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: self-hosted WordPress help desk, customer ticket portal and shared support workflow, with optional email piping and agent AI. Overlaps WordPress commerce/LMS support and knowledge-base integrations.

facts.label: Customer email
facts.value: Pro email piping forwards support-address mail to the provided mailbox, creates tickets and accepts email replies. Notifications can be customized independently.

facts.label: Website ticket forms
facts.value: Free native customer portal via shortcode/Gutenberg block; customers create, view and reply to tickets. Pro adds advanced form/custom-field/integration functions.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Pro Twilio integration sends ticket notifications to agents and lets configured agents reply to existing tickets from WhatsApp.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Pro integration for agent ticket notifications and replies from configured Slack threads.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Pro integration posts ticket notifications to a Discord webhook/channel.

facts.label: Telegram
facts.value: Pro comparison explicitly includes Telegram as a notification integration.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: No native synchronous visitor-chat offer or current widget-installation guide was established.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: A general mobile/app chat SDK or native in-app chat channel was not found.

facts.label: Instagram and Messenger
facts.value: Native Instagram/Messenger customer messaging and channel-specific terms were not established.

facts.label: SMS and voice
facts.value: A native customer SMS inbox or voice/calling offer and pricing were not found.

facts.label: Core collaboration
facts.value: Free supports agent assignment/permissions, internal notes, priorities, product/inbox filtering and basic customer history.

facts.label: Paid productivity
facts.value: Pro adds saved replies, collision detection, merged tickets, draft/autosave, custom fields/tags, manual/automatic workflows and auto assignment/closing.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: A native working-hours/holiday calendar with documented customer-response SLA pause rules was not established.

facts.label: Sites and business inboxes
facts.value: Paid domains: one/five/fifty. Docs allow multiple business inboxes and inbox-specific portals; the plan's managed piping allocations are ten/fifty/five hundred addresses.

facts.label: Cross-site portal
facts.value: Pro Remote Portal runs Free+Pro on the support site and free Fluent Support Client on the main WordPress site; HTTPS/application-password connection carries tickets and customer context.

facts.label: Knowledge-base suggestions
facts.value: Ticket form can suggest matching WordPress posts/pages/attachments and selected custom post types while the customer types a subject; article suggestion count is configurable.

facts.label: BetterDocs integration
facts.value: Pro integration with installed/active BetterDocs offers related docs on ticket creation; configure docs post type and suggested-article count.

facts.label: Article limits and publication scope
facts.value: No Fluent Support-specific total article quota, standalone help-center search/translation limit or article feedback entitlement was established.

facts.label: Built-in AI role
facts.value: Pro agent assistant drafts/rephrases replies, summarizes conversations and analyzes customer sentiment; agent inserts generated text and uses Add Reply/Reply and Close to send.

facts.label: External AI agent role
facts.value: Free MCP access can let authorized external AI clients read/manage tickets, draft or send replies, close/assign/tag tickets and query customer context. Docs describe autonomous first-response workflows.

facts.label: Built-in AI knowledge and review
facts.value: Uses ticket conversations/latest customer message and editable prompts; generated drafts can be selected, regenerated and inserted into the reply editor for review.

facts.label: MCP knowledge and boundaries
facts.value: AI can retrieve authorized tickets, customer history, queue context and saved replies; mailbox/agent permissions apply. Draft and publish tools exist alongside direct sending.

facts.label: Knowledge guarantees
facts.value: No fixed AI source count/size allowance, required citation format, recurring source-sync interval or universal enforced approval setting was found.

facts.label: Human review and fallback
facts.value: Native helper leaves tickets with agents. MCP can save a draft for review, leave an internal note/@mention or send a holding reply that leaves the ticket waiting on the team.

facts.label: After-hours bot escalation
facts.value: A customer-bot escalation trigger matrix, staffed-hours routing guarantee and transcript-transfer contract were not found.

facts.label: Commerce context
facts.value: Pro WooCommerce integration exposes order/product purchase, billing and shipping details using order/product custom fields; WooCommerce must be active on the site.

facts.label: MCP customer actions and checks
facts.value: MCP uses revocable WordPress Application Passwords and account permissions. It can update customer name/title/note/address but explicitly cannot change customer email.

facts.label: External action verification
facts.value: Prebuilt refund/account-change tools and a universal customer-verification/per-action approval process were not established.

facts.label: Relevant WordPress connections
facts.value: Free: FluentCRM/Fluent Forms. Pro: WooCommerce, Easy Digital Downloads and other plugin integrations; BetterDocs supplies article suggestions.

facts.label: Automation connections
facts.value: Pro workflows can send outgoing webhooks to external tools such as Zapier/Pabbly with JSON/form data and selected included information.

facts.label: Other developer-stack links
facts.value: Turnkey Shopify, Stripe, Linear and GitHub ticket connectors with current licence/fee terms were not established.

facts.label: Public REST API
facts.value: Free/Pro comparison includes REST API. Docs use WordPress authentication, with Application Passwords/basic auth as the described simple route; tickets, customers, replies and reports have documented endpoints.

facts.label: Webhooks and MCP
facts.value: Incoming webhooks/workflows are Pro; outgoing workflows send configured JSON/form payloads. MCP is separately available in Free via FluentHub.

facts.label: Rate and delivery guarantees
facts.value: A universal REST request limit, webhook retry/delivery guarantee and customer mobile/widget library matrix were not found.

facts.label: Runtime requirements
facts.value: WordPress 5.6+, PHP 7.4+ and MySQL 5.6+ are documented. Free installs through WordPress or ZIP; Pro adds a ZIP and valid licence, with Free kept active.

facts.label: Operations and storage
facts.value: Operator supplies WordPress hosting, mail delivery, backups and updates. Tickets/replies/customers/settings use plugin database tables; default media path is wp-content/uploads/fluent-support with ticket-specific folders.

facts.label: Custom email processing option
facts.value: Docs link an official email-parser repository for deploying a custom AWS Lambda function; requires JavaScript/serverless knowledge, an extra domain and Amazon SES inbound configuration.

facts.label: UI language evidence
facts.value: WordPress listing exposes eleven locales: Dutch, English (US), French (France), Japanese, Korean, Persian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish (Chile), Spanish (Spain) and Turkish. Version 2.0 changelog added full RTL interface support.

facts.label: AI/article language scope
facts.value: AI drafts are documented to follow the customer's language. A guaranteed language list/quality promise and Fluent Support-specific article translation plan were not found.

facts.label: Devices and dependencies
facts.value: Browser-based WordPress dashboard and responsive portal/frontend agent experience; WordPress required. Pro Remote Portal uses a second WordPress site and Client plugin.

facts.label: Reporting and satisfaction
facts.value: Free includes personal/product reports; Pro adds agent/business/activity/time tracking and satisfaction rating. Current reports cover ticket volume, response output, workload and agent performance.

facts.label: AI review report
facts.value: Pro AI Ticket Audit returns mood, score out of ten and short summary, with completed/failed counts and filters; agent AI activities include usage information.

facts.label: Personal data export
facts.value: Free public source registers WordPress privacy exporters for customer records, ticket content/metadata and customer-authored response content, with attachment links.

facts.label: Developer extraction
facts.value: REST reference includes ticket content, response/attachment structures, customer records and saved replies. Authenticated JSON extraction is an option for custom migration.

facts.label: Report export
facts.value: Public DataExporter emits agent-report CSV containing selected identity/performance columns, optionally likes/dislikes; report access permission and nonce are checked.

facts.label: All-object export gaps
facts.value: A one-click all-ticket/conversation/attachment-binary export, dedicated feedback export and complete article export were not found.

facts.label: Core and email-processing location
facts.value: Core database/files are on the operator's WordPress infrastructure. Managed piping forwards email to AWS Lambda; the piping policy says transient processing, encrypted transit and no retained copy after processing.

facts.label: AI and third-party data
facts.value: Configured AI provider receives conversation context for writing/audits. Remote Portal moves ticket/customer context between two WordPress sites; attachment integrations may use external storage.

facts.label: AI training and subprocessors
facts.value: No universal model-training exclusion, complete product subprocessor list or fixed vendor-hosted ticket-data region was established.

facts.label: Deactivation and uninstall
facts.value: Deactivation pauses features. Deleting the plugin does not permanently remove database records; reinstalling can recover them. Docs direct the user to support for permanent removal.

facts.label: Operator deletion and logs
facts.value: WordPress privacy eraser source calls ticket deletion for that customer's tickets and deletes the customer. Portal setting can delete ticket attachments on close. Admin cleanup removes selected old logs, minimum age seven days, not tickets/replies/customers/attachments.

facts.label: Report and vendor-account retention
facts.value: Reporting snapshots are captured every six hours and kept up to fifteen days. General privacy says vendor purchase/order information is retained unless deletion is requested.

facts.label: History and deletion deadlines
facts.value: A universal ticket-history expiry, vendor inactivity purge and guaranteed backup/provider erasure deadline were not found.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Fluent Support; active WordPress support-ticket plugin from WPManageNinja. Current documented version 2.5.0 was released November 2, 2026.

facts.label: Owner and country
facts.value: WPManageNinja LLC; registered office at 2035 Sunset Lake Road, Suite B-2, Newark, Delaware 19702, United States.

facts.label: Buying regions
facts.value: A complete buying-country restriction list or regional offer matrix was not found.

facts.label: Editions and free licence
facts.value: Self-hosted Free core and separately installed Pro add-on. Free plugin metadata explicitly says GPLv2 or later.

facts.label: Pro licence and service rights
facts.value: Product terms say all products are GPL; paid domain limits govern updates/support. Agency/50-domain keys may be used in client projects but cannot be resold or redistributed as licence keys.

facts.label: Vendor support access
facts.value: Paid plans include one year priority support. Docs, public plugin support and WPManageNinja ticket portal are available routes; premium tickets require account and licence details.

facts.label: Support timing
facts.value: Support guide says standard business hours, typically Monday–Friday. Exact timezone/hours and guaranteed response/resolution SLA were not published there.

facts.label: Freshness and review date
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026; changelog 2.5.0 released November 2, 2026, with scheduled replies, workflow editor, admin tools and fixes. Our next review target is December 5, 2026.

apps.name: Formilla
apps.line: Website live chat with human agents, chatbots, and customer messaging.

free.text: Free for 1 agent with unlimited live chats

cells.ai: $29.99/month for 100 bot chats

agents.math: The free Standard plan includes one agent and unlimited live chats, so 100 fits.
Prices for extra agents are not published, so the total for three agents is unknown.

apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found since January 1, 2025.

facts.label: Free offer
facts.value: Standard is ongoing Free for one agent, distinct from the 15-day paid-feature trial.

facts.label: Free human limits
facts.value: One chat-agent login; unlimited live chats.

facts.label: Free contact/history expiry
facts.value: Last 60 days of contact management and chat history. Pricing says contacts created over 60 days ago have all related chat data removed, including recent chats.

facts.label: Free tools and caps
facts.value: Desktop/mobile apps, widget colors/text/languages, five saved replies, five banned visitors, transcripts, reports, autoresponder and Google Analytics; 5,000 monthly popup views.

facts.label: Free exclusions
facts.value: No third-party integrations, proactive chat, custom pre-chat form, hours/department controls, multiple widgets/sites, file sharing, branding removal or native bots in current comparison.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Fifteen-day free trial, no credit card required. AI web-source allowance is limited during trial but no exact page count stated.

facts.label: Post-trial transition
facts.value: Exact automatic downgrade/payment behavior, trial AI-chat allowance and excess-agent/configuration handling not established.

facts.label: Premium price
facts.value: $17.49/month recurring monthly, or $13.99/month with yearly term paid in full; one agent included.

facts.label: Professional price
facts.value: $49.99/month monthly, or $39.99/month with yearly term paid in full; two agents included.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Custom pricing starting at $299.99/month; custom agent count/full-team access, included bots and tailored implementation/support.

facts.label: Currency and taxes
facts.value: Direct website offer shows $ without an established currency code; exact tax treatment not established.

facts.label: Human billing unit
facts.value: Account package includes a number of agent user logins: Free 1, Premium 1+, Professional 2+, Enterprise custom. Extra agents incur package-dependent fees.

facts.label: Usage units
facts.value: Human live chats unlimited on all current packages. Custom Bot and ChatGPT Bot chats have distinct monthly allowances; marketing popup views and email contacts are other units.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Paid service can start with one-agent Premium at $17.49 monthly or calculated $167.88/year; no AI mandatory for human chat.

facts.label: ChatGPT Bots and Copilot
facts.value: Premium/Professional add-on $29.99/month includes up to 100 bot chats/month; higher tiers available for added charge. Enterprise includes bots with custom limits.

facts.label: Custom Bots
facts.value: Separate rule-based add-on $24.99/month for up to 200 chats/month on Premium/Professional; Enterprise included.

facts.label: AI higher tiers and unit details
facts.value: Exact 500-chat tier price, session/reset definition, overage rate, Copilot counting and model multipliers not established.

facts.label: AI 100-chat illustration
facts.value: Our calculation: one-agent Premium $17.49 + ChatGPT add-on $29.99 = $47.48/month for purchased 100-bot-chat allowance.

facts.label: AI 500-chat illustration
facts.value: Exact total cannot be calculated: higher AI tier quote required; known Premium base remains $17.49/month or $167.88/year.

facts.label: Additional agent/volume charges
facts.value: Extra agents and higher bot tiers have additional fees; Enterprise email includes up to 10,000 contacts with more available for additional fee.

facts.label: Cancellation process
facts.value: Terms require cancellation by email and allow 24 to 48 business hours to process licence cancellation. Monthly paid plan labelled recurring.

facts.label: Refunds and quota behavior
facts.value: Refund policy, paid proration, payment grace period, exact bot hard-stop/auto-recharge behavior, unused quota carryover and idle-account deletion threshold not established.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: Professional/Enterprise remove Formilla branding from widgets/popups on request. Terms require written agreement for unlabeled/white-label use.

facts.label: Email branding
facts.value: Enterprise outbound email advertised without Formilla mention using own business domain. Support transcript/offline notification mark-removal rules not established.

facts.label: Self-service and solo access
facts.value: Public signup at https://www.formilla.com/sign-up.aspx; Free/Standard and Premium each include one chat agent. Enterprise uses contact-sales/custom pricing.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website live support plus autonomous FAQ-style AI and agent drafting, with lead capture, popups and outbound marketing.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native widget for websites, with live human messaging, offline submissions and optional bots. Unlimited human chats all plans.

facts.label: Offline email follow-up
facts.value: Offline chat form captures messages/contact email; transcripts can be emailed; vendor WordPress description says offline submissions can be searched/responded to.

facts.label: Campaign email
facts.value: Enterprise current comparison includes outbound email from verified business domain, with chosen From and Reply-to user; marketing guide describes campaign scheduling.

facts.label: Other customer channels
facts.value: Native WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, voice, Slack/Discord inboxes and generic support-mailbox intake not established.

facts.label: Departments and transfer
facts.value: Premium+ departments assign chat agents to widgets; current feature page documents two-click chat transfer with a private note to teammate.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Five saved replies on Free; no limitation on paid plans. Hashtag shortcuts can insert replies quickly.

facts.label: Hours and autoresponder
facts.value: Premium+ hours switch widget online/offline and collect offline forms; autoresponder available on all plans, e.g. after 60 seconds without agent response.

facts.label: Visitor targeting
facts.value: Premium+ proactive chat, Chat Smart Messages, custom forms and advanced page/CSS rules. Professional+ live visitor monitoring and file sharing.

facts.label: Collision protection
facts.value: Specific simultaneous-agent collision warning not established; user/agent typing indicators are published.

facts.label: Websites and widgets
facts.value: Premium+ unlimited live-chat widgets; Professional/Enterprise support installation on up to five websites from one dashboard.

facts.label: Multi-brand separation
facts.value: Multiple widgets can vary languages/colors/text and use display rules; departments decide which agents receive a widget's chats.

facts.label: Customer help center
facts.value: Native public article portal/search/custom domain/private article publishing not established. AI topics/website training are internal bot knowledge.

facts.label: Autonomous AI
facts.value: ChatGPT/Helper Bots answer website questions from trained topics/web content, with widget selection and always/online/offline availability.

facts.label: Agent Copilot
facts.value: Drafts answers using selected bot knowledge; agent inserts/edits before sending. Also usable in saved conversations and as a global lookup tool.

facts.label: Fixed Custom Bots
facts.value: Rule-based buttons/steps, lead fields, audience filters, Calendly scheduling and routing to Helper Bot.

facts.label: AI sources and source cap
facts.value: Authored Topics, public website pages and hosted documents by URL; scan single page or follow links to selected depth. Premium/Professional: 250 URLs; Enterprise custom.

facts.label: Review and manual training
facts.value: Preview imported content/test questions; Train my Bot lists untrained visitor messages with full-chat context to add/edit Topics.

facts.label: Source freshness and citations
facts.value: Automatic refresh interval, topic/character/document-size cap, supported document file types, guaranteed answer citations and answer-by-answer approval queue not established.

facts.label: AI no-answer and availability
facts.value: Configurable No Match Response can state office hours/follow-up instructions. AI may answer always, while humans online, or only offline.

facts.label: Human handoff limits
facts.value: Exact native ChatGPT-to-human takeover trigger, confidence threshold, visitor request button and automatic offline escalation destination not established.

facts.label: Scheduling and data collection
facts.value: Custom Bot can display Calendly to book a time and collect visitor fields; JS/REST can push customer attributes/events into Formilla.

facts.label: High-impact AI actions
facts.value: Native autonomous order lookup, refunds, account changes, arbitrary action calls and customer approval controls not established. Enterprise offers custom backend/API implementation by arrangement.

facts.label: Visitor identity protection
facts.value: Optional JavaScript secure mode uses server-generated SHA256 HMAC over logged-in user ID or email and a private account key.

facts.label: WordPress/WooCommerce and Shopify
facts.value: Official WordPress plugin works on WordPress/WooCommerce; Shopify app/manual Liquid install documented.

facts.label: CRM and automation
facts.value: Premium+ Zapier integration; native Infusionsoft integration creates contacts and posts new chat transcripts into CRM Notes, with email needed for contact creation.

facts.label: Other stack connectors
facts.value: Native Stripe support-data/refunds, Slack, Discord, Linear and GitHub integrations not established.

facts.label: JavaScript API
facts.value: Public contact/custom-attribute and event interface; secure mode available. Manual widget code uses Formilla.contactAttributes, Formilla.guid and Formilla.loadWidgets().

facts.label: REST API
facts.value: Public guide documents create/update contact via POST /contacts; owner enables disabled-by-default REST API, authenticating with formilla_auth_token header.

facts.label: Advanced integrations
facts.value: Enterprise advertises custom API integrations/webhooks to backend systems. Public standard-plan webhook event/limit/signature reference and native customer mobile SDK not established.

facts.label: Running the backend yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to researched hosted server offer. WordPress client installs/activates on own WordPress site and uses Formilla account/service.

facts.label: Widget languages
facts.value: All packages support editing widget text for any language; presets named include Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, German, French, Polish and Chinese.

facts.label: Copilot and other language surfaces
facts.value: Copilot Answer In selector follows source widget language and can be changed. Exact native AI supported-language list, staff-interface locales and automatic live-chat translation not established.

facts.label: Agent devices
facts.value: Web dashboard, Windows/macOS desktop apps, iPhone/iPad and Android agent apps included on every current plan.

facts.label: Website/platform needs
facts.value: Manual script or supported CMS plugin/app; WordPress/WooCommerce, Shopify and other platforms documented. Basic custom website does not require a particular CMS.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: All plans include basic offline-chat/user/device reports and Google Analytics chat events. Popup reports show views/clicks/conversion and subscriber export.

facts.label: AI review/reporting
facts.value: Standard AI setup has untrained-message review with full-chat context; Enterprise advertises sentiment, knowledge gaps and conversational AI analytics.

facts.label: Chat records
facts.value: View transcripts in dashboard and configure transcript-email notifications, all plans.

facts.label: Captured popup contacts
facts.value: Subscriber report for email-capture popups supports Export to Excel, with date filtering.

facts.label: Transcript integrations
facts.value: Infusionsoft can receive new completed chat transcripts and contact details; Zapier also advertised for transcript delivery.

facts.label: Complete export coverage
facts.value: Bulk contact/conversation/attachment export, bot topic/source portability and report/feedback export schema not established. Public REST guide is contact write integration, not data extraction.

facts.label: Hosting provider
facts.value: Privacy identifies Liquid Web Inc. datacenters as physical infrastructure host. Exact selected country/region and customer region choice not established.

facts.label: AI provider/data flow
facts.value: AI Helper Bots use OpenAI ChatGPT; both customer and staff chat messages may be sent to OpenAI. Formilla says no additional storage beyond exchanges recorded in the account.

facts.label: Training, DPA and subprocessors
facts.value: Blanket no-AI-training promise, model-provider retention configuration, complete named subprocessor list and public DPA text not established.

facts.label: Paid and Free retention conflict
facts.value: Privacy says customer data retained indefinitely unless deleted; current pricing specifically removes all related chat data for Standard contacts created over 60 days ago.

facts.label: Active deletion timing
facts.value: Delete customer data from Contacts; deletion queue approximately 0 to 72 hours. Separate backup media can retain data up to an additional 90 days.

facts.label: Termination and logs
facts.value: Terms permit destroying account/end-user data on or after 30 days from licence termination. User login/access logs kept for a rolling period up to 15 days.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Formilla; active live-chat/customer-engagement platform with ChatGPT Bots, Copilot, Custom Bots and marketing messaging/popups.

facts.label: Product relationships
facts.value: Formilla Live Chat and ChatGPT/Custom Bots are part of the platform. Formilla Edge describes marketing automation/email messaging; homepage also promotes Popup Builder and Buttonizer.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Formilla, LLC; company site/contact identifies San Diego, California, USA. About page says founded 2011.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Complete supported-country, excluded-market and business/consumer eligibility list not established.

facts.label: Hosted edition
facts.value: Proprietary hosted service with website integrations and agent desktop/mobile apps; terms license use of web software with a registered site.

facts.label: WordPress client licence
facts.value: Official formilla-live-chat WordPress plugin readme states GPLv2 or later. Hosted service remains governed by Formilla terms.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Chat/email support on all plans, with possible Free delay during support surges; phone support from Premium. Enterprise adds tailored priority SLA/account manager.

facts.label: Support schedule
facts.value: Exact staffed days, hours, timezone and standard-plan response commitment not established.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. ChatGPT guide published 2025-04-05, modified metadata 2026-10-27; privacy last modified 2025-03-27. Proposed next review 2026-12-05.

facts.label: File size and further charge rules

facts.label: Brand identity
facts.value: Company name, logo and favicon can be customized; code and form scripts allow further changes.

facts.label: Vendor-mark removal by surface

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Help desk with email tickets, agent/customer portals, knowledge base, assignment rules and telephony integrations.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email-to-ticket and replies using connected email accounts; multiple incoming/outgoing accounts supported.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: No ready-made visitor live-chat widget established in checked Helpdesk sources.

facts.label: In-app chat

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: No specific first-party Helpdesk WhatsApp inbox integration established.

facts.label: Instagram

facts.label: Messenger

facts.label: SMS

facts.label: Voice

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: No ready-made first-party Helpdesk Slack customer channel found.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No ready-made first-party Helpdesk Discord customer channel found.

facts.label: Ticket forms and portal
facts.value: Native customer portal creates tickets with description, custom template fields and attachments; email and agent-created tickets share the ticket system.

facts.label: Assignment and team access

facts.label: Private notes and saved replies

facts.label: Collision awareness

facts.label: Business hours, SLA and automation

facts.label: Sites, inboxes and brands

facts.label: Products and separate-brand quotas

facts.label: Knowledge base and access
facts.value: Articles/categories/subcategories, search and new-ticket suggestions; article visibility Public, Customers or Private.

facts.label: Custom domain

facts.label: Article feedback
facts.value: Helpful/not-helpful votes stored as HD Article Feedback; optional guest voting uses a browser cookie and permits up to five vote changes/hour/article.

facts.label: Native AI role
facts.value: No current Helpdesk-specific autonomous answering, drafting, summarizing or knowledge-answering entitlement established in the checked product offer.

facts.label: External AI-agent connection
facts.value: Framework v16+ offers MCP and frappectl connections so authenticated external agents can read/change documents and call allowed methods.

facts.label: AI knowledge controls
facts.value: No Helpdesk AI content-source size, sync schedule, citation or response-approval controls established.

facts.label: Human continuation and after-hours behavior
facts.value: Portal and email ticket history stays in the same ticket; an optional outside-working-hours banner explains expected delays.

facts.label: Custom actions and approval
facts.value: Human-operated form-script buttons can update ticket fields, create/link documents or call APIs; scripts can show a confirmation dialog.

facts.label: External AI action permissions
facts.value: Framework AI tools use the authenticated user's permissions; OAuth/browser authorization or API credentials connect a client.

facts.label: ERPNext connection
facts.value: Customer records synchronize bidirectionally with ERPNext, with bulk union merge and ongoing updates.

facts.label: Email, voice and custom automation
facts.value: Documented email providers, Twilio/Exotel calling, framework REST and document-event webhooks.

facts.label: Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe, Linear and GitHub
facts.value: No specific supported Helpdesk connector for this subset established in checked integration and developer pages.

facts.label: Public API
facts.value: Framework automatically provides authenticated JSON REST access to document types, with field selection, filters, pagination and user-role checks.

facts.label: Webhooks and request limits
facts.value: Document-event webhooks support conditions and optional HMAC-SHA256 signatures. Framework supports time-based fixed-window limits returning HTTP 429.

facts.label: SDK and MCP scope
facts.value: Generated framework/document access and v16+ MCP are available; no standard embedded Helpdesk customer-chat SDK found.

facts.label: Install paths and responsibilities
facts.value: Official production installer/container image, Bench installation or managed one-click Cloud hosting; self-hosters maintain infrastructure, email, backups and upgrades.

facts.label: Tagged release requirements
facts.value: Helpdesk v16.1.0 declares Python >=3.10, Frappe >=16,<17 and Telephony >=0.0.1,<1.0.0.

facts.label: Framework and development branches
facts.value: Current framework guide lists v16/develop with Python 3.14, MariaDB 11.8, NodeJS 24, Redis/Valkey 6+ and Yarn 1.22+; Helpdesk develop now targets Frappe 17 development.

facts.label: Maintenance and paid modules
facts.value: Latest stable release listed is v16.1.0 on 4 November 2026; public installation does not require a paid Helpdesk agent licence/module.

facts.label: Interface language resources
facts.value: Helpdesk source includes locale files such as Arabic, German, Spanish, French, Hindi, Portuguese/Brazilian Portuguese, Chinese and others.

facts.label: Article, widget and AI languages
facts.value: No complete supported-language matrix for articles, an embedded widget or AI answers found.

facts.label: Agent devices and mobile limitations
facts.value: Web application with PWA installation using Safari/Chrome Add to Home Screen; responsive ticket handling.

facts.label: Platform needs
facts.value: Standalone Frappe site, self-hosted or managed; not dependent on WordPress, Shopify or Gmail. Optional ERPNext and telephony add their own dependencies.

facts.label: Reports and satisfaction
facts.value: Dashboard: ticket volume, SLA fulfillment, first response, resolution and feedback ratings; team/agent/date filters; per-ticket analytics.

facts.label: Report export and AI review
facts.value: Ticket lists export CSV/Excel; Frappe Insights can create additional charts on Helpdesk data. No native failed-AI-answer review queue established.

facts.label: Ticket list export
facts.value: Agents can export selected or all filtered tickets; customer portal exports Excel or CSV with the list's displayed columns.

facts.label: Customers, contacts, articles and feedback records
facts.value: Framework Data Export supports CSV/Excel for selected document types/fields, subject to Read/Export permissions; REST provides another record access route.

facts.label: Messages and private notes
facts.value: Full site backup includes the database holding conversations/comments; exact content included in ticket-list CSV/Excel is not established.

facts.label: Attachments and full backup
facts.value: Framework File List can export selected files as ZIP. Cloud backup contains database, public files, private files and site configuration.

facts.label: Hosting regions and choice
facts.value: Cloud lets users choose provider and data-centre location; site page advertises five continents and ten countries and displays Mumbai for sampled entry plans.

facts.label: Processors and AI-use scope
facts.value: Processor list dated 16 September 2026 names hosting, payments, mail and support providers, plus Anthropic and OpenAI for data analysis.

facts.label: Training-use statement
facts.value: No Helpdesk-specific blanket no-training promise or exact message-to-model processing rule found.

facts.label: Data location for backups
facts.value: Cloud backup guide says offsite backups go to AWS S3 ap-south-1 Mumbai by default; privacy policy says all offsite backups are in India.

facts.label: Retention and deletion conflict
facts.value: Privacy policy says backups may remain up to six months; Cloud backup guide lists seven daily, four weekly, twelve monthly and ten yearly restore points.

facts.label: Requests, account retention and export window
facts.value: Deletion can be requested through support; policy retains account information/data for 180 days after termination, with legal/billing exceptions. No guaranteed post-cancellation export-access window found.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Frappe Helpdesk; active open-source support-ticket product from Frappe. Hosted and self-hosted routes are both offered.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Frappe Technologies Pvt. Ltd.; India.

facts.label: Markets and regional offers
facts.value: Prices are published in USD and INR; education and nonprofit discounts are available by contacting Frappe.

facts.label: Hosted edition
facts.value: Frappe Helpdesk on Frappe Cloud; pay for hosting and optional implementation/support services.

facts.label: Source licence and self-hosting
facts.value: Public Helpdesk source under GNU Affero General Public License version 3, AGPL-3.0.

facts.label: Support channels and eligibility
facts.value: Cloud support portal; free public installation docs and GitHub issue route. Product warranty is published for USD 50/month and above.

facts.label: Support scope conflict
facts.value: Helpdesk pricing describes product warranty as including guidance/feature help; the Cloud agreement expressly excludes functional how-to and configuration services.

facts.label: Published support hours and SLA
facts.value: Standard support hours Monday-Friday, 10:00-18:00 IST; critical-only weekend handling under the policy. Product-warranty Table I lists critical 1h response/4h resolution and low 2h response/40h resolution.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; latest stable v16.1.0 published 2026-11-04 at 19:33:52 UTC; next review by 2027-02-05.

apps.name: FreeScout
apps.line: Self-hosted shared email help desk with optional chat and knowledge modules.

free.text: Free AGPL software; you provide hosting

cells.channels: Email; chat requires a paid module
cells.ai: Free integration module; model/provider costs extra

apps.news: No sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Core software is free and self-hosted without a time-limited trial. AI Integration module is also free.

facts.label: Core limits
facts.value: Unlimited support agents, tickets and mailboxes.

facts.label: Other free resource limits
facts.value: No numeric contacts, storage, history or website cap found in core docs. Knowledge base and live chat require separate modules.

facts.label: Trial model
facts.value: No trial licence for paid modules; public demo lets buyers try many modules, but not on their own installation before purchase.

facts.label: Paid structure
facts.value: No monthly/annual agent tiers. Official paid modules are one-time purchases, including lifetime updates. Cards and PayPal supported.

facts.label: Exact current prices
facts.value: Localized storefront prices and currencies were not verified. Static HTML contains legacy-style purchase numbers, but site JavaScript replaces those prices from FastSpring.

facts.label: Tax
facts.value: Exact tax-inclusive totals and fixed billing currency not established; FastSpring handles invoices/VAT issues.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Core has no paid-seat unit; module key is sold for one FreeScout instance, regardless of working-agent count.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Zero software purchase needed for email core; optional modules paid in full upfront. No mandatory installation service.

facts.label: AI software charge
facts.value: AI Integration module is free, lifetime, AGPL-3.0; provider or local inference resources are separate.

facts.label: AI provider choices
facts.value: Supports OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, DeepSeek, xAI, Mistral, Groq, Perplexity, Together AI, Fireworks AI, DigitalOcean, Z.AI, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio and custom OpenAI-compatible endpoints.

facts.label: AI metering
facts.value: No unified token tariff, model multipliers, included request volume or fixed provider budget published by FreeScout.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Exact costs for 100 or 500 drafts/summaries cannot be calculated from published FreeScout inputs. Module licence component remains 0.

facts.label: Running and external fees
facts.value: Hosting, email delivery, storage and channel providers can charge separately; modules do not make those services free.

facts.label: Refunds
facts.value: Refund policy permits only inadvertent duplicate purchases of the same module; other refunds are not promised.

facts.label: Stopping rules
facts.value: No FreeScout credit recharge or ticket-volume hard stop published; operational failures can arise from server, mail, provider limits or module activation/connectivity.

facts.label: Email branding
facts.value: Remove outgoing email attribution using core Spread the Word setting, without purchasing a branding module.

facts.label: Widget branding
facts.value: Widgets White-Labeling removes Powered by FreeScout from Chat, Knowledge Base and End-User Portal contact widgets.

facts.label: App/help-center styling
facts.value: Customization & Rebranding changes logo, favicon/footer and custom CSS/email header/footer; does not remove widget attribution.

facts.label: Solo access
facts.value: Public core download/repository and self-service module purchase; no sales approval or paid-seat minimum for core. Requires server and connected email account.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared support mailbox/ticketing, extended by modules for chat, knowledge base and integrations.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native SMTP, IMAP/POP3 mailbox integration, with Google Workspace/Microsoft OAuth options.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Paid Live Chat module embeds on any website and receives/replies inside mailbox conversations.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Web widget can be embedded in a web application; no native customer iOS/Android chat SDK verified.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Paid module through 1msg.io or Twilio; WhatsApp Business only; customer must initiate.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: No official Instagram customer-message connector verified.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Paid Facebook module converts Page private messages to conversations and supports replies.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Paid SMS Tickets module uses Twilio to receive and reply; customer initiates, MMS limited to supported media.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Core supports recording phone conversations as tickets; live calling, phone-number provisioning or a native dialer not established.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Paid module sends event notifications to mapped public Slack channels, one Slack team/domain per FreeScout application.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No official customer intake/reply channel established.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Paid End-User Portal includes hosted ticket submission and embedded contact forms; creates tickets directly in database.

facts.label: Assignment, notes and collision
facts.value: Core assignment and internal notes; collision notice when agents open the same conversation and replying-agent highlight.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Paid Saved Replies module: mailbox replies, nested categories, global replies and default reply templates.

facts.label: Rules
facts.value: Paid Workflows: automatic/manual conditions and actions for assignment, status, messages, tags, deletion and webhooks.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Office Hours module gates automatic email replies; Chat has separate operating-hour settings.

facts.label: Mailboxes and brands
facts.value: Unlimited core mailboxes; each can have its own support portal, knowledge base and chat code.

facts.label: Customer separation
facts.value: Customers are global across mailboxes, not separate brand databases; Customer Visibility setting can hide customers from non-admins based on mailbox access.

facts.label: Knowledge base
facts.value: Paid module provides articles/categories, public or internal help content, images/files/video and embedded widget.

facts.label: Domains and translations
facts.value: One knowledge base per mailbox; custom domain configured on buyer's web server; multilingual articles/categories.

facts.label: Knowledge limits and feedback
facts.value: Numeric article/search-index limits and an article-voting configuration not established.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Agent copilot: draft replies, summarize conversations, improve spelling/grammar and reply wording.

facts.label: Knowledge-based bot
facts.value: No customer-facing knowledge bot/source-sync product documented by the official AI module. Knowledge-bot corpus limits/citations therefore not applicable to its published role.

facts.label: Agent AI context controls
facts.value: Exact context selection/truncation, maximum conversation size and draft approval permissions not fully specified in the checked module guide/README.

facts.label: Chat fallback
facts.value: Chat operating hours can replace chat with contact form, requiring End-User Portal module. Chat history is already in the support conversation.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: No autonomous AI refund, account-change or custom action/authorization framework documented.

facts.label: Portal identity
facts.value: Customer requests email login link, valid one hour; authenticated customer views/replies to own tickets.

facts.label: WooCommerce
facts.value: Paid integration displays recent customer orders in profile pane; different mailboxes can connect to different stores.

facts.label: Automation tools
facts.value: Official project links Zapier and Make; software API/webhook access is a separate module.

facts.label: Other stack connections
facts.value: No official direct Shopify, Stripe, Linear, GitHub or Discord connector verified in the checked module catalogue/project overview.

facts.label: API
facts.value: Paid API & Webhooks module; global and personal API keys, configurable browser-origin header; public reference documents customer/conversation/thread operations.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: POST on conversation/customer events; signed requests require PHP hash extension; non-2xx failures retried up to ten times over two hours.

facts.label: Numeric API quotas
facts.value: No numeric rate cap or paid API overage tariff found in module page or API reference.

facts.label: Runtime
facts.value: PHP 7.4–8.x; Nginx/Apache/IIS; MySQL 5.0+/MariaDB 5.0+/PostgreSQL listed. Installation guide warns against PHP 8.1 and supports newer versions.

facts.label: Installation and maintenance
facts.value: Configure database, web root, PHP/extensions, email, HTTPS and background jobs; scheduler every minute. Web updater/manual update and optional automatic update cron documented.

facts.label: Backup
facts.value: Copy installation directory and export database; restore both with compatible runtime/web-server setup.

facts.label: Agent languages
facts.value: Official README states 33 interface languages. Modules can be translated through Manage Translate and published/imported.

facts.label: Portal/widget and articles
facts.value: Portal uses logged-in user's language or app default; does not auto-detect browser language. Contact widget has explicit Language parameter; KB articles/categories multilingual.

facts.label: AI languages
facts.value: No tested/enumerated AI answer-language list published in module guide/README.

facts.label: Agent platforms
facts.value: Browser, iOS/Android agent apps, installable PWA for phones/desktops, and linked macOS menu-bar app.

facts.label: Mobile dependencies
facts.value: Native app push notifications require Mobile Notifications module; core browser/PWA push requires suitable HTTPS/browser permissions. Native app source not supplied according to FAQ.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Reports module includes conversation trends, agent productivity, response/resolution timing; satisfaction and time-tracking reports need corresponding extra modules.

facts.label: CSAT
facts.value: Satisfaction Ratings module rates individual email replies; not chats or other channels. Public internet access required for rating links.

facts.label: Autonomous AI analytics
facts.value: No autonomous-answer resolution/failure dashboard documented for the agent-copilot module.

facts.label: CSV export
facts.value: Paid Export Conversations exports metadata plus selected module data; explicitly excludes conversation thread text.

facts.label: Customers, text, notes, attachments
facts.value: API reference exposes customers, thread bodies/types and attachment metadata/file URLs; custom extraction requires API module and implementation.

facts.label: Article export
facts.value: No dedicated portable knowledge-article export format verified.

facts.label: Data location
facts.value: Buyer chooses self-hosted server/location; no vendor SaaS region selection. FAQ says no usage statistics collected and module activation sends application domain to vendor API.

facts.label: AI use and provider policy
facts.value: External provider or local inference selected by operator. No uniform FreeScout no-training or processor-retention guarantee found.

facts.label: Website purchase privacy
facts.value: Website stores purchase email and permits personal-data export/erasure requests, subject to administrative/legal/security exceptions.

facts.label: Deletion
facts.value: GDPR module deletes customer and all conversations in background, optionally deletes source emails on mail server; admin controls delegated permissions.

facts.label: Retention
facts.value: Operator controls deployment/backups; no vendor-defined ticket-history expiry or guaranteed backup-purge interval found.

facts.label: Outgoing mail logs
facts.value: Outgoing-email logs keep the last six months and are cleaned automatically once a month.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: FreeScout, active self-hosted help desk/shared inbox. Latest release listed when checked: 1.8.249, October 31, 2026.

facts.label: Team identity
facts.value: Official FAQ describes an international volunteer team whose members prefer anonymity.

facts.label: Module-store operator and country
facts.value: Web reader returned terms naming Badabing Lencap General Trading Limited, Hong Kong; direct reads of the same page omitted that operator sentence. Current legal attribution not fully reconciled.

facts.label: Regional purchase constraints
facts.value: No general country exclusion list found; Twilio number/SMS availability and Facebook business verification constrain individual channel modules.

facts.label: Core licence
facts.value: Self-hosted PHP application under GNU Affero General Public License version 3; source in official repository.

facts.label: Official modules
facts.value: Modules are also AGPL-3.0; paid keys deliver source and lifetime updates. Vendor requests one instance per key.

facts.label: Resale wording
facts.value: FAQ says module resale is not allowed, while its AGPL explanation permits sharing/modification any way the licence allows.

facts.label: Hosted edition
facts.value: Project explicitly does not provide a conventional hosted cloud service; it links third-party hosts/one-click installations instead.

facts.label: Support
facts.value: Docs/GitHub for core help; support email for module issues, bugs/security or private inquiries. Module support limited to confirmed bug fixes, without personal assistance.

facts.label: Support hours
facts.value: No staffed support hours or response-time SLA published in contact page, module FAQ or terms.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; release 1.8.249 published 2026-10-31 10:24:27 UTC. Next review 2026-12-05, our schedule.

apps.news: No sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: Ongoing Free offer for up to 10 agents, separate from the 14-day Enterprise trial.

facts.label: Free included scope
facts.value: Up to 10 agents; web/mobile widget, shared inbox, connected support email, roles/permissions and single sign-on in the current comparison.

facts.label: Free campaign contacts and AI
