facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 14-day Enterprise trial, no credit card required. Pricing says an account that does not continue will be suspended.

facts.label: Trial data
facts.value: Terms allow immediate suspension after trial and require export before trial ends; no obligation to retain trial data beyond that point.

facts.label: Paid plans / Growth / USD
facts.value: USD 23/agent/month billed monthly; USD 19/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Paid plans / Growth / INR
facts.value: INR 1,799/agent/month billed monthly; INR 1,499/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Paid plans / Pro / USD
facts.value: USD 59/agent/month billed monthly; USD 49/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Paid plans / Pro / INR
facts.value: INR 4,799/agent/month billed monthly; INR 3,999/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Paid plans / Enterprise / USD
facts.value: USD 95/agent/month billed monthly; USD 79/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Paid plans / Enterprise / INR
facts.value: INR 7,699/agent/month billed monthly; INR 6,399/agent/month equivalent billed annually.

facts.label: Tax and payment
facts.value: Fees exclude applicable taxes. Pricing accepts Visa, Mastercard, Discover and American Express; not PayPal. Offline payments follow USD pricing.

facts.label: Base and usage units
facts.value: Paid base is full working agent/month. AI sessions, Copilot seats, occasional-agent day passes, campaign contacts, connector tasks and voice services are separate units.

facts.label: AI session definition
facts.value: All end-user-to-AI interactions within 24 hours from session initiation count as one chat session; it is not a successful-resolution fee or a fee per message.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Per-agent pricing and self-service purchase are published; no larger seat minimum, standard setup fee or required AI add-on found in pricing/terms.

facts.label: Commitment and cancellation
facts.value: Monthly/annual terms; automatic renewal. General terms require written non-renewal/downgrade notice at least 30 days before term expiry and restrict mid-term seat reductions/downgrades.

facts.label: Freddy AI Agent price
facts.value: Growth/Pro/Enterprise: USD 49 per 100 chat AI sessions; INR 4,299 per 100 in the page’s INR data. First 500 sessions once per account for trial use.

facts.label: Freddy AI Copilot
facts.value: Pro/Enterprise add-on: USD 35/agent/month monthly or USD 29/agent/month billed annually; INR 2,879 or INR 2,399 respectively. Assign only to selected agents.

facts.label: Model/provider billing
facts.value: No public per-model multipliers, token-based Freshchat rate or separate mandatory customer-supplied model-provider bill established for native Freddy.

facts.label: AI examples / monthly Growth
facts.value: After the one-time 500 sessions: one human plus 100/500 AI sessions = USD 72/268 per monthly cycle; three humans = USD 118/314.

facts.label: AI examples / annual base
facts.value: Annual Growth base monthly equivalent plus 100/500 AI sessions per month = USD 68/264 for one human; USD 106/302 for three.

facts.label: AI exhaustion
facts.value: Usage emails at 70%, 80%, 90% and 100%. At exhaustion AI stops and live-chat deployment hands over to agents; self-service-only widget stops without human handoff.

facts.label: Auto-recharge and renewal
facts.value: Online-billed accounts can enable auto-recharge: one pack added when fewer than 50 sessions remain. Packs expire at cycle end, do not roll over, are not prorated and recur unless explicitly reduced.

facts.label: Day passes
facts.value: Occasional-agent day access: Growth USD 2/pass, Pro USD 7/pass, Enterprise USD 12/pass. Copilot day passes are not available.

facts.label: Connector and campaign extras
facts.value: Paid connector tasks: USD 80/5,000 tasks (INR 6,640 in page data). Campaign-contact add-on: USD 100/month per 5,000 contacts; paid plans include 500 campaign contacts/account/month.

facts.label: Other fees and inactive accounts
facts.value: SMS/voice/WhatsApp provider fees can be additional. A specific Free-account inactivity deletion clock, all human-volume hard stops and campaign auto-upgrade behaviour not established.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: All paid plans can remove Freshworks branding; cheapest is Growth, USD 23/month or USD 228/year for one seat (INR 1,799/month or INR 17,988/year).

facts.label: Email and portal branding
facts.value: Exact vendor-attribution removal rule for outgoing email or a separate help-center site, and trial-specific exceptions, not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service Freshchat trial/signup and paid-plan routes; an individual can be the Customer under terms.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: conversational support inbox for web/mobile chat, email and paid messaging channels, with bots and AI add-ons.

facts.label: Website and in-app chat
facts.value: Native web/mobile chat widget on Free and all paid plans.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email channel on all current plans; default support@yourcompany.freshchat.com address converts inbound email to conversations. Custom/Microsoft mail servers supported.

facts.label: Facebook and Instagram
facts.value: Integrated Facebook and Instagram messengers from Growth upwards.

facts.label: SMS, WhatsApp and LINE
facts.value: Paid pricing groups SMS, WhatsApp and LINE under text/digital messaging from Growth upwards.

facts.label: Deprecated Google channel
facts.value: Freshchat pricing still lists Google Business Messages, but Google says Business Profile chat ended July 31, 2024.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Freshcaller contact-center add-on/integration, with annual advertised starting rates USD 15/39/69 per agent/month for its Growth/Pro/Enterprise offers.

facts.label: Custom channels and missing intake
facts.value: Bring Your Own Channel is listed on Pro/Enterprise through APIs/webhooks. Dedicated native Slack/Discord customer inbox intake not established in checked Freshchat sources.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Canned replies, private notes, internal @mentions, transfer/assignment and resolving/reopening conversations documented in the Freshchat inbox guide.

facts.label: Routing and security gates
facts.value: Pro adds intelligent assignment/load balancing, multiple SLAs and agent availability dashboards. Enterprise adds skills, audit logs, JWT and allowed-domain/IP controls.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Business-hours guide documents global hours/away messages and multiple schedules from Pro. Holidays are explicitly unavailable in Freshchat.

facts.label: Collision warning
facts.value: Dedicated simultaneous-reply/collision-warning capability and exact Freshchat plan not established.

facts.label: Sites and widgets
facts.value: Growth and above allow multiple widgets, up to 30/account. Each extra widget has a unique WidgetUuid; the default widget differs.

facts.label: Identity separation across sites
facts.value: Classic web SDK documents siteId separation; current v2 uses multiple-widget configuration. Exact total domain/brand/support-address/phone-number caps not established.

facts.label: Help content
facts.value: Growth and above can display FAQ categories/articles inside the conversations widget; Freshdesk solution articles can be imported through integration.

facts.label: Help-center limits
facts.value: Exact article/category cap, independent custom-domain help-center offer and article-feedback gates not established for standalone Freshchat.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Freddy AI Agent automates customer chat/knowledge answers and workflows on paid plans; Copilot helps selected Pro/Enterprise humans with summaries, suggestions and response improvements.

facts.label: Standalone versus shared AI docs
facts.value: Chat AI is advertised for Freshchat, but some current shared setup guides require Freshdesk Omni and describe email agents in Freshdesk mailboxes.

facts.label: AI knowledge and citations
facts.value: Linked Studio knowledge guide covers public URLs, files, solution articles and custom Q&A; reference visibility is configurable. It explicitly mentions standalone Freshchat limitations on category selection.

facts.label: Knowledge limits differ in docs
facts.value: Studio introduction lists 100 files for chat AI; linked September 2026 knowledge guide lists 200/agent and account, up to 35 MB/file.

facts.label: Refresh and review
facts.value: Knowledge guide provides resync/relearn, source visibility controls and adding/editing Q&A. Exact guaranteed standalone URL-refresh interval and approval-before-every-answer control not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Chat AI workflow guide supports agent handoff with conversation context; triggers can include customer/AI choice and outside-hours handling.

facts.label: Outside working hours
facts.value: Global away messages, offline experience and response expectations are documented. Workflows can route, give an estimated response or create external follow-up when configured.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Agent workflows can collect order details, call custom APIs and chain lookup/refund/cancellation or account-update steps.

facts.label: Identity and approvals
facts.value: Enterprise JWT authenticates widget users; v2 SDK documents RS256 and backend-generated user identity. Workflow guide describes validation/approval flows; universal mandatory refund approval not established.

facts.label: Featured connections
facts.value: Official Freshchat integrations page names Shopify, Salesforce, Slack, Jira and Five9.

facts.label: WooCommerce
facts.value: WooCommerce by ChargeDesk is listed as a third-party marketplace app for Freshchat/Freshsales Suite, including payment/refund/subscription management.

facts.label: Stripe and missing dev connections
facts.value: Opened Stripe by ChargeDesk listing targets Freshdesk/Omni, not Freshchat. Current native Freshchat Stripe, Linear, GitHub and Discord connection/gate not established.

facts.label: Freshdesk integration
facts.value: Documented integration shares customer/ticket context, converts conversations to tickets and imports solution articles.

facts.label: API and SDK
facts.value: Public REST API uses access-token authentication; web SDK provides chat/user controls. URLs distinguish standalone and Freshsales Suite accounts.

facts.label: Current API limits
facts.value: Current non-Classic chat/conversation API: Free/Growth N/A; Pro/Enterprise 2,000 requests/minute/account. CRM contact/account rates: 1,000/hour Free/Growth, 2,000/hour Pro, 5,000/hour Enterprise.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: Documented message/create, conversation assignment/resolution/reopen events; payload signature verification and retry-count headers provided.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Self-hosted Freshchat backend runtime/database, backup and upgrade requirements do not apply to this vendor-hosted service.

facts.label: Operator languages
facts.value: Locale guide lists 36 interface locale entries, including English, Hindi, French, German, Arabic and Hebrew; RTL support for Arabic/Hebrew.

facts.label: FAQ and bot localization
facts.value: FAQ display follows configured app/device/browser locale, falling back to primary language. Guide lists separate Answers, flow-builder and small-talk language sets.

facts.label: Conversation translation and latest AI
facts.value: Current Pro/Enterprise pricing describes translation in over 45 languages. Full current independent widget/agentic-AI language guarantee not established.

facts.label: Agent devices and customer libraries
facts.value: Browser-based agent inbox plus iOS/Android agent apps. Public web/mobile embedding is supported; native app SDK routes differ from agent apps.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Growth adds standard reports/real-time dashboards. Pro/Enterprise add custom reports, availability dashboards and routing/SLA reporting.

facts.label: Contacts and users
facts.value: Upgrade guide says contacts remain exportable but visitors no longer exportable; segments need rebuilding. REST docs list filtered/paginated user retrieval.

facts.label: Conversation text and attachments
facts.value: REST message objects expose message text and media/file URLs; reporting APIs include a Chat-Transcript raw dataset.

facts.label: Reporting export windows
facts.value: Help export guide lists Chat-Transcript maximum 1 month (24 hours for classic); API reference describes a 24-hour transcript window.

facts.label: Transcript and bot-data routes
facts.value: Official export guide links transcript download/email marketplace apps and bot-report CSV/email or arranged AWS S3 delivery.

facts.label: Complete migration archive
facts.value: One-step complete archive of conversation attachments, articles, feedback and all associated objects not established.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: Freshchat is named in AWS infrastructure rows for US, EU, Australia, India and Middle East. Help guide says choose a datacenter at the start.

facts.label: Named processors
facts.value: Freshchat rows include AWS, Azure OpenAI/Microsoft, SendGrid backup email, Twilio communication, Google Translate, Cloudflare, Workato and analytics providers.

facts.label: Privacy and DPA
facts.value: Public privacy notice effective March 1, 2026; public DPA governs processing service personal data.

facts.label: AI training defaults and opt-out
facts.value: Supplemental terms permit training on Customer Data/AI Output unless opted out; stop processing for opted-out purposes within seven business days, with training licence expiry 180 days after opt-out/AI termination.

facts.label: Subscription end retention
facts.value: Export before closure recommended. Terms provide 14 days after account closure for export; beyond that Freshworks can retain data up to three months before deletion, subject to listed legal exceptions.

facts.label: Configured periodic deletion
facts.value: Support can configure retention days and deletion mode: remove users with conversations, or conversations/messages while retaining users; processing runs daily.

facts.label: History and backups
facts.value: Exact live-account history limits by plan, standard trash recovery period and all backup-purge timing not established.

facts.label: Identity and standalone sale
facts.value: Freshchat, formerly Freshdesk Messaging; active standalone Freshworks messaging product with its own Free/Growth/Pro/Enterprise pricing and signup.

facts.label: Freshdesk Omni relationship
facts.value: Freshdesk Omni is promoted as the upgrade for advanced ticketing, knowledge bases and unified support. Standalone Freshchat is not automatically the same product/account.

facts.label: Migration scope
facts.value: July 2026 phased migration instructions concern eligible classic Freshdesk Omnichannel/Omni 2023 accounts with Freshchat usage; existing chat remains active until channels move.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Freshworks Inc., a Delaware corporation; United States.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Terms restrict use from prohibited jurisdictions and sanctioned parties under export-control rules; examples include Cuba, Iran, North Korea and named occupied Ukraine regions.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription, web widget and mobile libraries. Limited service/software rights under Freshworks terms.

facts.label: Vendor support routes
facts.value: Official Freshworks support hub links Freshchat docs, developer resources, training and community; guides publish support@freshchat.com and support@freshworks.com.

facts.label: Support hours and response SLA
facts.value: Current standalone Freshchat support hours and contractual initial-response targets by Free/paid plan not established.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026; Freshchat release page has 2026 updates through October. Next review proposed December 5, 2026.

apps.name: Freshdesk
apps.line: Email-first customer help desk with tickets, automation, and a help center.

free.text: Free program: 2 agents, 1 support email, 6 months

cells.channels: Email, customer portal; chat is in Freshdesk Omni
cells.ai: $49 per 100 AI sessions

agents.math: 1 agent at $23 a month, with email support and 100 conversations.
3 agents at $23 a month each, with email support and 100 conversations.

apps.news: No sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found.

facts.label: Free offer
facts.value: Temporary Freshdesk Free Program: six months. Not available for Freshdesk Omni. No unrestricted ongoing new-account Free offer established.

facts.label: Free agents and email
facts.value: Up to two agents; one support email address. More than two agents requires a paid upgrade.

facts.label: Free knowledge and AI
facts.value: Knowledge base, ticket dispatch, team collaboration and ticket-trend reporting documented. No complimentary Freddy AI Agent sessions for Free.

facts.label: Free content and storage
facts.value: Knowledge creation guide allows as many categories/folders/articles as needed and marks Free available; storage FAQ says no platform storage limit.

facts.label: Other free quotas
facts.value: Numeric ticket/contact/conversation quotas and a Free-specific history-retention promise not established.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 14-day all-access/Enterprise trial; no card. Signup starts with omnichannel evaluation and permits email-only evaluation in the same account.

facts.label: End of trial
facts.value: Pricing says account suspended without a paid continuation; subscription guide allows Free Program enrollment. Terms require exporting before trial end and do not promise retention beyond expiry.

facts.label: Higher-plan trial and Free return
facts.value: Higher-plan trial configurations can be lost on reversion; extra agents must be removed to return to the two-agent program. Guide says paid upgrades cannot switch back to Free.

facts.label: Freshdesk Growth
facts.value: USD 19/agent/month billed annually; USD 23/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Freshdesk Pro
facts.value: USD 55/agent/month billed annually; USD 66/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Freshdesk Enterprise
facts.value: USD 89/agent/month billed annually; USD 107/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Omni Growth
facts.value: USD 29/agent/month billed annually; USD 35/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Omni Pro
facts.value: USD 79/agent/month billed annually; USD 95/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Omni Enterprise
facts.value: USD 119/agent/month billed annually; USD 143/agent/month billed monthly.

facts.label: Tax and other currencies
facts.value: Subscription charges exclude taxes unless stated; currency selected before paid activation, then fixed without billing assistance.

facts.label: Payment-method inconsistency
facts.value: Pricing FAQ says PayPal not accepted; subscription guide allows PayPal business ID/offline payments.

facts.label: Full agents and day passes
facts.value: Full-time working agents need user licences; occasional agents consume a day pass on portal login, valid through the applicable calendar day's end.

facts.label: Collaborators
facts.value: Pro/Enterprise include up to 5,000 collaborators, described as external participants helping full-time agents.

facts.label: Base minimum
facts.value: No explicit larger seat floor, mandatory setup fee, or compulsory add-on found for entry Growth in the current pricing, subscription guide or terms.

facts.label: Term and stopping payment
facts.value: Standard terms: no mid-term seat reduction/downgrade; written nonrenewal/downgrade notice at least 30 days before renewal.

facts.label: AI session price
facts.value: Additional Freddy AI Agent capacity: USD 49 per 100-session pack. First 500 sessions on paid Growth/Pro/Enterprise are once per account.

facts.label: Session definition by channel
facts.value: Chat: customer/AI interactions within 24 hours from initiation; Email: 72 hours from first customer email, including multiple AI replies.

facts.label: Session expiry and renewal
facts.value: Packs expire with the subscription billing cycle, unused units do not carry over, and purchased packs renew unless reduced for the next cycle.

facts.label: Auto-recharge pack conflict
facts.value: Purchase section says one pack = 100 sessions; same add-on guide's auto-recharge section says one pack = 50 sessions.

facts.label: Copilot price and allocation
facts.value: USD 29/assigned agent/month annually or USD 35 monthly; current pricing lists it for Pro/Enterprise, assignable to a subset of agents.

facts.label: AI small-volume examples
facts.value: Our calculation after one-time free sessions: 100 sessions = one USD 49 pack; 500 = five packs = USD 245 on monthly billing.

facts.label: AI limits to exact totals
facts.value: Exact annual all-in AI cash total, partial-cycle allocations, and a per-conversation conversion are not asserted.

facts.label: Session exhaustion
facts.value: At 100% session consumption, AI stops answering and chats hand to live agents. Notifications documented at 70/80/90/100%; online customers can enable auto-recharge.

facts.label: Occasional-agent charges
facts.value: Day passes, Freshdesk Growth/Pro/Enterprise: USD 2/7/12 each. Omni Growth/Pro/Enterprise: USD 5/10/15 each.

facts.label: Connector app tasks
facts.value: Public add-on rate USD 80 per 5,000 connector app tasks; validity aligns with the billing cycle.

facts.label: Connector task definition
facts.value: Each action block in a connector recipe is a task; one record synchronization can consume several tasks depending on direction/entity.

facts.label: MCP included actions
facts.value: Monthly MCP actions: Growth 100, Pro 500, Enterprise 1,000; trial 1,000 once. Rate limits 25/50/100 per minute respectively.

facts.label: MCP overage stop
facts.value: Execution continues from 100% to 110% entitlement, with overage at USD 15/1,000 actions; pauses at 110% until more capacity or reset.

facts.label: Storage and attachment limits
facts.value: Storage FAQ says no platform storage limit. Paid Growth+ email attachment threshold 20MB; Free/trial 15MB; oversized incoming files can be dropped while a ticket is still created.

facts.label: WhatsApp charge
facts.value: Meta per-message pricing from July 1, 2025; Freshworks adds a 20% markup to total Meta WhatsApp cost.

facts.label: Voice extra subscription
facts.value: Omni Voice add-on USD/seat/month, annual rates Growth 15, Pro 39, Enterprise 69; actual monthly rates 18/47/83. Usage/numbers use separate credits.

facts.label: Other unresolved costs/lifecycle
facts.value: General paid-account inactivity deletion timing, exact connector-task exhaustion rules, and a universal international SMS/voice bill not established.

facts.label: Portal branding removal
facts.value: Official removal guide says paid upgrade removes Freshdesk branding at the bottom of the customer portal; current first paid tier Growth.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: Paid-plan help-desk setting removes vendor branding; current widget also exposes Remove Freshworks branding.

facts.label: Outgoing email removal
facts.value: Distinct product support addresses/notifications and AI email signatures/legal-footer configuration are documented; complete removal of every vendor footer/reference from outgoing/system emails not established.

facts.label: Trial and solo access
facts.value: Public self-service signup; no card; organization-size option starts at 1–10. Terms allow a person or entity as customer.

facts.label: Paid access
facts.value: Account admin selects Freshdesk or Omni, plan, agent quantity, currency and billing cycle in Plans & Billing.

facts.label: Free Program activation
facts.value: September setup guide describes an in-product Free switch; 2026 release page says switching now requires a Customer Success Manager and is no longer self-service.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: help desk/shared ticket inbox with email, help articles, automation and AI; Omni adds live messaging channels. Overlaps knowledge bases, customer messaging and community feedback.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native support email converted to tickets; Freshdesk and Omni. Multiple addresses available from Growth; Free Program one.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: Native live chat in Omni Growth/Pro/Enterprise. Standalone Freshdesk widget is lite mode with articles and forms only.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Omni Web Chat supports website/web-app embedding and native iOS/Android SDK routes.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native connected business channel in current Omni Growth+; not offered to new standalone Freshdesk customers. Existing pre-December 2025 Freshdesk integrations can continue.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native Omni channel for business-account DMs, story replies and comments; not standalone Freshdesk.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger/posts
facts.value: Native Facebook private messages, posts and comments available to current paid Freshdesk and Omni.

facts.label: SMS/MMS
facts.value: Built-in Omni channel via a connected Twilio account and one or more Twilio numbers; text or media support depends on number capability.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Current Omni Voice add-on enables native calling workflow; Freshcaller integration is also documented.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Official staff collaboration integration can create tickets from messages, send notifications and sync ticket-thread discussion into private notes.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Freshworks-published DiscoDesk integration sends ticket/group notifications to a mapped Discord channel webhook.

facts.label: Contact/ticket forms
facts.value: Native support-portal and widget web forms create tickets; lite Freshdesk widget includes forms without live chat.

facts.label: Assignment and private notes
facts.value: Groups/agents, ticket replies, private notes and @mentions; restricted agents still cannot view a ticket just because tagged.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Canned responses insert reusable text; admins create global replies and agents can create personal replies.

facts.label: Collision warning
facts.value: Agent Collision detection available from Growth; shows who is viewing a ticket.

facts.label: Rules and API automation
facts.value: Ticket-create/update rules can trigger webhooks on Growth+; response-dependent Trigger API action starts at Pro.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Growth supports default schedule; additional business-hour schedules start at Pro. Omni can set channel-specific hours; standalone Freshdesk has one set across channels.

facts.label: SLA differences
facts.value: Freshdesk has one default SLA, Omni two; multiple custom SLA policies start at Pro for both.

facts.label: Support email capacity
facts.value: Paid Growth+ supports unlimited support email addresses; Free Program one.

facts.label: Products and portals
facts.value: Pro up to five products; Enterprise unlimited. Each can have its own incoming/outgoing mailbox, portal URL, knowledge and forums.

facts.label: Websites and widget continuity
facts.value: Multiple widgets may share one product and history; different product-linked widgets have separate conversation threads.

facts.label: Public/private help articles
facts.value: Native Knowledge Base/Solutions; folders may be public, agent-only, logged-in, or restricted by company/segment.

facts.label: Content limits and organization
facts.value: Creation guide says as many categories, folders and articles as needed. Enterprise adds multi-level hierarchy; other tiers use category/folder/article structure.

facts.label: Search, domain and feedback
facts.value: Customer portal includes searchable articles and own support-domain option. Article-feedback submissions can become linked tickets visible in the knowledge manager.

facts.label: Translations, versions and approval
facts.value: Pro adds multilingual KB, versioning, templates and bulk actions; Enterprise adds review/approval workflow and flexible hierarchy.

facts.label: Autonomous customer AI
facts.value: Email AI Agent answers incoming emails/portal/form tickets; Omni additionally supports Chat AI Agents across web and social messaging.

facts.label: Staff AI and insights
facts.value: Copilot drafts replies, summarizes, finds similar tickets/articles and helps generate knowledge articles. Insights analyzes trends and support operations.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Public URLs, uploaded text documents, solution articles, custom Q&As and connected apps supported; native article learning excludes restricted/private articles.

facts.label: Documented source limits
facts.value: Detailed guide: URLs 10/AI agent, 25/account, 3,000 pages/site; files 200/agent and account, 35MB/file, PDF/DOCX/TXT.

facts.label: Conflicting AI knowledge limits
facts.value: Studio overview says 50 URL parents and 100 files; detailed knowledge guide says 10 URLs/agent, 25/account and 200 files/account.

facts.label: Citations and refresh
facts.value: Source references can be shown/hidden. URLs/documents can be manually resynced/relearned; connected-app sync schedules vary.

facts.label: SharePoint knowledge
facts.value: Connector supports SharePoint Online, up to 100 sites, maximum indexed file 50MB; source/user-permission changes indexed approximately every 15 minutes after initial sync.

facts.label: Source control gaps
facts.value: Exact automatic refresh interval for ordinary public URLs and a requirement to approve every new source version were not established.

facts.label: Human fallback and context
facts.value: Configurable handoff when customer asks, AI lacks an answer, request is sensitive/out of scope, or workflow needs intervention; conversation context can transfer to a human group.

facts.label: After hours
facts.value: AI-level handover settings can transfer to an agent/group and send a chosen away message outside selected business hours.

facts.label: Unanswered requests
facts.value: AI fallback can send a configured message with optional human transfer or execute a workflow; customer details can be collected before handover.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Workflow API actions support order lookup/cancellation, refunds, subscription/billing changes and other connected-system actions.

facts.label: Confirmation and authorization
facts.value: API-action preference Ask for confirmation can make AI ask the customer before a consequential action; MCP uses OAuth and permission-controlled tools.

facts.label: Customer identity
facts.value: Optional JWT-enforced Web Chat accepts signed identity tokens from the business's backend; verified users can be required before chat/form access.

facts.label: Shopify
facts.value: Documented Shopify app supports multiple stores, order/payment/shipping context, refunds/cancellation and store-specific canned responses.

facts.label: WooCommerce and Stripe
facts.value: Workflow integration table lists WooCommerce for commerce actions and Stripe for billing/payment actions.

facts.label: Linear
facts.value: Freshworks-published Linear for Freshworks, free Marketplace app; create/link/view issues, listed for Freshdesk and Omni.

facts.label: GitHub
facts.value: Marketplace lists third-party GitHub–Freshdesk integration by DevOps integration for issue create/link/notify/log viewing.

facts.label: Slack and Discord
facts.value: Slack has staff collaboration and private-note sync; Freshworks DiscoDesk provides Discord ticket notifications.

facts.label: REST API and quotas
facts.value: Public JSON REST API. Account limits: Free 0 calls/minute, Growth 100, Pro 400, Enterprise 700; trial 50/minute.

facts.label: Webhooks and API actions
facts.value: Ticket-create/update rules can send outbound webhooks; 1,000 webhook requests/hour. Trigger API, whose response feeds later actions, starts at Pro.

facts.label: Widget and app libraries
facts.value: Public Web Chat API exposes fdWidget; older Help Widget API exposes FreshworksWidget. Official app SDK link also available.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable: Freshdesk explicitly says it is not downloadable on-premises software.

facts.label: Staff and portal language
facts.value: Primary language starts as English and sets agent/customer portal language; Pro+ adds secondary languages. Supported examples include Arabic, English, French, German, Japanese and Spanish.

facts.label: Widget and articles
facts.value: Web Chat SDK supports explicit locale or browser-language selection, falling back to primary language; multilingual articles require Pro+ and separately prepared translations.

facts.label: AI language behavior
facts.value: Chat AI guide lists English, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Urdu, French, German, Japanese and others; replies in configured supported languages.

facts.label: Agent mobile devices
facts.value: Official iOS/Android agent apps; mobile app is for support staff, not customers checking tickets.

facts.label: Customer platforms
facts.value: Browser portals, website/web-app embedding and Omni native iOS/Android SDK support. No required Gmail, WordPress, Shopify or macOS host.

facts.label: Reports and plan gates
facts.value: Free ticket-volume trend; Growth help-desk/timesheet reports; Pro/Enterprise custom reporting, schedules, exports, detailed agent/group/satisfaction reports.

facts.label: AI and human performance
facts.value: Impact Analysis documents AI/human first-response, assignment/handover times and AI/human/hybrid resolution attribution.

facts.label: AI review
facts.value: Conversation logs, customer feedback and session-consumption reports help review AI activity; preview and some workflow starts can consume sessions.

facts.label: Whole-account export
facts.value: Account administrator can export tickets, solutions, forums and customers in XML; full conversation/history needs account export rather than the ticket-list export.

facts.label: Ticket list export
facts.value: Admin/supervisor with export permission can export selected ticket fields as CSV or Excel, optionally description/multiline text. Excludes complete conversation and archived historical tickets.

facts.label: Contacts/customers
facts.value: Admin can export customer details from Contacts and export customer-specific ticket data.

facts.label: Attachment retrieval
facts.value: REST API ticket/conversation objects expose attachment metadata and attachment_url; separate file retrieval must be considered.

facts.label: Binary export completeness
facts.value: Account XML export's complete inclusion of attachment binaries, inline files and every current Omni channel transcript not established.

facts.label: Articles and properties
facts.value: Pro+ bulk article export produces CSV of article list/properties only; article content requires account export's Solutions XML.

facts.label: Forum and article feedback
facts.value: Account XML includes forums; article feedback is represented by linked tickets. Discussions API provides forum/topic/comment objects.

facts.label: Feedback portability gaps
facts.value: Complete voter identities/history, follow subscriptions and AI feedback export coverage not established.

facts.label: Hosting and region selection
facts.value: AWS-hosted SaaS; region selected when creating the account. Moving a region requires support and duration depends on data volume.

facts.label: Regions and processing exceptions
facts.value: AWS subprocessor lists US/EU/Australia/India/Middle East. Microsoft Azure OpenAI and other subprocessors have service-specific locations.

facts.label: Privacy roles
facts.value: Privacy notice is primarily controller processing; customer-hosted personal data is processed under DPA and the customer's own privacy notice.

facts.label: Proprietary AI training
facts.value: Supplemental AI terms grant training permission by default unless opted out; distinguish Custom Models from Collaborative Models. Third-party hosted generative model training on Customer Data is prohibited.

facts.label: AI training opt-out and timing
facts.value: Email support@freshworks.com to opt out of collaborative models or all training. Terms state stopping processing within seven business days; training-use data deletion/licence expiry can take 180 days.

facts.label: Paid export window
facts.value: Data available for export for 14 days after effective account closure; contact support during that period if retained/exportable and payment obligations are current.

facts.label: Deletion after closure
facts.value: Terms reserve retention for up to three months beyond export period with exceptions; product security guide says account data deleted after 90 days from termination.

facts.label: Backups and logs
facts.value: Product security guide: daily persistent backups retained seven days and application-log backups one year; later paragraph describes deletion-related logs purged after 21 days.

facts.label: Active-account data and deletion
facts.value: Security guide says data retained while customer active and user deletion immediate; knowledge manager warns deleted article/category/folder cannot be restored.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Freshdesk, a Freshworks customer support product; active hosted help desk.

facts.label: Product relationships
facts.value: Freshdesk is email-first; Freshdesk Omni handles more channels. Legacy Omni/Omnichannel and former Customer Service Suite terminology persist in docs.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Freshworks Inc., a Delaware corporation; US legal entity.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Terms prohibit access from comprehensively sanctioned jurisdictions, naming Cuba, Iran, North Korea and specified Ukrainian regions among examples.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Hosted proprietary service; vendor expressly says Freshdesk cannot be downloaded for on-premises use.

facts.label: Current and legacy editions
facts.value: Current Freshdesk and Omni each have Growth, Pro and Enterprise. Many guides separately show Sprout/Blossom/Garden/Estate/Forest and pre-December 2025 Omni.

facts.label: Vendor support hours
facts.value: Paid in-product chat: described as available 24/7, with human real-time agents available 24/5. Free Program guide specifies 24×5 email support.

facts.label: Support gaps
facts.value: Exact paid email/phone coverage and guaranteed response/fix times not established for every current tier.

facts.label: Freshness and changes
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026; official 2026 updates include contact integrity/field permissions, Free-switch policy change and third-party voice AI Marketplace apps.

facts.label: Next review
facts.value: Our proposed next review December 4, 2026; earlier before relying on Free activation, AI knowledge limits or an old Omni integration.

apps.line: Team inbox for email and messaging with Autopilot AI.

free.text: 14-day trial on Professional; no free plan

cells.channels: Starter: one channel type; email, chat, messaging, SMS
cells.ai: $0.89 per resolution

agents.math: 1 seat at $35 a month, or $300 a year paid upfront, which is $25 a month. Up to ten seats.
3 seats at $35 a month each = $105 a month, or $900 a year paid upfront ($75 a month).

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: No ongoing free working-agent subscription published in current pricing or plan documentation.

facts.label: Free limits
facts.value: Not applicable to an unestablished ongoing free working-agent plan.

facts.label: Trial and limits
facts.value: Fourteen days on Professional; no card. Limits: 15 teammates, 5 workspaces, 30 channels, 5,000 messages and 10 recipients/message. Guests, Sequences, auto-reply and forwarding rules are locked.

facts.label: After trial
facts.value: Front reserves the right to delete trial data once the trial ends. Exact read-only/access grace period was not established.

facts.label: Starter
facts.value: USD 35/seat/month monthly, or USD 25/seat/month billed annually; up to ten seats; one channel type.

facts.label: Professional
facts.value: USD 85/seat/month monthly, or USD 65/seat/month annually; up to fifty seats; multiple channel types.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: USD 105/seat/month, annual billing only. Minimum seat purchase requires sales confirmation.

facts.label: Taxes and annual cash timing
facts.value: Charges exclude taxes unless an Order Form says otherwise. Subscription charges are normally due in full at the start of the subscription term.

facts.label: Billing unit and guests
facts.value: A paid seat is a unique user's licence. Guests can read invited conversations, comment and edit drafts, but cannot send customer replies.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and setup
facts.value: Starter/Professional minimum: one licence. Enterprise: ask sales. An onboarding package is mandatory for contracts over USD 25,000; no mandatory package is stated for the small examples below.

facts.label: Autopilot outcome rates
facts.value: USD 0.05/triaged conversation; USD 0.39/handoff; USD 0.89/resolution. A conversation is charged once at its highest automation level.

facts.label: Autopilot billing and trial
facts.value: Pay as used, invoiced monthly; optional prepaid volume commitments. Separate thirty-day trial includes all automation types and up to 1,000 resolutions.

facts.label: Copilot entitlement conflict
facts.value: Current pricing and Copilot guide sell USD 20/seat/month on Starter/Professional and include it on Enterprise. Usage Policy says post-2026-04-28 Starter/Professional purchases have no Copilot access.

facts.label: External agents and AI units
facts.value: External agents keep their own model, logic and hosting. An exact all-in model-provider/hosting bill or universal Front external-agent usage rate was not established.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: 100/500 qualifying Autopilot resolutions add USD 89/445. With annual Starter equivalents, one seat totals USD 114/470 per month equivalent; three seats USD 164/520.

facts.label: Message usage and stopping
facts.value: Usage Policy specifies optimal processing of 300 messages/seat/day. Above it, SLA coverage may not apply and throttling or suspension can occur. Excessive use is addressed with notice and a fourteen-day resolution process.

facts.label: AI helper daily-limit conflict
facts.value: Usage Policy: Compose and manual Summarize 200 requests/user/day; Translate 1,500. Pricing comparison says Translate up to 200/teammate/day.

facts.label: Renewal and reductions
facts.value: Standard agreement requires thirty days' notice for cancellation or next-term seat/plan reductions; reductions are not permitted during the current term. It describes twelve-month renewals.

facts.label: Chat branding
facts.value: Pricing says Starter widgets retain non-removable Front branding; higher plans offer customization. Resolve includes a Front-branding control. Legacy Front Chat explicitly allows removal on Professional+.

facts.label: Help Center branding
facts.value: Professional+ can remove the Powered by Front footer and use a custom font/domain. Starter can customize basic appearance but retains vendor footer branding.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: General removal rules for all Front marks on outgoing support emails were not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Public self-service trial at https://front.com/signup?sref=true. Starter and Professional each permit one paid seat; Enterprise minimum is sales-led.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared inbox and help desk for customer-facing teams, with ticketing, multiple channels, Help Centers and AI automation.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email channels: Gmail, Office 365 or other providers through forwarding/SMTP. Starter can use email as its single type; Professional/Enterprise can mix types.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native Resolve supports human live support without automation or AI. Available on all plans; Starter must select Resolve as its channel type.

facts.label: Legacy website chat
facts.value: Front Chat remains documented for existing users but is unavailable to new customers from 2026-10-26 and will no longer be updated.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Resolve can be embedded in web apps, with a browser SDK and server-signed automatic user verification.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native Business channel add-on on Professional/Enterprise. Monthly cost is Meta's billed amount plus a 20% administration fee; one add-on can cover multiple numbers.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native Business-account DMs, Story Mentions/Replies and post comments, Professional+. Requires a Facebook-linked Business account; Creator accounts are excluded.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Page DMs, posts and comments, Professional+. Personal timelines are not supported.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Built-in Twilio channel integration sends and receives SMS with an external number/shortcode. Starter can choose SMS as its one type.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Aircall integration brings voice/call workflows into Front on Professional/Enterprise. Other telephony integrations are listed.

facts.label: Slack and Starter gate
facts.value: Native public/private channel and Slack Connect support; no DMs. The Slack guide says all plans and pricing matrix permits Starter single-type Slack, but the pricing FAQ lists only email/Resolve/SMS for Starter.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: A specifically supported direct Discord customer channel was not established.

facts.label: Ticket/contact forms
facts.value: Native website form channels accept customized HTML forms. Resolve flows and Help Center portals also support request intake.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Assignments, private internal comments, reusable message templates, shared drafts and real-time collision indicators are documented.

facts.label: Rules and macros
facts.value: Starter: ten rules; Professional: twenty rules and macros; Enterprise: unlimited rules/macros subject to usage policy.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Workspace-level and shared-inbox business hours, with time zones, on Professional+. Inbox hours take precedence.

facts.label: Channels and workspaces
facts.value: Starter/Professional/Enterprise allow 10/30/50 channels per purchased licence, counting shared and individual channels. Workspaces: 1/up to 5/unlimited.

facts.label: Products and sites
facts.value: Workspaces separate workflows/resources for brands or teams. Resolve supports one widget instance per page; an account-wide site/domain count or standalone brand surcharge was not established.

facts.label: Help Center features
facts.value: Hosted searchable articles, drafts/publishing, reactions/feedback and resource categories. Visibility can be public, Front-users-only, or login-controlled on Professional+.

facts.label: Published content limits
facts.value: Starter/Professional/Enterprise: 1/up to 2/up to 50 published knowledge bases; up to 1,000/5,000/10,000 published articles per knowledge base.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Autopilot autonomously triages, drafts, replies and executes workflows; Copilot assists a teammate who reviews output. Resolve can use an Autopilot agent or operate with humans and no AI.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs and size
facts.value: Front articles, public URLs, third-party sources, PDF uploads and notes. PDF limit: 25 MB/file and 500 MB/workspace. URL/third-party ingestion supports roughly 3,000 pages/source.

facts.label: Source updates and controls
facts.value: Published Front articles normally reach AI within minutes. External website and third-party source changes require manual re-sync. Third-party connectors include Notion, Confluence, Google Docs and SharePoint Word/Doc content.

facts.label: Citations and approval
facts.value: AI knowledge guidance documents sources for generated answers/drafts. Agent configuration selects knowledge, instructions, Playbooks and tone; customer-facing material should be curated separately from internal procedures.

facts.label: Human fallback and context
facts.value: Resolve supports customer-requested or configured handoff, missing answers, dissatisfaction and technical-error escalation. Email verification identifies the customer; the follow-up ticket includes a conversation summary.

facts.label: Email follow-up disagreement
facts.value: Resolve's guide says notification-email replies are added to the conversation, but its notification-sender section says those replies are unsupported and not added.

facts.label: External actions
facts.value: MCP Connectors let Autopilot look up Stripe payments and issue refunds, and let AI read/write other connected tools. Each action is off by default and administrators explicitly enable permitted actions/features.

facts.label: Customer verification and human billing actions
facts.value: Resolve supports email-code verification or server-signed JWT auto-verification. Human operators can use ChargeDesk to issue refunds, change subscriptions and request payments.

facts.label: Commerce and payments
facts.value: Shopify integration, all Front plans, displays customers/orders matched by email or phone and supports multiple stores. Stripe MCP integration is listed for all plans, requiring an appropriate Front AI feature.

facts.label: Developer issue tracking
facts.value: Linear integration, maintained by Linear, and GitHub integration are available on all Front plans. They link/create issues and can reopen Front conversations when an issue closes.

facts.label: Automation connections
facts.value: Zapier integration is available on Professional+; it supports Front triggers and actions. Connectors and APIs offer other automation routes.

facts.label: WooCommerce
facts.value: A specifically documented WooCommerce connection was not established.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: Public Core REST API with OAuth/API tokens, app/rule webhooks, client integration options and Resolve SDK. Default Core API limits per company: Starter 50, Professional 100, Enterprise 200 requests/minute.

facts.label: Rate-limit add-on conflict
facts.value: Pricing offers USD 200/month per additional 100 requests/minute on all plans. Developer rate-limit guidance says increases require Professional+.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched hosted Front service.

facts.label: Help Center languages
facts.value: Enterprise supports 38 listed languages, including English, French, Spanish, German, Japanese, and Simplified/Traditional Chinese. Manual or AI article translations can be published separately.

facts.label: Resolve and AI languages
facts.value: Resolve officially supports English; Autopilot/Playbooks are optimized for English. Providers support 40+ common languages, but mixed-language behavior is not guaranteed.

facts.label: Agent interface
facts.value: A complete supported language list for the agent interface was not established. Email translation and multilingual Help Centers are separate features.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Agent browser app, macOS/Windows desktop apps and iOS/Android mobile apps. Customer Resolve uses an HTTPS web embed/SDK.

facts.label: Support reports
facts.value: Starter has basic analytics; Professional adds advanced analytics and CSAT surveys; Enterprise adds custom reports and Smart QA/Smart CSAT. Reports cover volumes, reply times and satisfaction.

facts.label: Reporting-history conflict
facts.value: Starter: pricing says six months, Usage Policy up to twelve months. Professional: twenty-four months; Enterprise: unlimited subject to policy.

facts.label: AI review
facts.value: AI replies can be inspected in the AI replies hub; Compass advertises scoring of Autopilot and external-agent conversations and recommendations for improvement.

facts.label: Conversation export
facts.value: Company-admin request to support exports shared-inbox messages, conversations, discussions and comments, grouped in CSV files. EML must be requested and includes shared-inbox attachments.

facts.label: Attachment files
facts.value: Core API message attachment objects provide authenticated download URLs returning file bytes; downloads consume API requests.

facts.label: Customers
facts.value: Contacts Manager generates CSV exports for shared, private, or shared plus auto-created contacts; Contacts API is another route.

facts.label: Articles
facts.value: Support can export knowledge-base content with article/category identifiers, paths, HTML body and publication metadata. Published public knowledge bases also expose JSON with text/HTML content and attachment URLs.

facts.label: Feedback and reporting
facts.value: Professional+ customer-satisfaction report exports ratings and comments, with customer/teammate/date/inbox information. Operational analytics also support file exports.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: AWS primary hosting; customers can select US or EEA through their account representative/support. Without a selection, Front may choose or move the region.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Published list effective 2026-07-13 includes AWS, Microsoft Azure, OpenAI, Google, Ably and others, with processing countries and Front affiliates.

facts.label: AI data use
facts.value: Front may use AI inputs/feedback to improve the service for the customer, including instructions and tone. Model providers are contractually barred from training foundation models on customer data; provider API requests have zero retention per FAQ.

facts.label: End of paid subscription
facts.value: Agreement offers thirty days for electronic retrieval after termination. Deletion policy says automated paid-account deletion begins thirty days after cancellation/expiry, unless otherwise agreed or requested sooner.

facts.label: Message-level retention
facts.value: Optional policies move inactive conversations to Trash after a chosen period, then permanently delete after seven days. Inbox rules can override company retention; contacts can also be deleted when unused.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: Front remains active; Front Chat became legacy and unavailable for new customers on 2026-10-26, will no longer be updated, and has been replaced for new customers by Resolve.

facts.label: Company and markets
facts.value: FrontApp, Inc., a Delaware corporation, United States. Terms prohibit use in U.S.-embargoed regions or by denied parties.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted service, with browser, desktop and mobile clients and developer APIs. No self-hosted server edition established.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Help Center contact route, Academy, Community and weekly live office hours are published. A dedicated account team requires annual contract value of at least USD 25,000 on eligible higher plans.

facts.label: Freshness
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Current evidence includes the October 26 Resolve transition and announced Core API limiter rollout from October 19 to October 31, 2026. Next review proposed: 2026-12-04.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, social, voice, SMS
cells.ai: $1.50 per extra AI interaction

The total is the same. The Starter plan includes three user seats.

apps.news: No sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: No ongoing free plan established in current pricing/MSA; published free route is a seven-day trial.

facts.label: Free limits
facts.value: Not applicable to an established ongoing free-plan offer.

facts.label: Trial duration, payment and end
facts.value: Seven days, no payment information needed to start. If a payment method is supplied, MSA permits billing the day after trial end unless cancelled by 11:59 PM Pacific Time on its last day.

facts.label: Trial feature conflict
facts.value: Pricing FAQ says trial includes all features; current Help Center setup explicitly says a Help Center cannot be created during a free trial.

facts.label: Starter, AI off
facts.value: USD 10/account/month, monthly only; 50 Helpdesk tickets/month; three user seats; USD 0.40 per extra ticket.

facts.label: Basic, AI off
facts.value: USD 60/account/month monthly or USD 50/month equivalent, USD 600 paid annually; 300 tickets/month; 500 user seats.

facts.label: Pro, AI off
facts.value: USD 360/account/month monthly or USD 300/month equivalent, USD 3,600 paid annually; 2,000 tickets/month; 500 seats; extra tickets USD 0.36 each.

facts.label: Advanced, AI off
facts.value: USD 900/account/month monthly or USD 750/month equivalent, USD 9,000 paid annually; 5,000 tickets/month; 500 seats; extra tickets USD 0.36 each.

facts.label: Custom Enterprise
facts.value: Sales quote for needs beyond the standard plans. Published custom-plan features include unlimited Help Centers, SAML/SCIM, dedicated success/solutions staff and API at four requests/second.

facts.label: Currency, tax and annual cadence
facts.value: Pricing specifies USD; annual subscriptions paid upfront for 12 months. Taxes are additional under MSA, including applicable sales tax based on billing address.

facts.label: Billable Helpdesk ticket
facts.value: At least one message sent from Helpdesk by a human, AI Agent or Rule. Multiple replies in one thread count once; unanswered inbound tickets and internal-only edits/notes do not.

facts.label: Thread splitting and merged tickets
facts.value: A reply after more than ten inactive days splits an email thread; chat/social/SMS use more than three days. Merging does not necessarily erase the original billable events.

facts.label: Older guide and legacy conflict
facts.value: Vendor plan guide says viewing/interacting can count and fully automated replies do not count; current billing docs require an outbound message and count AI Agent replies.

facts.label: Minimum and required extras
facts.value: Smallest published Helpdesk subscription USD 10/month, includes up to three users. No mandatory AI, Voice or SMS subscription for human email/chat. No setup fee published for this self-service scenario.

facts.label: Automated interaction definition
facts.value: Customer request fully handled by AI Agent or supported self-service feature without a human within 72 hours. AI Agent resolution can also count as a Helpdesk ticket.

facts.label: Paid AI presets and excess usage
facts.value: Monthly AI-on presets add USD 30 for 30 automated interactions to Starter/Basic, USD 190 for 190 to Pro, USD 530 for 530 to Advanced. Preset excess rate USD 1.50/interaction.

facts.label: AI rate presentation conflict
facts.value: FAQ gives USD 1.00 monthly / USD 0.90 annual as base interaction rates; comparison gives Advanced USD 0.85, while its annual preset is USD 477 for 530, equivalent USD 0.90 each.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Our conditional monthly Starter-preset calculation: USD 165 for 100 AI-resolved tickets; USD 925 for 500. Same for one or three users.

facts.label: Helpdesk overages
facts.value: Usage above included tickets is billed as overage; current cards publish Starter/Basic USD 0.40 each and Pro/Advanced USD 0.36 each.

facts.label: Cancellation and notice scope
facts.value: Self-service owner/admin can cancel auto-renewal; managed accounts request cancellation through CSM. Guide says service/add-ons remain active until next renewal; MSA requires at least 30 days' written notice for monthly and annual subscriptions.

facts.label: Changes and unestablished stops
facts.value: MSA restricts downgrades to renewal, with 30-day annual / five-day monthly downgrade notice. Usage monitoring and plan changes are documented; a universal prepaid-credit expiry, recharge rule or spend hard stop was not established.

facts.label: Widget and Help Center attribution
facts.value: Exact right, first eligible plan and fee to remove Gorgias attribution were not established. Branding colors/logos/custom headers are documented.

facts.label: Email appearance
facts.value: All Helpdesk plans support per-email-integration signatures with agent variables, rich text and images. Vendor-attribution removal policy was not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Starter, Basic and Pro have self-service trial links; Advanced and custom Enterprise direct buyers to sales. Individuals aged 18+ can contract; Starter supports one or three working users.

facts.label: AI eligibility
facts.value: AI Agent requires an active AI subscription and connected Shopify store; setup guide explicitly excludes BigCommerce, Magento and WooCommerce stores.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: ecommerce-focused help desk with email, web chat, social support, Help Center and optional AI/voice/SMS. Overlaps customer messaging, knowledge bases and AI support agents.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email support on current paid plans. Generated base address supports send/receive; own-address forwarding/domain verification and Gmail/Outlook integrations are documented.

facts.label: Website and web-app chat
facts.value: Native JavaScript chat on all current Helpdesk plans, including Starter. Supports ordinary websites without connecting an ecommerce store.

facts.label: Messenger / Facebook
facts.value: Native Facebook/Messenger tickets, including business-page comments, ad comments, mentions and messages. Current comparison includes social channels on Starter and higher.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native comments/mentions and direct-message support; current paid plan comparison includes social channels.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native connected WhatsApp tickets on all Helpdesk plans and any connected store; agents except Observers can reply. Within 24 hours use free-form replies; afterward approved templates only.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Gorgias SMS is a separately billed native add-on. Current billing guide counts a ticket after at least one outbound Helpdesk SMS; repeated messages within a thread count once.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native Gorgias Voice add-on: answered inbound calls, incoming voicemails and connected outbound calls qualify as Voice tickets. Multiple calls within the same ticket count once.

facts.label: Voice/SMS eligibility conflict
facts.value: Pricing heading says add Voice/SMS to any plan; its feature comparison marks Starter unavailable and Basic/Pro/Advanced available.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Custom HTTP integration can post new-ticket notifications to Slack or forward email into a Slack channel. Available to integrate broadly; vendor setup/troubleshooting assistance is Advanced+ only.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: A maintained native Discord customer channel was not established.

facts.label: Contact forms
facts.value: Native Help Center contact form and chat offline capture create support tickets, with email handling for submissions.

facts.label: Inbox workflow
facts.value: Manual/automatic assignment, teams, internal notes, tags, priorities, snoozing, macros and Rules. An Also viewing banner shows another agent's name/avatar when they are on the same ticket.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Default/custom business hours and holiday exceptions control channel availability, Rule conditions, SLA timing and call routing. Business-hours guide lists Basic, Pro, Advanced and Enterprise.

facts.label: Stores, brands and platforms
facts.value: Manage several connected stores/channels in one account; separate chat integration per store. Current plan table: Shopify/WooCommerce all plans, BigCommerce Basic+, Magento Pro+.

facts.label: Numeric site/inbox caps
facts.value: Standard-plan maximum stores, email addresses, chat integrations and Help Centers, plus extra-unit prices, were not established. Custom Enterprise advertises unlimited Help Centers.

facts.label: Public Help Center
facts.value: Native articles/categories, search, multiple languages and standalone/embedded deployment; all paid Helpdesk plans. Everyone can view published articles.

facts.label: Internal-content caveat
facts.value: “Internal knowledge base” guide uses a robots noindex tag and explicitly says the page remains browsable if someone has/shares its URL.

facts.label: Domain, feedback and article limits
facts.value: Custom-domain help is documented, with default brand-name.gorgias.help. Numeric article/storage caps and a fully specified article-feedback entitlement/export were not established.

facts.label: Customer-facing AI
facts.value: Autonomous post-purchase support and pre-purchase Shopping Assistant in one AI Agent: email, chat, SMS, Instagram DMs, Messenger and WhatsApp on enabled eligible channels.

facts.label: Staff-facing AI
facts.value: Fall 2026 release describes Gaia for ticket summaries, tagging/assignment, investigation and drafting rules/macros; AI can also suggest Help Center article drafts.

facts.label: AI sources and source controls
facts.value: Shopify products/orders/customer data, Help Center articles, guidance, store website, single-page URLs and uploaded PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX documents. Up to 100 guidance enabled at once.

facts.label: Refresh and approval
facts.value: Manually re-sync store/URL content no more than once every 24 hours. Enable/disable snippets; article/guidance edits are drafts until published, and drafts can be tested without affecting live answers.

facts.label: Citations and unestablished limits
facts.value: Staff can review each AI answer and its knowledge sources/reasoning. A universal shopper-visible citation guarantee, maximum total URL/document bytes and document/page-count allowance were not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Built-in handover for explicit human requests, anger/frustration, listed sensitive subjects and unreliable answers; configurable handover topics, ignored-ticket Rules and team assignment.

facts.label: After-hours and handoff messages
facts.value: Separate chat instructions for online, offline and error scenarios; online wait-time/email capture options and offline business-hours messaging.

facts.label: Autonomous store actions
facts.value: Opt-in Shopify Actions can cancel unfulfilled orders with full refund/restock, change shipping address, remove items with refunds, replace items and reship orders.

facts.label: Identity and action boundaries
facts.value: Chat AI requests personal order/history details only after email/SMS one-time-code sign-in; if shopper cannot sign in, they can message a human. Older Order Management portal buttons submit refund/cancellation requests rather than automatically executing them.

facts.label: Ecommerce integration
facts.value: Shopify data/actions integrated in ticket sidebar; WooCommerce supplies customer/order/fulfillment context with synchronization. BigCommerce/Magento support is plan-gated in current comparison.

facts.label: Slack and automation
facts.value: Slack via HTTP webhook/email forwarding; Zapier via HTTP integrations, webhooks and REST API.

facts.label: Other stack connections
facts.value: Native customer-context Stripe, GitHub, Linear and Discord connections were not established from the checked official directory/docs/searches.

facts.label: REST API and limits
facts.value: Public REST/JSON API with pagination. API-key access: 40 requests/20 seconds; OAuth apps: 80/20 seconds; Enterprise uses ten-second windows. HTTP 429 and retry/rate headers documented.

facts.label: Widgets and outbound events
facts.value: JavaScript GorgiasChat API controls widget behavior. HTTP integrations can send ticket-created events to external webhook URLs; Zapier and Slack guides demonstrate it.

facts.label: Running the backend yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched proprietary hosted offer. Embedded scripts and ecommerce connections do not constitute a self-hosted Helpdesk edition.

facts.label: Chat languages
facts.value: Chat locale guide lists 15 options: English US/UK, French France/Canada, Spanish, Danish, Swedish, Italian, Dutch, German, Norwegian, Czech, Brazilian Portuguese, Japanese and Finnish.

facts.label: Help Center and staff interface
facts.value: Help Center guide lists 11 locale options with browser matching/fallback. Complete current agent-interface translation list was not established.

facts.label: AI answer languages
facts.value: AI Agent supports over 80 languages and can reply even when knowledge is not translated. AI article-suggestion guide separately limits generated article suggestions to English.

facts.label: Staff devices and limitations
facts.value: Web helpdesk plus native iOS/Android apps. Mobile supports ticket work/notifications, but cannot make/take Voice calls, send images/links or preserve all rich text/integration signatures.

facts.label: Customer app libraries
facts.value: Website/web-app JavaScript API is documented; dedicated native customer iOS/Android SDK availability was not established.

facts.label: Support reports and satisfaction
facts.value: Current comparison includes support performance/live/automation statistics on all plans; revenue attribution Pro+. CSAT report is available on all Helpdesk plans.

facts.label: AI failure/quality review
facts.value: Per-skill/content volume, handover and average CSAT for last 28 days; review underlying tickets and export lists. AI answer reasoning/sources and coaching feedback are documented.

facts.label: View export / metadata
facts.value: Owner/admin/lead can export a ticket view as CSV on all Helpdesk plans, maximum one million tickets; download link lasts 14 days. Includes ticket/customer metadata and survey score, not message content.

facts.label: Message-history export
facts.value: Analytics drill-down CSV can include public message text for the most recent 30 days of a selected period, maximum 100,000 tickets. Excludes internal notes, ticket events and specified Facebook/Instagram media content.

facts.label: Customer and message API
facts.value: Paginated customer, ticket and message APIs. Message object includes text/HTML, internal/public marker and attachments; archived email bodies may use body_url after 30 days.

facts.label: Articles and custom export
facts.value: Direct Help Center article export is not supported; request support-assisted export. Custom export guide lists article title/URL/content/SEO, ticket message body, customer notes, tags, macros and other data as requestable.

facts.label: Attachments and feedback completeness
facts.value: A one-click binary archive, post-closure attachment-link validity, complete article-helpfulness feedback export and guaranteed inclusion of CSAT comment text in the standard ticket CSV were not established.

facts.label: Data hosting
facts.value: Google Cloud Platform in United States, European Union and Australia; pricing FAQ says hosting follows the region closest to the customer.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Current list names Google Cloud, Cloudflare, Segment, Confluent, OpenAI, Anthropic, Twilio and other feature/affiliate processors with their functions/locations.

facts.label: AI training and provider retention
facts.value: MSA permits Customer Data use to improve Gorgias's internal AI models, subject to its obligations/law. It prohibits third-party model training and commits third-party AI providers to zero data retention.

facts.label: Return/deletion after termination
facts.value: DPA section 9 says return a complete Personal Data copy by secure transfer in a reasonably requested format and delete other copies promptly, within 90 days of expiry/termination or written notice.

facts.label: Account access and individual deletion
facts.value: Cancellation ends access at the applicable renewal/end date in the cancellation guide. Pricing FAQ says customers can delete shopper data and tickets.

facts.label: Remaining retention gaps
facts.value: Fixed active ticket-history cap, inactivity-only deletion, unpaid-trial recovery window and separate backup purge timetable were not established.

facts.label: Identity and state
facts.value: Gorgias; active hosted customer-support platform. Helpdesk, AI Agent, Gaia, Voice and SMS are related products/features sold through the platform.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Gorgias Inc. is the contracting entity; United States business with a San Francisco, California legal contact address.

facts.label: Buying and phone markets
facts.value: MSA restricts use in US-embargoed/sanctioned territories and by restricted parties; its examples include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria and Crimea. Voice/SMS destination coverage has a separate published country list.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary software-as-a-service with limited contractual access rights, mobile apps, integrations and embedded customer widgets. No self-hosted backend buying/install route established.

facts.label: Vendor help channels
facts.value: Dashboard live chat, support@gorgias.com, help site, community and training resources. Standard support is included in the subscription under MSA.

facts.label: Vendor support hours
facts.value: May 2026 vendor plan article advertises 24/7 email/chat across support tiers. Exact current staffing hours or response-time SLA were not independently established in pricing/MSA/support docs checked.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. Official Fall 2026 release covers AI Agent social channels, Gaia, skills and reporting. Suggested next review December 4, 2026.

facts.value: Not applicable to a currently published permanent free tier.

facts.value: One member plus 1,000 emails: USD 29/month or USD 23/month annual equivalent. Three members plus the same account volume: USD 59/month or USD 47/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: Pro price
facts.value: Zero-email Pro: one member USD 25/month or USD 20/month annual equivalent; three members USD 75/month or USD 60/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: Unlimited price
facts.value: USD 620/month or USD 495/month annual equivalent; marketed as unlimited team members/widgets, with 50,000 emails.

facts.value: The public feed separately names USD/EUR/GBP costs; checked configurations have equal numerical values in those currencies. Tax inclusion/exclusion was not established.

facts.label: Seats, roles and growth
facts.value: Basic/Pro price depends on purchased team members and email capacity. Unlimited is a flat plan with unlimited members. No non-billable staff/viewer seat exemption found.

facts.label: Email counting and reset
facts.value: Manual Inbox emails, campaign sends, automated emails and unread chat messages resent by email all consume volume. Each sent email remains counted for thirty days; quota replenishes gradually.

facts.label: Minimums, term and required extras
facts.value: One-member plans are public. Monthly or annual billing; annual is prepaid. Email sending needs nonzero email volume. No required setup fee found.

facts.label: Autonomous AI plan allowances
facts.value: Pro: five AI Agents, 50 AI conversations/month, 200 source items, thirty-day analytics. Unlimited: unlimited Agents, 100 conversations/month, 500 source items, ninety-day analytics. Basic has no AI Agents.

facts.label: AI conversation/source extensions
facts.value: Added 100 conversations: USD 29/month, or USD 23.20/month equivalent annually. Added 500: USD 125/month, or USD 100/month equivalent annually. Added 100 source items: USD 5/month or USD 4/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: AI Editor counting and limits
facts.value: Separate staff editor, included in all plans. Successful requests are pooled across Inbox and KB: Basic feed shows 20 per bought member; Pro 50; Unlimited displays unlimited.

facts.label: Precise AI counter edge cases
facts.value: No complete rule found for repeated entry into an AI block, multiple AI Agents on one thread, reopened conversations or exactly when a failed attempt consumes quota.

facts.label: AI100/AI500 capacity costs
facts.value: Our calculation on zero-email Pro: one person USD 54/150 monthly for 100/500 AI-counted conversations; three people USD 104/200. Annual totals/equivalents are below.

facts.label: AI hard stops
facts.value: After the monthly conversation quota is used, the AI block is skipped and the chatbot continues to the next block. No automatic extra charge. Source/Agent creation blocks at the cap.

facts.label: Knowledge-base branding

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Current Pro removal entitlement expressly includes emails. Transcript settings can hide branding if the subscription permits; signatures and verified own-domain senders are editable.

facts.value: Native web in-app integration, plus customer iOS/Android/React Native SDKs. User authentication links a customer's conversations across devices.

facts.value: Pro/Unlimited; connects through 360dialog using a registered business number/API key. Team receives/replies inside HelpCrunch.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native connection for Professional/Business accounts linked to an authorized Facebook Page: DMs, story mentions and story replies.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Page direct messages via authorized page connection.

facts.label: SMS

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Aircall integration card is explicitly inactive/coming soon. A current native voice/calling plan was not established.

facts.label: Slack customer conversations
facts.value: Official Slack integration sends new-message notifications to a selected staff channel. Native bidirectional customer Slack/Slack Connect ingestion was not established.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No named ready-to-use Discord customer inbox/connector found in current channel/integration documentation.

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: Native pre-chat/offline forms collect name, email, company and phone; required fields are configurable. Offline messages remain available to the team.

facts.label: Telegram
facts.value: Native customer DMs to a Telegram bot using its token.

facts.label: Viber
facts.value: Native bot direct messages, available on all HelpCrunch plans. Requires an active Rakuten Viber bot/API token.

facts.label: Inbox coordination
facts.value: Manual assignment, departments, statuses, tags, private notes, saved responses and custom inbox views.

facts.label: Collision and shared draft specifics
facts.value: A specific collision/typing warning or shared-reply-draft editing mechanism was not established in checked inbox guides.

facts.label: Widgets and messenger connections
facts.value: Basic/Pro/Unlimited: one/five/unlimited separately configured widgets; fifteen/twenty-five/one hundred messenger connections.

facts.label: Custom email domains and addresses

facts.value: Exact retraining/update cadence, byte/token/file cap per source and guaranteed customer-visible citations were not found.

facts.value: Customer/chat/message webhooks send JSON HTTP POST; verify HMAC-SHA1 over raw body with X-HelpCrunch-Signature. Delivery retries and disable-on-failure behavior are documented.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the hosted application. No independent server runtime/installation offer found.
