facts.value: Basic KB: one language; Pro/Unlimited: any number of languages in pricing. AI Editor translation menu lists English, Ukrainian, Spanish, French, Portuguese and German; Agents claim 120+ languages.

facts.label: Agent-interface locale list
facts.value: A complete supported staff-interface language list was not found.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs

facts.label: AI quality review and history
facts.value: Performance tracks handled, deflected, routed, resolved and abandoned outcomes. Unresolved Questions lists knowledge gaps, route offered, language/tags and conversation outcome.

facts.label: Contact export
facts.value: Dashboard exports all, selected or filtered contacts as CSV or XLSX, delivered to the confirmed registration email.

facts.label: Conversation text and transcripts
facts.value: Email transcripts can send full conversation history manually or on closure. REST chat/message listing returns JSON message text/private-note types, with offset/limit pagination up to 100 records.

facts.label: Attachments and articles out
facts.value: No complete bulk attachment-binary export or article/category/translation export format found. Message-model examples do not establish an attachment archive.

facts.label: Ratings, reports and AI exports
facts.value: Chat model includes rating; report chat lists export CSV/XLSX via emailed download link. AI performance exports CSV/JSON.

facts.label: Retention/deletion timing
facts.value: Privacy allows personal-data update/deletion requests and limits use to legitimate purposes, but no fixed active-history, unpaid-trial cleanup or backup-purge duration was found.

facts.label: Legal company and country
facts.value: HelpCrunch Corporation, registered in Wilmington, Delaware, United States.

facts.value: Chat/docs and support@helpcrunch.com; trial/paid plans advertise personal onboarding. Current pricing labels Basic medium, Pro high, Unlimited highest priority support.

facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Privacy says last reviewed 2026-10-30; terms updated 2022-11-23. Billing guide says updated six days ago; widget initialization one week ago.

facts.label: Previous standalone Business
facts.value: One hundred teams/forwarding addresses/reply addresses/custom email domains/templates; fifty active rules, twenty custom fields, one hundred shared/twenty private macros; twenty Viewers.

facts.value: Current offer permits multiple websites per account; numeric website maximum not stated. Separate multibrand management is an Enterprise feature marked coming soon.

facts.value: Current offer manages AI knowledge sources/articles, but a separately published public customer portal, help-domain entitlement, article cap and article feedback/translation limits are not established for the base offer.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native two-way email ticketing; unlimited mailboxes. Office 365/Microsoft Graph OAuth, Google OAuth, standard IMAP/SMTP and supported Exchange routes.

facts.label: Web portal / contact form
facts.value: Native support portal and embeddable question/feedback form; customers submit requests and check their history/status.

facts.label: Live chat / web-app chat
facts.value: Official HelpSpot FAQ positions product as asynchronous email-first with external chat-tool integrations. A current native live-chat product or native customer mobile SDK not established.

facts.label: Phone / IM intake
facts.value: Staff can manually create requests for phone or IM encounters. No native phone number/dialer/recording/call-carrier offer established.

facts.label: Microsoft Teams
facts.value: Developer page advertises Teams connection via Zapier; detailed native two-way Teams inbox/bot and delivery limits not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS and Discord
facts.value: Native managed channels, included numbers/messages and specific current tariffs not established in checked product/manual sources.

facts.label: Ownership and collaboration
facts.value: Single owner per ticket, shared Inbox/My Queue, filters, public/private/external notes, collision indicators, mentions, batch actions and saved responses.

facts.label: Automation and business hours
facts.value: Real-time triggers, scheduled rules, inbound mail rules; round robin/least requests/default/random assignment; macros/responses and escalations. Default and holiday hours affect timing/when rules run.

facts.label: Brands / sites / mailboxes
facts.value: Unlimited brands, mailboxes and portals advertised; each brand may have unique portal URL/templates, book selection, mailbox templates and fields/categories.

facts.label: Portal separation limits
facts.value: Secondary portals share primary logins and some settings; same server/network-accessible installation files required. Public secondary content also appears on primary unless primary is overridden.

facts.label: Help center
facts.value: Unlimited knowledge books, chapters and pages; public or private agent books; full-text search/table of contents; WYSIWYG/images/files, helpful/not-helpful ratings and missing-search reporting.

facts.label: Domains / translated article management
facts.value: Own domain/brand-specific content selection supported. Built-in article translation/version linking, per-article locale routing and exact public file-size allowance not established.

facts.label: Built-in AI role
facts.value: Composer drafts, writing transformations, translation, summaries, automatic/suggested categorization, out-of-office detection and KB article drafting. Composer never sends on its own.

facts.label: External assistant through MCP
facts.value: Connected AI clients can search/update requests and KB pages, add notes, change fields/status, close requests and aggregate reports within staff permissions.

facts.label: Knowledge and training inputs
facts.value: Composer uses ticket history, customer info, linked KB articles and chosen prompts. Auto categorization needs at least 10 closed requests per selected category; suggest-only mode available.

facts.label: Sources / refresh / citations limits
facts.value: No documented general website/PDF ingestion index, exact token/article context cap, automatic resync cadence or guaranteed customer-visible source citations established for Composer.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: No distinct built-in autonomous customer bot/chat handoff applies to documented Composer flow: a staff member reviews and sends each draft. Portal form/email reaches the human ticket queue.

facts.label: Staff-facing actions and controls
facts.value: MCP writes can edit tickets/KB; admin can disable tools or all write tools. Operations run as authenticated staff; whether client asks before each change depends on client/settings. Live Lookup brings external customer context into HelpSpot.

facts.label: Commerce writes / customer verification
facts.value: Turnkey autonomous refund/order-change action, required end-customer identity verification and transaction-specific approval guarantee not established.

facts.label: Setup and operating duties

facts.label: Surveys / AI review

facts.label: CSAT headline definition
facts.value: Survey creation guide defines CSAT as percentage of scores 4 or 5; Survey Reporting describes CSAT overall score as the average score.

facts.label: CSV tickets / notes

facts.label: Customer data ZIP

facts.label: Knowledge / forums / survey data
facts.value: Public API returns KB page HTML/tags/structure and forum topics/posts; authorized MCP can read KB pages/history. Survey trends export to Excel; reports CSV.

facts.label: Whole-instance exit
facts.value: Vendor advertises full data export and free help migrating between Cloud regions/self-hosted; self-hosted operator has SQL/files access. Exact Cloud export package format, timing and post-cancellation download window not stated.

facts.label: Primary hosting / backup regions

facts.label: AI-provider coverage
facts.value: October 29, 2026 data-services doc describes OpenAI and says Groq is no longer used. Current AI marketing page also names Anthropic. Exact provider-by-feature routing not established.

facts.label: AI use / retention claims
facts.value: AI marketing says no customer data retained by AI providers or used to train third-party models; operational doc says securely sent to OpenAI, not used for training. Local categorization model resides in HelpSpot database.

facts.label: Regional privacy wording / processors
facts.value: EU Cloud says all data stays in EU; general privacy policy says provided personal information is transferred to/processed in US. Built-in AI uses hosted gateway with no complete published regional-routing/provider location list.

facts.label: History / expiry retention
facts.value: Trial data deleted if not converted; exact active-history expiry, cancellation/export grace period and Cloud purge-from-backups delay not published in checked sources.

facts.label: Deletion controls
facts.value: Customer Tools permanently deletes individual notes/attachments, complete requests or all customer requests/files by ID/email. Trash auto-deletes after configured days; 5.8.7+ also has permission-controlled permanent deletion.

facts.label: Backups / raw mail retention
facts.value: US Cloud database backups every 5 minutes, 15-day retention; daily server snapshots 14-day retention. Stored original EML mail files default cleanup after 5 days, configurable.

facts.value: US Cloud, EU Cloud and self-hosted proprietary HelpSpot under HelpSpot License Agreement. Post-January 4, 2016 purchases are subscription licences.

facts.value: No exact supported HelpJet answer-language list, core Help Assistant locale list or full pretranslated UI-language count found in checked KB and deployment docs.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Browser-based WordPress admin and customer-facing web pages/widgets; requires plugin-capable WordPress host. Current tiers include a free Chrome extension to search/access the KB from other webpages.

facts.label: Reporting / core
facts.value: Plus+: popular/empty search analytics, article feedback and transfer analytics. Search effectiveness and transfer rates show failed searches and moves to support; weekly email reports cover views/top-rated content and feedback.

facts.label: Reporting / AI transition
facts.value: Legacy conversation analytics is frozen at sunset; CSV export is indicated. HelpJet separately offers full activity threads, resolution/satisfaction labels, unresolved/negative filters and usage accounting.

facts.label: Article export
facts.value: Current KB changelog supports standard WordPress export filtered by article category, author, dates and status. WordPress Tools Export produces WXR/XML for custom post types and related fields/taxonomies.

facts.label: Analytics and legacy AI export
facts.value: Changelog records analytics export support and directs frozen legacy built-in AI conversation analytics to CSV export before removal.

facts.label: HelpJet conversations and exit
facts.value: Separate HelpJet DPA says specific conversation exports/deletions can be requested; ask before account closure for data return. Dashboard activity lets staff inspect full threads.

facts.label: Export completeness
facts.value: Exact KB analytics CSV columns, attachment-file portability, all feedback export coverage and full HelpJet chat-export format were not established.

facts.label: Core data location and check-in
facts.value: Core articles live in the operator’s WordPress database. Changelog says weekly usage check-in runs only after activation with a valid licence.

facts.label: AI data location / separate service
facts.value: HelpJet processor list: Vercel app/API hosting primarily Washington, D.C., worldwide edge; Convex data/storage/search in US AWS us-east-1; OpenAI/Azure models in US/other regions; AI Gateway and Cloudflare paths worldwide.

facts.label: AI data-use terms
facts.value: HelpJet terms permit use of Customer Data to improve service, models and features; DPA governs personal data, processing instructions and anonymised/aggregated information, with priority for personal-data conflicts. No blanket no-training promise established.

facts.label: Retention / core and vendor website
facts.value: KB guide allows deleting individual/all article votes. No fixed default KB analytics/history/backup purge schedule found. Vendor website policy retains basic customer information for six years after customer relationship for tax purposes.

facts.label: Retention / replacement AI
facts.value: HelpJet keeps customer personal data while retained in the account. Admin/owner can request conversation deletion in writing; account closure deletes data unless legally required, or returns it if requested before closure. Backup copies expire on the backup schedule.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Heroic Knowledge Base, also Heroic KB; active commercial WordPress knowledge-base plugin from HeroThemes. No closure or acquisition notice for the whole product found.

facts.label: AI sunset and replacement
facts.value: Built-in AI Help Assistant deprecated in 4.7.0 (September 18, 2026); cannot be newly enabled. Version 4.8.0 retires training, freezes legacy conversation analytics, and says the built-in assistant and AI Article Writer will be removed in the next release. HelpJet replaces the assistant.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Heroic Media Ltd, company 08589870, registered in England and Wales; registered office The Glades, Festival Way, Stoke-On-Trent, England, ST1 5SQ. HeroThemes is its brand.

facts.label: Markets and restrictions
facts.value: No complete country purchase restrictions or regional eligibility list found.

facts.label: Edition and software licence
facts.value: Self-hosted WordPress plugin. Product terms state GNU General Public License version 3 for the Product. Sample articles/images have a separate non-exclusive, non-transferable licence limited to use with the purchased Product/site.

facts.label: Theme, bundles and companion products
facts.value: Every current KB tier lists a dedicated knowledge-base theme, FAQ builder and glossary. KnowAll is a related theme; Heroic Inbox is a separate mailbox product. Pro lists Inbox/Help Scout integrations.

facts.label: Hosted AI boundary
facts.value: HelpJet is HeroThemes’ hosted AI support product with a separate account, service terms and Free/Pro pricing. Its WordPress plugin connects a site to a HelpJet bot. Heroic KB itself remains a self-hosted plugin.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Active licence required. Essential/Plus standard support, Pro premium. KB and one-to-one email support; aims to respond in 12–24 hours weekdays and 24–48 hours weekends/holidays.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Latest displayed KB release: 4.8.0, October 12, 2026. Proposed next review 2026-11-19, focused on next-release AI removal and Pro/HelpJet entitlement.

apps.name: Hiver
apps.line: Shared inbox and support workspace for email, chat, and customer help.

free.text: 7-day trial, no card; free-plan offer conflicts

cells.ai: AI Agent requires higher plan; usage price unknown

agents.math: The current Omni pricing requires two seats at $35 each. The Gmail buying guide starts at five seats.
The current Omni pricing lists five seats at $35 each. Seat rules vary by edition.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Current edition pricing lists Growth, Pro and Elite, with suspension after the trial. A live official blog still advertises a forever-free Hiver plan. New-customer Free eligibility is unresolved.

facts.label: Free limits
facts.value: Older official comparisons describe free email, live chat, a knowledge base and basic collaboration; current edition-specific Free seat/inbox/history/storage/AI limits and eligibility were not established.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Seven days with Elite features; no credit card needed. Both edition pricing FAQs publish the same duration.

facts.label: Trial expiry
facts.value: Without a paid upgrade, the account is suspended. Pricing says upgrade within seven days after trial expiry to reactivate.

facts.label: Growth, both editions
facts.value: USD 35/user/month monthly; USD 25/user/month with annual billing. Growth supports up to ten users and two shared inboxes.

facts.label: Pro, both editions
facts.value: USD 65/user/month monthly; USD 55/user/month annually. Unlimited users, five shared inboxes.

facts.label: Elite, both editions
facts.value: USD 95/user/month monthly; USD 85/user/month annually. Unlimited users. Gmail lists unlimited shared inboxes; the Omni table did not give a numeric Elite shared-inbox allowance.

facts.label: Currency, taxes and payment
facts.value: Fees are in USD, exclusive of applicable taxes, payment-processing fees and currency-conversion costs. Orders authorize immediate payment of the applicable fees/tax.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Paid user seats sold in bundles, not simply the count of people currently working. Subscription cost is the per-seat rate multiplied by the purchased seat tier.

facts.label: Minimum and seat-pack conflict
facts.value: Current pricing: start at two seats, then five, then increments of five. Gmail's purchase guide: minimum five. Terms examples describe seven users billed at a five-seat tier, inconsistent with treating that tier as a maximum of five.

facts.label: Native AI entitlement
facts.value: Both pricing tables include AI Agents, Skills and Copilot on Growth. AI Agent setup guides instead require Pro or Elite; Omni chat-agent setup also requires early-access enablement.

facts.label: Native AI rate and allowance
facts.value: No current public billable-unit definition, numerical recurring allowance, credit-to-action conversion or overage price for native AI Agents/Copilot/Skills was established.

facts.label: External AI assistants
facts.value: Hiver MCP connects an external AI client under the member's identity. Any client subscription/model bill is separate; Hiver does not publish a bundled external-model allowance in this guide.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: An exact base-plus-100 or base-plus-500 native AI resolution/action bill cannot be calculated from the published information. Both the billable unit and the applicable allowance/rate are missing.

facts.label: Seat changes and other overages
facts.value: Terms permit additional charges/plan changes when usage exceeds plan quotas. Crossing seat tiers adds a prorated charge; lowering tiers does not refund the current paid period.

facts.label: Voice pricing conflict
facts.value: Omni pricing includes 1,000 minutes per voice seat/month, pooled, then USD 0.03/minute. The voice product page instead advertises USD 35/seat/month with no minute metering or overage caps and included SMS.

facts.label: AI stopping and credit terms
facts.value: No current native AI hard-stop threshold, automatic recharge rule, purchased-credit expiry or defined AI overage schedule was established.

facts.label: Chat branding
facts.value: Omni lets admins set widget colors, logo, heading and tagline. Permission to remove every Hiver vendor mark, its first qualifying plan and any charge were not established.

facts.label: Help Center branding
facts.value: Own logo/favicon/colors and custom domain are documented on current paid plans. A separate vendor-footer removal switch/entitlement was not established.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: A published plan-specific guarantee of removing Hiver branding from outgoing mail was not found.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Public self-service trial and paid checkout. A person can start setup, but current pricing requires at least two purchased seats. Pro/Elite cards also offer demos.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared inbox/help desk with customer messaging, self-service content and support AI. Omni combines channels in its own workspace; the Gmail edition centers on email collaboration inside Gmail.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Omni: native connected email from Google, Microsoft, Zoho and other providers. Hiver in Gmail: shared email inside an existing Gmail/Workspace account.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native Chat Inbox/widget on Omni Growth, Pro and Elite. Gmail chat documentation is explicitly legacy-only for accounts opened before 2026-05-18.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Omni's web widget can be installed on a website or web app, with programmatic open/close and authenticated-user loading examples. Mobile embedding is linked from setup; a native customer SDK entitlement was not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native WhatsApp Inbox on all Omni pricing tiers, connected to Meta Business/Developer accounts and a suitable business number.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: The current Omni FAQ refers generally to social channels, but an Instagram-specific connector, account requirements, reply limits and plan gate were not established.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: A specifically documented Facebook Messenger customer channel and its current entitlement were not established.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Native two-way SMS is advertised with Hiver Omni Voice. Omni's table marks SMS included across tiers; the product page ties the no-extra-cost SMS promise to the phone offer.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native inbound/outbound phone channel for Omni, with number provisioning or a bring-your-own-telephony route, voicemail, recordings and transcripts. Voice is an add-on on all Omni tiers.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Omni Pro/Elite: bidirectional support from public/private Slack channels. Internal Slack discussions and alert integration are separate features included more broadly.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No named ready-made Discord customer-support connector established.

facts.label: Forms and portal
facts.value: Omni Web Forms create tickets in a connected email inbox and can use custom fields/uploads. Hosted links are documented; embedding is early access. Pro/Elite add a customer portal for submitting/tracking requests.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Assignment, private notes/@mentions, shared drafts, templates and collision detection are included in current shared-inbox plans. Collaborators outside an inbox can join a verified internal discussion.

facts.label: Rules and working hours
facts.value: Growth/Pro/Elite: 10/20/unlimited automations per shared inbox. Round-robin assignment is documented; advanced routing/custom-object features are higher-tier. Analytics Business Hours is marked Pro/Elite, while Omni chat includes offline-hours settings across tiers.

facts.label: Inboxes and account capacity
facts.value: Growth: two shared inboxes, up to ten users, one send-from alias/inbox and two custom fields. Pro: five inboxes, unlimited users/aliases and ten custom fields. Elite: unlimited users/aliases/fields; Gmail explicitly has unlimited inboxes, while Omni’s numeric inbox cap was not established.

facts.label: Multiple brands/help sites
facts.value: Pro/Elite tables include Multiple Help Centers; Growth does not. The generic setup guide says as many Help Centers as needed without a plan qualification.

facts.label: Help Center capabilities
facts.value: Native external public and internal private article sites, nested categories, publication workflow, search/AI summaries, custom domain, contact form and optional snippets. Current paid tables include these on Growth and above.

facts.label: Article caps, translation and feedback
facts.value: Current numeric article/storage limits, a complete native translation workflow and article-feedback/voting limits were not established.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Native autonomous customer agents for chat and, in the October release, email; AI Skills can execute multi-step processes. Copilot assists staff with answers, drafting and summaries. Elite adds QA/insights.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources and caps
facts.value: Help Center content, website pages/linked pages, snippets, PDF/TXT/DOCX and connected Notion/Google Drive/Confluence. Up to five uploaded files at a time, up to 30 MB each; no fixed source-count cap published by the guide.

facts.label: Updates and approval
facts.value: Uploaded documents need deletion/re-upload to update. Initial source processing may take up to ten minutes. Admins/inbox owners control sources; agents can be previewed and Skills evaluated before enablement.

facts.label: Citations by surface
facts.value: Help Center AI search includes source-article links and says article changes may take up to five minutes to appear in summaries. A guaranteed citation on every autonomous chat/email answer was not established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Confidence/custom handoff rules move chat to the inbox's Unassigned view with the full transcript. Rules can include requests for a person, account access and unresolved troubleshooting; staff can take over live conversations.

facts.label: Offline and missed chats
facts.value: Omni widget can show an offline message/contact form, follow a business-hours template, alert on unanswered chats and switch members offline after consecutive misses.

facts.label: Actions and approval
facts.value: Skills can reply, tag, add notes, assign, change status, search knowledge, update HubSpot and make external API calls. Selected actions/replies can pause for member approval.

facts.label: Identity and permissions
facts.value: Chat examples can set a user identifier, name, email and phone after an app login check. No documented server-signed widget identity scheme or universal customer verification step before sensitive AI actions was established.

facts.label: Shopify and entitlement
facts.value: Native Shopify customer/order context, multi-store connections and inbox/role visibility. The setup requests read/write customer and order scopes. Pricing's table marks Shopify on Growth, while its Pro card calls Shopify a premium integration.

facts.label: WooCommerce and automation
facts.value: Omni pricing marks WooCommerce across Growth/Pro/Elite for customer/order details. Hiver also advertises Zapier and custom API integrations.

facts.label: Slack and engineering tools
facts.value: Native Slack alerts/discussions and Omni Pro/Elite customer Slack channel. Jira is a listed integration; Linear is named on the integration platform page.

facts.label: Other requested connections
facts.value: Dedicated current Stripe, GitHub, Discord and Make connectors and their gates were not established.

facts.label: Gmail API
facts.value: Pro/Elite API access; admins generate bearer-token keys with admin privileges. Public REST documentation publishes one request/second per account and 5,000 requests/day.

facts.label: Omni API
facts.value: Separate REST API, admin-created bearer tokens; pricing Pro/Elite. Omni setup says early-access enablement through support is required.

facts.label: Omni rate-limit discrepancy
facts.value: The explicit Rate limiting section says 60 requests/minute/token, about one per second with limited bursts. The same public page embeds an introduction saying 100/minute/token.

facts.label: Webhooks and widget
facts.value: Public widget JavaScript controls and installation examples. The integration page advertises webhooks, but a general customer-configurable event catalogue, signature/retry rules and plan-specific webhook limits were not established.

facts.label: MCP access
facts.value: Hiver MCP works with accessible email inboxes, not other-channel conversations; external clients connect per member with OAuth. It can create shared drafts, notes and tags, but cannot send an email.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable: the researched editions are a hosted platform and a browser extension backed by Hiver's service.

facts.label: Agent, widget and article languages
facts.value: A complete current agent-interface locale list, widget-language list and native linked-article translation workflow were not established.

facts.label: AI and WhatsApp languages
facts.value: No complete native AI-answer language list or per-language guarantee established. WhatsApp templates have a selected language in Meta setup.

facts.label: Platforms and mobile
facts.value: Omni is a standalone browser product; Gmail edition requires the latest stable Google Chrome and standard Gmail view. Official mobile page links separate iOS/Android apps for Gmail, Omni and Omni Chat.

facts.label: Reports and satisfaction
facts.value: Growth: conversation reporting, twelve-month window, no report exports. Pro/Elite: broader reports/exports with eighteen-/twenty-four-month windows. Pro+ adds CSAT and SLA reports.

facts.label: AI review and failures
facts.value: Elite pricing includes AI QA/Insights. Agent chats have full transcripts; Skills record completed, awaiting-approval, failed and declined runs with step-level review over selectable recent periods.

facts.label: Gmail data export
facts.value: Admin export produces linked XML files with conversation subject/ID/assignee/status/tags, shared notes, templates, shared drafts and contacts. Only one export can run at a time.

facts.label: Omni conversation portability
facts.value: Terms allow export of Customer Content after termination, but a full Omni conversation-body/notes/attachment archive format and self-service bulk route were not established.

facts.label: Omni customer export
facts.value: Admins can export accounts and contacts as CSV. Accounts: name/domains. Contacts: name, primary email, phone and account.

facts.label: Article export
facts.value: Both Help Center guides offer admin CSV export with article/category IDs, title, excerpt, publication state, author and dates. Gmail's detailed list defines excerpt as the first 1,000 ASCII characters.

facts.label: Attachments and transcripts
facts.value: Closed Omni chats can email transcripts to visitors or chosen addresses. A complete bulk binary-attachment export across channels was not established.

facts.label: Reports and feedback
facts.value: Pro/Elite analytics export to CSV, with metric/date/filter/column selection. Scheduled exports are early access and can email recipients or send to S3. A full AI-answer rating/audit archive was not established.

facts.label: Hosting and residency
facts.value: Security page says services/data are hosted in the USA on AWS. Privacy policy says information from users outside the US is transferred to the US. A selectable Hiver hosting region was not established.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Public list dated 2026-10-19 includes Google/AWS, Microsoft, Pinecone, LangChain, OpenAI and others; Twilio telephony/voice processing is explicitly Omni-only.

facts.label: Native AI data use
facts.value: Terms prohibit training AI models on Customer Content. AI policy claims zero retention for direct LLM API requests/responses, or processing inside Hiver-controlled model environments; anonymized signals may improve the product.

facts.label: Omni termination and deletion
facts.value: Terms give fourteen calendar days after Platform termination to export Customer Content. Privacy says personal information is deleted within fourteen days after termination; encrypted backups may persist up to two months.

facts.label: Gmail retention and leaving
facts.value: Privacy says Gmail message content/attachments are deleted within one hour of collection and headers within fourteen days after termination. Terms say underlying email stays in Gmail, while Hiver-specific notes, tags and assignments are deleted.

facts.label: Cancellation and trial lifecycle
facts.value: Terms allow termination on thirty calendar days' written notice; payments are non-refundable. Exact expired-trial purge date and a general guaranteed read-only period were not established.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Hiver, active customer-service platform. Current editions are Hiver Omni and Hiver in Gmail.

facts.label: Company and markets
facts.value: Legal supplier: Hiver, Inc. Grexit Software Pvt. Ltd. in India is listed for development/support. A precise incorporation/home-country statement and complete buying/phone-country coverage list were not established.

facts.label: Hiver Omni edition
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted platform with a standalone browser workspace; supports Gmail, Outlook and other email providers.

facts.label: Hiver in Gmail edition
facts.value: Proprietary subscription Chrome extension operating on an existing Gmail/Google Workspace account.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Current paid pricing includes 24/7 email and chat support. Docs list support@hiverhq.com; early-access features may need that team to enable them.

facts.label: Freshness and changes
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Latest visible changelog entries are dated 2026-10-26, including AI Agent in Email and Skills in Chat. Our next-review suggestion: 2026-12-04.

apps.name: HubSpot Service Hub
apps.line: Customer support inbox, tickets, live chat, and AI within HubSpot CRM.

cells.ai: 50 credits per resolved text conversation

agents.math: Free covers one user and a basic shared inbox for 100 conversations.
3 seats at $10 a month each for eligible new customers, under a limited-time promotion.

apps.news: News check 2026-11-09: no sale, shutdown, rebrand, or incident found.

facts.label: Permanent free offer
facts.value: USD 0/month for up to two users; free CRM FAQ also specifies 1,000 contacts and no expiration date.

facts.label: Free working seats and inbox
facts.value: Two-user account limit; one default conversations inbox. Free users with inbox access can manually assign and reply to unassigned conversations.

facts.label: Free task and branding limits
facts.value: Basic tickets, team email, branded website chat, limited rule-based bots and simple Messenger replies. No Professional help desk workspace or Professional knowledge-base entitlement.

facts.label: Other free resource limits
facts.value: 1,000 CRM contacts published. Exact general storage, conversation/message quota, history-retention window and widget/site maxima not established in checked free pricing/catalogue/inbox sources.

facts.label: Premium trial and end
facts.value: Product offers a 14-day Service Hub trial. Terms allow trial data to be permanently deleted at trial end unless the applicable paid subscription is purchased.

facts.label: Trial card requirement
facts.value: Credit-card requirement for the premium Service Hub trial not established from checked product/pricing/terms.

facts.label: Customer Agent trial
facts.value: Eligible first-time setup can opt into 14 days without credit consumption. Pricing advertises unlimited messages/features during this period with at least one Professional/Enterprise Service Seat.

facts.label: USD Starter standard
facts.value: Normally USD 20/month per Core Starter seat. Starter bundle includes service plus other Starter products; no required onboarding.

facts.label: USD Starter promotion
facts.value: New customers, limited-time offer: USD 10/seat/month billed monthly, no annual commitment; USD 7/seat/month with annual commitment/upfront payment.

facts.label: USD Professional
facts.value: USD 90/Service Seat/month on annual payment; USD 100/seat/month on monthly payment with annual commitment. Required one-time onboarding USD 1,500.

facts.label: USD Enterprise
facts.value: Starts USD 150/Service Seat/month; required one-time onboarding USD 3,500; sales-led purchase.

facts.label: Flexible programme Starter
facts.value: EUR 20/GTM Seat/month starting rate; maximum 10 paid seats; at least one GTM Seat; 5,000 monthly credits.

facts.label: Flexible programme Professional
facts.value: Starts EUR 100/GTM Seat/month; optional Ops Seat EUR 50/month; 10,000 monthly credits.

facts.label: Flexible programme Enterprise
facts.value: Starts EUR 175/GTM Seat/month; optional Ops Seat EUR 50/month; 15,000 monthly credits.

facts.label: Tax and eligibility
facts.value: Fees exclude applicable tax/VAT/GST. Flexible migration FAQ says accounts are eligible when selected/notified; regional partner material describes EMEA rollout.

facts.label: Seat charge and access
facts.value: Starter Core seats; full Professional/Enterprise service functionality needs Service Seats, which include Core access. Free View-Only Seats cannot edit/work tickets.

facts.label: Minimum and onboarding
facts.value: Each account has at least one dedicated seat. Starter has no required onboarding; USD Professional/Enterprise onboarding is USD 1,500/USD 3,500 respectively.

facts.label: Commitment and stopping
facts.value: Auto-renew unless turned off in Account & Billing before current term ends, unless Order says otherwise. Fees generally non-refundable; added seats/credit capacity normally removable at renewal.

facts.label: AI credits and allowance, USD model
facts.value: Customer Agent text resolution uses 50 credits. Service Hub included monthly pool: Starter 500, Professional 3,000, Enterprise 5,000; pool is not multiplied by seats or added across hubs.

facts.label: Extra AI credit pricing
facts.value: USD 0.010/credit; capacity packs USD 10 for 1,000 monthly credits. Pay-as-you-go invoiced in increments of 10 credits after buying additional capacity; remaining included-only usage pauses at exhaustion.

facts.label: Resolution counting
facts.value: A sourced answer/action without qualifying visitor-initiated handoff is evaluated 72 hours after last visitor response; completed lead qualification can resolve immediately. Manual/workflow assignment alone does not prevent resolution counting.

facts.label: Other AI units and EUR model
facts.value: Customer Agent voice beta: 50 credits/minute; Knowledge Base Agent beta: 200/new article. Flexible programme text resolution also 50 credits; extra credits EUR 0.010 each, EUR 10/1,000 pack.

facts.label: 100 and 500 text resolutions
facts.value: Our calculation, Professional-only 3,000-credit pool reserved for agent: 100 × 50 = 5,000, needs 2,000 extra credits = USD 20/month; 500 × 50 = 25,000, needs 22,000 extra = USD 220/month.

facts.label: Credit expiry and spending controls
facts.value: Credits reset monthly and unused credits expire. Included-only exhaustion pauses features. Additional-credit accounts can auto-upgrade for remaining term or use pay-as-you-go; account/tool spend caps supported.

facts.label: Other charge triggers
facts.value: Telecom/SMS, WhatsApp messaging, additional capacity, third-party apps and optional consulting can add cost. Non-payment suspension possible 10 days after notice; reactivation fee may apply.

facts.label: Flexible programme usage
facts.value: One-to-one email from connected/hosted inbox excluded from email credit charging. Other HubSpot-sent email and workflow actions can consume credits; templated WhatsApp uses 20 credits/message; extra calling 10/minute.

facts.label: Widget branding removal
facts.value: Free chat has HubSpot branding; Starter and above permit removal; Messenger branding removal also starts at Starter.

facts.label: Knowledge-base branding
facts.value: Professional/Enterprise knowledge-base themes allow own logo, header/footer content, address, menus and copyright text; no blanket vendor-attribution rule across legacy/current themes established.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Starter bundle comparison removes branding from one-to-one emails; a separate all-support-email/footer policy across inbox, help desk and trial was not established.

facts.label: Solo buying access
facts.value: Free self-service entry up to two users; Starter self-service purchase; Professional also has a public buy route; Enterprise uses sales. One working seat is a published unit.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: cloud support inbox/ticketing, live chat, knowledge base, customer success and AI connected to a shared CRM.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Basic team email/conversations inbox available free; Professional/Enterprise help desk connects shared email and automatically creates tickets from connected channels.

facts.label: Website/in-app web chat
facts.value: Native website widget in all products/plans, with availability, page targeting, desktop/mobile behavior and optional bots. External sites require HubSpot tracking code.

facts.label: Forms and portal
facts.value: Ticket records and forms available at basic level; help-desk-connected forms automatically create tickets on Professional/Enterprise. Paid knowledge base/customer portal are separate advanced features.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Native integration; free simple messages/quick replies, Starter removes branding, Professional advanced branching/reporting, Enterprise custom bot code actions.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native verified WhatsApp Business connection to help desk on Service Hub Professional/Enterprise. Pricing table lists up to 1,000 messages/month.

facts.label: Service SMS
facts.value: Beta for Professional/Enterprise, inbox or help desk; requires registration/add-on, US number, one SMS number/account; sole proprietors excluded. Incoming MMS supported, outgoing rep images not supported.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Calling channel supported in help desk; USD plan table: Starter 500 minutes/1 number, Professional 3,000/3, Enterprise 12,000/5. Country availability restricted.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: HubSpot-built help desk integration syncs selected tickets, internal comments and property updates to Slack on Professional/Enterprise. Basic live-chat product also advertises Slack notification/reply integration.

facts.label: Instagram, Discord and custom intake
facts.value: Custom channels API/Marketplace can connect external messaging; native Instagram DM/Discord support-inbox entitlement not established in checked channel setup/pricing.

facts.label: Collaboration and routing
facts.value: Help desk provides ticket owners, notes, drafts, snippets/templates, macros, custom views, SLAs and routing; advanced functions require assigned Service Seat.

facts.label: Collision awareness and hours
facts.value: Specific current duplicate-reply locking guarantee not established from checked help-desk response/inbox guides. Chat availability schedules and human/AI routing are documented.

facts.label: Inboxes/sites and brands
facts.value: Free/Starter have default inbox; multiple inboxes require Pro/Enterprise. Chatflows can target pages on external sites with tracking code. Brand-separated assets require distinct product/add-on entitlements.

facts.label: Multi-brand add-on
facts.value: USD hub-model docs require Marketing Hub Enterprise plus Brands add-on; one add-on/brand, up to 100 brands. Each adds a brand domain; account still has one primary domain.

facts.label: Help center and access
facts.value: Service Hub Professional/Enterprise knowledge base: searchable articles, categories/tags, support form, custom domain, public or membership/SSO-restricted content, article feedback and language variants.

facts.label: Professional article allowance
facts.value: One knowledge base, up to 2,000 articles under USD Service Hub Professional.

facts.label: Enterprise knowledge-base conflict
facts.value: USD pricing table says 25 knowledge bases/10,000 total articles; migrated-article guide says up to 100 knowledge bases/10,000 total articles.

facts.label: Flexible programme knowledge base
facts.value: Flexible Professional and Enterprise table: 100 knowledge bases/account, up to 10,000 total articles.

facts.label: Customer Agent role
facts.value: Autonomous answers on connected channels using supplied knowledge; asks follow-up questions or escalates when uncertain. Agent also supplies help-desk reply recommendations.

facts.label: Staff assistance and article creation
facts.value: Breeze Assistant provides drafting/context assistance; Knowledge Base Agent beta can turn support interactions into articles, at 200 credits/new article in catalogue.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and limits
facts.value: HubSpot articles/pages/landing pages/blogs, public URLs, uploaded files, authored short answers, and reviewed Q&A generated from tickets/inbox conversations/files. Related-URL import can sync up to 5,000 URLs/domain.

facts.label: Refresh, citations and control
facts.value: Synced knowledge-base changes re-sync automatically; other sources weekly, with manual refresh/removal. Citation toggle can be disabled; private sources are not cited but can still inform public responses.

facts.label: Handoff triggers and destinations
facts.value: Default handoff when unable to answer, visitor requests human, or agent paused; custom guidelines/segments supported. Separate chat/email rules can route live or asynchronously to inbox/help desk/users/teams/workflows.

facts.label: Availability and history
facts.value: Availability/unavailability messages configurable; async follow-up supported. Conversation remains in inbox/help-desk context. Team-only routing can hand off even when nobody is available.

facts.label: Actions and approval
facts.value: Up to 20 configured Customer Agent actions; external API lookups/tasks, order-status lookup, password-reset email, CRM-object updates and workflow enrollment documented. Test/preview then publish/unpublish actions.

facts.label: Customer verification
facts.value: Action protection levels: None, Match email, Verify email link. Already verified visitor identification can avoid another link. API auth can use request signature/API key.

facts.label: Shopify
facts.value: Official Shopify Data Sync connects contacts/companies/products/orders/carts. Orders and abandoned checkouts flow from Shopify to HubSpot; custom field mappings need Data Hub Starter.

facts.label: Stripe
facts.value: Official guide supports Stripe payment processing or data sync without processing. Customers sync bidirectionally to contacts; invoice/product/subscription/transaction objects have differing one-way routes.

facts.label: Slack and other requested connections
facts.value: HubSpot-built Slack sync for help desk established; public Conversations API can connect external tools. Packaged WooCommerce, Discord, Linear, GitHub Issues, Zapier or Make support-specific entitlements not established in checked subset.

facts.label: Public APIs and webhooks
facts.value: Conversations API generally available in fall 2026: inboxes/channels/threads/messages, filtering/pagination, assignments/status, reads/writes and real-time event webhooks. Scopes conversations.read/conversations.write.

facts.label: API limits
facts.value: Public OAuth Marketplace apps: 110 requests/10s/account. Private apps: Free/Starter 100/10s/app and 250,000/day/account; Pro 190/10s and 625,000/day; Enterprise 190/10s and 1,000,000/day.

facts.label: Widget/web-app library
facts.value: Official widget primer exposes window.HubSpotConversations, window.hsConversationsSettings and window.hsConversationsOnReady; supports load and authenticated visitor identification.

facts.label: Self-host operation
facts.value: Not applicable: no self-hosted Service Hub edition offered in checked product/licence sources.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: 17 published software languages: traditional/simplified Chinese, Danish, Dutch, English, Finnish, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian Bokmål, Polish, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish, Swedish and Thai.

facts.label: Widget and help articles
facts.value: Chatflow has language selector; system-generated chat/form/email strings use published default-content language list. Pro/Enterprise knowledge-base language variants support manual authoring and AI-assisted translation tools.

facts.label: AI answers
facts.value: Customer Agent can restrict response languages or auto-detect first-message language if none selected. Handoff messages auto-translate based on visitor language.

facts.label: Agent desktop/mobile
facts.value: Browser SaaS; official free HubSpot app for iOS/Android provides CRM/inbox features. Current help-desk setup guide explicitly says help desk is not yet available in mobile app.

facts.label: Host and customer SDK dependencies
facts.value: External website needs tracking code for chat; any compatible web app can integrate widget/visitor identification. No mandatory WordPress/Shopify/Gmail platform for core Service Hub. Native customer mobile-chat SDK not established.

facts.label: Service reporting
facts.value: Professional/Enterprise service analytics and surveys; help-desk performance reports, ticket/SLA analysis, customer success and Enterprise journey analytics. Basic dashboards also exist on free/Starter.

facts.label: AI quality review
facts.value: Customer Agent resolution/handoff/deflection reports, source-performance groups and coaching opportunities for knowledge/action gaps, handoff issues and negative feedback.

facts.label: Customers and ticket records
facts.value: CRM records export CSV/XLS/XLSX with selected/current property values and associations. Activities/conversation messages are separate exports/API routes.

facts.label: Conversation text and internal notes
facts.value: Public Conversations API retrieves threads/messages and original full content for truncated messages. Help Desk Notes need CRM Notes associated with tickets; existing legacy comments are not migrated to Notes.

facts.label: Attachments and files
facts.value: Conversation API exposes attachment/file references; Files tool has its own export route. Message export is not automatically a single ZIP of all media binaries.

facts.label: Knowledge articles
facts.value: Pro/Enterprise plus assigned Service Seat and knowledge permission: export article data CSV/XLS/XLSX, including title/language/URL and other fields.

facts.label: Survey responses
facts.value: Service Pro/Enterprise survey response export CSV; choose current-view or all available survey data, with filters affecting exported rows.

facts.label: Export windows and limits
facts.value: Record export links expire after 30 days; up to 300 exports/rolling 24h, three simultaneous. Full-account neutral export with guaranteed all-object fidelity not established.

facts.label: Hosting regions and choice
facts.value: AWS hosting: US East Virginia, US West Oregon, EU Germany, Canada Montreal, Australia Sydney. Initial location from signup geolocation; paid subscriptions can change location; free must upgrade to change.

facts.label: AI providers and processing
facts.value: Current processor register includes AWS and OpenAI for HubSpot AI; processing locations depend on account region/provider, with EU columns including EEA/Switzerland and other account regions sometimes using US.

facts.label: Model training and opt-out
facts.value: HubSpot's own model training is on by default; Super Admin can opt out prospectively without losing AI access. Sensitive Data accounts opted out by default and cannot opt in.

facts.label: Third-party AI training/retention
facts.value: HubSpot says its engaged AI providers cannot train on customer data; zero retention enforced wherever possible, not an unconditional all-provider zero-day guarantee.

facts.label: Deletion and continuing free use
facts.value: Paid expiry generally leaves free services unless cause termination. DPA calls for return/deletion according to product terms, with legal exceptions and isolated backups deleted under vendor practices.

facts.label: Retention detail and exit window
facts.value: Complete Service Hub-specific fixed post-cancellation retrieval window, live ticket-history cap and final backup-erasure days not established in checked Service/general terms, DPA, privacy and export docs.

facts.label: Deleted threads and AI objects
facts.value: Conversations API archive/delete moves thread to trash, permanently deleted after 30 days unless restored. Customer Agent can be edited/paused but setup guide says it cannot be deleted once created.

facts.label: Knowledge-base migration retention
facts.value: Migration guide says old knowledge base becomes read-only and remains accessible for 30 days after new version is published, then is deleted.

facts.label: Identity and state
facts.value: HubSpot Service Hub, an active product within HubSpot's customer platform; Customer Agent/Breeze are related AI capabilities.

facts.label: Component sunset
facts.value: Help Desk thread-comment creation through Conversations API retired September 23, 2026; CRM Notes should be associated with tickets instead.

facts.label: Owner and contracting country
facts.value: HubSpot, Inc., Cambridge, Massachusetts, USA. Contracting entity varies with customer location; free users contract with HubSpot, Inc.

facts.label: Channel/region restrictions
facts.value: Calling and AI are not guaranteed in every geography. Service SMS beta requires a US-based sending number, one number per account, and excludes sole proprietors.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted subscription, with free services and paid Starter, Professional and Enterprise editions. No self-hosted Service Hub edition offered in checked product/catalogue/terms.

facts.label: Buyer support by tier
facts.value: Free: knowledge base/community. Starter paid seats: email/chat. Pro/Enterprise paid seats: phone/callback/email/chat.

facts.label: Hours and response qualification
facts.value: Terms: phone Sunday 8pm to Friday 8pm EST; email/in-app accepted 24×7 but responses during phone-support hours, with holiday/week-of-rest exceptions. Target one business day, no guaranteed response time.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Active October/November 2026 docs; credit guide updated October 28, help-desk channels October 29, Service SMS November 2, buyer support November 4. Suggested review 2026-12-05.

facts.label: Sales CRM, direct India

facts.value: Developer listing returned RM 403.60 MYR/month or RM 3,420.37 MYR/year, plus WhatsApp usage.

facts.label: Shopify vendor-page dollars
facts.value: Interakt's own Shopify page shows $41/$51/$99 monthly and $296/$468/$839 yearly across its feature cards, with additional usage charges.

facts.label: Taxes and convenience fee
facts.value: Terms add 2% convenience fee to subscription payments and prepaid credit loads, non-refundable. All payments exclude applicable government taxes/levies.

facts.label: Billing units
facts.value: Plan subscription plus channel-message usage/prepaid credits; CRM extra seats and AI messages are separate billed units.

facts.label: Agent counting and roles
facts.value: Marketing/support advertises unlimited agents; Starter specifies owner roles, higher plans exclude separately priced CRM roles. Sales CRM includes five sales-agent seats.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and setup
facts.value: Published direct plans use one subscription per selected term, with no minimum filled seats on unlimited-agent plans; self-service pages advertise no setup cost.

facts.label: Commitment and renewals
facts.value: Selected subscription term auto-renews unless revoked in writing; subscription and prepaid credits non-transferable/non-refundable under payment terms.

facts.label: AI subscription price conflict
facts.value: Static AI tab says INR 2,499/month; add-on banner and billing-toggle script say INR 3,000/month, INR 9,000/quarter or INR 36,000/year. Growth/Advanced subscription required.

facts.label: AI usage unit
facts.value: AI tab includes 100 AI messages, then INR 0.50 per AI message; three agents can be active together: sales, support and lead qualification.

facts.label: Older AnswerBot allowance
facts.value: Pricing separately lists AnswerBot four runs on Growth and six on Advanced, max five website URLs; meaning/reset of a run is not established.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: first 100 AI messages within the advertised unused allowance add INR 0 usage; 500 messages incur (500−100) × INR 0.50 = INR 200 nominal usage.

facts.label: Indian WhatsApp delivery rates
facts.value: Starter/Growth/Advanced marketing: INR 0.970/0.958/0.949; utility 0.160/0.150/0.140; authentication and service 0.129/0.128/0.127 per message.

facts.label: Free service allowance versus old docs
facts.value: Current pricing charges service messages after 1,000 free messages. Linked December 2024 guide says non-template replies are completely free and also uses older service-conversation pricing.

facts.label: Prepaid balance and overspending
facts.value: Insufficient prepaid balance blocks service until topped up; negative balances immediately due and may be charged to the linked payment method or offset against later loads.

facts.label: Credit expiry and inactivity
facts.value: Without an active subscription, account deemed inactive; unused prepaid balance lapses after 365 calendar days, without refund or restoration after late reactivation.

facts.label: Cancellation and refunds
facts.value: Written non-renewal/termination request in terms; a vendor guide also describes Cancel Interakt subscription under Billing Details. Access ends on Subscription End Date; ordinary subscription/usage charges non-refundable.

facts.label: Other paid extras
facts.value: Concierge support INR 2,499/month recurring; custom AI/web/voice services and Shopify Premier may require different offers. Exact voice/SMS/RCS tariffs not established.

facts.label: Widget appearance
facts.value: Widget style, text, brand colors, business image, greeting and desktop/mobile position customizable.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: No paid tier or surcharge for removing Interakt attribution from widget, outgoing messages or a customer help center established.

facts.label: Solo access
facts.value: Self-service Start Free Trial and sales/demo routes. Marketing/support plans advertise unlimited agents, so a single owner can start.

facts.label: Platform and number dependencies
facts.value: WhatsApp route requires an eligible business number able to receive OTP by SMS/voice, Meta setup and messaging-policy compliance; Instagram uses its own channel connection.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: WhatsApp/Instagram shared support inbox with campaigns, commerce, sales CRM, rule-based automation and optional AI agents.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native business messaging shared inbox, templates, workflows and AI; Starter has selected-channel/term restrictions, Growth/Advanced both WhatsApp and Instagram.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native DMs/comments and automations, including price/giveaway replies; monthly Starter is Instagram-only and higher direct plans include Instagram.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native website button is documented as a WhatsApp launcher. Separate custom AI Web/Chat deployment is marketed through sales.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: No customer iOS/Android chat SDK or authenticated app messenger plan found.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: No native support-email channel documented in the inspected inbox/channel/API sources.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: No Facebook Messenger conversation inbox entitlement found in the checked product sources.

facts.label: RCS
facts.value: Enterprise lists RCS messaging in the main plan comparison.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: October Shopify voice guide lists SMS in Configure Channels, without general SMS plan, region or rate details.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: WhatsApp calling appears in the plan comparison; Shopify Voice AI campaigns require Shopify Premier, connected store and verified WhatsApp number.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: No native customer Slack support channel or named connector established.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: No native Discord customer-support channel or documented connector established.

facts.label: Forms
facts.value: WhatsApp Forms/Flows collect information, lead details and feedback; pricing specifies send/use routes by tier.

facts.label: Inbox and manual assignment
facts.value: Assign/reassign conversations, labels, smart cards, customer/order history, internal notes and tags supported.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Quick replies support variables/fallback values, images/documents and slash-command search in the composer.

facts.label: Auto-routing
facts.value: Advanced/Enterprise auto-assignment: least-open-chat load distribution plus trait/tag-based rules; enable assignment and rules explicitly.

facts.label: Rules and hours
facts.value: Welcome, out-of-office and delayed replies; Growth linear chatbot flows; Advanced branching, conditions, API calls and assignment features.

facts.label: Workflow gaps
facts.value: No documented collision-prevention warning, queue-wide drafting lock, note/export role matrix, or exact per-plan business-hours schedule cap found.

facts.label: Channels, contacts and fields
facts.value: Growth/Advanced include WhatsApp+Instagram and unlimited contacts/messages subject to provider limits; Growth 25 custom fields/30 tags/5 events, Advanced 30/45/7.

facts.label: Brands, websites and numbers
facts.value: No complete per-subscription count for independent brands, websites, multiple WhatsApp numbers or separately isolated inboxes found.

facts.label: Public help center
facts.value: No purchaser-hosted public article/search/custom-domain/translation/article-feedback product established.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Customer Support AI answers FAQs; Sales Agent recommends products; Lead Qualification Agent collects contact traits. Existing fixed automations take precedence over AI.

facts.label: AnswerBot source access
facts.value: Pricing and Support Hub mention AnswerBot, but the linked setup article returned HTTP 404.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs and size
facts.value: Support/sales agents use website pages, uploaded documents and business descriptions; sales requires synced Meta catalog. Multiple documents accepted, stated maximum 20 MB.

facts.label: Editing and publishing
facts.value: Agent prompts editable; agents independently enabled/disabled. Test mode allows up to four whitelisted WhatsApp numbers; Go Live disables test mode and exposes the agent to customers.

facts.label: Freshness and citations
facts.value: Manual extra URLs/retraining described; no exact recrawl schedule, answer-citation promise, immutable source version or review-approval queue for knowledge changes found.

facts.label: Human handoff
facts.value: Auto-Handoff assigns an unanswered chat to a human using existing assignment rules; requires auto-chat assignment configured and a plan supporting it.

facts.label: Context and off-hours behavior
facts.value: Shared inbox keeps customer conversation history; exact AI-handoff transcript mapping, fallback destination outside business hours and staffed response guarantee not published.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Shopify voice can confirm COD orders, permit order cancellation and request address updates; cancellation directly changes Shopify, address change completes via WhatsApp form/workflow.

facts.label: Identity and approval limits
facts.value: No general identity-verification protocol or compulsory human approval for every customer-account action established.

facts.label: Relevant named connections

facts.label: Other integrations
facts.value: No documented native Stripe, Linear, GitHub or Discord connection established in the checked relevant subset.

facts.value: Growth 300 requests/minute; Advanced 600/minute; Enterprise configurable. Starter public APIs unavailable. User/event tracking, Get Users, template sending and chat assignment documented.

facts.value: Older API overview says incoming-message webhooks on Growth/Advanced; current price comparison places incoming/chatbot message events under Advanced/Enterprise, with a smaller Growth event set.

facts.label: SDK and library scope
facts.value: Track guide links a Python SDK and Postman collection; no dedicated native customer mobile chat SDK established.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: No customer-operated server/plugin edition established; server install/runtime/backup/upgrade comparison not applicable.

facts.value: Developer's Shopify app listing states English. General operator/widget and WhatsApp AI supported-language lists not established; Shopify voice setup gives English/Hindi as examples.

facts.label: Full locale commitments
facts.value: No comprehensive operator, widget or support-AI locale matrix/translation limits found in checked docs.

facts.label: Agent devices and hosts
facts.value: Web inbox plus Android/iOS operator apps documented; widget uses site HTML or Shopify app-embed installation.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Conversation and agent analytics track responses, closures, waiting/resolution time; filters and CSV export. AI guide adds Messages Answered and Human Handovers dashboard.

facts.label: CSAT and voice reports
facts.value: Support Hub claims surveys/feedback for CSAT; Shopify voice guide lists attempted/connected/failed calls, duration and outcome metrics.

facts.label: Contacts export

facts.label: Reports export
facts.value: Conversation Analytics exports CSV for selected filters/time range, with conversation performance data.

facts.label: Full conversation and attachment portability
facts.value: No verified bulk chat transcript/media/internal-note export format or API history-extraction method found.

facts.label: Articles, knowledge and feedback export
facts.value: No purchaser help-article, AI-training dataset/agent configuration or customer-feedback export format established.

facts.label: WhatsApp data locations
facts.value: Privacy policy says WhatsApp messaging infrastructure uses Meta Cloud API, with data centers in North America/EU and no company-offered localization for that infrastructure.

facts.label: Other hosting/processors
facts.value: No complete Interakt-hosting region list, purchaser-selectable region, named AI-provider inventory or formal subprocessor/location schedule found.

facts.label: AI data/training policy
facts.value: No explicit no-foundation-model-training promise or feature-specific AI data-processing policy found.

facts.label: History and access
facts.value: Support page says old interactions retained for reference; terms end access immediately on Subscription End Date. No guaranteed chat-history retention duration/export grace period published.

facts.label: Deletion requests
facts.value: Privacy policy permits a Data Deletion Request with registered email/mobile and data/account details; verified requests delete/anonymize active-system information, subject to stated exceptions.

facts.label: Hosting and licence
facts.value: Proprietary centrally hosted SaaS; limited, non-exclusive, personal, revocable, non-transferable and non-licensable subscription access.

facts.label: Standard support hours
facts.value: No dependable plan-by-plan staffed-hours/response-time schedule for ordinary Starter/Growth/Advanced support found.
