facts.value: First-party direct-message channel into the shared Inbox.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: First-party private Facebook-message channel into Inbox.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Native two-way SMS through Inbox; sending and receiving billed by region-dependent segments.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native Phone support and Switch from phone to Messenger; usage charged separately.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Native conversational Slack/Slack Connect integration, all helpdesk plans; customer messages create Inbox conversations and replies sync back to the thread.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Official integration catalogue lists Discord for Fin community support; a current helpdesk plan gate, app publisher, and fee were not established.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Customer ticket creation forms can be sent from Inbox, including the Slack modal flow; automated delivery uses Workflows.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: Shared Inbox supports assignment, notes, mentions, snoozing, and macros/saved replies.

facts.label: Collision awareness
facts.value: Teammate presence displays who is viewing the same conversation/ticket, including table-row avatars when enabled.

facts.label: Rules and working hours
facts.value: Advanced/Expert add Workflows, multiple team inboxes, and round-robin; Expert adds team-specific office hours/reply times, SLAs, and workload management.

facts.label: Websites and workspaces
facts.value: A web installation uses a workspace/app ID. A consolidated published numerical cap on ordinary website domains or support email addresses was not found.

facts.label: Brands and help centers
facts.value: Expert includes multibrand Messenger and Help Centers; up to 100 Help Centers per workspace.

facts.label: Separation and multiworkspace billing
facts.value: Without a contract, each workspace bills independently; contracted Fin usage can be pooled across workspaces.

facts.label: Help center capability
facts.value: Public Help Center on all plans, with articles, search, default hosted address, configurable appearance, custom domain, and article reactions.

facts.label: Private and multilingual content
facts.value: Private Help Center and multilingual Help Center start at Advanced; multibrand starts at Expert.

facts.label: Article structure limits
facts.value: Up to 500 articles per collection; nested collections support 3 levels.

facts.label: Total article/storage allowance
facts.value: A total workspace-wide article or storage allowance was not established.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: Fin answers customers using approved knowledge and data, can execute Procedures, and escalates or requests help when configured.

facts.label: Agent assistance and analysis
facts.value: Copilot helps human agents find answers; Pro/Operator supports AI analysis and operations; CX Score rates customer experience using conversation content.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs and controls
facts.value: Public/internal articles, snippets, documents, public website sources, and supported external knowledge systems; enable Fin/Copilot and audience access per content source.

facts.label: Website limits and refresh
facts.value: Maximum 100 website sources. Public URLs only; usually weekly refresh, heavy sites every 14 days; unused sources can pause automatic syncing after 90 days.

facts.label: Documents and citations
facts.value: PDF/DOCX; maximum 100 documents/workspace and 100 MB/document. Text-based, not password-protected or multicolumn; replace by re-uploading.

facts.label: Source links by channel
facts.value: Public source links appear inline in Fin chat/email answers, but not social-channel answers including WhatsApp, Instagram, and Facebook; private snippets/documents have no public source link.

facts.label: Approval before answers
facts.value: Human in the Loop beta on chat/email can hold matching answers for teammate input/approval based on configured confidence thresholds; Procedures also have a dedicated human-input step.

facts.label: Human handoff and context
facts.value: Fin can hand the conversation to teammates on request, uncertainty, or escalation rules; teammates can take over with the existing thread and context.

facts.label: Out-of-hours fallback
facts.value: Deployment settings can collect information and set handover expectations; workflow destinations/office hours depend on configuration and plan.

facts.label: Customer actions and authentication
facts.value: Procedures and Data connectors can query/update connected systems. Connectors support API tokens, filtered data fields, audiences, and optional enforcement of workspace customer-authentication rules.

facts.label: Named action connections and approvals
facts.value: Connector templates cover Stripe, Shopify, Chargebee, Paddle, Recurly, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and Statuspage; Procedures can request human input at a defined step.

facts.label: First-party connections
facts.value: Intercom lists Shopify, Stripe, Slack, GitHub, WordPress, Salesforce, HubSpot, and others as its own apps.

facts.label: WooCommerce and billing systems
facts.value: Data connector templates offer WooCommerce, Chargebee, Paddle, Recurly, and BigCommerce via account API keys/access tokens.

facts.label: Linear, Discord, and automation depth
facts.value: Official catalogue names Linear and Discord, plus Zapier MCP; exact current publisher, helpdesk-plan gate, and complete recurring fees for these routes were not found.

facts.label: Developer access
facts.value: Public REST API, access-token/OAuth app routes, webhooks, web Messenger JavaScript and npm installation, and mobile SDKs.

facts.label: API limits and conflicting private-app scope
facts.value: Current API guide: private apps share 10,000 requests/minute/workspace; public apps 10,000/minute/app; aggregate 25,000/minute/workspace. Help FAQ instead says 10,000 per app generally.

facts.label: Webhook recovery
facts.value: Webhook notifications reference changed objects; delivery can be paused/suspended after repeated endpoint errors.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the vendor-hosted helpdesk offer researched.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Spanish.

facts.label: Customer Messenger languages
facts.value: Published locale list includes Arabic, Bengali, Chinese variants, English, French, German, Hindi, Japanese, Portuguese, Spanish, Ukrainian, and others.

facts.label: Fin and article languages
facts.value: Fin supports languages including English, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, Japanese, Chinese variants, Spanish, Urdu, and Uzbek, with regional variants and optional real-time fallback translation; multilingual Help Center starts at Advanced.

facts.label: Agent devices / maintenance
facts.value: Browser Inbox plus Intercom Conversations for iOS/Android. Agent mobile apps are in maintenance mode: no new features, only widespread severe issues considered.

facts.label: Customer platform needs
facts.value: Web JavaScript/npm Messenger and mobile libraries for iOS, Android, React Native, and Cordova; no WordPress/Shopify/Gmail host requirement.

facts.label: Support reporting
facts.value: Prebuilt reports on all plans; Advanced adds custom reports, Expert real-time dashboard; dataset CSV export available for supported metrics.

facts.label: AI and failed-answer review
facts.value: Fin content-gap recommendations analyze failed/escalated replies, expose the source conversations, and propose content fixes. CX Score provides AI-generated experience ratings; Pro meters analyzed conversations.

facts.label: Contacts export
facts.value: Users/leads/company data can be exported as CSV; emailed download link expires in 1 hour. Customer fields depend on chosen columns.

facts.label: Transcript downloads / bulk conflict
facts.value: Main export guide documents Inbox PDF/TXT transcripts and bulk operations of 200–300 conversations. Conversations FAQ says bulk transcript export is unavailable and describes TXT only.

facts.label: CSV reports and views
facts.value: Dataset export provides CSV metrics/attributes without message bodies. Saved Inbox View CSV is a point-in-time column snapshot, available on all plans with the required export permission.

facts.label: Cloud conversation content / attachments
facts.value: Cloud-export guide documents S3 or Google Cloud Storage JSON/JSONL with conversation parts and optional attachments; main guide also says S3 exports lack transcripts.

facts.label: Conversation API migration route
facts.value: Conversations API can list/retrieve conversation contents individually. Exported conversations cannot simply be imported into another Intercom workspace as history.

facts.label: Articles and feedback portability
facts.value: Articles API exports full article HTML, title, metadata, and localization by article ID; no article-export UI. A complete public-board/vote export is outside this product scope.

facts.label: Article feedback export
facts.value: Complete export format/method for article reactions and comments was not established.

facts.label: Hosting regions and eligibility
facts.value: Default US Northern Virginia; optional EU Dublin or AU Sydney. Regional hosting is available to new contracted Advanced/Expert workspaces via Sales, not Early Stage.

facts.label: Regional processing exceptions
facts.value: Regional storage does not keep every processing operation in-region. AU AI processing and some email services use the US; EU has documented administrative/support and optional-service exceptions.

facts.label: Third-party AI use
facts.value: External AI providers are contractually restricted from training/improving their services on Inputs/Outputs; legal guide describes zero retention after generating output, with stated service/safety processing.

facts.label: Intercom model training and opt-out
facts.value: Intercom fine-tunes its models on de-identified production conversations involving Fin, not human-only conversations. Opt-out via Workspace > Security > AI model training and fine-tuning, relationship manager, or legal@intercom.io; processed within 30 days.

facts.label: Previously trained data after opt-out
facts.value: Security page says opt-out data deleted within 30 days; detailed training guide promises request processing within 30 days and no further training-data creation, without a precise account of existing trained-model removal.

facts.label: Active account history
facts.value: Terms say Intercom is not an archiving service and will not intentionally delete customer data before subscription termination; no single numeric lifetime history guarantee was found.

facts.label: Cancellation and data-access window
facts.value: Service use ends on termination; terms give no customer-data access after 30 days and permit deletion after termination.

facts.label: Processor deletion and backups
facts.value: DPA: return/delete on customer election; written deletion request completed as practicable within 30 days. Without request, automatic deletion within 180 days of termination/expiry; backups within 14 days of live-system deletion.

facts.label: Contact deletion effect
facts.value: Deleting a contact removes associated conversations; archiving is reversible. FAQ says accidental permanent-deletion recovery requires contacting support within 7 days.

facts.label: Identity and company rebrand
facts.value: Intercom remains an active vendor-hosted customer service product with Messenger, Inbox, tickets and help center. Its company announced a name change to Fin on 2026-05-12; Salesforce completed its acquisition of Fin, formerly Intercom, on 2026-09-10.

facts.label: Lifecycle / deprecated export
facts.value: The old conversation data export is deprecated; use Reports > Dataset export.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Salesforce owns Fin, formerly Intercom, after completing the acquisition on 2026-09-10. Intercom remains the customer-service product brand. Current terms still name Intercom, Inc., Delaware, United States for US/Brazil shipping addresses and Intercom R&D Unlimited Company, Ireland for other addresses.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Terms impose export-control and sanctions restrictions; a complete product-specific list of eligible or blocked countries was not found.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted subscription service; terms grant limited service-use rights.

facts.label: Self-hosted edition
facts.value: No customer-operated Intercom server edition or server licence found.

facts.label: Vendor help channels
facts.value: Messenger and team@intercom.io email; Fin support 24/7 with the option to request a human; public docs and community.

facts.label: Paid support
facts.value: Premier Support and Premier Support Rapid Response are paid add-ons with a 24/7 Premier team; public price and numeric response SLA not established.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-09; Intercom announced the company name change to Fin on 2026-05-12 while retaining Intercom as the customer-service product brand; Salesforce completed the acquisition on 2026-09-10. No app-wide shutdown or sunset notice found.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: No separate ongoing free production tier to tabulate; evaluation restrictions are recorded under F08.

facts.label: Hosted trial
facts.value: 21 days; no credit card required. Vendor trial article describes hosted trial as unrestricted except for 400 users.

facts.label: Self-hosted evaluation restrictions
facts.value: No time expiry; trial disables ticket/KB search, technician-only comments, ticket attachments, modern-auth Office 365 connection, some integrations, custom email templates, theme changes, due dates, time tracking, escalation and scheduling.

facts.label: Trial conversion and expiry data
facts.value: Paying with the trial account's email preserves the existing hosted helpdesk/data. Trial data remains available for three months after expiry, then is permanently deleted including backups.

facts.label: Hosted Freelancer

facts.label: Hosted Startup

facts.label: Hosted Company
facts.value: $129 per month, monthly billing; $108.25 per month displayed for annual billing. Includes 7 agents, Startup features, downloadable backup and hide powered by Jitbit.

facts.label: Hosted Enterprise
facts.value: $249 per month, monthly billing; $208.25 per month displayed for annual billing. Includes 9 agents, Company features, expedited support and HIPAA/BAA offer; extra agents $29 each on the monthly display.

facts.label: Hosted currency, annual cash and taxes
facts.value: Hosted pages display $ without an express ISO currency in the checked pricing/terms. Exact annual invoice totals and universal tax-inclusive/exclusive treatment were not established.

facts.label: Self-hosted 10 agents
facts.value: USD 2,490 one-time perpetual base licence; 12 months of updates/support included.

facts.label: Self-hosted 25 agents
facts.value: USD 4,490 one-time perpetual base licence; 12 months of updates/support; one production installation.

facts.label: Self-hosted 50 agents
facts.value: USD 6,990 one-time perpetual base licence; 12 months of updates/support; one production installation.

facts.label: Self-hosted 100 agents
facts.value: USD 10,990 one-time perpetual base licence; 12 months of updates/support; one production installation.

facts.label: Self-hosted Unlimited
facts.value: USD 16,990 one-time perpetual base licence; unlimited agents and production installations within the same company; 12 months of updates/support.

facts.label: Billing unit and roles
facts.value: Hosted: fixed subscription tier with included working agents, then published Enterprise extra-agent charge. Self-hosted: agent-capacity perpetual licence; end users and tickets explicitly unlimited there.

facts.label: Hosted usage ceilings beyond storage
facts.value: Every hosted tier explicitly has unlimited storage. A numerical hosted ticket/conversation, end-user or mailbox cap and a separate free-viewer allowance were not established in the checked pages.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Hosted minimum is Freelancer, 1 agent, $29 paid monthly; Startup is the first tier covering 3 working agents. Self-hosted minimum is 10 agents at USD 2,490. SaaS FAQ says no setup fee.

facts.label: Hosted AI allowance and charge
facts.value: Startup, Company and Enterprise include unlimited AI credits, with no per-resolution or per-session fee in the vendor's own explanation. Freelancer does not include AI credits.

facts.label: Self-hosted core and advanced AI
facts.value: Core drafts, summaries, triage and prompts can use the operator's OpenAI/Azure OpenAI/AWS Bedrock key. Advanced semantic KB search/external-doc indexing add-on costs $999 one-time with 12 months of updates; requires Helpdesk 11.22+.

facts.label: Hosted AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Startup $69 monthly + $0 separately published included-AI usage charge = $69 for either 100 or 500 AI replies, assuming those replies use the included models/allowance.

facts.label: Self-hosted AI example boundary
facts.value: Exact total for 100/500 generated answers cannot be calculated from a reply count alone: model, prompt/context size, tool calls and operator hosting determine extra cost.

facts.label: Hosted extras and cancellation
facts.value: Enterprise extra agents: $29 each on monthly display. Lower-tier downloadable-backup add-on exists with no public amount. Cancel anytime; service continues to end of paid period, without refund for remaining time.

facts.label: Self-hosted renewals
facts.value: Published rule: renewal costs 50% of current plan price before expiry or within 60 days afterward; 80% later. October notice's numeric renewal table does not equal these percentages.

facts.label: Third-party charges and stop rules
facts.value: External hosting, SQL licensing where needed, mail, paid integrations and model-provider usage can add costs. No numeric AI auto-recharge, credit expiry or hosted ticket-overage schedule found.

facts.label: Hosted branding removal / portal
facts.value: Company and Enterprise explicitly include hide powered by Jitbit. All hosted tiers list custom domain; settings support own logo, theme and favicon.

facts.label: Widget, email and self-hosted branding
facts.value: Exact coverage of attribution removal in chat widget and outgoing email, a paid self-hosted removal entitlement, and hosted-trial exceptions not clearly established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Public self-service hosted trial and purchase route; one-person Freelancer subscription. Public self-hosted evaluation download requires an email address; paid on-premises orders start at 10 agents.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: email-first support ticketing system for external customer support or internal IT, with live chat, knowledge base, asset tracking and an ideas forum.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native two-way ticket email; SaaS includes support@company-name.jitbit.com. Own address can forward to it, or configured Office 365 OAuth, IMAP/POP3 and other documented mailbox routes can be used.

facts.label: Website and in-app web chat
facts.value: Native embedded live-chat widget in both SaaS and self-hosted editions; real-time messages become part of the ticket workflow.

facts.label: Ticket forms and portal
facts.value: Native customer portal/new-ticket form, plus embeddable popup support form. Knowledge-base suggestions can be shown before ticket submission.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Built-in two-way integration with Meta WhatsApp Cloud API: inbound messages become tickets and replies return to ticket creator on WhatsApp.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Two-way bot: end users create/track tickets and receive/reply to messages; technicians can take, answer and close from channel cards/threads.

facts.label: Microsoft Teams
facts.value: Two-way bot for end-user tickets, personal-chat replies and actionable technician cards; one Microsoft 365 tenant per helpdesk connection.

facts.label: Instagram and Messenger
facts.value: Native inbound Instagram or Facebook Messenger channel and plan/fee details not established.

facts.label: SMS, voice and Discord
facts.value: Native two-way SMS, voice/call handling and Discord customer-channel offers were not established.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: Assign/take tickets, categories/priorities, subscribers and mentions; canned replies/KB insertion; real-time warning when another agent views or replies; category/company permissions.

facts.label: Private notes, rules and working hours
facts.value: API supports technician-only comments; rules can assign/reply/escalate; working hours, holidays and auto-close/reopen settings are configurable.

facts.label: Multiple emails, products and brands
facts.value: Multiple incoming mailboxes and category-address routing are documented; hosted account has a helpdesk URL/custom domain. Numeric mailbox/site/widget limits and independent multi-brand portal allowances not established.

facts.label: Self-hosted installation allowance
facts.value: 10/25/50/100-agent licences: one production installation. Unlimited tier: any number of installations within the same company.

facts.label: Help center capabilities
facts.value: Native searchable KB with categories/tags, attachments, article creation/update dates, HTML/WYSIWYG or Markdown editing and ticket-to-article publishing. Can be public, registered-only or technician-only.

facts.label: Article limits, translations and article feedback
facts.value: Total article allowance, first-class translated article variants/language routing and per-article customer helpfulness voting not established.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Agent drafting, thread summaries, draft improvement, KB article generation, KB/search assistance, automatic sentiment/category/priority triage, AI ticket replies and customer chat autoresponses.

facts.label: AI knowledge and citations
facts.value: Ticket conversation, KB articles, canned responses, indexed external web documentation and approved past-ticket search can ground replies. KB integration instructs AI to reference relevant articles.

facts.label: External indexing and refresh
facts.value: General assistant guide says website indexing is SaaS-only; current self-hosted paid AI module explicitly supports external-doc indexing. General guide permits reindexing after 7 days.

facts.label: Human fallback and transcript
facts.value: Chat AI pauses when visitor asks for a human; live human chat runs in the helpdesk ticket. Leaving the browser turns it into a normal email ticket for continued follow-up.

facts.label: Custom actions and controls
facts.value: AI can call configured external HTTP tools or MCP servers for lookups/actions. HTTP tool definitions include JSON schema/required parameters and headers; technician-only tool restriction is documented in release notes.

facts.label: Customer verification and write approval
facts.value: A universal end-customer verification procedure and compulsory per-write/refund approval were not established for custom AI tools.

facts.label: Developer and automation connections
facts.value: Native GitHub/Bitbucket/GitLab/Jira issue creation from tickets; Slack/Teams bots; Google Drive/OneDrive/Dropbox file attachment; Zapier connector and custom user lookup.

facts.label: Commerce/billing subset
facts.value: Maintained native Shopify, WooCommerce, Stripe or Linear connector and its gates were not established in checked directory/admin documentation.

facts.label: REST API
facts.value: Public JSON-oriented API for SaaS and self-hosted versions at helpdesk /api; ticket/user/comment/KB/attachment methods; user permissions apply. Most calls limited to 90/minute, Search and UserByEmail 60/minute.

facts.label: Webhooks and widget controls
facts.value: Automation can send HTTP requests with method, URL, body and headers using ticket variables. Web widgets expose hdWidget configuration/toggleWidget and a separate popup-form script.

facts.label: MCP developer route
facts.value: Built-in Streamable HTTP MCP endpoint for external assistants; local jitbit-helpdesk-mcp npm option. Supports ticket/KB reading, searching, ticket creation and replies/internal notes.

facts.label: Self-hosted requirements
facts.value: Current guide: .NET 10; Windows Server 2016+ with IIS/hosting bundle, Linux with ASP.NET Core runtime/reverse proxy, Docker Compose, or single-instance Azure App Service. SQL Server 2016 SP1+ required.

facts.label: Capacity and operator work
facts.value: Guide gives 8 GB RAM; recommends 16 GB for combined application/database and four CPU cores. Operator supplies server/network/SQL setup, secure configuration, storage, backups and software upgrades.

facts.label: Advanced AI deployment
facts.value: Optional $999 module: Docker 20.10+, Helpdesk 11.22+, about 4 GB additional free RAM; AI service plus Qdrant vector database, persistent index/model volumes.

facts.label: Interface languages
facts.value: Product home says 25 languages, features page 25+, and FAQ says 30; includes English, German, French, Spanish, Arabic, Hindi and other named locales.

facts.label: AI, widget and article language scope
facts.value: Assistant is instructed to respond in the conversation's language and preserve language when polishing drafts. Exact per-widget locale list and help-article translation workflow not established.

facts.label: Devices and platform needs
facts.value: Browser-based agent/customer UI plus native iOS/Android agent apps. Hosted app does not require a host CMS/store; self-hosted server follows .NET/SQL requirements.

facts.label: Ticket and response reports
facts.value: Summary, ticket volume, response/resolution speed, technician/user/company statistics, overdue tickets, SLA/custom reports and real-time dashboard; reporting exports include CSV/Excel routes.

facts.label: Response-time definition
facts.value: Operational report docs: creation to start/in-process date. Reporting marketing page: creation to first agent reply.

facts.label: Satisfaction and KB analytics
facts.value: Email Good/OK/Bad survey with optional comment; link valid 10 days while ticket remains closed; satisfaction CSV. KB report shows article views, searches and result counts.

facts.label: Customers, tickets and articles CSV
facts.value: Admin import/export offers user CSV; tickets with subject/body/owner/status/dates/time/tags and other fields; KB with article ID, subject, body, category and tags.

facts.label: Full replies and attachments
facts.value: API comments method returns reply body, author, timestamp and technician-only flag. Attachment list returns metadata/URLs; individual attachment method downloads a file.

facts.label: Full hosted backups
facts.value: Company/Enterprise include downloadable database backup; lower tiers have an add-on of unpublished price. Expired-account policy also offers complete database access through support during the three-month window.

facts.label: Feedback and reporting exports
facts.value: Customer satisfaction CSV includes ticket ID/subject/submitter/rating/comment. Bulk Ideas forum ideas/votes/comments export and a complete feedback API were not established.

facts.label: Hosted region and backups
facts.value: Primary SaaS hosting: AWS North Virginia, United States. AI search index: Hetzner Helsinki, Finland. Backup policy uses Amazon S3 separate from application servers.

facts.label: AI providers and training
facts.value: Privacy policy says customer data is not used for AI training/data mining. OpenAI processes data when AI is used; FAQ describes no-storage/no-training under its OpenAI DPA and private provider options.

facts.label: Named subprocessors and connected services
facts.value: Policy names AWS, OpenAI, Hetzner, Cloudflare, PostHog and FastSpring; Google Analytics for website use and GitHub for internal code/issues without customer data.

facts.label: Subscription/trial retention and data requests
facts.value: Inactive/expired hosted accounts retained three months, then data deleted including backups. Privacy access/export/correct/delete requests handled through support, published response period 30 days.

facts.label: Ticket deletion and configurable cleanup
facts.value: Ticket delete moves item to bin, then permanent deletion after 15 days. Admin settings allow auto-close/auto-delete after configured days and reopen limits; auto-delete job handles 500 tickets per run.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Jitbit Helpdesk; active product, available as SaaS and on-premises software.

facts.label: October 2026 self-hosted licence change
facts.value: On October 5, 2026, Jitbit changed self-hosted plan tiers and renewal terms and stopped selling new source-code licences. Existing helpdesk licences remain perpetual; SaaS is unaffected.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Vendor identifies itself as Jitbit Software; founded in 2005; public business address in Poole, Dorset, United Kingdom; remote team.

facts.label: Exact legal entity and market restrictions
facts.value: Registered legal suffix/registration number and a complete country eligibility or regional-offer list not established. Terms require users to be at least 16.

facts.label: Editions and commercial licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted SaaS subscription and self-hosted perpetual commercial licence. Self-hosted purchase includes 12 months of updates and support; the software keeps working after that period.

facts.label: Exact self-hosted licence text
facts.value: A complete current self-hosted EULA or public source licence identifier was not located.

facts.label: Source-code availability
facts.value: October 5 change notice: source-code sales discontinued; existing source-code access lasts until updates expire, then renewal is Unlimited without source. Live purchase page still says contact us; FAQ says source can be bought and renewed.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public email/support portal, documentation and vendor phone contact; hosted Enterprise explicitly adds expedited support. On-premises licence includes 12 months support/updates.

facts.label: Support hours and response promise
facts.value: Exact staffed support hours, guaranteed response time by support tier and a separate extended-support tariff not established.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Latest listed release: 11.26, October 29, 2026; prior 11.25, October 6, follows October 5 licensing change. Our proposed next review: 2026-12-04.

facts.label: Free limits

facts.label: Trial length and card

facts.label: Trial end and recovery
facts.value: Without payment details, trial suspends and access ends. Contact support within 30 days of suspension for up to 2 days of reactivation to add billing; otherwise account terminates.

facts.label: Starter price
facts.value: Offer: USD 15/agent/month monthly or USD 11/agent/month equivalent paid annually. Regular: USD 19 monthly or USD 15 annual equivalent. Maximum 5 human agents.

facts.label: Team price
facts.value: Offer: USD 26/agent/month monthly or USD 22 annual equivalent. Regular: USD 35 monthly or USD 29 annual equivalent. Maximum 15 human agents.

facts.label: Business price
facts.value: Offer: USD 44/agent/month monthly or USD 38 annual equivalent. Regular: USD 59 monthly or USD 49 annual equivalent. Any team size.

facts.label: Enterprise price
facts.value: Flat USD 3,999/month monthly or USD 3,199/month equivalent paid annually; includes 80 human agents. Extra agents USD 49/month monthly or USD 39/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: Promotion conditions
facts.value: Start a trial by November 22, 2026; select a plan before the 30-day trial ends. Offer price stays while that plan is kept, including added agents.

facts.label: Currency, tax and cadence
facts.value: Prices displayed in USD, exclude VAT; EU customers invoiced in EUR. Monthly or annual advance payment; annual billing covers 12 months.

facts.label: Base billing unit
facts.value: Human agent with an individual login. Starter/Team/Business charge per agent; Enterprise includes 80 then charges extra agents.

facts.label: AI counting unit
facts.value: AI-agent allowance counts configured workers, not conversations. One configured agent reused on three websites counts once. Provider usage is charged separately.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and setup
facts.value: One Starter agent is selectable; monthly or annual commitment. No setup fee. Email and website chat need no separately priced LiveAgent add-on on Starter.

facts.label: AI charges and providers
facts.value: LiveAgent AI fee USD 0; no LiveAgent charge per answer, conversation or resolution and no token markup. Connect own OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini or FlowHunt account; provider bills separately.

facts.label: AI-agent allowances
facts.value: Starter 1; Team 5; Business 50; Enterprise unlimited configured AI agents.

facts.label: FlowHunt requirement conflict
facts.value: Current pricing says FlowHunt is optional and names four providers. Chatbot setup and overview still say FlowHunt is required.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: Exact base-plus-100/500 AI conversation or resolution totals cannot be calculated from a guaranteed unit rate. LiveAgent component is known; provider spend depends on model and workload.

facts.label: Resource limits and fair use
facts.value: At plan limits, adding items requires removing something or upgrading. Existing items continue working; downgrading while over limit can deactivate excess items. “Unlimited” remains subject to fair use.

facts.label: Extras and outside bills
facts.value: Additional knowledge base USD 19/month on Starter, Team or Business. Phone numbers/minutes billed by phone provider; AI usage billed by AI provider. WhatsApp needs a connected business provider.

facts.label: Cancellation and billing changes
facts.value: Stop renewal through My Account/Stop Account or owner email to support@qualityunit.com; email cancellation is processed within one business day. Access remains until paid period ends.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: Business and Enterprise remove LiveAgent branding from chat buttons/windows, portals/knowledge bases, contact and feedback forms, call buttons/windows and email templates.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Starter, Team and Business offer self-service trials; Enterprise directs buyers to sales. One working person can select one agent.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: help desk with shared ticket inbox, website chat, self-service content, optional voice/social channels and AI. Overlaps knowledge bases, customer messaging and feedback boards.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email ticketing on all current paid plans; incoming/outgoing connected email accounts 3/10/150/unlimited for Starter/Team/Business/Enterprise.

facts.label: Website and web-app chat
facts.value: Native JavaScript chat widget on all paid plans. Chat-button limits 2/5/50/unlimited.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Native embedded contact forms and portal ticket submission; forms 3/10/50/unlimited by plan.

facts.label: Social messaging
facts.value: Facebook/Messenger, Instagram, X, Viber and Telegram included from Team. Telegram bots: Team 5, Business 20, Enterprise unlimited.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Built-in ticketing connection through Twilio or 360dialog; Team 5 numbers, Business 20, Enterprise unlimited.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: No native SMS integration, according to official FAQ; a third-party service such as ClickSend plus custom/API work can provide it.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native call center from Team; connects an outside phone provider.

facts.label: Slack and Discord
facts.value: Slack native plugin sends ticket/status notifications; Zapier example creates tickets from Slack messages. Official FAQ says no Discord integration.

facts.label: Inbox teamwork
facts.value: Assignment/department routing, collision detection, canned responses, predefined answers and private notes. Private notes remain with transferred tickets.

facts.label: Automation and working hours
facts.value: Event rules 50/150/500/unlimited. Time rules absent on Starter, then 30/100/unlimited. SLA rules/levels absent on Starter, then 5/5, 50/20, unlimited.

facts.label: Sites, addresses and separation
facts.value: Email accounts 3/10/150/unlimited; chat buttons 2/5/50/unlimited; departments 10/20/150/unlimited. Separate buttons can route to separate departments.

facts.label: Customer portals / knowledge bases
facts.value: Included sites: Starter 1, Team 1, Business 2, Enterprise 10. Extra site USD 19/month on the first three plans.

facts.label: Help center and search
facts.value: Native public/internal articles and categories, forums, suggestions, search and portal ticket history. Internal sections are agent-only.

facts.label: Custom domain
facts.value: Hosted tenant defaults to mycompany.ladesk.com; custom support domain uses CNAME to that tenant. Managed Let's Encrypt or own SSL/TLS certificate.

facts.label: Article limits, translation and feedback
facts.value: Numeric article/storage limits, automatic article translation and a defined article-helpfulness voting scheme were not established.

facts.label: Customer-facing AI role
facts.value: AI chatbot answers in the website chat before or alongside human support. Configurable instructions and connected knowledge/tools.

facts.label: Agent and background AI roles
facts.value: Answer assistant drafts/improves replies; human clicks Send. Ticket summaries, call transcripts and rule-triggered AI agents are also documented.

facts.label: Answer-assistant knowledge and control
facts.value: Drafts use the conversation, ticket context and native knowledge-base articles. Tone/style instructions are configurable; agent reviews and sends.

facts.label: FlowHunt chatbot sources
facts.value: Documented FlowHunt route supports scheduled website/LiveAgent KB checks, preset Q&A and uploaded documents/media. Default uses all workspace sources unless restricted.

facts.label: Knowledge limits and citations
facts.value: Provider-independent byte/page/token caps, exact refresh intervals, customer-visible source citations and approval-before-indexing controls not established.

facts.label: Human handoff and history
facts.value: Customer can request a person; bot/tool or support agent can initiate transfer/takeover. Conversation continues in the same chat/ticket with bot history visible to both sides.

facts.label: No human online
facts.value: Offline scenario can show chatbot; customer can stop it and leave an offline message when no department agent is available. Different bots can serve online/offline scenarios.

facts.label: Actions and permissions
facts.value: AI agents use authenticated built-in MCP tools for ticket actions; selected tools limit what a configured agent may do. Documented examples include ticket updates and KB article creation.

facts.label: Sensitive action safeguards
facts.value: A universal customer identity-check procedure, required approval before refunds/account changes and a guaranteed autonomous refund workflow were not established.

facts.label: Ecommerce and automation
facts.value: Shopify and WooCommerce native order-context plugins; Zapier workflows documented. Slack plugin handles notifications and Zapier can create tickets from Slack events.

facts.label: Stripe and payment actions
facts.value: ChargeDesk integration connects Stripe and other gateways; lists viewing payments, refunds, subscription changes and invoices.

facts.label: Issue trackers
facts.value: Supported native Linear/GitHub connections were not established.

facts.label: API, widget access and limits
facts.value: REST API v3, older API v1, JavaScript widget API and public API documentation. API keys 1/5/10/unlimited by plan; documented cloud rate limit 180 requests/minute/key.

facts.label: Webhooks and external AI tools
facts.value: Automation rules can send an HTTP request to a chosen URL. External MCP connection for tools such as Claude/ChatGPT is Business/Enterprise; built-in AI-agent tools are available on all plans.

facts.label: Legacy self-host runtime
facts.value: Archived requirements: PHP 8.2 for v5.42 with named extensions, MariaDB 10.2+ (10.4 recommended), PHP-capable web server, HTTPS and cron. Elasticsearch optional; wkhtmltopdf needed for PDF export.

facts.label: Legacy backups and maintenance
facts.value: Operator backs up application files/database and accounts directory, replaces release files and runs update wizard. Final supported standalone release is 5.42.6.18; no continuing support or patches.

facts.label: Agent, portal and widget languages
facts.value: Vendor says 43 interface languages. Agents choose active language; portal follows browser preference/default, with documented URL-switching option. Chat button language is configurable.

facts.label: AI reply language
facts.value: Answer assistant can generate in the customer's language and keep the draft language when improving text; company gives a Slovak-from-English-articles example.

facts.label: Agent devices and host needs
facts.value: Browser-based agent panel; native iOS and Android apps, with separate Livephone apps for calls. No required Gmail, Shopify or WordPress platform for the core product. No official React library; plain widget JavaScript can be embedded in React.

facts.label: Customer mobile libraries
facts.value: Dedicated customer iOS/Android chat SDKs were not established.

facts.label: Reporting and satisfaction
facts.value: Team and higher: agent, department, channel, SLA compliance, time and tag reports, plus CSAT surveys. Analytics can be exported as CSV.

facts.label: AI failure review
facts.value: Chatbot conversations are visible in tickets/Chats overview, but a defined failure-rate report or automatic failed-answer quality score was not established.

facts.label: Customers and ticket text
facts.value: Contact CSV export and permission-controlled UI exports. API v3 can retrieve tickets and their messages; official CSV example uses pagination and filters.

facts.label: Attachments and full-service exit
facts.value: Paying customers leaving can request database SQL plus separate S3 files/folders through owner-authorized support. Individual tickets also export to HTML/PDF; HTML excludes inline images.

facts.label: Articles and suggestions
facts.value: Older API v1 reference documents retrieving KB entries and suggestion categories; it also exposes file retrieval.

facts.label: Complete feedback/content portability
facts.value: A current packaged article/board export with vote identities, comments, subscribers and attachments together was not established.

facts.label: Cloud hosting and region choice
facts.value: AWS regions selected at signup: EU Germany/Ireland; US Northern Virginia/Northern California; Asia-Pacific Singapore. Legacy UK London remains, but no new UK accounts.

facts.label: Subprocessors and AI routing
facts.value: Public list includes AWS, Quality Unit LLC, Quality Unit Ukraine, Twilio and Makara Partner. Customer-connected AI providers are under customers' separate agreements and omitted from that subprocessor list.

facts.label: Answer-assistant data and training
facts.value: Sends the current ticket and relevant help articles when an agent requests a reply. LiveAgent says it does not store drafts and deletes instructions once the draft is written. Provider may retain the conversation; its terms decide model-training use.

facts.label: Active history and deletion
facts.value: All current plans publish unlimited ticket history. Privacy policy says terminated accounts are deleted from active cloud within 30 days, followed by another 30 days of cold database backup.

facts.label: Inactivity and suspension conflict
facts.value: Terms: warning after 4 weeks inactive, deletion after 8 weeks. Help article: paid accounts have no inactivity suspension; suspended paid accounts terminate after 120 days.

facts.label: DPA return/deletion request
facts.value: Public EU DPA template says return or irreversible deletion within 5 business days of written request after the relevant service/processing ends, subject to legally required storage.

facts.label: Identity and state
facts.value: LiveAgent; active customer-support platform. AI agents, chatbot, answer assistant and customer portal are features of this app.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Quality Unit, s.r.o.; Bratislava, Slovakia. Quality Unit LLC in the US and Quality Unit Ukraine are related operating entities.

facts.label: Buying and calling markets
facts.value: A complete country eligibility list and provider-specific phone-number restrictions were not established.

facts.label: Cloud edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary service, embedded widgets and customer portal; limited contractual use rights, not an open-source grant.

facts.label: Legacy self-hosted edition
facts.value: Proprietary standalone edition remains usable by existing valid licence holders. New standalone licences stopped June 1, 2020; technical support ended December 31, 2024.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Email, chat, calls, WhatsApp and public docs. Current pricing lists staffed chat/calls/WhatsApp Monday–Friday 07:00–23:00 Central European time, with AI/urgent coverage outside that schedule.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. Current offer ends November 22, 2026; subprocessor list updated October 29, 2026. Cloud active; standalone EOL.

facts.label: Discord customer channel
facts.value: A supported customer Discord inbox channel was not established.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: Automatic/manual chat handling, transfers to agents/groups, internal notes, canned replies, supervision, and customer typing preview are documented.

facts.value: Human chat transfers stay in the agent workspace; asynchronous mode retains widget history and allows email replies. Offline visitor messages can wait in Chats until agents return.

facts.label: ChatBot handoff
facts.value: Connected ChatBot can transfer chats to agents, agents can transfer back, and bot conversations are archived in both services.

facts.label: Order context and payment actions
facts.value: Shopify guide documents human access to carts/order history. Stripe Marketplace app displays current charges/subscriptions and sends one-time or recurring Stripe Checkout payment messages; displayed price $2.50/agent/month.

facts.label: Action verification boundary
facts.value: A legacy AI refund action, built-in customer verification before such an action, and human approval controls were not established.

facts.label: Shopify and WooCommerce
facts.value: LiveChat installation guide includes both; Shopify's dedicated guide documents cart/order context and sales tracking. Requires the corresponding store/platform account.

facts.label: Stripe
facts.value: Separately priced Marketplace app by LiveChat Integrations, with payment/subscription context and Stripe Checkout messages.

facts.label: Automation, Slack, and GitHub
facts.value: Zapier connector can store transcripts/create contacts. Official recipes send Slack chat/queue notifications and create a GitHub issue when a chat receives a Bug tag.

facts.label: Linear and Discord connections
facts.value: A current named LiveChat Linear integration or customer Discord integration was not established in the checked official index and plan/channel pages.

facts.label: API and webhooks
facts.value: Public Agent Chat API v3.6 documents chat/archive/customer operations with permissions/scopes. Webhooks include new chats/events, transfers, and agent/group updates.

facts.label: Widget and customer libraries
facts.value: Chat Widget JS API v5.0 uses LiveChatWidget; Customer SDK supports custom customer-side chat; custom identity-provider integration is documented.

facts.label: Numeric request limit
facts.value: Agent API reference documents throttling and Too many requests errors, but no single numerical rate limit was found in the checked overview/reference.

facts.label: Running the full service yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the hosted LiveChat edition researched.

facts.label: Customer widget languages
facts.value: Official guide lists 48 translations; language can be set per group/site. Campaign text is not automatically translated with the widget language.

facts.label: Agent interface and article locales
facts.value: A complete current legacy agent-interface language list and an included translated KnowledgeBase article allowance were not established.

facts.label: AI language limits
facts.value: Chat summary uses the original chat language; Autocomplete only works when the widget language is English and is unavailable on mobile.

facts.label: Agent devices and current app names
facts.value: Handbook lists web, desktop, iPhone/iPad, Android, and Huawei devices. Current app page says mobile is now named Text – Live Chat for Business while existing accounts/conversations stay in the app.

facts.label: Customer installation needs
facts.value: Add the legacy widget snippet before the website closing body tag, or use a documented CMS/store integration. Customer widget requires no visitor download; no mandatory WordPress/Shopify host is required for generic HTML installation.

facts.label: Reports and plan scope
facts.value: Team has basic reports; Business adds advanced/on-demand reporting, staffing prediction, and agent performance. Reports cover chat volume, response times, queue activity, availability, and satisfaction.

facts.label: Surveys and satisfaction exports
facts.value: Pre/post-chat surveys can collect contact details, department selection, ratings, and comments. Reports export is Team+; raw-data exports and scheduling are Business/Enterprise.

facts.label: AI question analysis
facts.value: Insights groups common customer questions; Team/Business/Enterprise. It needs archived chats from the preceding week and does not analyze history from before activation.

facts.label: Individual conversation text
facts.value: Archives can email a chat transcript. API get_thread_transcript returns a JSON response with a plain-text transcript, including messages, rich messages, file references, and pre/post-chat forms.

facts.label: Bulk chats and report export
facts.value: list_archives returns complete chat/thread objects with events, subject to scope/pagination. Team+ can export report CSV; Business/Enterprise can export raw chat data and schedule exports.

facts.label: Customer data
facts.value: get_customer returns a known customer's ID, available name/email, and other customer fields; chat/archive objects also identify participants.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: Chat event schema includes file name, URL, content type, size, and optional image/thumbnail information.

facts.label: Feedback and help content
facts.value: Report exports include chat rating/survey information; transcript API includes pre/post-chat forms. Public KnowledgeBase articles are managed in the separate KnowledgeBase app.

facts.label: Missing complete export details
facts.value: A single full contacts CSV, attachment-binary ZIP, article export bundled with LiveChat, and export of the processed AI knowledge corpus were not found.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: LiveChat publishes US and EEA/EU storage regions and a choice of region; European-location signup instructions are public. Other Text services follow their own hosting policies.

facts.label: AI suppliers and supplier training
facts.value: LiveChat AI policy names authorized AI partners including OpenAI, describes processing selected messages/queries/chat content/metadata, and says queries are not used to train or improve those suppliers' models.

facts.label: Text's own AI improvement
facts.value: The same policy says customer data is used to improve Text's AI features, with separation from other customers.

facts.label: Current full subprocessor list
facts.value: Public help link redirects to https://trust.text.com/subprocessors, but the destination exposed only a Trust Center shell and no readable processor list.

facts.label: Chat-history access
facts.value: Starter: 60 days. Team/Business/Enterprise: unlimited chat history in the plan table.

facts.label: Conversation deletion
facts.value: Documented procedure: tag conversations to delete, contact support from the registered address, and return the email verification code. Vendor confirms deletion afterward, subject to lawful exceptions.

facts.label: Export assistance and closure
facts.value: DPA says export/access before cancellation; if tools are insufficient, reasonable assistance within 30 days of a verified written request, if technically possible and still stored. Nonstandard work can incur advance-notified fees.

facts.label: Purge and inactivity timing
facts.value: Fixed legacy trial-expiry deletion days, inactivity shutdown timing, Starter physical purge time, and a universal backup-erasure deadline were not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: LiveChat, continuing hosted chat product; current subscriptions, prices, and login remain available to existing customers.

facts.label: Text relationship
facts.value: Text is a separate product from the team behind LiveChat, HelpDesk, and ChatBot. Text plans and features are not included merely by holding a LiveChat subscription.

facts.label: Ticket-system sunset
facts.value: Native LiveChat Tickets retired by plan: Starter January 6, 2025; Team/Business January 15, 2025; Enterprise/custom January 31, 2025. New-account availability had ended June 1, 2023.

facts.label: Legal owner and country
facts.value: Text, Inc., United States; terms give 101 Arch Street, Boston, Massachusetts. Services are for business/professional use.

facts.label: Market restrictions
facts.value: Terms prohibit use from, or on behalf of, countries/regions subject to US sanctions and restricted parties; examples include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia, and Belarus.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription, embedded customer widget, and agent clients. Terms grant service access rather than a licence to operate the full server.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Standard LiveChat cards advertise 24/7/365 support; handbook identifies support chat in the agent app and website. Enterprise adds product-expert/onboarding/engineer assistance and negotiated SLAs.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle review
facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026. Handbook updated October 7, 2026; accessibility guide July 27, 2026. Current pricing distinguishes Text and continuing LiveChat. Our proposed next review: December 5, 2026.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, SMS, WhatsApp, social

agents.math: 1 user at $18 a month, with one shared email account and 100 conversations.
3 users at $18 a month each, with one shared email account and 100 conversations.

apps.news: No qualifying sale, shutdown, rebrand, product retirement, regulatory action, licence change, or customer-data breach found.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: No ongoing free plan. New first organizations receive a temporary 30-day trial.

facts.label: Free limits
facts.value: Not applicable to an ongoing free plan; temporary trial limits are recorded under F08.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Thirty days of Productive features for the first organization; no card required. Up to 25 users, 10 shared accounts, 2 personal accounts per user and the latest 30 days of history.

facts.label: After the trial
facts.value: Access pauses until the owner selects a paid plan. Sending, commenting and adding accounts stop; history is hidden and push notifications stop. No automatic charge without subscribing.

facts.label: Starter
facts.value: USD 18/user/month paid monthly; USD 14/user/month with yearly billing. Up to 5 users.

facts.label: Productive
facts.value: USD 30/user/month paid monthly; USD 24/user/month with yearly billing. Up to 50 users.

facts.label: Business
facts.value: USD 45/user/month paid monthly; USD 36/user/month with yearly billing. Unlimited users.

facts.label: Invoice cadence and taxes
facts.value: Yearly plans are paid for 12 months in advance. Monthly and yearly choices exist; applicable taxes are the customer's responsibility and additional to the known base amounts below.

facts.label: Paid billing unit
facts.value: Active users, per organization. Everyone in an organization uses the same plan; the same person belonging to separately paid organizations can create charges in each.

facts.label: Guests
facts.value: Five free guests per paid member; each guest can access up to five conversations and comment internally, but cannot reply to customers.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: One paid user can use Starter; monthly purchase is available. No mandatory AI add-on or setup fee was found for ordinary email. Live chat additionally requires a Twilio account.

facts.label: Missive AI credits
facts.value: Productive and Business only. Prepaid balance shared across supported providers; provider usage price plus a 25% markup. Eligible organizations start with USD 5 once, not every month.

facts.label: Bring your own key
facts.value: Productive/Business can connect their own OpenAI, Anthropic or Google API key; pay the provider directly at its rates, without Missive's 25% markup.

facts.label: Unpublished credit terms
facts.value: Credit purchase package sizes/minimum top-up, expiry date and any automatic recharge option were not established. No flat credit-to-draft or credit-to-resolution conversion published in the checked pages.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: Exact totals for 100 or 500 drafts, messages or resolutions cannot be calculated from a published fixed unit. Known Productive base: one user USD 30 monthly or USD 288/year; three users USD 90 monthly or USD 864/year, plus AI usage.

facts.label: Extra connected accounts
facts.value: Paid plans include five shared accounts per paid user, pooled across the organization, and ten personal accounts per user. Each extra block of five shared accounts costs USD 15/month.

facts.label: AI stopping
facts.value: Admins get a low-balance email. At USD 0, credit-funded AI stops until an admin buys credits in Settings. Own-key usage follows the provider's billing and limits.

facts.label: Live-chat provider charges
facts.value: Twilio Conversations counts unique monthly active users who send or receive messages. First 200 MAUs are free; the 201–5,000 tier displays $0.05 per active user. Media storage displays $0.25/GB/month.

facts.label: Renewal and seat changes
facts.value: Plans automatically renew for the same period unless changed/cancelled before the end. Added seats are prorated; removing annual seats does not refund the already purchased annual term.

facts.label: Chat branding removal
facts.value: chat.hideBranding works only on Productive and Business. Starter does not qualify for that widget setting.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Custom personal/organization signatures and a per-draft No signature option are documented. A separate guarantee that every vendor mark can be removed, and its first qualifying plan, was not found.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service trial/start route links to https://mail.missiveapp.com/. One working owner can buy a plan; Missive says its tiers have no user minimums.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared inbox and team email client, with private discussion, shared drafts and several customer messaging channels. Overlaps support AI and team collaboration.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native connected email accounts on Starter, Productive and Business: Gmail/Workspace, Microsoft 365/Outlook, Exchange, iCloud and IMAP providers.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Missive's native Live Chat widget is powered by a separately connected Twilio Conversations account. Available on all paid plans, with no Missive chat surcharge.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: The same website JavaScript widget can be used within a web application, with user identity and metadata hooks. A native customer iOS/Android SDK was not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native connection to Meta's WhatsApp Cloud API; business account/phone setup required. Meta bills usage directly, with no Missive surcharge.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native Instagram Business or Creator direct messaging, linked to a Facebook Page with the necessary administrator access.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Page Messenger connection; Page administrator permission required. Personal Messenger is not the documented channel.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Provider-backed native SMS connections include Twilio, SignalWire, Dialpad and Quo.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Aircall and Dialpad connections bring call activity/voicemail into conversations. In-app calling uses the corresponding integration rather than a Missive-operated phone service.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: A ready-made bidirectional customer-support Slack channel was not established.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: A ready-made Discord customer conversation connector was not established.

facts.label: Ticket/contact forms
facts.value: No native hosted ticket-form builder established. A developer can send messages from a custom form/source into a custom channel through the API.

facts.label: Collaboration and replies
facts.value: Shared conversations, assignment, private comments/@mentions, shared drafts and saved responses. Live collaborative drafting shows colleagues' edits and helps prevent duplicate replies.

facts.label: Rules
facts.value: Productive and Business include rules/automations, with up to 1,000 rules advertised; Starter does not. AI rules can classify, draft, add notes/tasks and labels.

facts.label: Business hours and team routing
facts.value: Organization and individual team schedules/time zones are configurable. Assignment and chat availability can reflect teams and staff presence.

facts.label: Accounts, sites and brands
facts.value: Paid pool: five shared accounts per user and ten personal accounts per user. Extra shared blocks are priced above. A numeric website/domain/brand limit for the live-chat widget was not established.

facts.label: Organization separation
facts.value: Teams can share inboxes and conversations inside one organization. Separate organizations are siloed and need their own subscriptions; a user can belong to several.

facts.label: Help center
facts.value: No native customer-facing knowledge base; Missive explicitly describes pairing with a separate tool. Native article counts, search, custom domains, translations and article-feedback limits are not applicable to this offer.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Staff-facing assistant, reply drafting/refining, summaries, translation/search and AI rules. Available on Productive/Business. No standalone autonomous customer-answering agent established.

facts.label: AI context sources
facts.value: The assistant uses conversation messages/internal comments and supported attachments including PDFs; searches email, calendars, contacts and canned responses. MCP can add Notion, Linear, Stripe and custom sources.

facts.label: Knowledge limits and review
facts.value: Numeric knowledge/source caps, fixed refresh intervals and a promise of citations in every generated customer answer were not established. Drafts remain reviewable; some changes pause for approval.

facts.label: Reaching a human
facts.value: Live-chat conversations enter Missive for human staff and can be shared, mentioned and assigned with history in the same conversation. This is primarily a human chat workflow.

facts.label: Outside working hours
facts.value: Widget availability can follow schedules and relevant staff online status. Offline messaging and email follow-up for unread chat answers are documented.

facts.label: Customer/account actions
facts.value: Staff can view payments, charge, refund and cancel payments/subscriptions via ChargeDesk. AI MCP connections can retrieve Stripe billing context, manage subscriptions/payment links and create Linear issues.

facts.label: Visitor identity

facts.value: Conversation and comment exports include associated attachment files, rather than merely a promise of message text.

facts.label: Article export
facts.value: Not applicable to a native customer article/help-center product.

facts.label: Feedback and report export
facts.value: A dedicated export of customer satisfaction results, AI ratings or reporting datasets was not established.

facts.value: The GDPR page publishes named service providers and countries and offers a data-processing agreement on request.

facts.value: Missive says it does not train models on email content. Provider APIs generally do not train by default, subject to account/tier and opt-ins. Retention claims conflict: AI rules says providers store nothing beyond the immediate request; Anthropic setup and the privacy FAQ describe up to 30-day monitoring retention.

facts.label: Paused/inactive deletion timing
facts.value: A precise disconnection or purge deadline for unpaid/paused organizations was not established.

facts.label: Identity
facts.value: Missive, active collaborative email and messaging service.

facts.label: Company and markets
facts.value: Operated by Heliom Inc., based in Quebec, Canada. A complete list of permitted buying countries or regional service offers was not established.

facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted service, accessed through web, desktop and mobile clients. No self-hosted Missive backend edition or server source licence established.

facts.value: Public docs and support@missiveapp.com; public demos and a partners directory are offered. Exact staffed hours, guaranteed response times and a per-plan support SLA were not found.

facts.value: Checked 2026-11-04. Latest visible release: 11.38.0, 2026-10-23. Our proposed next review: 2026-12-04.
