facts.value: AI marketing says nothing touches outside servers/data never leaves your infrastructure, while the extension docs configure remote provider API calls that include ticket context.

facts.label: Policy scope and training terms
facts.value: Website privacy policy explicitly excludes RT/RTIR products. A universal hosted-ticket training-use policy, product processing agreement and complete AI/subprocessor list were not found in the checked pages.

facts.label: Hosting termination and backup window
facts.value: MSA says hosted data/software will be deleted after termination, and a copy must be requested before termination. Cloud backup retention: Starter none, Business seven days, Growth/Enterprise fourteen.

facts.label: User deletion/anonymization
facts.value: RT provides anonymization and Shredder tools. Clearing a user record does not remove personal data from message bodies/headers; attachment munging and linked-record handling may be needed.

facts.label: Ordinary retention and deletion timing
facts.value: No universal ticket-history expiry, automatic age-based purge, backup-erasure completion deadline or trial-data retention period was found.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Request Tracker (RT); active. Current official product URL is requesttracker.com/request-tracker/. Best Practical remains the developer; RTIR is the related incident-response product.

facts.label: Version sunset
facts.value: RT 4.4 and RTIR 4.0 reached end of life on November 1, 2025. RT 6.0 and RT 5.0 remain supported; current listed releases are 6.0.4 and 5.0.11.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Best Practical Solutions, LLC, a Delaware limited liability company, with a Waltham, Massachusetts, United States address.

facts.label: Market restrictions
facts.value: A complete list of buying-country restrictions was not found.

facts.label: Editions and exact licence
facts.value: Self-hosted RT source is licensed under GNU General Public License version 2. The vendor also offers managed Cloud RT and optional on-premise support services.

facts.label: Cloud support
facts.value: Starter community/docs; Business email with two-business-day response SLA; Growth email/chat one business day; Enterprise email/chat four business hours.

facts.label: Self-hosted support
facts.value: Community forum/security notices, no response SLA. Build email/two business days; Scale email/chat/one business day; Transform email/chat/four business hours and 24×7 emergency support.

facts.label: Vendor support hours
facts.value: Published normal hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–6pm US Eastern. Paid help uses support@bestpractical.com; community help is separately available.

facts.label: Release freshness and next check
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. RT 6.0.4 and 5.0.11 were announced 2026-11-02, including security fixes; RT 4.4 is EOL. Our next review target: 2026-12-05.

apps.name: respond.io
apps.line: Omnichannel customer inbox for messaging, calling, and support automation.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, WhatsApp, social, calls
cells.ai: 10,000 credits on Growth; $15 per 1,000 extra

agents.math: One Starter workspace includes five users and unlimited active contacts.
The same Starter workspace includes five users, and three people work. Contacts are unlimited.

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: No ongoing free plan found. The advertised free offer is a seven-day trial.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable to an ongoing free tier in this researched offer.

facts.label: Trial length and capacity
facts.value: Seven days; no card; Growth features for five users and 1,000 Monthly Active Contacts, excluding broadcasts. Some features, including WABA top-up, require subscription.

facts.label: Trial stopping and data lifecycle
facts.value: Trial can end early at 100% MAC usage. It does not automatically become paid. Organization is scheduled for permanent deletion 30 days after trial expiry unless subscribed first.

facts.label: Starter
facts.value: USD 99/month paid monthly; USD 79/month equivalent paid annually, with USD 948/year billed upfront. Includes five users and unlimited MACs.

facts.label: Growth
facts.value: USD 199/month monthly; USD 159/month equivalent annually, USD 1,908/year upfront. Ten users; starts with 1,000 MACs.

facts.label: Advanced
facts.value: USD 349/month monthly; USD 279/month equivalent annually, USD 3,348/year upfront. Ten users; starts with 1,000 MACs.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Custom quote; unlimited users, more workspaces and higher API limits.

facts.label: Taxes and renewal
facts.value: Unless specified, prices exclude applicable taxes, fees and costs. Subscription renewals and saved-payment charging are described in billing settings.

facts.label: Billing unit and included users
facts.value: Organization plan plus included users and MAC tier. Starter/Growth/Advanced include 5/10/10 users; Enterprise unlimited.

facts.label: Monthly Active Contact definition
facts.value: Contact sending/receiving a non-broadcast message, or making/receiving a call, during the billing month. Failed outbound non-broadcast attempts also count. Resets each billing cycle.

facts.label: Extra users
facts.value: Monthly billing: Starter USD 15, Growth USD 25, Advanced USD 30 per extra user/month. Annual comparison shows USD 12/20/24 per extra user/month equivalent.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Cheapest published bundle is Starter at USD 99 monthly or USD 948 annually. Five included users are purchased capacity; fewer users do not lower the base price.

facts.label: Setup/onboarding obligation
facts.value: No compulsory setup fee or mandatory onboarding charge found for ordinary Starter email/chat use. Optional onboarding programs/add-ons are marketed.

facts.label: Included AI credits
facts.value: Starter 5,000; Growth starts at 10,000; Advanced 20,000; Enterprise 40,000 per billing month. Growth/Advanced/Enterprise scale at 10×/20×/40× MAC tier up to 10,000 MACs.

facts.label: AI units and consumption
facts.value: Typical AI Agent response: 2–5 credits; builder test response 2–3. Prompt, Translate, Assist and Chat Summary: 1 each. Voice AI about 70 credits/minute; call/audio transcription about 2/minute.

facts.label: AI overage and hard cap
facts.value: Current paid plans automatically bill USD 15 per additional 1,000 credits, rounded up. Total monthly use stops at 200% of the included allowance. Cannot opt out of on-demand billing.

facts.label: AI cost examples
facts.value: On entry Growth with no other AI use, 100 or 500 actual credits fit within 10,000 included: no added AI charge; USD 199 monthly or USD 159 annual monthly equivalent.

facts.label: Contact overage
facts.value: Growth USD 12 per extra 100 MACs; Advanced USD 15 per extra 100. Service continues; charges applied at cycle end. Starter has unlimited MACs.

facts.label: WhatsApp charges
facts.value: Subscription excludes Meta messaging/calling fees. Vendor guide describes first 1,000 service messages per phone number/month free, then country-based per-message charges; paid templates have category-specific charges.

facts.label: WhatsApp balance and auto-recharge
facts.value: WABA top-ups: minimum $10, maximum $2,000/transaction; optional automatic recharge and alerts. Normal 5.5% transaction fee waived from October 1, 2026 until further notice.

facts.label: Voice/provider bills
facts.value: Telnyx bills directly: advertised outbound from $0.007/minute, inbound from $0.0055/minute; recordings can add cost. WhatsApp outbound calls are country/minute-based and require permission.

facts.label: Cancellation/refunds
facts.value: Admin cancellation takes effect at cycle end. Paid subscriptions normally non-refundable, including unused periods/plan changes, except law or discretionary vendor exceptions.

facts.label: Payment failure
facts.value: Five-day payment grace period, then frozen platform access; incoming messages still stored while frozen, outgoing messages/workflows stopped. Unpaid through cycle end leads to cancellation.

facts.label: Workflow stopping limit
facts.value: Workflow guide caps 150 workflows/workspace; vendor's Wati comparison advertises unlimited workflows on Growth/Advanced.

facts.label: Widget branding
facts.value: Both Website Chat Widget and Growth Widget document a Hide Respond.io Branding control. Exact first plan and trial-removal restriction not stated in checked setup guides.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Paid subscribed organizations can hide respond.io branding on email replies and customize sender/signature.

facts.label: Buying access and solo use
facts.value: Self-service registration: https://app.respond.io/user/register . Starter bundles five users and can serve a one-person business. Advanced/Enterprise cards route to sales.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted omnichannel shared inbox with human/AI messaging, workflow automation, calling and conversational sales/support.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Built-in connected mailbox channels: Google Workspace, Microsoft 365/Outlook and other email providers through documented IMAP/SMTP/forwarding setup.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native Website Chat Widget; live, session-based conversation, 4,000-character customer-message limit and 20MB supported attachments.

facts.label: In-app web chat
facts.value: Generic website script can identify logged-in website users through window.__respond_settings and an identifier field.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Connected WhatsApp Business Platform/Cloud API, plus Business App coexistence route. Free-form replies require the 24-hour customer service window; approved templates continue outside it.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Connected Business account DMs and comment/private-reply routes; overview permits replies up to seven days after customer's last reply, with Human Agent tagging after 24 hours.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Connected Facebook Page inbox, private replies and call support. Standard 24-hour reply window; eligible Human Agent use can extend to seven days; utility templates support other permitted outreach.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Integration channels: Twilio, Telnyx, Bird and Vonage; provider-dependent SMS/MMS capability and rates.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Built-in inbox calling through connected WhatsApp, Messenger and Telnyx VoIP. Advanced+ can publish Voice AI for inbound calls on those channels.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Native incoming Slack customer-support channel not found in checked directory/channel guides.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Native incoming Discord customer-support channel not found.

facts.label: Forms and other messaging
facts.value: Website widget supports a pre-chat contact form. Separate ticket-submission portal not established. Other documented channels include TikTok, LINE, Telegram, Viber, WeChat and Twilio RCS.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: Assigned owner, additional teammate collaborators, internal comments/mentions, snooze, conversation events and closing notes.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Snippets provide reusable replies and variables; up to 5,000 snippets/workspace. Owners/Managers manage them; inbox users insert them.

facts.label: Automation and business hours
facts.value: Growth+ Workflows automate routing, messages and branches. Date & Time step checks business hours/timezone/date ranges; supports away-message and shift-routing flows.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: No explicit agent collision-warning/typing-lock feature established in checked inbox collaboration and assignment guides.

facts.label: Workspaces and brands
facts.value: Current pricing includes multiple workspaces on Advanced; Enterprise has custom/higher capacity. Workspace guide still refers to Business/Enterprise names.

facts.label: Sites/channels and numbers
facts.value: Widget can whitelist multiple website URLs, including configured wildcard domains. Definitive account-wide inbox/widget/phone-number maxima not established.

facts.label: Public help center
facts.value: No customer-owned public article/help-center publishing feature established. AI knowledge sources ingest content; they do not establish a hosted public article portal.

facts.label: Customer AI role and availability
facts.value: AI Agents on Growth+ answer customer messages and perform configured conversation/contact actions. Voice AI publishing is Advanced+. Starter includes agent helpers, not autonomous AI Agents.

facts.label: Human helper and Copilot roles
facts.value: AI Assist/Prompts draft, rewrite, translate and summarize. Copilot and connected AI assistants can prepare workflows and perform permitted workspace tasks with confirmation controls.

facts.label: Knowledge sources
facts.value: Public URLs; PDF/TXT/MD/CSV/DOCX/PPTX/PPSX and supported images. Paid files up to 20MB; trial files 1MB; maximum 100 file sources/workspace.

facts.label: Website refresh and controls
facts.value: Website crawling defaults three levels, configurable to 100; up to five extra entry URLs/source. Manual/scheduled resync; sources selectable per Agent; 50 add/edit changes/day.

facts.label: Source review and human activation
facts.value: Test replies can show source labels for inspecting used knowledge. Agents start inactive and are published after configuration/testing.

facts.label: Context and helper boundaries
facts.value: AI Agent cannot see internal comments, quoted/replied-to original messages, or more than the latest 20 conversation messages. AI Assist can optionally answer outside supplied knowledge.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: AI assignment skill routes to a person/team/another AI Agent, with online checks, round robin or least-open assignment. Handoff remains within the contact conversation.

facts.label: Offline and voice fallback
facts.value: Agent prompts/workflows can explain office hours and queue for people. Voice AI can transfer a live call to human agents with configured target/conditions. Website sessions require contact details for later follow-up.

facts.label: Built-in actions
facts.value: AI skills can update contact fields, tags/lifecycle, add internal comments, assign/close conversations and trigger Workflows.

facts.label: External customer actions
facts.value: Advanced/Enterprise and selected legacy plans can publish AI HTTP-request actions: look up orders/accounts or create external records through configured APIs. Up to ten actions per skill.

facts.label: Verification and approvals
facts.value: No universal authenticated-customer or per-action human-approval rule established for autonomous HTTP actions.

facts.label: Shopify and WooCommerce
facts.value: Official Zapier guides cover contact sync and order/cart/booking messages. Shopify widget installation is a separate website integration.

facts.label: Automation gate ambiguity
facts.value: Current pricing places Zapier/Make on Growth+. Integration directory labels some Zapier ecommerce connections Starter/Growth/Advanced.

facts.label: CRM, scheduling and developer tools
facts.value: HubSpot, Salesforce, Calendly, Cal.com, Google Calendar, Make and n8n have official guides. Native Stripe/Slack/Discord/Linear/GitHub setup not found in checked listings.

facts.label: API access
facts.value: Public Developer API, token setup on Growth+. Overview supports message automation, CRM synchronization and workflow triggers.

facts.label: Detailed API reference/rates
facts.value: Full endpoint/rate tables could not be read from the Developer Hub's JavaScript-only page with the research fetch tools.

facts.label: Webhooks and custom channels
facts.value: Advanced+ webhook events for contacts, messages, conversation/assignment changes, comments and calls; Advanced also lists custom channels/HTTP requests.

facts.label: Hosted MCP and customer widget
facts.value: Hosted OAuth MCP connects one authorized workspace with existing user permissions. Website widget documents identification settings and programmatic opening. Native customer mobile chat SDK not found.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the researched hosted application.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: Profile guide lists 18: English, Spanish, Portuguese, Arabic, Burmese, Thai, Traditional/Simplified Chinese, Italian, German, Russian, French, Japanese, Indonesian, Turkish, Korean, Vietnamese and Hebrew.

facts.label: Customer and AI languages
facts.value: Widget form labels/text can be customized by language. Voice AI claims 32 languages with automatic detection/switching; defaults to English. Complete text-AI language list not established.

facts.label: Agent platforms
facts.value: Browser app plus native iOS/Android Inbox apps. Published minimums: iOS 15.1+, Android 7+. New account creation initially uses desktop web.

facts.label: Mobile scope and installation needs
facts.value: Mobile handles messaging, calls, assignments, comments and AI helpers; dashboard, reports, workflow/AI configuration and broadcasts remain web modules. Generic widget works across HTML sites with named CMS guides.

facts.label: Reporting gates and support measures
facts.value: Basic Reports all plans; Advanced Reports Growth+. Guides cover response/resolution times, user/team performance, channels, calls and conversation heatmaps.

facts.label: Satisfaction surveys
facts.value: Growth+ Workflows can send post-conversation CSAT and save responses to Google Sheets, CRM or a warehouse.

facts.label: AI inspection
facts.value: Conversation logs, builder source labels and sentiment/closing-note tools help review AI activity. Vendor also documents an external n8n/AI conversation-QA recipe.

facts.label: Export objects and formats
facts.value: Data Export offers Contacts, Conversations, Messages and Failed Messages. Support reporting guide confirms CSV and message Content alongside timestamps, sender/contact/message IDs and types.

facts.label: Export gates conflict
facts.value: Pricing marks Data Export included on all current plans; guide allows Owners/Managers. Contacts overview says Enterprise is needed to export beyond its 2,500-row contact view.

facts.label: Export operating limits
facts.value: One export job/workspace at a time. File valid seven days from request. Jobs over 15 minutes dismissed; retry permitted 30 minutes after original request.

facts.label: Attachments, users and workflows
facts.value: File library supports file download/URL copy. Workspace users export to CSV; workflows have export/import actions.

facts.label: Remaining exit coverage
facts.value: Complete attachment archive, AI knowledge-source bulk export and all feedback/closing-note fields in a single portable package not established.

facts.label: Hosting and backup facts
facts.value: Hosted on AWS; security page describes encryption, daily database backups and replication across multiple data centers.

facts.label: Region choice and DPA
facts.value: Exact customer-data regions/region selection not found. Public DPA page offers an agreement on email request; full DPA terms not posted there.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Published September 2026 list names AWS, OpenAI, Mistral AI, Google Cloud/Vertex AI, LangSmith, ElevenLabs, Telnyx and other processors.

facts.label: AI training and Google-data scope
facts.value: Policy says customer message/history content is not used for generalized/foundation-model training or improvement by respond.io or permitted AI providers. Google user data has additional AI-transfer/training restrictions.

facts.label: Cancellation/trial deletion
facts.value: After effective cancellation or trial ending, organization data is permanently deleted after 30 days; workspace access and storing new messages stop on cancellation.

facts.label: Contact/workspace deletion
facts.value: Deleting a contact also deletes its conversation history. Workspace deletion removes contacts, channels, fields and associated data irreversibly.

facts.label: Other retention scope
facts.value: Policy deletes server logs after 30 days with legal exceptions; fixed active-account message retention, attachment expiry and backup-purge schedule not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: respond.io; active customer-conversation platform for business messaging, calls, sales and support.

facts.label: Earlier name
facts.value: Rocketbots, founded in Hong Kong in 2017; headquarters moved to Kuala Lumpur in 2019; company brand changed to respond.io in 2020.

facts.label: Legal company, parent and headquarters
facts.value: Terms contract with Rocketbots Limited. Privacy policy gives its Hong Kong address and names Respond, Inc., Delaware, USA as parent. Marketing headquarters: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia.

facts.label: Buyer restrictions
facts.value: Terms require adult users representing a business and exclude specified US-embargo/prohibited-party categories.

facts.label: Calling regions
facts.value: WhatsApp outbound business calling excludes numbers from USA, Canada, Egypt, Vietnam and Nigeria; guide also names sanctioned regions and local restrictions. Telnyx international numbers/calls require L2 verification.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription service, with browser and native agent mobile access. Public API and hosted MCP are connection routes.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Pricing publishes 24/7 support on every plan. Contact routes include WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram, Telegram, LINE, WeChat and email; public help center available.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. Same-day changelog entries launch Twilio RCS and AI-assisted workflow building. Suggested next review: December 4, 2026.

apps.name: Shopify Inbox
apps.line: Free storefront chat and customer messaging for Shopify merchants.

free.text: Free app; requires an eligible Shopify store

cells.ai: Optional AI agent; no separate app fee

agents.math: The Inbox app is free, but it needs the Basic store plan. This covers one owner.
The Inbox app is free, but it needs the Grow store plan. This covers one owner and two staff accounts.

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.label: Ongoing free app
facts.value: Inbox itself is listed Free; Shopify says Inbox is free on Basic and above. Required Shopify store subscription is separate.

facts.label: Human access limits
facts.value: Inbox uses Shopify owner/staff permissions. Platform Basic has 0 additional staff, Grow 5, Advanced 15, Plus unlimited; store owner is exempt from staff count.

facts.label: Conversation/storage allowances
facts.value: No numeric monthly human-chat, contact, attachment-storage or chat-history quota found for the free Inbox app.

facts.label: FAQ limits
facts.value: Custom instant answers: create as many as desired, display up to 100.

facts.label: Inbox trial
facts.value: No distinct time-limited Inbox trial: the app has an ongoing free price for an eligible Shopify store.

facts.label: Required platform trial
facts.value: US pricing advertises 3 days free, then USD 1/month for 3 months; eligibility and length vary by store/location.

facts.label: Trial card and Inbox data
facts.value: Exact card requirement for every signup route and an Inbox-specific post-trial data/access window not established.

facts.label: Inbox paid plans
facts.value: No paid Inbox tier or separate annual/monthly app subscription listed; ongoing app charge is zero.

facts.label: Required Shopify Basic / US USD
facts.value: USD 39/month on monthly payment; USD 29/month equivalent on annual billing.

facts.label: Required Shopify Grow / US USD
facts.value: USD 105/month monthly; USD 79/month equivalent annually; 5 additional staff accounts.

facts.label: Higher Shopify host tiers / US USD
facts.value: Advanced USD 399/month monthly or USD 299/month equivalent annually; Plus starts USD 2,300/month.

facts.label: Taxes
facts.value: Shopify service fees exclude applicable taxes; tax depends on billing address and applicable exemption.

facts.label: Inbox and platform billing units
facts.value: Inbox has no published seat, message, ticket or resolution charge. Shopify host plan is per store/subscription, with staff allowances.

facts.label: Conversation counting
facts.value: Exact analytics session timeout, reopen boundary and cross-device/session deduplication rules not established.

facts.label: Minimum suitable purchase
facts.value: No separate Inbox purchase minimum. An eligible paid Shopify store is required; Basic for owner-only, Grow for ordinary staff accounts.

facts.label: Platform commitment
facts.value: Annual Shopify billing charges a full year upfront; monthly billing is separate. General terms deny refunds on termination unless otherwise provided.

facts.label: AI pricing
facts.value: Current free Inbox includes optional Inbox agent, staff suggested replies and generated instant-answer suggestions; no separate AI price, model multiplier or own-key bill published.

facts.label: AI safety usage limits
facts.value: Per conversation: agent answers up to 100 messages for unsigned customers or 1,000 for signed-in customers. Each customer can start up to 50 conversations/day.

facts.label: 100 and 500 AI conversations
facts.value: Our conditional calculation: 0 additional published Inbox charge for 100 or 500 AI conversations, subject to all per-customer and per-conversation limits.

facts.label: AI stopping rules
facts.value: On reaching a safety limit, agent stops and offers staff handoff when available, otherwise the sender email address.

facts.label: Other platform costs
facts.value: Store subscription, applicable sales/payment fees, purchased apps, domains, themes and external mailbox service remain separate expenses.

facts.label: Inactive app and commercial-change gaps
facts.value: No Inbox-specific inactivity purge clock, monthly human-chat hard stop, or current future-price-change notice promise verified.

facts.label: AI disclosure branding
facts.value: Agent displays Shopify-powered/AI notice automatically; it cannot be removed or customized.

facts.label: Other surfaces branding
facts.value: Staff-only widget attribution and follow-up-email attribution removal rules not established; no standalone Inbox help-center branding plan found.

facts.label: Start and store dependency
facts.value: Self-service installation on a Shopify store. Current Inbox guide permits Basic, Grow, Advanced and Shopify Plus.

facts.label: AI-specific requirements
facts.value: Inbox installed, active Shopify online store and new customer accounts; legacy customer accounts do not support the Inbox agent.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: Shopify-store live chat, assisted sales, simple shared inbox and opt-in customer AI. Overlaps ecommerce and AI sales assistants.

facts.label: Storefront web chat
facts.value: Native online-store live chat; staff or optional autonomous agent.

facts.label: Email continuation
facts.value: Native staff-chat follow-up can email a customer after they leave, if an email connection exists.

facts.label: Shop app
facts.value: Merchant chat via the Shop app discontinued February 19, 2025.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger and Instagram
facts.value: Current support for Messenger/Instagram intake not established in current Inbox docs/listing. Cached terms name Messenger and Apple Business Chat.

facts.label: WhatsApp and SMS
facts.value: Native WhatsApp/SMS customer-message intake not established.

facts.label: Voice, Slack and Discord
facts.value: Native phone/voice intake, Slack and Discord customer channels not established.

facts.label: Ticket forms and customer mobile apps
facts.value: Independent incoming ticket-form channel and embeddable native customer-app SDK not established.

facts.label: Assignment and private notes
facts.value: Manual staff assignment; private notes on customer profile; open/closed conversations, keyword/name/email/order-ID search and sender blocking.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Custom quick replies with one-word shortcuts on web, iOS and Android.

facts.label: Business hours and first replies
facts.value: Per-day availability schedule; default always available. Separate in-hours/out-of-hours first replies, each up to 2,048 characters.

facts.label: Notifications
facts.value: Desktop, mobile and email alerts; user controls own preferences. Desktop behavior differs across browsers.

facts.label: Collision and advanced routing
facts.value: Simultaneous-reply warning, round-robin rules, SLA timers and a custom automation-rule builder not established.

facts.label: Stores and inbox separation
facts.value: Install Inbox separately on each Shopify store, then switch stores in web/mobile. Agent customer data stays separate per store.

facts.label: Multiple brands and addresses
facts.value: One Inbox storefront can use theme/page entry points; exact independent brand, support-address and phone-number allowances not established.

facts.label: Customer self-service surface
facts.value: Instant answers in the chat and Track my order; no dedicated searchable Inbox article portal/custom-domain help center established.

facts.label: Help-center limits and translations
facts.value: Standalone Inbox article limits, search, language versions and article-feedback controls not found.

facts.label: AI roles separated
facts.value: Opt-in autonomous Inbox agent; generated instant-answer suggestions; staff suggested replies requiring review/send; automatic topic classification.

facts.label: Agent knowledge and grounding
facts.value: Agent uses store catalog, policies, published storefront pages/blogs and Knowledge Base facts/files; cited web search can supply qualitative context for a catalog product.

facts.label: Knowledge Base transition
facts.value: Old app no longer installable, deprecated January 15, 2027. Replacement lives in Sales channels > Agentic > Knowledge base.

facts.label: Replacement knowledge limits and updates
facts.value: Replacement holds 1,000 total facts; published content is public through Storefront MCP. Regular storefront scans suggest changes for approval; requested rescan can take 48 hours.

facts.label: References and persona approval
facts.value: Knowledge fields can have reference URLs. Practice/live response ratings create persona suggestions that require merchant acceptance.

facts.label: Files, refresh and citations gaps
facts.value: Exact Inbox file types/byte quotas, catalog indexing delay, guaranteed automatic refresh interval and all-answer buyer citations not established.

facts.label: Human handoff
facts.value: Customer request or agent inability can move chat with prior AI context to Unassigned; staff get configured notification. Outside availability, customer is shown sender email.

facts.label: AI-off operation
facts.value: Choose Never for autonomous agent assignment; staff handle chats. Other modes are All conversations or Only when staff unavailable.

facts.label: Customer actions and identity
facts.value: Agent can recommend products, add items to cart and look up order status. Account/order access requires sign-in; unsigned general chat is allowed.

facts.label: Sensitive/custom actions
facts.value: Hosted Inbox refunds, order cancellation, account changes and merchant-defined arbitrary webhooks/approval flow not established.

facts.label: Native Shopify connection
facts.value: Uses Shopify products, inventory, policies, customers/cart context and existing discount links.

facts.label: Other developer-stack connections
facts.value: Native WooCommerce, Stripe-merchant, Slack, Discord, Linear, GitHub or Zapier Inbox connectors not established.

facts.label: Public Inbox API and webhooks
facts.value: Public endpoints/scopes for reading, exporting or replying to hosted Inbox conversations and Inbox webhooks not established.

facts.label: Developer extension boundary
facts.value: Shopify publishes checkout chat-extension resources and a separate storefront agent reference app.

facts.label: Self-host operation
facts.value: Not applicable to hosted Shopify Inbox. Shopify supplies the backend; merchant configures store, permissions and app embed.

facts.label: Published app languages
facts.value: Listing names 21 languages: English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Brazilian/European Portuguese, Spanish, simplified/traditional Chinese, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Korean, Norwegian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Vietnamese and Polish.

facts.label: Language differences by feature
facts.value: AI staff drafts and generated instant-answer suggestions are English-only. Agent replies in customer chat language; catalog details can remain store language. Default staff greeting translates; custom greeting does not.

facts.label: Stale terms language conflict
facts.value: Cached Inbox terms say English-only; current App Store lists 21 languages.

facts.label: Operator platforms and host
facts.value: Desktop web inbox.shopify.com; iOS/Android operator apps; requires Shopify store/install and suitable permissions.

facts.label: Reporting
facts.value: Inbox agent Overview reports assisted sessions, assisted orders, positive-rated-response percentage and average agent response time.

facts.label: Review and reporting gaps
facts.value: Merchant can review/rate real AI responses and practice scenarios. Report CSV, complete staff-response/SLA report, date-range retention and feedback export not established.

facts.label: Customer contacts export
facts.value: Shopify customer profiles export as UTF-8 CSV; exported files limited to 15 MB. Up to 50 customers downloads in browser; larger exports emailed.

facts.label: Conversation archive and attachments
facts.value: Native bulk/single full-transcript export, attachment-binary archive, response-rating export and related exact formats/gates not established.

facts.label: Knowledge content export
facts.value: Current bulk portable export for Inbox instant answers, persona and replacement Knowledge Base not established.

facts.label: Processing location
facts.value: Shopify is Canadian and can transfer personal data internationally, including to the US. EEA/UK/Swiss customer data is initially processed by Shopify International Limited, Ireland.

facts.label: Subprocessors
facts.value: Public platform list names AWS/Google cloud hosting, Cloudflare, Groq and messaging providers; several conversational-AI entries explicitly describe Sidekick.

facts.label: AI data use
facts.value: Inbox docs disclose real-time chat processing and use to improve agent quality; store-specific conversation data is not shared across stores.

facts.label: Model and region gaps
facts.value: Named production Inbox model/provider, universal foundation-model no-training policy/opt-out and Inbox-specific region-choice controls not established.

facts.label: Conversation deletion and history
facts.value: Conversations can be closed/reopened and searched; workflow explicitly says they cannot be deleted in Inbox.

facts.label: Store-level retention policy
facts.value: Merchant privacy notice: store information retained two years after closure/nonpayment/termination before deletion/anonymization begins; requested store deletion begins after 90 days, with legal exceptions.

facts.label: DPA return/delete and backup scope
facts.value: DPA European processing appendix provides return/delete choice after termination, with legal and standard backup/record-retention exceptions.

facts.label: Inbox-specific timing gaps
facts.value: Exact live-message retention, uninstallation purge, trial/frozen-store chat recovery, full export window and backup-erasure completion not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Shopify Inbox; active first-party Shopify storefront chat and optional AI sales/support agent.

facts.label: Previous names
facts.value: Shopify Ping and Shopify Chat relaunched as Shopify Inbox on July 15, 2021.

facts.label: Partial channel sunset
facts.value: Shop app Inbox chat discontinued February 19, 2025; existing Shop-origin chats also became inaccessible. Online-store chats remained accessible.

facts.label: Company and contracting region
facts.value: Shopify; Canadian parent Shopify Inc. Contracting entities vary by merchant billing region.

facts.label: Market availability
facts.value: An exhaustive Inbox-specific country restriction list and local eligibility schedule were not found.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Shopify-hosted application, storefront app embed, web operator interface, iOS and Android apps. Proprietary service; no self-hosted Inbox edition established.

facts.label: Public reference software boundary
facts.value: Shopify/shop-chat-agent is an educational reference app, archived October 16, 2026; its README directs merchants to Inbox for no-code chat.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Shopify supplies first-party app support; all platform plans have 24/7 chat. Plus has additional inbound phone/email options.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Current AI-agent docs/active listing; 2025 Shop-channel retirement; pending Knowledge Base app deprecation 2027-01-15. Proposed next review 2026-12-05.

apps.name: SiteGPT
apps.line: Website AI support agents with human replies and an optional inbox.

cells.ai: Message quotas; model choice changes usage

agents.math: The Starter plan covers one person and website chat with people answering first. The AI is off.
The Growth plan includes four members, which covers three people for website chat.

facts.label: Ongoing free plan
facts.value: No ongoing free plan; the free offer is a trial.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable: no ongoing free production plan.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: Seven days on self-service plans; credit card required. Cancel before expiry to avoid the subscription charge.

facts.label: Trial cancellation and expiry
facts.value: Cancelling a trial stops service immediately; cancelling an active paid subscription keeps access until its paid period ends. Once the subscription ends, bots stop answering and content cannot be added or resynced.

facts.label: Starter price
facts.value: USD 59/month paid monthly; USD 468/year paid yearly, equivalent to USD 39/month.

facts.label: Growth price
facts.value: USD 129/month monthly; USD 948/year yearly, equivalent to USD 79/month.

facts.label: Scale price
facts.value: USD 429/month monthly; USD 3,108/year yearly, equivalent to USD 259/month.

facts.label: Enterprise price
facts.value: Custom quote for monthly or yearly billing.

facts.label: Currency and taxes
facts.value: USD; prices exclude tax. Additional local tax may be collected according to region.

facts.label: Base billing unit
facts.value: An account subscription with included bots, members, content pages, and a monthly message pool; not a charge for each support resolution.

facts.label: Working members
facts.value: Member limits include the owner and pending invitations. The same person is counted once across the owner's bots. Agent role can read and reply, take over, resolve conversations, and manage leads.

facts.label: Message definition and reset
facts.value: Both visitor message and chatbot reply count: one question plus one answer uses two messages. Account-wide pool resets on the first day of each calendar month, UTC; unused messages do not roll over.

facts.label: Minimum and dependencies
facts.value: Lowest public purchase is one Starter subscription. Email and WhatsApp each require the relevant paid add-on; website chat and human support do not require either channel add-on.

facts.label: Models and weighting
facts.value: GPT-4.1 Mini costs one message unit; GPT-4.1 costs ten Mini-equivalent units. New bots default to GPT-4.1.

facts.label: Included AI allowances
facts.value: Per calendar month: Starter 4,000 Mini-equivalent messages or 400 GPT-4.1; Growth 10,000 or 1,000; Scale 40,000 or 4,000; Enterprise custom.

facts.label: Extra AI pack
facts.value: Extra 5,000 monthly message units: USD 59/month monthly, or USD 468/year yearly, equivalent to USD 39/month; multiple packs can be bought.

facts.label: Email AI drafting
facts.value: Email can auto-send AI answers or generate drafts for human approval. A generated draft counts toward messages even if discarded.

facts.label: 100 and 500 AI-unit examples
facts.value: Our calculation: Starter with 100/500 Mini-model metered messages, or 100 GPT-4.1 metered messages, fits its base USD 59/month or USD 468/year. For 500 GPT-4.1 messages, provision one extra pack: USD 118/month or USD 936/year.

facts.label: Exhausted message shares
facts.value: When one model's share runs out, bots use the other while it has capacity. When both are exhausted, current-plan bots keep answering on website, integrations, and API, but bot dashboard pages are blurred behind a limit notice.

facts.label: Overage tariff and automatic recharge
facts.value: No fixed per-excess-message tariff or automatic pack-purchase rule established for current plans.

facts.label: Content limit and plan changes
facts.value: New content can become untrained at the page limit; refreshing existing content remains possible while subscribed. Plan changes apply immediately with prorated charges or credits.

facts.label: Cancellation and later deletion
facts.value: Paid cancellation ends at the current period; after subscription end bot limits become zero. Data deletion is scheduled no earlier than 30 days afterward, with at least seven days' advance email notice.

facts.label: Email rate and content limits
facts.value: AI reads first 8,000 new-text characters; never reads attachments. Sender throttling ignores mail after five prior emails in an hour; conversation throttling ignores mail after 20 prior customer emails in 24 hours.

facts.label: Widget branding
facts.value: Remove SiteGPT Branding add-on: USD 59/month monthly or USD 468/year yearly, equivalent to USD 39/month; available with an active plan.

facts.label: Email sender and disclosure
facts.value: Own-domain sending after verification of two CNAME records; one domain per chatbot. AI footer editable up to 300 characters; empty text restores its default. Edited drafts and manually typed replies omit the AI footer.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service trial and paid subscriptions; Starter explicitly serves solo founders. Enterprise is custom, through sales. No existing help desk or Shopify store required for website chat.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: an AI answering layer trained on a business's content, with a human inbox and lead capture. Overlaps website chat and knowledge-based AI.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native hosted widget, inline embedding, and standalone chat page on any current plan. Human replies supported.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native hosted email integration on any active plan plus paid AI Email Support add-on, per inbox. Forward an existing support address to the generated sitegpt.email address.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Web widget and JavaScript controls can embed chat in a web application. A dedicated native iOS/Android customer SDK was not established.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Connected WhatsApp channel on any active plan plus USD 59/month per number, or USD 468/year per number. AI and native human replies use the same conversation.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: No current Instagram integration, explicitly stated in the integration overview.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Facebook Messenger integration on Growth and above; native human replies in SiteGPT supported.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: SMS customer-support channel not established.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Customer phone/voice support channel and per-minute rates not established.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Slack chat integration on Growth and above. Human follow-up is performed in Slack rather than SiteGPT's native reply box.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Discord support channel not established in the checked current integration docs.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Dedicated ticket-submission forms with ticket lifecycle not established. Lead capture in chat and human-handoff contact collection are documented.

facts.label: Human inbox workflow
facts.value: Any-plan Chat History supports human replies, takeover, returning to AI, resolution state, tags, and starring.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Human-first, AI-first, working-hours, and visitor-choice modes; timezone and weekly hours configurable.

facts.label: Email rules
facts.value: First matching sender, subject, or recipient rule can send to team, ignore, draft, or answer normally; maximum 20 rules/inbox. Unverified senders and emails with attachments remain drafts for human review.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration gaps
facts.value: Individual assignment, private internal notes, agent saved replies, and collision warnings not established.

facts.label: Bot and member counts
facts.value: Starter one bot/one member; Growth two/four; Scale three/ten; Enterprise custom. All member figures include the owner.

facts.label: Enterprise capacity conflict
facts.value: Pricing headings promise up to 10,000 chatbots and members, while nearby descriptions/breakdown say 1,000. Plan docs say Custom.

facts.label: Websites and brands
facts.value: The same bot can be allowed on multiple domains; an empty Allowed Domains list allows any domain. Separate bots provide separate content/settings within the owner's allowance.

facts.label: Inbox and phone quantities
facts.value: Email add-on sold per inbox, one to 25 inboxes per account. WhatsApp add-on sold per number, one to 25 per account; each bot connects one WhatsApp number and each number one bot.

facts.label: Help center
facts.value: Public article publishing, article-search portal, own help-center domain, article count, and translated article collections not established.

facts.label: AI roles
facts.value: Autonomous grounded answers in website/connected channels; email auto-replies or approval drafts; Scale+ AI conversation topic, sentiment, and resolution insights.

facts.label: Knowledge sources
facts.value: Website import/sitemaps/links, YouTube transcripts, uploaded text-bearing files, text snippets, Notion, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, Box, and selected GitHub files.

facts.label: Content size
facts.value: Starter 1,000 pages; Growth 10,000; Scale 50,000; Enterprise 500,000, shared across bots. A page is 2,500 cleaned characters per document, rounded up.

facts.label: File-count conflict
facts.value: Pricing breakdown still lists 10/100/500/1,000 files across tiers, but its FAQ says pages replaced separate link/file limits; the plan reference uses unified pages.

facts.label: Refresh schedules
facts.value: Manual resync all plans; website/sitemap/GitHub auto-sync monthly on Growth+, weekly on Scale+. Sitemap scanning for new/deleted URLs daily/weekly/monthly on Scale+.

facts.label: Enterprise daily refresh conflict
facts.value: Enterprise pricing advertises daily auto-sync, while the current refresh guide says Daily is shown in the UI but no plan includes daily auto-sync.

facts.label: Source display and retrieval
facts.value: Widget has a Hide Sources control. Webhook source arrays identify retrieved passages, which are not necessarily links actually cited in the final answer.

facts.label: Answer corrections and scope
facts.value: Any-plan Managers+ can write custom question/answer responses; matched by meaning and preferred by the AI, but wording can change. Content is indexed for retrieval, not model fine-tuning.

facts.label: Human fallback and history
facts.value: Any-plan human support can collect contact information, notify the team, and retain the existing conversation for takeover. Working hours determine live waiting versus an away/contact flow.

facts.label: Zendesk handoff
facts.value: Scale+ SiteGPT can answer as a Zendesk Messaging AI agent and pass conversation/history to Zendesk agents. Requires Zendesk Suite Professional+ with Sunshine Conversations.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Official product explainer says SiteGPT does not independently issue refunds, change orders, or take irreversible actions. Answering bot cannot browse links or look up live data.

facts.label: Customer identity
facts.value: Growth+ verified widget identity uses server-generated HMAC-SHA256 of email with the legacy API key.

facts.label: Site platforms and Slack
facts.value: Code installation instructions cover Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix, and Squarespace. Slack/Google Chat/Messenger/Crisp/Freshdesk Messaging/Zoho SalesIQ are Growth+ connections.

facts.label: GitHub and cloud documents
facts.value: Selected GitHub repository content via read-only fine-grained token; selected Notion/Drive/Dropbox/OneDrive/Box content via connectors.

facts.label: Other relevant connections
facts.value: Native WooCommerce orders, Stripe billing actions, Linear issues, Discord, Zapier, and Make connections not established in the checked current docs.

facts.label: Public API and SDKs
facts.value: API v2, CLI, MCP, and TypeScript/Python/Go SDKs require Growth+ access. Own plan or chatbot owner's qualifying plan can provide access, restricted by token scopes and membership.

facts.label: Widget library
facts.value: JavaScript widget commands control visibility, context, messages, and customer identity. Install loader is separate from authenticated administrative API access.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: Scale+ or a documented webhook add-on; events cover messages, escalation changes, and new leads. JSON POST uses X-WEBHOOK-TOKEN, not a cryptographic payload signature.

facts.label: Webhook add-on price
facts.value: Standalone webhook add-on price and exact purchase eligibility not established.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the documented hosted service.

facts.label: Customer languages
facts.value: Widget text can be manually translated; AI usually answers in the visitor's language, controlled by instructions rather than a guarantee. Welcome text and starters are not automatically translated.

facts.label: Operator languages
facts.value: iPhone app is English only. Full web-dashboard locale list not established.

facts.label: Web platform needs
facts.value: Browser dashboard plus embedded script or supported website builder/plugin. Does not require WordPress, Shopify, or a particular desktop OS.

facts.label: iPhone operator app
facts.value: iPhone with iOS 18+; not iPad. Growth+ owner entitlement, while accepted invited members can sign in without buying their own plan. Free app, no in-app signup or purchases.

facts.label: Android and desktop app availability
facts.value: Privacy and account-deletion pages describe Android as well as iPhone apps. Exact Android store availability, OS minimum, plan entitlement, and a native desktop app not established.

facts.label: Basic and advanced reporting
facts.value: Starter totals; Growth+ daily charts, analytics CSV export, unanswered-question review, and weekly digest.

facts.label: AI insights and outcomes
facts.value: Scale+ AI topics, sentiment, resolution classification, and frequent questions. Classification generally follows about 30 minutes without a new message.

facts.label: Conversation exports
facts.value: Chat History CSV contains one row per message with question/answer text, timestamps, thread ID, page URL, rating, mode, model, email, tags, and status flags. Individual conversation export also documented.

facts.label: Contacts and feedback export
facts.value: Leads export to CSV includes contact/custom fields; conversation CSV includes reactions and status.

facts.label: Knowledge retrieval
facts.value: Growth+ authenticated document API can return document details and optional inline text content using knowledge:read scope.

facts.label: Complete archive and attachments
facts.value: A complete bulk export of all uploaded binaries, reply attachments, article layouts, and an independently restorable account archive not established.

facts.label: Hosting and region choice
facts.value: Stored with listed vendors, mostly United States; SiteGPT explicitly does not offer EU-only hosting. Cloudflare hosting/CDN/file storage is global; Convex and Pinecone storage are listed as US AWS.

facts.label: AI processing and training
facts.value: OpenAI generation via Portkey; Cohere embeddings; Pinecone vector storage; Context.dev file parsing. SiteGPT says it does not use customer content/conversations to train AI models.

facts.label: Customer and provider roles
facts.value: SiteGPT is controller for its own account/billing data, processor for customer knowledge, end-user chats, and leads. Paddle is merchant of record and independent controller for payment data.

facts.label: Processing terms and HIPAA scope
facts.value: Baseline processing obligations are in terms for all plans. Enterprise can execute a signed DPA and BAA; HIPAA mode uses a restricted processing path with OpenAI zero-retention endpoints.

facts.label: Active-account retention
facts.value: Standard active accounts have no scheduled deletion of chatbot content, conversations, or leads; they stay until customer deletion or post-subscription deletion.

facts.label: Account and visitor deletion
facts.value: Self-service account deletion requires cancelling an active subscription first; begins immediately. Email deletion requests to privacy@sitegpt.ai are completed within one month after account verification.

facts.label: Selective deletion
facts.value: Conversation, chatbot, and lead deletion available. Deleting a lead alone retains conversations; Delete all visitor data removes the visitor's conversations and lead for that chatbot.

facts.label: Email-specific retention
facts.value: Unanswered emails that created no conversation are deleted after seven days. Removing the last email address deletes stored received emails/attachments, but conversation history stays labelled Inbox removed.

facts.label: Backups and residual records
facts.value: Exact backup-erasure deadline and numerical server-log retention not established. Billing records remain as law requires; server logs follow providers' schedules.

facts.label: Identity and state
facts.value: SiteGPT; active hosted AI customer-support product with website chat, human replies, email, and connected messaging channels.

facts.label: Operator
facts.value: An individual operator and team, described in the terms and privacy policy.

facts.label: Country and regional eligibility
facts.value: Operator's home country, incorporated owner, and complete country eligibility list not established. Terms choose Delaware law.

facts.label: Hosted edition and rights
facts.value: Proprietary vendor-hosted service. Terms retain service intellectual property; customers retain their own uploaded content.

facts.label: Self-hosting and plugin
facts.value: No customer-operated SiteGPT server edition or server source licence found. WordPress plugin is an installation route for the hosted bot.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Public documentation and support@sitegpt.ai; Enterprise lists priority support. Privacy requests have a separate address.

facts.label: Hours and response commitment
facts.value: Staffed support hours, timezone, and guaranteed response/resolution time by plan not established.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle review
facts.value: Product checked 2026-11-05 UTC. Current November changelog covers changes through November 4: account deletion page, six-digit sign-in, reply attachments, and delegated API access fixes.

apps.name: Smartsupp
apps.line: Website chat and shared inbox for email, social, and ecommerce support.

cells.channels: Website chat, email, WhatsApp, Messenger, Instagram
cells.ai: Mira costs €20 per 100 AI conversations/month

agents.math: The Solo plan covers one operator and 100 conversations a month.
The Plus plan includes three working operators and 100 conversations a month.

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: Free is an ongoing plan separate from the 14-day Expert trial. Mira is a paid optional product, including for accounts with Free live chat.

facts.label: Free people, sites, channels
facts.value: One operator, one website, zero connected email mailboxes; website chat, WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram listed.

facts.label: Free volume and history
facts.value: 25 conversations per calendar month across usage; counters reset on the 1st; 14-day conversation history.

facts.label: Other Free limits
facts.value: One personal shortcut and one basic automatic message; no included Flows, AI Reply Assists, statistics, office hours or human vendor support.

facts.label: Trial and card
facts.value: 14 days of Expert access, no credit card required. Includes the Expert human-support features; Mira has its own trial allowance.

facts.label: Trial expiry
facts.value: Account temporarily deactivates and widget stops displaying until the user chooses a paid plan or continues with Free.

facts.label: Solo price
facts.value: EUR 20/month paid monthly; EUR 14/month displayed with annual billing. USD 24/month monthly; USD 17/month displayed with annual billing. One operator included.

facts.label: Plus price
facts.value: EUR 30/month monthly; EUR 21/month displayed annually. USD 35/month monthly; USD 25/month displayed annually. Three operators included.

facts.label: Expert price
facts.value: EUR 99/month monthly; EUR 69/month displayed annually. USD 117/month monthly; USD 83/month displayed annually. Five operators included, expandable.

facts.label: Ultimate price and term
facts.value: Starts EUR 239/month or USD 280/month displayed; custom limits, setup and support. Plan guide specifies annual billing only.

facts.label: Annual invoice precision
facts.value: Exact USD annual invoice totals are unresolved: Solo's USD 17 headline and USD 85 annual saving do not reconcile with USD 24 monthly; Plus USD 25 and USD 127 saving likewise differ. Expert EUR headline and savings also differ.

facts.label: Currency and taxes
facts.value: Prices payable in CZK, EUR, USD or PLN; fees exclude taxes and VAT unless explicitly stated otherwise.

facts.label: Human billing unit
facts.value: Plan packages include 1, 3, or 5+ working operators; only unblocked agents count. A blocked owner/manager cannot chat and does not use a seat.

facts.label: Human and bot usage
facts.value: Free has 25 monthly human conversations; current paid plans have unlimited human conversations. Eligible current Flows plans have unlimited Flow conversations. Mira is separately metered.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Paid human service can start with Solo's one-operator package on monthly or annual billing. Mira can run alone; no paid human base is mandatory.

facts.label: Mira price and volume
facts.value: Mira starts at 100 AI conversations/month: EUR 20 monthly or EUR 16/month displayed annually; USD 20 monthly or USD 16/month displayed annually. Pricing selector scales in 100-conversation steps up to 5,000.

facts.label: Billable Mira unit
facts.value: One unique visitor session with Mira responding; multiple messages in that session count once. Session ends a few minutes after leaving; a later return can count again. Reset is the 1st of each calendar month.

facts.label: Agent writing AI
facts.value: Solo includes 50, Plus 250, Expert 500 AI Reply Assists/month; Ultimate custom. Writing, grammar/tone refinement and translation are distinct from autonomous Mira chats.

facts.label: AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation: 100/500 purchased monthly Mira conversation units cost EUR 20/100 monthly or EUR 192/960 annually. With Solo: EUR 40/120 monthly; EUR 360/1,128 annually. With Plus: EUR 50/130 monthly; EUR 444/1,212 annually.

facts.label: Hard stops and unused allowances
facts.value: Free blocks new conversations at 25 until the 1st or paid upgrade; email alerts at 20 and 25. Mira stops replying at its own quota until reset or a purchased top-up; human live chat continues.

facts.label: Renewal, changes and refunds
facts.value: Subscriptions auto-renew. Upgrades and added seats are prorated immediately; downgrades start next period. Email non-renewal notice must arrive at least three days before term end.

facts.label: Usage and unpaid invoices
facts.value: Terms reserve prorated or retrospective billing when usage exceeds plan size. Failed-payment invoices must be settled before plan changes; subscription is marked past due.

facts.label: Extra operator
facts.value: Expert extra operator: EUR 29 monthly or EUR 20/month displayed annually; USD 34 monthly or USD 24/month displayed annually.

facts.label: WhatsApp provider-fee disagreement
facts.value: Smartsupp's WhatsApp guide claims service replies became chargeable by Meta on 2026-10-01. Meta's public pricing page says service messages and utility messages replying to users are free.

facts.label: Widget branding
facts.value: Powered by Smartsupp cannot be hidden or removed on any plan, including paid. Fixed iOS chat-box branding/options elements also cannot be disabled.

facts.label: Email and public help branding
facts.value: Outgoing-email vendor-mark removal not established; no native customer article/help-center publishing surface established.

facts.label: Solo and self-service access
facts.value: Self-service 14-day trial and paid checkout; Solo includes one operator. Ultimate uses a custom sales route. Mira can also be purchased without a paid live-chat plan.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website support and ecommerce sales chat, with a shared email/social inbox and optional autonomous shopping assistant.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native customer web widget and hosted Chat page; all plans. Paid human plans have unlimited conversations; Free has 25/month.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native connected-mailbox inbox from Solo: Gmail/Outlook OAuth or other SMTP/IMAP providers; compose, reply, CC, forwarding, signatures and attachments.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native inbox integration on all packages; WhatsApp Business and Facebook account required. Replies from Smartsupp stop 24 hours after the customer's last message.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native Facebook Page inbox integration; multiple Pages can connect. Smartsupp replies limited to 24 hours; agent-side file uploads unsupported, though incoming attachments can be read.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native inbox for Business/Creator accounts, including multiple profiles; all plans per pricing. Smartsupp reply window 24 hours; operators answer these messages.

facts.label: Other channels
facts.value: Native SMS, voice, incoming Slack/Discord support queues and standalone ticket-form channel were not established. Widget contact/lead forms exist; they are not proved standalone ticket portals.

facts.label: Assignment and queues
facts.value: Open/Resolved queues, per-channel views, takeover and reassignment; assignment and tags from Solo. Groups, limited agent access and team shortcuts from Expert.

facts.label: Private notes and saved replies
facts.value: Team-only internal notes inside conversations; visitor notes also private. Personal shortcuts available on all plans, one on Free, unlimited paid; shared team shortcuts Expert+.

facts.label: Automation and hours
facts.value: Office hours and basic automatic messages from Solo; advanced Flows and multilingual workflows from Plus; groups and automatic tagging from Expert.

facts.label: Human collision warning
facts.value: A specific two-human-agent typing/collision warning was not established. AI/human takeover locking is documented separately.

facts.label: Site and mailbox limits
facts.value: Free: 1 website/0 email addresses. Solo: 1/3. Plus: 1/10. Expert: 3/50. Ultimate: custom/custom.

facts.label: Multi-brand separation
facts.value: Expert adds multi-language/multi-design widget and groups. Multiple Facebook Pages and Instagram profiles can feed one account.

facts.label: Customer help center
facts.value: A native public article portal, custom help-center domain, article cap, article feedback and private-article permissions were not established.

facts.label: Autonomous AI
facts.value: Mira autonomously answers FAQs, recommends products and hands off website conversations; available as separately priced AI.

facts.label: Agent AI and fixed automation
facts.value: AI Reply Assistant refines/drafts/ translates human replies; conversation summarization is described. Flows use predefined steps and branches, not autonomous generative knowledge.

facts.label: AI and Flow coexistence
facts.value: Mira and a classic Flow cannot be active on the same website at the same time; activate one and deactivate the other.

facts.label: Knowledge source types
facts.value: Website web scrape, XML product feed, text content and custom Q&A; custom responses take priority. Website scraping excludes detailed product information, which belongs in the feed.

facts.label: Source size limits
facts.value: Up to 20 website pages; 30 custom Q&A pairs per Mira agent; five text sources of up to 10,000 characters each. Higher Q&A/text limits can be requested.

facts.label: Product catalog cap
facts.value: Current pricing says up to 30,000 products; current English plan guide says up to 50,000.

facts.label: Refresh and manual controls
facts.value: Web pages refresh every month, every two weeks, or off; feeds every week, day, 12 hours, or off. Manual update/delete and source toggles supported. Builder has Playground, draft, Publish/Unpublish controls.

facts.label: Learning and source attribution
facts.value: FAQ says Mira does not directly learn from conversations; corrections can create curated Q&A. Answers can link to supplied website pages, but a guaranteed per-answer citation/source-audit feature was not established.

facts.label: Live human handoff
facts.value: Configurable handover on demand/when convenient, or never. When unable to answer, Mira can ask for name/email/reason and notify the team; transcript remains in Smartsupp.

facts.label: Offline and external fallback
facts.value: Outside business hours, collect contact/reason and say the team will reply by email. Handoff transcript/contact can go to a chosen email address; no native Freshdesk/Zendesk ticket creation.

facts.label: Agent takeover and fixed flows
facts.value: Agent can take over an active AI/Flow conversation and later assign it to AI. A Flow ending as resolved cannot be replied to even by email; use a handover ending if follow-up is needed.

facts.label: Product lookup
facts.value: Mira answers specific-product stock questions using XML availability tags and can mention sizes; it recommends products based on relevance with a soft preference for stock.

facts.label: Order/account-changing actions
facts.value: Autonomous order lookup against an authenticated customer account, cancellation, refunds, account edits, custom tool calls and customer identity/approval controls were not established.

facts.label: Staff AI connector actions
