facts.label: Maintenance and backups
facts.value: Operator maintains WordPress, database/media, mail, cron and add-on updates/backups. Email polling/training depend on cron; external cron can improve work on low-traffic sites.

facts.label: Interface languages
facts.value: Docs claim 20+ bundled translations and name twenty locale variants, including Arabic, traditional/simplified Chinese, Dutch variants, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hungarian, Italian, Persian, Polish, Portuguese variants, Russian, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.

facts.label: Multilingual content and AI
facts.value: WPML/Polylang handle dynamic labels/pages; WPML needs String Translation for dynamic content. A guaranteed language list for AI answers and help-article translations was not found.

facts.label: Devices/platform needs
facts.value: WordPress browser-based agent/customer portals and website chatbot; Gutenberg/Elementor integration in core. No native desktop/iOS/Android agent app entitlement was established.

facts.label: Reports and surveys
facts.value: Core has agent dashboard/activity visibility; Pro Reports covers ticket statistics, response/closing delays and other filtered reports. Pro Satisfaction Survey stores ticket number, rating and customer comment.

facts.label: AI quality/usage visibility
facts.value: Chat sessions show complete conversation, reaction, status, tokens and linked ticket. Pro reports cover outcomes and AI tokens/requests by agent/feature, without currency figures.

facts.label: Ticket CSV export
facts.value: Pro Export Tickets produces filtered, role-accessible CSV with configurable fields for agents/admin versus customers. Explicitly excludes descriptions, replies, attachments and private credentials.

facts.label: Conversation/customer developer route
facts.value: REST lists tickets and paginated ticket threads; related customer and attachment endpoints exist. Custom authenticated extraction is an alternative to the limited CSV.

facts.label: Chat and media export gaps
facts.value: Full portable chatbot-session export, dedicated survey/feedback archive, attachment-binary package and article export were not established.

facts.label: Core data location
facts.value: Tickets are stored in the buyer's WordPress database/infrastructure. Email piping connects to the buyer's configured mailbox provider, rather than requiring a vendor-hosted ticket inbox.

facts.label: AI external processing
facts.value: Knowledge data is uploaded/indexed with the chosen OpenAI/Gemini provider; chatbot/assistant inference also uses that configured provider.

facts.label: Training policy and subprocessors
facts.value: A universal AI no-training guarantee, complete product processor/region list and guaranteed regional AI hosting selection were not found.

facts.label: Ticket retention/anonymization
facts.value: Configurable personal-data retention runs from ticket creation and anonymizes name/email/IP/personal-marked fields; zero days retains those fields indefinitely.

facts.label: Archiving and ticket deletion
facts.value: Can auto-archive closed tickets then permanently delete archived tickets after configured periods. Zero disables the respective automation; archived tickets are not deleted by default, permanent deletion is irrecoverable in the app.

facts.label: Chat sessions and vendor account retention
facts.value: Chatbot sessions can auto-delete after operator-selected days/months/years. Vendor privacy separately says checkout and vendor-support-ticket information is retained indefinitely, with deletion requests available.

facts.label: Uninstall and backup windows
facts.value: Complete uninstall cleanup behavior, enforced backup purge timing and a product-wide post-cancellation export deadline were not established.

facts.label: Identity and lifecycle
facts.value: SupportCandy; active WordPress help desk with AI chatbot and agent assistant. Vendor-published core 3.5.5 was released November 3, 2026.

facts.label: Company and location
facts.value: Terms identify PSM Web Solutions PVT LTD as seller/distributor. Privacy gives 401, Nilkanth Heights, Sawata Road, Shrirampur, Maharashtra, India 413709.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: A complete list of blocked buying countries or region-specific offers was not found.

facts.label: Edition and dependency
facts.value: Self-hosted Free core plus optional Pro extensions. FAQ says premium add-ons are not sold separately; current bundles include all extensions/integrations.

facts.label: Exact licence conflict
facts.value: Website terms say core/extensions GPL version 2.0 or later, unless otherwise stated. Current core header and distributed licence say GPL version 3 or later; README says GPL v3.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Paid annual licences get one-year priority support/updates; lifetime licences get support during product lifetime subject to terms. Free users have plugin support/docs; premium support requires active licence.

facts.label: Support hours
facts.value: Published site footer: Monday–Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST; support@supportcandy.net is published as contact.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Core changelog 3.5.5 is dated 2026-11-03, including UI/AI-chat-session changes and authorization/security fixes. Our next review target is 2026-12-05.

apps.name: SupportPal
apps.line: Self-hosted support inbox with email tickets and website messaging.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, optional messaging add-ons
cells.ai: No plugin fee; model and hosting costs are extra

agents.math: One installation includes one brand and unlimited operators.
The same installation supports three operators. The license is not charged per seat.

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.label: Ongoing free offer
facts.value: No ongoing free core plan published; free evaluation is 30 days. Chat, Help Widget and AI Assistant are free add-ons requiring a licensed core installation.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable to a permanent free core edition; trial restrictions and free add-on scope appear separately.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 30-day self-hosted trial, no card required. One trial per customer organization unless approved; evaluation-only, not production use.

facts.label: Trial end
facts.value: Trial rights expire after the granted evaluation period; extension can be granted in writing. No automatic permanent-free conversion or published post-trial application-data export window found.

facts.label: Monthly licence
facts.value: USD 29.95/month, monthly rolling subscription; all listed core features, unlimited operators/users/tickets/departments, one brand, email support and updates.

facts.label: Annual licence
facts.value: USD 299.95/year paid annually, annual rolling subscription, same listed core scope and one brand.

facts.label: Taxes and historical prices
facts.value: Current price page excludes VAT for UK buyers; terms exclude applicable VAT/sales/use taxes generally. Old 2022 rates are historical, not today's new-account prices.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Per licensed installation/domain and purchased brands/add-ons, not per support operator, customer, ticket or message.

facts.label: Staff and customer roles
facts.value: Operators are licensed within the unlimited operator allowance; customer accounts are separate users. Brand/department and role permissions restrict staff access.

facts.label: Minimum and dependencies
facts.value: One core subscription, one production installation/domain and one included brand; no paid seat minimum. Suitable hosting/database, PHP/ionCube and outbound licensing access required.

facts.label: Renewal/cancellation
facts.value: Automatic renewal; cancel at least 7 days before term end through billing portal or authorized billing email. Subscription cancellation takes effect at current term end.

facts.label: Refund and setup services
facts.value: Normally non-refundable, no partial-term refunds. Software refund considered only for verified fault preventing operation on a supported server within 28 days of purchase. Professional/setup/integration fees non-refundable.

facts.label: AI software charge
facts.value: Official AI Assistant add-on is free; listed version 1.4.0 requires SupportPal ≥6.0. External model/embedding and vector-database services must be configured.

facts.label: AI provider choices
facts.value: Supports Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI and local Ollama; Ollama Cloud explicitly unsupported. LLM and embedding providers may differ.

facts.label: Retrieval infrastructure
facts.value: Meilisearch or Qdrant vector store; local/self-managed or cloud options. Meilisearch enabled by default in official Docker instances. Changing embedding model requires full vector resync.

facts.label: AI examples / 100 and 500 responses
facts.value: Exact totals cannot be calculated from public app units: SupportPal AI add-on licence adds USD 0, but model/embedding token use, provider/model choice and retrieval deployment are unspecified.

facts.label: Brands and branding extras
facts.value: Extra brand: USD 9.95/month or USD 99.95/year each. Client-facing Powered by removal: USD 4.95/month or USD 49.95/year.

facts.label: Multiple-IP option
facts.value: Base licence locks to one internal and external IP; multiple-IP support listed at USD 4.95/month or USD 49.95/year. Exact extra-IP quantity covered by one option not spelled out.

facts.label: Twilio channel charge
facts.value: Marketplace lists Twilio add-on at $5.00/month or $50.00/year, plus separate Twilio account, number and provider traffic costs.

facts.label: Payment failure and service stops
facts.value: Terms may suspend services/licence validation after 5 unpaid days and terminate after 14; reinstatement fee may apply. EULA permits deactivating keys after termination/breach.

facts.label: Customer-portal attribution
facts.value: Core licence includes a Powered by line on client-facing help-desk parts; paid removal option USD 4.95/month or USD 49.95/year.

facts.label: Widget removal scope
facts.value: Per-widget removal switch/coverage for the current Chat and Help Widget footers was not clearly specified beyond the general client-facing branding-removal offer.

facts.label: Outgoing mail identity
facts.value: Brand/context-specific operator signatures and per-brand email templates documented; a separate vendor email-footer removal policy not found.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Public trial and self-service monthly/annual order links; one operator can use an installation because operator count is unlimited. Requires own suitable server and licence activation.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: self-hosted shared support inbox/ticketing with self-service articles, automation, multiple brands, optional messaging and AI.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native incoming email-to-ticket/reply processing; duplicate Message-ID rejection, plus-addressed reply routing and configurable email rate limiting.

facts.label: Web portal/forms
facts.value: Native customer web ticket interface plus free Help Widget for knowledge search and a contact form that creates tickets.

facts.label: Website chat/messaging
facts.value: Free official Chat channel for SupportPal 6+; rich messages/files, persistent conversation history, email reply notifications and optional AI responses.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Paid Twilio channel converts inbound WhatsApp to tickets and lets operators reply; supports media/location/file features described by the add-on.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Paid Twilio channel imports incoming SMS as tickets and sends operator responses back by SMS.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Paid Twilio channel supports receiving/managing calls in operator-panel widget; recording saved with a ticket.

facts.label: Facebook
facts.value: Free official Facebook add-on advertises processing Page posts and private messages as tickets.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Free Slack Notifications plugin posts selected ticket events to Slack; not documented as incoming customer Slack conversation intake.

facts.label: Other channels and SDKs
facts.value: Native Instagram, Discord, or a dedicated customer mobile-chat SDK not found in checked channel/docs/marketplace/pricing sources.

facts.label: Inbox collaboration
facts.value: Assignment/take, private notes, @mentions, watchers, merge/unmerge, close/lock, priorities and chronological ticket timeline documented.

facts.label: Collision awareness
facts.value: Reply-draft icon indicates another operator's draft; pulses while typing, and can reveal draft text/operator/time so colleagues avoid duplicate or conflicting replies.

facts.label: Automation and hours
facts.value: Macros run manually, automatically by cron, or at hook points; saved filters, canned responses, schedules/holidays and SLAs are core features.

facts.label: Brands/sites
facts.value: One brand included; each added brand paid. Multiple personalized frontends/self-service areas share one backend; user accounts and templates per brand, shared departments with permissions.

facts.label: Widget/inbox resources
facts.value: Multiple Chat and Help Widget configurations supported; unlimited core departments/users/tickets. Numerical widget, email-address and external-number maxima not found in checked pricing/setup.

facts.label: Self-service articles
facts.value: Core self-service types/categories/articles, search, tags, pinned content, attachments and translations. Article can be published/unpublished and restricted to registered users.

facts.label: Article limits and domain
facts.value: Served from the operator's licensed brand/domain. No numerical article/page cap found in checked pricing/article/EULA sources; actual storage/search capacity is deployment-dependent.

facts.label: Comments and feedback
facts.value: Article comments and ratings can be enabled, restricted to registered users or public, and moderated. Comment rating threshold and CAPTCHA controls documented.

facts.label: Agent-assist AI
facts.value: AI Assistant drafts ticket replies, summarizes threads, improves spelling/grammar/tone and handles follow-up prompts using ticket and knowledge context.

facts.label: Customer-facing AI
facts.value: Chat conversation button can enable automatic AI replies; requires configured AI Assistant plugin. AI is assigned as operator while handling that conversation.

facts.label: Automated ticket changes
facts.value: Optional Ticket Resolved Detector closes acknowledgment/thanks-only replies; Ticket Priority Updater adjusts priority based on the continuing conversation.

facts.label: AI knowledge sources
facts.value: Historical tickets, public self-service articles, public canned responses and configured websites. New tickets/messages and enabled article/canned updates automatically sync.

facts.label: Indexing and refresh
facts.value: Websites crawl in background and can be scheduled to recrawl. Embeddings stored in selected vector database; changing embedding model/provider needs full resync.

facts.label: Knowledge limits/citations
facts.value: Fixed source-size/page/token quotas, exact refresh interval/latency guarantee, and per-answer source-citation guarantee not published in checked AI/pricing/legal pages.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Chat AI stops responding and unassigns itself when user asks for a human or shows dissatisfaction, escalating conversation to staff.

facts.label: History and offline follow-up
facts.value: Chat keeps previous conversations, supports emailed full transcripts, and emails users about unread replies after they leave. Authentication can be required or optional.

facts.label: Actions and verification
facts.value: Chat supports email verification by 6-digit code and server-generated JWT auto-authentication. Documented AI actions are replies, ticket close and priority changes; autonomous order/refund/account tools not found.

facts.label: Commerce and billing
facts.value: Free official WooCommerce plugin retrieves orders/subscriptions in tickets; free WHMCS and Blesta Information plugins expose hosting/billing context and user synchronization.

facts.label: Slack and translation
facts.value: Free Slack Notifications and Google Translate add-ons listed. Slack uses incoming webhook per brand/events; translation provider setup/cost remains external.

facts.label: Other requested connectors
facts.value: Native Shopify, Stripe, Linear, GitHub issue, Discord, Zapier or Make connectors not found in checked official marketplace/docs index.

facts.label: REST API
facts.value: Basic authentication using an API token; admin-issued tokens can be read-only or read/write. Public API reference includes tickets/messages/attachments, users and self-service resources.

facts.label: Extension interfaces
facts.value: Official PHP API client linked; PHP plugin model/ticket events provide creation/reply/note/assignment hooks; Help Widget exposes JavaScript control APIs.

facts.label: Rate limits and webhook gaps
facts.value: Fixed REST request quota, generic outbound webhook delivery/retry policy and customer mobile SDK not found in checked API/macros/plugin/pricing/legal docs.

facts.label: Installation paths
facts.value: Docker monolithic, Docker microservices, manual Linux/LAMP and cPanel guides. Docker recommended for Linux/macOS/Windows; cPanel intended for small deployments with restrictions.

facts.label: Runtime/database
facts.value: Current docs support PHP 8.3.1–8.5.x and ionCube Loader ≥14.4.1; MySQL 8.0.29–8.4 / 9.0–9.7, MariaDB 10.5–12.3, Percona 8.0–8.4.

facts.label: Hardware and capacity
facts.value: Guidance: minimum 4 vCPU on servers; web server 2 GB RAM (up to 50 concurrent staff), database server 4 GB RAM, at least 2 GB swap recommended; SSD preferred.

facts.label: Operations and licensing network
facts.value: Operator manages cron/email tasks, backups, restore tests and upgrades. Outbound 443 to licensing.supportpal.com and marketplace.supportpal.com required; licence results cached.

facts.label: Realtime and updates
facts.value: Default event broadcasting uses XHR polling; optional Pusher-protocol WebSockets. Upgrades available through operator panel, CLI or supported Docker scripts, with major-version migration guidance.

facts.label: Interface language packs
facts.value: English official/default fallback; additional community-maintained packs through marketplace, including Danish, Dutch, French, German, Norwegian, Persian, Portuguese/Brazilian, Russian, Slovak, Spanish, Swedish and Turkish.

facts.label: Articles and widget languages
facts.value: Dynamic content supports translated departments, status/email text, articles/tags and SEO links. Chat/Help Widget strings can be translated and detect browser language.

facts.label: AI answer languages
facts.value: AI prompt can request another language; optional Google Translate plugin exists. A complete named AI-response language list or translation-quality guarantee not published in checked docs/listings.

facts.label: Devices and browsers
facts.value: Browser-based, mobile-first interface; current core supports latest two Chrome, Edge, Firefox and Safari versions; recommended viewport ≥360 px.

facts.label: Host platform and native apps
facts.value: Core needs supported PHP/database/server, not WordPress/Shopify/Gmail. No official native agent desktop/mobile app or customer mobile SDK established in checked product/runtime/widget/API sources.

facts.label: Reports and satisfaction
facts.value: Core report dashboards/cards, time/date filters, underlying ticket/user data, print/PDF and CSV. Ticket feedback supports customizable questions/ratings, delayed-after-resolution survey and negative-feedback notifications.

facts.label: AI review metrics
facts.value: Published AI tools support drafts, summaries and ticket actions; no standardized failed-answer, autonomous resolution-rate or AI-cost dashboard found in checked AI/reports/pricing docs.

facts.label: Full installation backup
facts.value: Built-in backup/restore includes database and all installation files by default; generic portable format uses database dump and application archive.

facts.label: Attachments and backup exclusions
facts.value: Full backup includes stored files. --minimal excludes storage containing attachments/avatars/images; symlink targets must be backed up separately. Docker has deployment and portable backup modes.

facts.label: User export
facts.value: Per-user export runs in background after selecting data; official GDPR guide specifies JSON containing that user's personal data.

facts.label: Conversations/customers/articles API
facts.value: Public API lists user records, ticket messages with reply/note filter, attachments and self-service articles including protected/published filters.

facts.label: Reports and feedback portability
facts.value: Report cards/underlying tables export CSV and print/save PDF. No documented single neutral archive covering every ticket, file, article revision and feedback object found.

facts.label: Local help-desk data
facts.value: Installation database/files, storage and backups live on infrastructure chosen by the operator. GDPR guide explicitly discusses own-server or chosen-host deployment.

facts.label: Vendor account/telemetry data
facts.value: Vendor privacy covers billing/trial/support/website data plus licence status, domain/IP, limited system fingerprints and general usage. Vendor website/SMTP hosted by AWS Europe/London; listed processors may transfer outside UK.

facts.label: AI processing and training policy
facts.value: AI data goes to selected model/embedding provider and vector store; local Ollama plus local retrieval is an option. App-specific blanket no-training policy/provider retention schedule not found.

facts.label: Local retention and cleanup
facts.value: Configurable cleanup removes inactive users/tickets/organizations after chosen days. Resolved pruned tickets enter trash, normally permanently deleted 30 days later; related messages/files/feedback removed.

facts.label: Logs, files and user deletion
facts.value: Raw inbound email content retained 30 days by default, configurable. Attachment/export/log pruning available. Deleting users removes related tickets/comments and associated activity/email records.

facts.label: Vendor retention and end of licence
facts.value: Vendor deletes trial-only signup information after 24 months without further contact/active services; business/licensing records may be retained as needed. Ending subscription ends software rights, not a published vendor purge schedule for locally stored tickets.

facts.label: Identity and aliases
facts.value: SupportPal; formerly ArcticDesk, originally launched in 2012 and renamed with version 2 in 2016. Active self-hosted support software.

facts.label: Edition retirement
facts.value: Owned/perpetual licence retired for new orders immediately in July 14, 2022 announcement; existing owned licences remain honoured. New buyers choose monthly/annual subscriptions.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: SupportPal Limited, registered England and Wales, company number 10035240; office in Isleworth, Middlesex, United Kingdom.

facts.label: Markets and currencies
facts.value: Terms allow USD or GBP billing unless otherwise stated; licence requires compliance with applicable export/sanctions laws. No complete country buying/telephony availability list found.

facts.label: Edition and core licence
facts.value: Self-hosted/on-premises proprietary software under SupportPal's EULA; one installed copy on licensed production domain, with brands licensed individually.

facts.label: Subscription versus owned rights
facts.value: Subscription permits use/support/updates during paid term. Existing owned licence permits continued use of last eligible version when support expires, without future updates/support, absent breach.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Unlimited email support/product updates during active subscription. EULA: email/ticket support on commercially reasonable efforts, no guaranteed response/resolution time or SLA.

facts.label: Paid remote support
facts.value: Remote desktop support listed at USD 75 per 30 minutes; optional professional services quoted separately.

facts.label: Unsupported-version help discrepancy
facts.value: EOL policy says assistance continues regardless of version, including EOL, with owned support active. EULA excludes support for unsupported versions.

facts.label: Freshness and release
facts.value: Latest reviewed stable patch 6.1.2, October 22, 2026; updates Docker PHP following security releases. Core 6.0 release June 17, 2026 added Chat and expanded AI.

facts.label: Version lifecycle and next review
facts.value: 6.x active; 5.7 security fixes only; 2.0–4.2 EOL. When 7.x ships, 6.x becomes security-only and 5.x EOL. Suggested review 2026-12-05.

facts.label: Saved replies and rules

facts.label: Business hours

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.value: No ongoing free Desk plan is published on the current pricing page; the free offer is a 30-day trial. Free part-time agents are roles inside a subscription.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable to a separately published ongoing free Desk plan. Trial and free part-time-agent limits are recorded under F08 and F10.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 30 days; no credit card required. Trial ticket replies and agent count do not create charges. Purchasing a plan ends the remaining trial.

facts.label: Trial end
facts.value: Billing guide allows a few days after trial to choose a plan and enter card details. Terms end access at the free period's expiry and instruct deletion, subject to retention exceptions. Exact grace period and purge date remain uncertain.

facts.label: Starter / annual
facts.value: USD 9.50 per user per month, billed yearly; maximum 10 full-time agents.

facts.label: Pro / annual
facts.value: USD 17.00 per user per month, billed yearly; unlimited agent capacity.

facts.label: Premium / annual
facts.value: USD 33.00 per user per month, billed yearly.

facts.label: Enterprise
facts.value: Quote-based price; inherits Premium features and adds Enterprise items including single sign-on and the vendor's HIPAA-related offering.

facts.label: Monthly prices
facts.value: Monthly billing exists; exact current monthly seat rates were not established from the readable official pricing and billing sources.

facts.label: Tax
facts.value: Quoted prices exclude applicable sales taxes under the terms. Pricing specifically applies tax to Irish customers and EU customers without a valid tax registration number.

facts.label: Full-time billing unit
facts.value: Paid full-time agent seat; can answer unlimited tickets. Starter allows up to 10 full-time agents.

facts.label: Free part-time agents
facts.value: Unlimited number of part-time agents; each may reply on 10 unique tickets in a 30-day period. Multiple replies on those tickets are allowed. Reset is 30 days after the first reply.

facts.label: Seat management
facts.value: Changing a person to part-time does not automatically reduce purchased seats. Part-time agents never become paid agents automatically.

facts.label: Purchase minimum and setup costs
facts.value: Explicit minimum paid seats/spend, mandatory setup charge, and a mandatory separate Teamwork.com project subscription were not established.

facts.label: Payment and proration
facts.value: Monthly pays the first month immediately; annual pays the full year immediately. Additional seats and Help Docs sites during an annual term are prorated to the term's end.

facts.label: Cancellation, renewal and refunds
facts.value: Desk guide says cancel anytime with immediate account closure; pricing says no cancellation fees. General terms describe automatic renewal, at least 30 days' written notice before term end, and non-refundable fees.

facts.label: Dotty base charge and allowance
facts.value: Dotty is advertised at $69/month for the whole Desk subscription, with 1,000 tickets analyzed and 100 AI-drafted replies per billing month. Paid Desk plan required.

facts.label: Dotty additional replies
facts.value: Additional suggested replies advertised for $9/month; the number of replies bought by that charge and a currency code specific to that guide were not established.

facts.label: Availability
facts.value: Current pricing offers Dotty as an add-on on every paid Desk plan and an October 26, 2026 guide explains purchase. The August 5, 2026 suggested-reply guide still labels it Early Access for selected accounts.

facts.label: Model accounting and external bills
facts.value: No public Dotty model-specific multipliers, model-choice rate table, or mandatory bring-your-own-model bill was found.

facts.label: AI example / 100 drafts
facts.value: Our conditional calculation: Starter's USD 9.50 annual monthly equivalent plus advertised $69/month Dotty = 78.50/month equivalent if both charges are USD at those cadences. Covers up to 100 drafts and 1,000 analyzed tickets, not 100 guaranteed resolutions.

facts.label: AI example / 500 drafts
facts.value: Exact total cannot be calculated: 500 drafts exceed the included 100 by 400; $9 top-up pack size is missing. 500 analyzed tickets alone fit within the 1,000-ticket analysis allowance.

facts.label: Help Docs extras
facts.value: One Help Docs site included; each extra site is advertised at $20/month/site in the purchase guide.

facts.label: Excess use and AI stops
facts.value: Fair usage applies. Terms allow extra fees for excessive/misused service use. Exact AI hard-stop, automatic recharge, unused allowance expiry/carryover, and analysis top-up rules were not established.

facts.label: Email and message constraints
facts.value: Domain verification is required for reliable own-domain sending; the inbox guide mentions sending limits for unverified domains without a number. Ticket replies have 5 MB content and 20 MB total attachment limits.

facts.label: Help center branding
facts.value: Custom logo, favicon, touch icon, colors, editable header/footer templates, stylesheet, and JavaScript are documented. Full CSS customization and custom domain appear on all plan columns.

facts.label: Portal branding
facts.value: Custom colors, logo, favicon, stylesheet, and reuse of Help Docs styles are documented; custom portal domain is supported.

facts.label: Email identity
facts.value: Editable inbox signature, including agent variables and images. Verify the sender domain to avoid the documented “via teamworkdesk.com” relay identity; own SMTP is Premium/Enterprise in pricing.

facts.label: Attribution removal / plan
facts.value: Exact removal permission, first eligible plan, fees, and trial restrictions for widget, Help Docs, portal, and all outgoing-email vendor attribution were not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service trial and paid subscription management; Enterprise has a sales/demo route. Site administrators purchase subscriptions and choose their paid user count. Solo paid minimum remains unconfirmed.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: email help desk with shared inboxes, customer portal, Help Docs, optional website live chat, and agent AI assistance. Particularly aimed at services businesses connecting support to client project work.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email ticketing on all plans; connect Gmail or Outlook team email, use forwarding, or create a Desk-powered email address.

facts.label: Website ticket forms
facts.value: Native embedded contact form on all plans; submission creates a ticket in a selected inbox. Form can search Help Docs before submission.

facts.label: Website live chat
facts.value: Native live chat in the contact widget; Pro, Premium, and Enterprise. Customer supplies email to start.

facts.label: Customer portal
facts.value: Native portal allows customers to create tickets, view history, reply, and search linked Help Docs.

facts.label: Other customer channels
facts.value: Native WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, SMS, voice, Slack, Discord, and customer mobile SDK channels were not established.

facts.label: Assignment and collaboration
facts.value: Assign/reassign tickets individually or in bulk; private notes, followers, canned replies, tags, collision detection, and custom views appear across all current plan columns.

facts.label: Automation / Pro
facts.value: Triggers, ticket time tracking, undo send, and customized task/ticket workflow start on Pro.

facts.label: Advanced workflow / Premium
facts.value: Business hours, Training Wheels, inbox-administrator role, ticket templates, scheduled replies/new tickets, custom fields, and SLAs start on Premium.

facts.label: Inboxes and separation
facts.value: Multiple inboxes can organize departments, clients, or contact types; inbox-specific addresses, agent access, signatures, form destinations, and portal labels are supported. Exact per-plan inbox and widget maxima were not found.

facts.label: Help Docs sites
facts.value: One included Help Docs site with unlimited articles; paid additional sites. Multiple Help Docs sites can be shown in the same customer portal.

facts.label: Help center and limits
facts.value: Help Docs included from Starter; unlimited articles in the included site, categories, keyword search, related articles, draft/unpublished/published states, and revisions.

facts.label: Domain and access
facts.value: Custom Help Docs domain via CNAME; publication toggle; optional agent/admin login, shared password, IP allow or block restrictions.

facts.label: Language and comments
facts.value: Site language translates interface strings; contact form can create tickets; Disqus comments are supported. Article creation is manual through the editor.

facts.label: Article feedback / translations
facts.value: Built-in article helpfulness voting, exact supported locale list, and automatic article-body translation were not established.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Dotty analyzes tickets, finds similar resolved tickets and recurring trends, summarizes threads, and drafts replies on demand or automatically suggests drafts. It does not send customer replies automatically.

facts.label: Knowledge sources
facts.value: Current ticket/history and internal notes, selected-inbox resolved tickets and previous replies, connected Help Docs sites, and organization-owned public links. A connected Help Docs site syncs all its pages.

facts.label: Scope and approval
facts.value: Jobs configured per inbox; Dotty does not analyze unselected inboxes. Agent permissions still limit access. Auto-suggest replies depends on Identify trends in the same inbox.

facts.label: Citations, refresh and sizes
facts.value: Source references may be shown and should be reviewed; an every-answer citation guarantee, maximum source size/pages, refresh schedule, and update-delay commitment were not established.

facts.label: Human response and chat history
facts.value: Dotty leaves the human agent responsible for sending. Human live chat is Pro+; closed chats can become tickets and customers can request an emailed transcript.

facts.label: Outside-hours behavior
facts.value: Exact live-chat offline routing, queue/response promise, and transcript transfer outside working hours were not established. Premium adds business-hours features.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Stripe connection shows matched billing history; Zapier/API can create or update support records. Autonomous Dotty order changes, refunds, account changes, and associated identity-verification controls were not established.

facts.label: Teamwork connection
facts.value: Native Teamwork.com integration on all plans links support tickets and project tasks. Pro adds linked time tracking and workflow controls; Premium adds task automation.

facts.label: Stripe
facts.value: Documented built-in integration matches Desk customer email to Stripe customers and displays invoice/subscription history with invoice links.

facts.label: Automation services
facts.value: Zapier supports ticket/customer triggers, searches, and actions; Make supports scenarios, including Google Forms to new Desk customer/ticket workflows.

facts.label: Commerce and developer stack gaps
facts.value: Native Shopify, WooCommerce, Slack, Discord, Linear, and GitHub connections were not established from the checked Desk pages. Custom API or automation paths are available.

facts.label: REST API
facts.value: Desk v2 REST API with bearer API key and JSON resources. Included in all pricing columns; public developer reference at apidocs.teamwork.com/docs/desk.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: Publicly documented HTTP POST events cover customers, agents, inboxes, threads, ticket replies, assignment, notes, statuses, priorities, tags, and deletion.

facts.label: API limits and client libraries
facts.value: Exact Desk API request-rate limits, webhook retry guarantees, and customer iOS/Android widget SDK availability were not established in the checked guides.

facts.label: Running it yourself
facts.value: Not applicable to the vendor-hosted Desk edition researched.

facts.label: Customer-surface languages
facts.value: Help Docs has a site-language selector for interface strings. Portal can use a chosen language or the customer's browser language. Exact supported-language lists were not found.

facts.label: Agent editor and AI languages
facts.value: Per-inbox ticket-editor language changes spelling checks, explicitly not the Desk interface. Complete agent UI, widget, and Dotty response-language lists were not established.

facts.label: Devices and dependencies
facts.value: Browser-based Desk; agent iOS and Android apps linked to their official stores. Website contact/chat widget uses generated JavaScript; no Shopify, WordPress, Gmail, or macOS-only host is required by that installation guide.

facts.label: Base reporting
facts.value: First-response time and top-agent reports appear across all plan columns; Premium+ adds handle time, replies to resolve, agent performance insights, tickets by channel, and Help Docs reports.

facts.label: Satisfaction and AI review
facts.value: Customer happiness ratings start on Premium. Dotty shows generated-reply activity with ticket/status/date context and identifies trends in enabled inboxes.

facts.label: Bulk export route
facts.value: Settings → General → Export Data creates downloadable ZIP files containing JSON for customers, tickets, Help Docs, and agents. Advanced-security settings can disable exports.

facts.label: Customer export
facts.value: JSON includes customer ID, names/email, company, job title, address, phone/mobile, social links, notes, and creation/update dates. Customers with spam tickets are excluded according to the overview.

facts.label: Ticket export scope
facts.value: Ticket JSON documents IDs, relationships, status/type information, dates, response/resolution times, custom fields, and a Threads/Counts entry. Full message-body and attachment-file coverage is not clearly specified.

facts.label: Ticket-report CSV
facts.value: Premium/Enterprise report export includes filtered ticket properties, customer details, happiness rating/comment, time figures, custom fields, and First Message.

facts.label: Help Docs export
facts.value: JSON includes sites, article contents and text contents, titles, status/private flags, URLs, dates, categories, and site configuration.

facts.label: Export plan distinction
facts.value: Pricing's all-plan ticket export and Premium+ report CSV are different export routes, not necessarily conflicting plan statements. Exported media binaries and separate feedback-history portability remain unresolved.

facts.label: Hosting and regional scope
facts.value: Security page says AWS servers in US and EU. Desk portal docs give different US/EU custom-domain CNAME targets.

facts.label: Region choice and transfers
facts.value: Signup region selection/migration process and a Desk-only residency guarantee were not established. Privacy notice permits US/EU hosting and international transfers; model-provider processing locations vary.

facts.label: AI providers
facts.value: Published possible AI subprocessors include AWS infrastructure, OpenAI, Anthropic, Google/Gemini, and other approved providers. Locations vary by customer region or provider configuration.

facts.label: Training and activation
facts.value: AI policy says customer data is not used to train Teamwork's own models or general-purpose models by Teamwork or its providers. Enabled Desk AI may process relevant ticket content continuously; features can be disabled.

facts.label: Deleted tickets
facts.value: Ordinary deleted tickets remain restorable in Trash for 30 days, then are permanently deleted; admins can empty Trash sooner. Deleted archived tickets bypass Trash and cannot be restored.

facts.label: Deleted chat and attachment links
facts.value: Deleted live chats remain in Trash for 30 days before permanent deletion. Links to attachments from previous messages in ticket replies expire after 30 days.

facts.label: Account cancellation and backup request
facts.value: Cancellation immediately blocks site access. Terms allow destruction after termination unless a written request for the latest backup arrives within 10 days; delivery is a reasonable-endeavours target within 30 days after request, with fees paid and reasonable expenses chargeable.

facts.label: General retention and AI purge timing
facts.value: Exact active-ticket history cap, inactive-account deletion schedule, backup purge duration, and AI-provider retention days were not found. Privacy/DPA allow retention needed by law or controller obligations.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Teamwork Desk; active hosted help desk in the Teamwork.com product family. No Desk shutdown, sunset, or acquisition notice found in the checked sources.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Teamwork Crew Limited, incorporated in Ireland; registered number 313652; registered office in Cork, Ireland.

facts.label: Markets and restrictions
facts.value: A complete Desk-specific supported-country or excluded-country list was not found.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription with browser access, hosted customer surfaces, and agent mobile apps. Terms grant limited service access; no self-hosted Desk edition or public core-source licence was identified.

facts.label: Vendor help channels
facts.value: Public help docs, Submit a Request support form with attachments, and vendor live chat described in the support guide. Pricing lists email support across plans.

facts.label: Hours and response commitment
facts.value: Desk-specific staffed hours, time zones, guaranteed first-response times, and public paid support upgrade rates were not established.

facts.label: Freshness and review
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05. Dotty purchase guide modified 2026-10-26; AI suggested-reply guide modified 2026-08-05; general export guides modified 2025-06-20. Suggested next review: 2026-12-05.

facts.label: Ongoing free plan

facts.label: Free-plan limits

facts.label: Trial length and card
facts.value: 14 days, no credit card required; pricing FAQ says full access to AI Agent, live chat, help desk, and Copilot during trial.

facts.label: Trial end
facts.value: Terms say trial rights end automatically at expiry; continued access requires selecting paid service and providing payment details. The reviewed materials do not state a fixed post-trial data grace period.

facts.label: Essential plan
facts.value: USD 25 per user per month when billed monthly; USD 19 per user per month equivalent when billed yearly (USD 228 per seat per year by calculation).

facts.label: Growth plan
facts.value: USD 99 per user per month when billed monthly; USD 79 per user per month equivalent when billed yearly (USD 948 per seat per year by calculation).

facts.label: Enterprise plan
facts.value: Custom quote; plan page describes custom AI, tailored workflows, multiple brands, custom roles, SSO, audit logs, SLAs, and expert services.

facts.label: Published plan prices versus pricing FAQ
facts.value: Pricing cards and comparison table publish Essential and Growth rates, while the same page's FAQ says there is no fixed one-size-fits-all price and tells readers to contact the team for a matched quote.

facts.label: Included AI resolution allowances
facts.value: Essential: 10 resolutions per month. Growth: 200 per month. Enterprise: custom allowance; its FAQ says 2,000+ while the pricing table labels the allowance custom.

facts.label: Extra AI resolution package
facts.value: USD 49.50 for 50 additional resolutions, or USD 0.99 per resolution, on Essential and Growth.

facts.label: Tax and payment currency
facts.value: Fees are payable in USD; listed prices exclude applicable taxes unless the vendor must collect them.

facts.label: Seat billing
facts.value: Essential and Growth are priced per user per month; team size changes the base subscription.

facts.label: AI usage unit
facts.value: One resolution per conversation when the AI directly answers at least one customer question; a successfully completed Custom Skill that directly fulfills the request can also count.

facts.label: Ticket volume and API units
facts.value: Text says it does not charge per ticket; API usage is a separate request meter with 10,000 calls/month on Essential and 20,000/month on Growth.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Public prices are stated per user; pricing and terms do not publish a minimum seat count, setup fee, or mandatory base add-on for Essential/Growth.

facts.label: AI included in base plan
facts.value: AI Agent is included in every public paid plan, with a plan-level monthly resolution limit and no separate model-selection fee listed in the plan table.

facts.label: AI resolution billing
facts.value: Billed capacity follows successful resolution, not every message or every conversation: one charge when the agent answers at least one real question or completes a Custom Skill that directly fulfills the request.

facts.label: Model choices and provider charges
facts.value: The public Text pricing/help pages reviewed do not offer a customer-facing AI model selector or disclose separate model-provider pass-through rates for the built-in AI Agent.

facts.label: 100 AI resolutions/month example
facts.value: Our calculation for one Essential seat, monthly plan: USD 25 base + 2 × USD 49.50 packages = USD 124/month. Two packages provide 100 extra units plus the included 10, so up to 110 resolutions that cycle.

facts.label: 500 AI resolutions/month example
facts.value: Our calculation for one Essential seat, monthly plan: USD 25 base + 10 × USD 49.50 packages = USD 520/month. Ten packages plus the included 10 provide up to 510 resolutions that cycle.

facts.label: AI package refill and stop behavior
facts.value: New resolution packages are manually chosen; the AI Agent stops taking new chats when the account reaches its resolution limit, until capacity is added.

facts.label: Automatic refill conflict
facts.value: The Terms of Use updated Nov 9 say Text automatically adds a refill when AI usage exceeds the plan. The dedicated AI-resolution help article dated Nov 6 says packages must be added manually and Text never adds unselected packages.

facts.label: API and provider extras
facts.value: Extra 100,000-call package is listed at USD 29.50 for Essential and Growth. Twilio SMS and third-party integration/provider charges may be billed by those providers.

facts.label: Widget customization
facts.value: Widget colors, light/dark theme, language, position, visibility, greeting, and text can be customized; custom logo is listed for all plans.

facts.label: Vendor branding removal
facts.value: “White label” removal of “Powered by Text” branding is listed for Enterprise only.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Public self-service route: start a 14-day Text trial without a card. Enterprise is contact-sales/quote led.

facts.label: Solo and new-customer route
facts.value: Per-user pricing and commercial-use terms allow a business owner acting for their business to buy one seat. New signups from LiveChat, HelpDesk, and ChatBot product routes are directed to Text.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: unified customer-service suite for website and in-app chat, email tickets, social messaging, human support, autonomous AI support, and sales conversations.

facts.label: Scope boundary
facts.value: Text positions AI as both customer support and sales assistance; the Shopify-connected functions include product context and attributed sales.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native Text website widget; plan table includes website and in-app surfaces across Essential, Growth, and Enterprise.

facts.label: In-app chat
facts.value: Widget can be embedded in a mobile app; the plan matrix lists in-app as an included channel across plans.

facts.label: Hosted chat page
facts.value: A standalone Text chat page can be shared without embedding a widget on a website.

facts.label: Email and ticketing
facts.value: Incoming email can be forwarded into Text and handled as a ticket in the shared inbox.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Native Messenger connection to a Facebook Business Page; messages appear in Text Inbox and can be answered by human agents or AI.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: SMS channel uses a customer's Twilio account and is listed in the plan table.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Instagram Professional accounts can connect for direct messages and story replies; personal accounts are not supported as-is.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Official Text pages list WhatsApp messaging and the company announced native Text-WhatsApp integration; no separate Text channel surcharge is listed.

facts.label: Unified inbox

facts.label: Assignment and routing
facts.value: Smart assignment, manual assignment, chat transfer, ticket assignment, and channel/page/location-based routing are documented.

facts.label: Collaboration

facts.label: Website count

facts.label: Teams and brand separation

facts.label: Help-center surface
facts.value: Text includes a Knowledge hub for AI Agent and Copilot sources, including website pages, files, and in-app articles. A public customer-facing article portal, custom domain, or public article limits were not established in the reviewed product, pricing, and help pages.

facts.label: Article feedback and translations
facts.value: The source guide explains AI knowledge articles and Q&A but does not publish public help-center article voting, feedback, or translation tools.

facts.label: Autonomous AI role
facts.value: AI Agent answers customers autonomously, works across supported conversations, can use customer context, resolve, collect details, create tickets, and hand off to a person.

facts.label: Agent Copilot

facts.label: AI reporting and review
facts.value: AI Agent performance exposes handled chats, resolutions/rate, CSAT, transferred chats, and sales if the store integration is connected; unresolved questions appear as Knowledge Gaps.

facts.label: Website knowledge

facts.label: File knowledge

facts.label: Article and Q&A knowledge

facts.label: Source citations and refresh
facts.value: The reviewed setup pages describe source scanning and auto-updates but do not promise that customer-facing AI answers include clickable citations.

facts.label: Human takeover

facts.label: No-agent fallback

facts.label: Outside-hours handling
