facts.label: Customer details and tickets
facts.value: AI Agent can collect optional name/email details and create or update a ticket with issue, status, content, and visitor information.

facts.label: External actions
facts.value: Skills and integrations can run workflow actions such as creating a lead in Salesforce, notifying Slack, or updating Shopify-connected data.

facts.label: Shopify
facts.value: Official Shopify integration can show cart/order context and supports sales reporting tied to chats and AI-assisted orders.

facts.label: WordPress and WooCommerce
facts.value: Text provides a WordPress plugin; WooCommerce data can add cart/product context.

facts.label: Webflow
facts.value: Text supports a guided Webflow install/marketplace route for widget, tickets, and AI Agent.

facts.label: Messenger and Instagram
facts.value: Messenger connects Facebook Business Pages; Instagram connection supports Business or Creator accounts, DMs, and story replies.

facts.label: Twilio SMS
facts.value: Text's SMS connection uses the customer's Twilio account.

facts.label: Salesforce and Slack
facts.value: Text materials describe Skills/workflows that can create a Salesforce lead or notify Slack; both are named in Text's integration ecosystem.

facts.label: Developer API and usage
facts.value: Text publishes platform APIs and SDK documentation. Essential includes 10,000 API calls/month, Growth 20,000/month, Enterprise custom; a 100,000-call package is listed at USD 29.50.

facts.label: Webhooks and widget SDK
facts.value: Public docs cover widget JavaScript API, React/Vue/Angular installation routes, and webhooks/configuration APIs.

facts.label: Developer API billing
facts.value: Platform marketplace apps have no extra API charge; private API calls use a separate tiered meter or package pricing.

facts.label: Self-hosting
facts.value: Not applicable: Text is offered as vendor-hosted SaaS; reviewed terms and install guides do not publish a customer-operated core server edition.

facts.label: Widget interface languages
facts.value: Widget labels and interface are listed in 48 languages; customization setting changes the interface, not the content of customer/agent messages.

facts.label: AI response languages
facts.value: AI Agent language settings permit all languages or a selected subset; Text's widget feature page says AI replies are supported in 45 languages.

facts.label: Plan gate for multilingual support
facts.value: One pricing-table row marks “Multilingual” included across plans, while a later “Multilingual support” row under widget features marks Essential unavailable and Growth/Enterprise included.

facts.label: Browser and desktop clients
facts.value: Text has a browser app and desktop downloads for macOS (Universal, Apple Silicon, Intel) and Windows (32-bit and 64-bit).

facts.label: Mobile clients
facts.value: Text publishes iOS and Android mobile apps for agent notifications, chat/ticket replies, and account activity.

facts.label: Widget install targets
facts.value: Website widget supports plain HTML, Google Tag Manager, Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, and React/Vue/Angular SDK paths.

facts.label: WordPress requirements
facts.value: WordPress install guide lists WordPress 6.0+ and PHP 7.4+; the plugin is free to install but requires a Text account.

facts.label: Public customer access
facts.value: Text offers an embedded widget and standalone chat page; no separate customer mobile app is required to contact a business through the website widget.

facts.label: Chat and ticket reporting
facts.value: Reports include chat/ticket metrics, satisfaction, first/average response time, duration, ticket resolution/handling time, team performance, and CSV export.

facts.label: AI reporting
facts.value: AI reporting includes resolutions/rate, AI-handled volume, CSAT, transfer rate, knowledge gaps, and Shopify-attributed sales where connected.

facts.label: Report customization
facts.value: Metrics Breakdown can be exported as CSV; custom report sections currently require contacting Text support according to the guide.

facts.label: Chat and ticket report export
facts.value: Raw reports export chats, tickets, and teammate performance as CSV with customer details, rating, IDs, dates, and interaction data.

facts.label: Individual transcript export
facts.value: Archived chats can be sent by email or downloaded; sender can choose whether to include system messages, private notes, and session variables.

facts.label: Data export before cancellation
facts.value: DPA says clients may access, export, and delete their Client Data during the subscription using available tools; support can assist in a verified written request within 30 days if no tool exists.

facts.label: Migration scope
facts.value: LiveChat migration page says setup and chats come with the customer; the HelpDesk and ChatBot pages reviewed do not publish equivalent guaranteed migration inventories for every legacy account.

facts.label: Contracting and processing roles
facts.value: Text, Inc. is the U.S. provider; privacy policy says it can act as a processor for Client Data and controller for its own operational/account data.

facts.label: Hosting/data region
facts.value: Privacy and DPA describe international processing and transfer safeguards but do not publish a selectable hosting region or a complete data-residency location for customer content.

facts.label: AI use and training
facts.value: Terms state AI may use Text-developed or third-party technology and warn generated output can be inaccurate. The checked legal pages do not state a specific built-in model or a clear customer-content training opt-out/commitment.

facts.label: Subprocessors and safeguards
facts.value: Privacy policy links a subprocessor list and describes providers for hosting, messaging, analytics, security, and AI; Trust page advertises SOC 2 Type 2.

facts.label: Conversation history by plan
facts.value: Essential includes 60 days of conversation/file history; Growth and Enterprise list unlimited history.

facts.label: Ticket archive and trash
facts.value: Tickets with Pending, Solved, or Closed status are auto-archived after 60 days' inactivity; Trash tickets are permanently deleted after 30 days' inactivity.

facts.label: Account deletion and backup
facts.value: DPA allows access/export/delete through available tools and states data may remain in protected backups after termination for legal, compliance, or evidentiary needs.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Text is an active, hosted customer-service product at text.com, with AI Agent, live chat, inbox, ticketing, and automation.

facts.label: Legal company and product distinction
facts.value: Text, Inc. is the U.S. service provider/subsidiary; Text S.A. is the Polish parent company. The current product name is Text, formerly called Text App in company announcements.

facts.label: Relationship to LiveChat
facts.value: New signups from LiveChat.com start on Text. Existing LiveChat customers keep their LiveChat accounts and plans; they can optionally move to Text, carrying core setup and chats, at their current subscription price according to the migration page.

facts.label: Relationship to HelpDesk
facts.value: HelpDesk.com recommends Text App for new setups and sends its pricing/signup route into Text. Existing customers can still use the previous HelpDesk workflow, which remains documented.

facts.label: Relationship to ChatBot
facts.value: ChatBot.com pricing now sells Text plans with Text’s AI Agent. The former ChatBot Visual Builder and AI Assist workflow remains available to existing ChatBot users.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Text S.A. is headquartered in Wrocław, Poland; Text, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary with a Boston office and contracting address.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Terms require business/commercial use and prohibit use from or on behalf of U.S.-sanctioned countries/regions or restricted parties; examples listed include Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Syria, Russia, and Belarus.

facts.label: Edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary SaaS with browser, desktop, and mobile agent access plus customer-facing widgets.

facts.label: Standard product support
facts.value: Plans list 24/7/365 support; help page directs users to in-app/site chat or support email.

facts.label: Enterprise support
facts.value: Enterprise lists SLAs, product expert, training, legal assistance, and software-engineer help; standard plans do not list those negotiated services.

facts.label: Freshness and lifecycle
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-09. Text is currently offered and actively updated; the help center has a guide updated Nov 6, 2026, and the blog has posts through Nov 6, 2026.

facts.label: Sale, shutdown, rebrand, and incident review
facts.value: Checked Text blog, product updates/changelog, Press/newsroom, investor news, and status history plus a web news search for sale/acquisition, shutdown, and rebrand since Jan 2025. No Text sale, product shutdown, or closure notice was found in those sources.

facts.label: Recent status history
facts.value: Status page was operational at check; history lists short resolved incidents on Nov 4–5, 2026 affecting ticket loading, canned responses, supervision, and takeover.

apps.name: ThriveDesk
apps.line: Shared customer support inbox for email, website chat, and forms.

cells.channels: Email, website chat, forms, help center
cells.ai: Credit-based; included allowance and rates unclear

agents.math: The Basic plan includes two teammates and one inbox. One person works.
The Standard plan includes five teammates and two inboxes. Three people work.

apps.news: ThriveDesk announced a refreshed brand identity on November 1, 2026, including a new logo, mascot, colors/type and rebuilt site; the announcement says existing accounts, data, plans, prices, integrations and team remain unchanged.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: About page explicitly says no ongoing free plan; new accounts have a temporary trial.

facts.label: Free-plan limits
facts.value: Not applicable: no current ongoing free plan was established. Trial rules are recorded separately.

facts.label: Trial and expiry
facts.value: Seven days; no card. Account pauses afterward until a plan is selected; trial data retained thirty days.

facts.label: Basic pricing
facts.value: USD 29/month paid monthly, or USD 19/month equivalent billed yearly. Includes two teammates and one inbox.

facts.label: Standard pricing
facts.value: USD 69/month paid monthly, or USD 49/month equivalent billed yearly. Includes five teammates and two inboxes.

facts.label: Unlimited pricing
facts.value: USD 129/month paid monthly, or USD 99/month equivalent billed yearly. Unlimited teammates and five inboxes.

facts.label: Taxes and billing intermediary
facts.value: Prices exclude tax. Paddle.com Market Ltd. is reseller/merchant of record and adds/remits required sales tax/VAT at checkout; periods paid in advance.

facts.label: Published add-ons
facts.value: Extra inbox USD 15/month; extra knowledge base USD 20/month; remove ThriveDesk branding USD 50/month.

facts.label: Billing model conflict
facts.value: Current pricing/subscription say flat plans with included teammates; June billing guide still gives USD 15/user Pro billing and per-user prorated examples.

facts.label: Teammate limit conflict
facts.value: Pricing cards/table specify two Basic, five Standard, unlimited Unlimited; same page's FAQ says any account can add unlimited support agents.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Lowest current paid purchase is one Basic plan, including two teammate slots. Monthly or annual commitment; one product/email inbox fits Basic.

facts.label: Cancellation/notice conflict
facts.value: Subscription agreement says cancel from billing settings at any time, effective at paid-period end; main terms also require at least one month's written/email notice for termination.

facts.label: Plan changes and renewal
facts.value: Auto-renews until cancellation; upgrades immediate/prorated, downgrades next period after reducing usage to limits. Price increases get at least thirty days email notice and apply at next renewal.

facts.label: AI pricing conflict
facts.value: October product facts say AI is included on every plan with no extra/per-resolution fee; AI help docs still allocate monthly credits, meter actions and sell credit bundles.

facts.label: Managed AI credit examples
facts.value: June guide: default draft five credits, potentially eight to ten on longer threads; labeling one, potentially two to four with 100+ labels; prioritization one. Chatbot examples vary by model, including four or six to ten credits/request.

facts.label: Training credit units
facts.value: Guide: article one credit; website crawl one; scraped/document page one per 5,000 cleaned-text characters; ticket/conversation embedding 0.5 credit.

facts.label: BYOK metering conflict
facts.value: BYOK guide says one ThriveDesk credit per action; credit guide also says this generally, but its chatbot table instead says fifty percent off token-based cost. BYOK requires Standard or higher in credit docs.

facts.label: Provider fallback
facts.value: BYOK supports OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Grok and DeepSeek; only one custom provider active. If it fails or is disabled, Neo automatically takes over and account is notified.

facts.label: 100/500 AI examples
facts.value: Our conditional calculation from five-credit default drafts: 100 calls × 5 = 500 credits; 500 × 5 = 2,500 credits. BYOK non-bot draft at one credit/call would use 100/500 credits, plus provider charges.

facts.label: Credit rollover and exhaustion
facts.value: Help guide: monthly credits do not roll over; purchased bundle credits do not expire. At the limit, chatbot shows a try-again-later message; upgrade, buy credits or wait for next billing-cycle reset.

facts.label: Refund policy conflict
facts.value: Current October terms/subscription give full refund within fourteen days of first monthly/yearly payment, no renewal refund; June billing guide still advertises thirty days.

facts.label: Failed payments and resource limits
facts.value: Paddle retries; after fourteen days unpaid account may pause, with no deletion while paused for non-payment. For plan usage beyond limits, vendor says it asks for upgrade before restricting.

facts.label: Brand-removal price conflict
facts.value: Current add-on lists USD 50/month to remove ThriveDesk branding; Assistant guide instead says Pro-plan users toggle branding, with a Powered by mark for others.

facts.label: Surface customization
facts.value: Assistant supports logo/colors/icon/position/text; Docs supports custom domain, logo, colors/fonts. Complete credit-removal scope for widget, help center and outgoing email was not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service seven-day trial and plan selection; Basic includes two teammates, so a solo operator can start without sales approval. Optional demo route also exists.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted shared inbox/help desk for email, web chat and forms, with help centers, ecommerce actions and AI assistance. Overlaps knowledge bases, customer messaging and ecommerce support.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native shared inbox: inbound email/forwarding and replies from the application or email are included on Basic and above.

facts.label: Website/in-app web chat
facts.value: Native live-chat Assistant on websites/web applications, included Basic and above; JavaScript installation and API control documented.

facts.label: Ticket/contact forms
facts.value: Pricing includes in-app forms on all plans; help-center contact-form feature starts Standard. Assistant can collect name/subject/message/attachments.

facts.label: WhatsApp and Messenger availability
facts.value: Current pricing/integrations mark WhatsApp/Messenger as Coming soon, while Service Description lists them among service channels.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Business-hours guide lists Facebook/Instagram/WhatsApp as unselectable. No published available native Instagram inbox/price was established.

facts.label: Voice/phone
facts.value: Phone integration imports externally emailed MP3/WAV voicemails into conversations with private call metadata; official FAQ explicitly says ThriveDesk does not make/take phone calls.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: No operational native SMS inbox or rate was established despite the combined Phone & SMS navigation label.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Official integration sends selected conversation/chat events to mapped Slack channels or people, with conversation links; one Slack team/domain per ThriveDesk account.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: Native customer Discord ingestion/agent reply integration was not established.

facts.label: Core workflow
facts.value: Basic includes assignment, private notes, mentions, tags, merge, search, collision detection and instant/auto replies; Standard adds rule templates/custom workflow builder and CSAT.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Standard+: owner/admin sets inbox/channel schedules, holidays and timezone; conditions/out-of-hours replies follow that schedule. Applies to email/ticket and live chat.

facts.label: Inboxes/sites/brands
facts.value: Basic one inbox, Standard two, Unlimited five; extra inbox USD 15/month. Multiple assistants/help centers support brands, but numeric current assistant/site limits are not fully listed.

facts.label: Knowledge-base add-ons and limits
facts.value: Standard includes one public help center; Unlimited adds private/multiple centers. Extra knowledge base USD 20/month; exact number of included Unlimited centers not specified in current pricing.

facts.label: Help-center availability conflict
facts.value: Current pricing begins public Docs at Standard and private/WordPress portal at Unlimited; June billing guide says every plan includes at least one Docs site.

facts.label: Content, search and domain
facts.value: Docs offers article/category editing, search, SEO controls, feedback/analytics and Assistant articles. Default host is customer.thrivedeskdocs.com; custom subdomain has no extra domain fee.

facts.label: Article and translation limits
facts.value: June billing guide says no cap on collections/categories/articles per Docs site; a complete current help-center translation quota/matrix was not found.

facts.label: AI role
facts.value: Neo autonomously answers email/chat, uses configured knowledge/actions and escalates; team Copilot drafts/summarizes/searches. Skills encode step-by-step procedures and actions.

facts.label: External AI-client role
facts.value: Standard+ MCP lets approved AI clients read/work tickets, live chat, contacts and reports using scoped workspace permissions.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs and sync
facts.value: Help center, site pages/sections, PDFs/Word/spreadsheets, snippets, Q&A and historical team replies. Article changes sync; web pages weekly or Sync now; replace files by uploading a new version.

facts.label: Citations and review
facts.value: Training page describes source-linked answers, internal-only sources for team drafts, and human approval before suggestions from past team replies go live. Incorrect answers can be saved as snippets/article edits/guidance.

facts.label: Knowledge-size quotas
facts.value: Current per-plan trained-source/page/storage/file limits and a fixed source citation contract for every answer were not found.

facts.label: Human fallback and history
facts.value: Rules/guidance can hand off on topic/sentiment/customer request and route by team/language/brand. Teammate receives conversation history, private summary and work already done.

facts.label: Live-chat fallback/transcript controls
facts.value: Assistant can be shown only when an agent is available; otherwise always-visible setting exists. Optional emailed transcript requires email captured before chat ends.

facts.label: Actions and approval
facts.value: Vendor tools page describes store/order lookups, shipping-address update, cancellation, Stripe refunds, custom API and connected MCP tools; each can run Direct or wait for a teammate approval, with usage log.

facts.label: Customer identity boundary
facts.value: Assistant identify(name,email) only prefills/skips questions. Developer guide says it is not verification and no public JWT/HMAC identity contract is documented; sensitive data requires the buyer's authenticated backend.

facts.label: MCP approval and permissions
facts.value: User chooses one workspace and read-only/standard/full or individual grants, bounded by role and inbox membership; can revoke. Reply/live-chat/forward actions send immediately; drafts/notes do not.

facts.label: Relevant connections
facts.value: Directory names WooCommerce, Shopify, SureCart, Easy Digital Downloads, Freemius, Slack, Zapier, Make, Pabbly and WordPress. Tools page also describes Stripe/custom API actions.

facts.label: Linear/GitHub/Discord detail
facts.value: Turnkey Linear, GitHub or customer Discord connectors with plan/fee documentation were not established.

facts.label: Developer availability and gates
facts.value: API Terms say developer access comes with account; current plan table restricts External API calls to Unlimited. MCP explicitly starts Standard; Assistant SDK/webhooks have public docs.

facts.label: REST authentication/limits
facts.value: Public bearer-token API; key expires after one year. Global default 300 requests/minute per client IP; registration ten/minute, verification five/minute; list default twenty/max one hundred records.

facts.label: Webhooks and JS SDK
facts.value: Signed event callbacks use X-TD-SIGNATURE; any 2xx succeeds, 410 disables/deletes subscription, repeated failures eventually discard event. Assistant global API initializes/controls widget.

facts.label: Self-hosting core
facts.value: Not applicable: ThriveDesk operates and updates the hosted core; optional WordPress connector does not establish a self-hosted help-desk edition.

facts.label: Optional WordPress connector setup
facts.value: Current connector 2.7.1 requires WordPress 4.9+ and PHP 7.4+. Install/activate the free plugin, connect a ThriveDesk account/API key, choose the Assistant; script/snippet installation is an alternative.

facts.label: AI and widget language
facts.value: Neo is advertised in 50+ languages and follows customer's language without translating every source. Assistant lets operators translate/edit each visible label.

facts.label: Agent/help-content languages
facts.value: The official translate-ThriveDesk article returned title/navigation but no substantive instructions; a complete current agent-UI/help-article locale matrix was not established.

facts.label: Devices and host platform
facts.value: Hosted web app, native iOS/Android agent apps and browser JavaScript Assistant. Optional WordPress portal on Unlimited; WordPress/Shopify are not required for the base service.

facts.label: Reporting and feedback
facts.value: Product facts describe response/resolution times, channel volume, CSAT and teammate reports; help center has article/search insights. Current pricing gates CSAT from Standard.

facts.label: AI answer review
facts.value: Training workspace groups unanswered/escalated topics, lets staff mark wrong answers and publish fixes/articles from approved team responses.

facts.label: Conversation export/developer route
facts.value: Current REST docs retrieve conversation metadata and full thread events including incoming/outgoing messages, notes, drafts, scheduled/system events; guide walks inbox pages for initial sync.

facts.label: Attachment/contact/article routes
facts.value: MCP docs provide contact read/search/update, full chat transcript, KB search and temporary attachment download links, within authorized workspace/inboxes.

facts.label: Export freshness conflict
facts.value: Privacy still says machine-readable Inbox API is coming soon; current developer docs already describe public conversation/thread/sync endpoints.

facts.label: Portable full export gaps
facts.value: Complete bulk contact/article/feedback/media export format and delivered all-object archive were not found. DPA promises export rights; data-request page offers machine-readable portability via support.

facts.label: Hosting location conflict
facts.value: Service/security/DPA say all servers in US; pricing FAQ says AWS servers/locations, while October processor list names Azure UK, Hetzner US, MongoDB US and globally located services.

facts.label: AI processing and training
facts.value: Processor list names OpenRouter for Neo/Copilot/embeddings and Azure OpenAI; Firecrawl reads configured website training sources. GDPR FAQ says no model training/fine-tuning on conversations; sources are retrieved at answer time.

facts.label: User-selected AI services
facts.value: BYOK keys route through selected providers; external MCP client's provider processes what the authorized client reads under that provider's terms.

facts.label: DPA
facts.value: Published DPA applies to customer-data processing; signed copy available by email. Customer controls support data; ThriveDesk acts as processor, with stated subprocessor and transfer clauses.

facts.label: Active retention and cancellation window
facts.value: GDPR/privacy say conversations retained up to five years while active. Subscription/DPA give thirty days after subscription ends to export, then delete; backups clear within sixty days unless law requires retention.

facts.label: Instant deletion conflict
facts.value: Pricing FAQ promises all account data removed instantly; privacy/subscription/DPA describe thirty-day post-subscription retention and up to sixty-day backup clearing.

facts.label: End-user deletion/request route
facts.value: Docs say delete the customer's conversations then contact record; remaining data can be requested by support. Data requests normally answered within one month, with up to two more for complexity.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: ThriveDesk; active hosted customer-support platform. Neo is its AI agent and mascot; Copilot is team-facing AI, not a separate app record.

facts.label: Brand rebrand/refresh continuity
facts.value: New logo, colors, mascot and website; announcement says existing account, data, plan, price and integrations stay unchanged and the same team remains.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: ThriveDesk LLC, registered in the United States; main terms specify Wyoming law. Company describes itself as independent since 2021.

facts.label: Market restrictions
facts.value: Complete buying-country restrictions and region-specific purchase offers were not found in checked pricing/terms/subscription pages.

facts.label: Editions and hosting
facts.value: Vendor-operated web service, plus optional WordPress plugin/portal and browser chat SDK. No self-hosted core installation is offered in the checked service description.

facts.label: WordPress connector licence
facts.value: Connector 2.7.1 is free public source. README and main header say GPLv2 or later, but the same file's grant paragraph says GPL version 3 or later.

facts.label: Vendor support
facts.value: Human help via help@thrivedesk.com/contact and public help center; marketing promises a reply within an hour. No formal universal service-credit SLA is included unless separately agreed.

facts.label: Support schedule
facts.value: Exact staffed hours/timezone, weekend coverage and contractual support-response guarantee were not found.

facts.label: Freshness and review date
facts.value: Checked 2026-11-05; v5 release October 1 and brand refresh updated November 1, 2026. Our next review target December 5, 2026, with priority for unresolved billing/AI/legal discrepancies.

apps.name: Tidio
apps.line: Customer support inbox for live chat, email tickets, and AI answers.

cells.ai: $75/month for 100 Lyro conversations

agents.math: The Starter plan covers 100 human conversations a month and ten seats.
The same project price covers three of the ten seats and 100 conversations.

apps.news: No qualifying sale or merger, rebrand, product shutdown or sunset, pivot away, closed signups, major paid-feature retirement, customer-data breach, regulatory action, or licence change found.

facts.label: Free plan
facts.value: Ongoing Free plan, not just the 7-day trial; no payment details required.

facts.label: Free agents and support
facts.value: 10 agent seats; 50 human-handled conversations/month per project, shared across chat, tickets/email, and social channels.

facts.label: Free automation
facts.value: Flows reach 100 unique visitors/month; 50 Lyro conversations once for the project's lifetime; 1 Action on Free.

facts.label: Guidance allowance discrepancy
facts.value: Current pricing comparison shows 5 Guidance items on Free/Starter/Growth; Free and package help guides say 1 free and 3 on paid Lyro.

facts.label: Free contacts, storage, and history
facts.value: No consolidated numerical contact/storage/article/history allowance for Free was found.

facts.label: Trial
facts.value: 7 days from creating a new project; no credit card; paid features available for evaluation, with quota limits.

facts.label: Trial end
facts.value: Continue on Free or buy a subscription. Pricing says automatic Free downgrade; help guides show a Free/upgrade choice in the panel.

facts.label: Starter
facts.value: USD 29/month monthly for 100 billable human conversations and 10 seats; annual display USD 24.17/month, with 2 months free.

facts.label: Growth entry
facts.value: USD 59/month monthly for 250 billable conversations and 10 seats; annual display starts at USD 49.17/month.

facts.label: Growth volume levels
facts.value: Public pricing configuration: 400 conversations USD 89/month; 600 USD 129; 800 USD 159; 1,000 USD 179; 1,500 USD 249; 2,000 USD 349, monthly billing.

facts.label: Plus and Premium
facts.value: Plus starts USD 300/month plus monthly usage; custom quotas/seats. Premium is quote-only, with managed AI and pay-per-resolution terms.

facts.label: Annual bill and taxes
facts.value: Our calculation from 2 months free: Starter USD 29 ×10 = USD 290/year. Tidio's own Shopify listing also publishes USD 290/year. Applicable taxes are extra under terms.

facts.label: Human billing unit
facts.value: Pricing counts a conversation when a human responds or proactively initiates it; human quota excludes Lyro and Flows replies.

facts.label: Counting trigger discrepancy
facts.value: Monthly quota guide says human conversation is counted when solved; pricing says when a human replies/starts it. The guide says reset normally on the 1st; Free guide says activation/purchase anniversary.

facts.label: Minimum purchase
facts.value: Standard Starter is one project subscription with 10 included seats; monthly or annual recurring billing. No mandatory extra seat pack established for one or three workers.

facts.label: Setup and custom commitments
facts.value: A universal setup fee, minimum Plus/Premium contract length, and complete custom minimum total were not established.

facts.label: Lyro standard subscription
facts.value: From USD 39/month monthly for 50 Lyro conversations; annual display USD 32.50/month. Standard paid quota selectable from 50 to 1,000/month; higher quotas by custom quote.

facts.label: Lyro example package levels
facts.value: Public pricing configuration: 100 AI conversations USD 75/month; 500 USD 350/month, monthly payment.

facts.label: AI counting conflict
facts.value: Detailed Lyro guide closes a thread after 15 minutes of inactivity and charges a later AI reply as another thread; pricing FAQ says returning later remains one conversation.

facts.label: Premium AI unit
facts.value: Premium advertises pay-per-resolution billing and a 50% resolution-rate guarantee; rate, contractual definition, minimum spend, and remedy require a quote.

facts.label: Copilot and external model costs
facts.value: No separate standard Copilot usage quota/unit fee, per-model multiplier, or external model-key charge was established in the checked pricing, Copilot guide, or AI terms.

facts.label: Small AI examples
facts.value: Our calculation with monthly Starter and auto-upgrades disabled: 1 or 3 agents +100 Lyro threads = USD 104/month; +500 = USD 379/month.

facts.label: Default automatic upgrades
facts.value: Eligible new standard monthly projects have automatic upgrades enabled by default: warning at 80%, next package at 95% usage. Can be disabled.

facts.label: When human/AI/Flows limits stop service
facts.value: Without an applicable upgrade, human cap blocks replies and details of further incoming communication; Lyro quota exhaustion stops Lyro; Flows quota exhaustion stops Flows.

facts.label: AI fair use
facts.value: Terms allow queuing/throttling after combined Input/Output token use exceeds the customer-wide 95th percentile for 2 consecutive days, with at least 24 hours' email notice before sustained throttling.

facts.label: Channel and attachment extras
facts.value: WhatsApp can add country-dependent message fees. Standard shared files are up to 10 MB; pricing marks its "100mb file upload size" Lyro feature and larger attachments on Plus/Premium.

facts.label: Widget branding
facts.value: Growth can buy No Tidio Branding; current annual pricing display says USD 16.67/month. Plus/Premium include removal. Free/Starter comparison marks no removal.

facts.label: Own main widget logo
facts.value: Main Brand Logo replacement control is available on Plus.

facts.label: Email and Help Center attribution
facts.value: Separate Help Center/email attribution-removal rules and their exact first plan were not found.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service Free and standard paid upgrades; Plus/Premium through sales. Signup link observed: https://www.tidio.com/panel/register .

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: shared customer-support inbox with web chat, email, social messaging, help articles, fixed Flows, and autonomous AI; ecommerce connections are a prominent use case.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native embedded live chat, including Free; public Chat Page is separately gated to a Customer Service subscription and Support verification.

facts.label: Email tickets

facts.value: Pro includes 5M AI tokens/month and 20 configured AI Agents; Business 10M and 50; Enterprise advertises unlimited by quote.

facts.value: No exact 100/500 autonomous-conversation total for self-hosting without a model, prompts/output lengths, deployment and provider/compute rates.

facts.value: Automatic token recharge, numeric expansion/extra-user pricing, credit expiry/rollover and inactive-hosted-account deletion clock not established.

facts.value: Astra simple text response/simple action uses one credit; rich response or advanced action uses three; voice-agent use consumes eight credits/minute.

facts.value: Growth 1,000, Pro 2,000, Business 5,000 automation triggers/month. Price-page FAQ says after allowance, respond manually or buy more triggers; 1,000 extra shown at INR 1,000/month.

facts.label: Message rate-card retrieval
facts.value: Growth INR rate card linked from pricing could not be read with the web tool; exact destination/category rates not verified.

facts.label: Messaging wallet auto-recharge
facts.value: Optional threshold-based auto-recharge documented for USD payments; unavailable for INR payments. Manual top-up minimum shown as $10 in that guide.

facts.label: Cancellation and account access
facts.value: Terms say subscription runs to term end; cancellation guide says account becomes inaccessible immediately and requests at least three days before renewal.

facts.label: Refunds and nonpayment

facts.label: Paid plans / monthly Basic
facts.value: Basic: $149/month billed monthly; 3,000 AI replies; two agents; unlimited paid seats.

facts.label: Paid plans / monthly Scale
facts.value: Scale: $499/month billed monthly; 10,000 AI replies; four agents; unlimited paid seats.

facts.value: Annual toggle shows $32.50/month Starter, $125/month Basic, and $417/month Scale, with two months free / 17% savings.

facts.label: Paid plans / Enterprise
facts.value: Enterprise is custom priced and sold through a demo/sales route; annual credit commitment is custom.

facts.value: Pricing shows $ without an ISO currency code. Terms say references to currency mean Singapore currency unless an SOW says otherwise; an older tax-help page displays US$.

facts.value: VAT/GST may apply at checkout; the help article describes entering a business registration number to exclude VAT/GST where eligible.

facts.label: Billing unit
facts.value: Current plans meter monthly AI reply credits, not seats or reported resolutions. One customer question plus the agent answer is one AI reply on a fast model; a frontier-model answer can consume more than one credit.

facts.label: Seat billing
facts.value: Free has two seats; all paid plans list unlimited team seats at no per-seat fee.

facts.label: Retired billing model
facts.value: Older docs and pages describe weighted message credits and per-message prices; the 2026 guide says that model was retired.

facts.label: Minimum purchase / seats
facts.value: Free includes two seats; paid plans say unlimited seats, with no paid seat minimum shown.

facts.label: Minimum purchase / contract and setup
facts.value: Current pricing offers monthly and yearly billing and says plans can be changed at any time; Terms require an SOW, allow a 1-month or 1-year initial term depending on plan, and otherwise renew annually with 30 days’ written notice.

facts.label: Minimum spend / add-ons
facts.value: No minimum spend, setup fee, or mandatory add-on is shown for Starter, Basic, or Scale.

facts.label: AI charges / allowance
facts.value: Included AI replies/month: Free 50, Starter 500, Basic 3,000, Scale 10,000, Enterprise custom. Allowance resets monthly.

facts.label: AI charges / model choice
facts.value: Fast models consume one credit per reply. Frontier models, available from Basic, may consume more than one credit per reply; no exact multiplier table is published.

facts.label: AI charges / external model fees
facts.value: Pricing presents credits as included in the Wonderchat plan. No separate customer-side model-provider charge is stated for using the listed models.

facts.label: AI cost examples / 100 fast replies
facts.value: Our calculation: 100 fast-model replies exceed Free’s 50-credit allowance; Starter costs $39 for the month and includes 500 replies. Annual option is $390/year by our calculation.

facts.value: Our calculation: Starter at $39/month includes exactly 500 fast-model reply credits. Frontier use may consume more credits per reply and requires Basic or above.

facts.label: Extra charges / limit behavior
facts.value: Pricing says Wonderchat alerts at 80% use and the AI stops responding unless credits are topped up; the current guide says exhausted allowance shows a handover form to reach a person.

facts.label: Extra charges / top-ups
facts.value: Current pricing mentions topping up credits but does not publish the current price, amount, expiry, or automatic recharge rule.

facts.label: Extra charges / channel and tax fees
facts.value: Wonderchat’s current price table does not itemize third-party channel charges; VAT/GST can apply separately.

facts.value: Pricing says the “Powered by Wonderchat” badge remains through Scale and is removed on Enterprise; older technical FAQ says removal is not offered on retail plans.

facts.label: Branding / email and other surfaces

facts.value: Current changelog says tickets can be read, drafted/replied to, assigned, prioritized, internally noted, and closed through Wonderchat’s MCP server.

facts.value: Live chat can have local-time opening hours and can be disabled on selected days.

facts.value: Current pricing says manual recrawl on Free, monthly retraining on Starter/Basic, and weekly on Scale; the agent can cite website URLs or PDF pages.

facts.value: The recent guide describes an unanswered-question Review queue and corrections. Whether all generated answers can be held for approval before delivery was not established in pricing, docs FAQ, or review guides.

facts.value: Current guide says Shopify can be connected without code; older Shopify installation guide describes manual theme-code embedding.

facts.value: API export returns chat logs with timestamps, chatbot ID, optional contact details, feedback, resolution state, page URL, and user/bot messages; a second endpoint returns individual message text and timestamps.

facts.value: Terms permit Customer Data export on request during the subscription or within 90 days after termination.

facts.label: Lifecycle / acquisition
facts.value: No official Wonderchat shutdown, sunset, or acquisition announcement found.

facts.value: No geographic eligibility or restricted-country list found.

facts.value: Default deletion process begins nine months after trial end without subscription; Voice trials instead begin deletion after 90 days.

facts.label: Support Team price
facts.value: USD 19/agent/month paid yearly; USD 25/agent/month with monthly billing.

facts.label: Suite Team price
facts.value: USD 55/agent/month paid yearly; USD 69/agent/month with monthly billing.

facts.label: Suite Professional price
facts.value: USD 115/agent/month paid yearly; USD 149/agent/month with monthly billing.

facts.label: Enterprise and other editions
facts.value: Current Suite Enterprise + Copilot card: sales quote. Exact new-customer prices for other documented standalone/legacy editions not established.

facts.label: Taxes
facts.value: Contractual charges exclude applicable taxes; customer is responsible for taxes described in the agreement.

facts.label: Paid seat counting
facts.value: Account owner, admins, and full agents consume seats; role-based exceptions exist for light agents, contributors, and Explore viewers.

facts.label: Light agents and customers
facts.value: Suite Team can buy light-agent seats; Growth includes 50, Professional 100, Enterprise 1,000, Enterprise Plus 5,000. End users do not need agent licences.

facts.label: Base minimum purchase
facts.value: No explicit larger seat floor, compulsory onboarding fee, or mandatory add-on found for Support Team or Suite Team. Exact contractual minimum remains unconfirmed.

facts.label: Commitment and reducing the bill
facts.value: Monthly, annual, and negotiated terms exist. Standard terms prohibit mid-term seat reductions/downgrades and require written nonrenewal notice at least 30 days before renewal.

facts.label: Specific optional minimum
facts.value: High Volume API add-on requires at least ten agent seats on eligible Suite Growth+ or Support Professional+ accounts.

facts.label: Current resolution tiers
facts.value: System introduced May 18, 2026: assisted escalation and contained resolution do not consume allowance; verified resolution does. Verification uses an LLM after conversation end.

facts.label: Current default allowance / Team
facts.value: Support Team and Suite Team: USD 2 per paid agent seat/month in the resolution-allowance model.

facts.label: Current default allowance / other plans
facts.value: Suite Growth/Professional USD 5/seat/month; Suite Enterprise/Enterprise Plus USD 10. Support Professional/Enterprise USD 2.

facts.label: Current tier rate and migration scope
facts.value: Exact verified-resolution price, voice/digital rate difference, and which model a new self-service order receives could not be reconciled from the public pages.

facts.label: Prior platform / included resolutions
facts.value: Explicit pre-tier platform: Suite Team 5, Growth/Professional 10, Enterprise/Enterprise Plus 15 automated resolutions per paid agent/month, allocated for the subscription period with 10,000/year cap.

facts.label: Prior platform / paid unit
facts.value: Public headline USD 1.50 per committed resolution or USD 2 per PAYG resolution; prior-platform purchasing starts at 100 committed resolutions.

facts.label: Copilot versus limited included tools
facts.value: Copilot advertised at USD 50/agent/month paid yearly. Professional's listed limited Copilot tools have five uses/agent/month pooled, capped at 500/account/month.

facts.label: AI examples / current model
facts.value: For 100 or 500 verified resolutions: additional charge is max(0, units × applicable tier rate − monthly allowance); exact result unconfirmed.

facts.label: AI examples / old PAYG rate
facts.value: At the stated USD 2 PAYG rate, 100 additional billable resolutions cost USD 200; 500 cost USD 1,000, after included allowance is exhausted.

facts.label: Current AI overage and stopping
facts.value: Resolution-allowance model defaults to allow overage, billed monthly even with annual base subscription. Selecting Don't allow overage pauses paid-resolution functionality at the limit.

facts.label: Increasing current AI budget
facts.value: Eligible sales-assisted owners/billing admins can add currency in-product. Managed and self-service accounts are instructed to contact sales.

facts.label: Old AI spending controls
facts.value: Prior-platform usage guide offers pause versus overage controls and monthly usage limits.

facts.label: Action credits
facts.value: Team/Growth Suite and Support Team include 40,000/month or 480,000/year; Suite/Support Professional 100,000/month or 1,200,000/year. Extra packs are 100,000 actions through sales/support.

facts.label: Storage / Team
facts.value: Account base 10GB data + 10GB files; paid Team agent adds 50MB data + 2GB files. External content allowance 100MB on Team.

facts.label: Storage / higher tiers and extras
facts.value: Growth/Professional add 100MB data + 5GB files per agent; Enterprise adds 200MB + 10GB. Warning at 80%; over-limit restrictions/charges may apply.

facts.label: Unresolved lifecycle and provider totals
facts.value: Paid-account inactivity deletion rule, exact extra-storage/action-pack prices, and a single worldwide phone/SMS/WhatsApp bill were not established.

facts.label: Messaging widget branding
facts.value: Removing the Zendesk logo from the messaging Web Widget requires Suite Enterprise.

facts.label: Classic widget and help center branding
facts.value: Official removal guide permits removing branding from Web Widget Classic and Guide/help center on any plan that includes that surface.

facts.label: Outgoing email branding
facts.value: Email template footer placeholders can be removed to remove Delivered by Zendesk from most notifications.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service purchasing, with monthly or annual selection and agent quantity; trial not required before purchase. Enterprise + Copilot uses sales.

facts.label: Solo access and signup
facts.value: Pricing FAQ includes individuals; public 14-day trial registration at https://www.zendesk.com/register/ .

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: help desk with shared ticket inbox, customer messaging, help articles, phone support, and AI automation. Overlaps knowledge bases, customer messaging, and community feedback.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email-to-ticket support; Support Team is the entry plan. Connect an external support address by forwarding or supported email setup.

facts.label: Website chat
facts.value: Native current messaging Web Widget on Suite Team+. Persistent conversations; new accounts default to messaging.

facts.label: In-app messaging
facts.value: Native Web Widget for web apps and SDKs for iOS/Android customer apps.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native business messaging on Suite; standalone route requires Support + Chat + Social Messaging add-on.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Native Instagram business direct messages and story replies; not post/reel comments. Suite, or documented standalone product/add-on combination.

facts.label: Facebook Messenger
facts.value: Native private Page messaging; Suite or Support + Chat + Social Messaging add-on.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: Native Zendesk Text, using a supported purchased/ported number; country-specific number and usage fees.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Native telephony in Suite, with number/minute and other consumption charges beyond agent licence.

facts.label: Slack customer messages
facts.value: Native Slack Direct Messages channel, including B2B Slack Connect use.

facts.label: Discord customer channel
facts.value: Native Discord channel or a verified Zendesk-maintained equivalent not located.

facts.label: Ticket and contact forms
facts.value: Native help-center request submission; messaging widget offers customer detail capture rather than the Classic widget's complete contact-form experience.

facts.label: Assignment and private notes
facts.value: Ticket groups/assignees and internal comments form the inbox workflow; business rules can assign and notify.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Macros are manually applied prepared replies/actions; access and macro permissions control who can use them.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: Viewing/editing indicators and ticket-update notices; expressly unavailable on Team plans.

facts.label: Rules and automation
facts.value: Time-based automations run hourly; up to 500 active automations, 1,000 tickets processed per automation/hour, and 100 automation updates per ticket.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Suite Growth/Professional and Support Professional have one schedule; Enterprise supports multiple schedules. Holidays and time zones supported.

facts.label: Brands by edition
facts.value: One default brand across plans; Suite Growth/Professional five; Suite Enterprise/Enterprise Plus 300; standalone Support Enterprise five.

facts.label: Widget and multi-brand boundaries
facts.value: Messaging supports one widget per brand; multi-brand email still uses one account-wide email template.

facts.label: WhatsApp numbers and other capacity
facts.value: Suite includes five WhatsApp numbers; additional capacity is an add-on.

facts.label: Articles and visibility
facts.value: Native help articles with public or restricted visibility; maximum 40,000 articles excluding translations and archived content.

facts.label: Article resource limits
facts.value: Article body up to 1MB per translation; up to 500 attachments/article, maximum 20MB each.

facts.label: Search and custom domain
facts.value: Native help-center search and request submission; own support subdomain supported through CNAME host mapping and SSL setup.

facts.label: Translated articles
facts.value: Multi-language help centers on Suite Growth+; standalone combination requires Guide Professional + Support Professional or above.

facts.label: Customer AI role
facts.value: AI agents can answer customers autonomously through messaging, email, and voice; channel connection and appropriate entitlement required.

facts.label: Staff AI role
facts.value: Copilot assists human agents; auto assist suggests replies/actions, while admins can enable or disable features. It is distinct from autonomous customer AI agents.

facts.label: Current knowledge sources and freshness
facts.value: Connect one or more native Zendesk help centers and external knowledge sources. Native help-center answers use current live content; external content uses last synchronization, typically within 24 hours.

facts.label: External source capacity
facts.value: External content can enter via knowledge connectors, web crawler, or API; platform supports up to 50 external sources.

facts.label: Old Advanced imports
facts.value: Pre-March 10, 2026 Advanced can import Zendesk/Freshdesk/Salesforce help centers, Confluence, CSV, and crawled content; scheduled import options include daily/weekly/monthly.

facts.label: Citations
facts.value: Generative-reply sources can be shown or hidden; shown by default. Customers can open cited article links; CSV data is not listed as a source.

facts.label: Approval and source-specific limits
facts.value: A universal per-source word/document limit or required human approval of every refreshed source was not established.

facts.label: Human handoff and history
facts.value: AI can escalate when unable to answer, when a customer requests a person, or for a complex issue; handoff carries conversation history.

facts.label: Outside-hours fallback
facts.value: Documented workflow escalates to human messaging during business hours and collects details into an email ticket outside hours.

facts.label: Order lookup and refunds
facts.value: Shopify actions include order/customer lookup, cancellation and refund; action flows can connect external systems and custom actions.

facts.label: Action approval and limits
facts.value: Admins can preapprove auto-assist actions; Zendesk recommends human approval for consequential write operations. Action flows: maximum 100 flows and 60 steps/flow.

facts.label: Customer identity checks
facts.value: One-time email-passcode authentication block available for AI conversations in messaging Web Widget.

facts.label: Shopify
facts.value: Official Shopify integration connects multiple storefronts, displays orders in Support, and can enable refunds/cancellations.

facts.label: WooCommerce
facts.value: Zendesk-maintained action-builder connector announced September 4, 2026; customer/product create/update and order/customer/product lookup/search.

facts.label: Stripe
facts.value: Zendesk connector for action flows: customer create/update/lookup/search, subscription cancellation, invoice create/lookup/search.

facts.label: Linear
facts.value: Linear-maintained Marketplace integration creates/links issues from Zendesk and can reopen linked tickets when an issue is completed.

facts.label: GitHub and custom automation
facts.value: Zendesk-maintained GitHub action-flow connector can create/update/search issues and pull requests; uses OAuth and connecting-user permissions. Webhooks can notify an external service.

facts.label: Public API and limits
facts.value: Ticketing REST API available across plans. Support Team/Suite Team 200 requests/minute; Support Professional/Suite Growth/Professional 400; Enterprise 700; Suite Enterprise Plus 2,500.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: All Support plans can configure webhooks used by triggers/automations to send event notifications to external systems.

facts.label: Widget SDKs and private apps
facts.value: Public Web Widget/mobile SDK docs; private Support app installation requires Suite Growth+ or Support Professional+.

facts.label: Self-host operation
facts.value: Not applicable to the hosted subscription researched.

facts.label: Agent and customer interface languages
facts.value: Product-specific locale lists include English, French, German, Spanish, Japanese, and others; Support, widget, mobile apps, and legacy Chat have distinct lists.

facts.label: Help articles
facts.value: Help-center locales and translated articles can be configured independently; Bangla end-user support announced April 15, 2026.

facts.label: AI text and voice languages
facts.value: Text AI documentation names English, Arabic, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, French, German, Japanese, and many others. Transliteration unsupported; automatic-dialogue translation has a narrower list. Voice AI launch states 53 languages.

facts.label: Agent devices
facts.value: Browser-based hosted workspace plus official Zendesk Support apps for iOS and Android. New conversational mobile experience supports Agent Workspace messaging.

facts.label: Customer platform needs
facts.value: Website/web-app script and native mobile SDK installation; no mandatory Gmail, Shopify, WordPress, or macOS host platform.

facts.label: Support reports and satisfaction
facts.value: Explore reports cover ticket volume, first human reply time, resolution time, reopenings, and CSAT including comments.

facts.label: Prebuilt versus custom reporting
facts.value: All Explore editions have prebuilt dashboards; Explore Professional/Enterprise allow custom dashboards/reports.

facts.label: AI review and billing trace
facts.value: Current resolution dashboard links contributing tickets/conversation logs, shows resolution tier and channel, and permits disputes through support.

facts.label: Built-in export gate
facts.value: Main export guide excludes Team; separate Where is the data export option article says any Suite, plus Support Professional/Enterprise.

facts.label: Tickets and customer records
facts.value: JSON/CSV/XML exports have different coverage; JSON supplies ticket/user/organization data. All plans can use REST API export routes.

facts.label: Attachment binaries
facts.value: No built-in single download of every ticket attachment; comments API returns attachment content_url values for separate downloads.

facts.label: AI conversation transcripts
facts.value: AI-agent tickets lack native full-transcript export; Ticket Audits API is the documented programmatic history route.

facts.label: Help articles and article attachments
facts.value: Help Center API can back up article bodies/metadata; article attachment API supplies attachment metadata and content URLs.

facts.label: Article feedback
facts.value: Article Comments API lists comments as JSON; Votes API exposes votes for articles, comments, and community posts/comments.

facts.label: AI usage export
facts.value: Resolution usage dashboard exports CSV: ticket ID, tier, channel group, brand, timestamp, cost; download link lasts 14 days.

facts.label: Hosting and regional choice
facts.value: Data Center Location entitlement plus a selected region is required for a hosting-location commitment; options include US, EEA, UK, Japan, Australia.

facts.label: Regional exceptions
facts.value: Text data US-only; analytics has US/EEA restrictions. AI accounts predating March 10, 2026 limited to US/Belgium without migration; older messaging accounts also have transfer limitations.

facts.label: Subprocessors and privacy roles
facts.value: Published subprocessor policy lists AWS and service-specific providers/locations. Privacy notice mainly covers Zendesk's controller activities; customer Service Data is governed by DPA and service terms.

facts.label: Proprietary model training
facts.value: Zendesk's own models may train on customer data to the extent instructed; customer controls exist. Data-use page describes excluding identifiers and sanitizing free text.

facts.label: Third-party generative models
facts.value: LLM integrations state customer inputs are not used to train provider models; zero retention beyond ephemeral processing. AI addendum limits provider use to providing/securing AI services.

facts.label: Export window
facts.value: On written request, Service Data available for export during the subscription and 30 days after its end, subject to agreement exceptions.

facts.label: Cancellation deletion
facts.value: Default process starts 90 days after cancellation/termination; ticket/user/attachment and help-center structured data then take 40 days; analytics 90, live-chat/Agent Workspace categories 120.

facts.label: Backups and other retained copies
facts.value: Ticketing/help-center/community backups: 130 days after process starts; logs 365; archived emails 90; search indices 70.

facts.label: In-product deletion controls
facts.value: Standard ticket/end-user deletion schedules and redaction are documented across plans; advanced conditional retention policies require Advanced Data Privacy and Protection.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Zendesk; active customer service platform. Support is its ticketing product; Suite combines products and channels.

facts.label: Product and edition names
facts.value: Guide is now described as Knowledge; Gather supplies community forums. Documentation still distinguishes AI agents - Advanced bought before March 10, 2026 from the newer experience.

facts.label: Company and country
facts.value: Zendesk, Inc., a Delaware corporation, with applicable affiliates or successors; US legal entity and San Francisco legal notice address.

facts.label: Regional commercial terms
facts.value: Eligible Brazilian accounts can be offered BRL billing with a valid CPF/CNPJ; Zendesk Brasil Software Corporativo Ltda. is the specified Brazilian contracting party.

facts.label: Geographic restrictions
facts.value: Official March 10, 2022 announcement suspended sales in Russia and Belarus and said existing relationships would end as subscriptions expired.

facts.label: Hosted edition and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription service with limited contractual access rights. Embedded widgets, SDKs, and integrations extend the service.

facts.label: Current versus legacy plans
facts.value: Support documentation has current and pre-February 1, 2021 sections. Suite Growth, Enterprise, and Enterprise Plus remain documented even though the main current pricing cards differ.

facts.label: Standard vendor support
facts.value: Standard support: local business hours five days/week, described as 8×5 via messaging, webform, callback; docs and community available.

facts.label: Paid Premier support
facts.value: Premier offers 24/7 English technical support; critical first response within 30 minutes, major within one hour. Pricing based on annual licence spend.

facts.label: Freshness and operation
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. October 2026 release notes include voice AI general availability, AI-ticket redaction and resolution allowance updates.

facts.label: Next review
facts.value: Our proposed next review: December 4, 2026; review sooner before buying AI capacity, Enterprise, or legacy Chat functionality.
