facts.label: Ongoing Free
facts.value: Free edition is ongoing, described as free forever for three users.

facts.label: Free agents and email
facts.value: Three agent seats; one support email address. Extra Free seats cannot be purchased.

facts.label: Free forms and internal knowledge
facts.value: One feedback widget and one advanced web form; private agent knowledge base. Public knowledge base and ASAP are not included in the Free column.

facts.label: Free workflow
facts.value: Manual support handling, default roles/profiles, two macros and a default SLA; no workflow-rule allowance.

facts.label: Free resource quantities
facts.value: Numeric Free ticket, contact, total storage, private-article and retained-history caps not found in the checked plan sources.

facts.label: Free AI and API
facts.value: Pricing matrix excludes Free from Answer Bot and generative AI services; Free has 5,000 API credits daily.

facts.label: Trial length and card
facts.value: 15-day trial of the chosen plan; no credit card required.

facts.label: Post-trial preservation
facts.value: Desk pricing says automatic Free downgrade; general trial terms warn trial data/customizations are lost unless purchased or exported before expiry.

facts.label: Express USD
facts.value: USD 9/user/month paid monthly; USD 7/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Standard USD
facts.value: USD 20/user/month paid monthly; USD 14/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Professional USD
facts.value: USD 35/user/month paid monthly; USD 23/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Enterprise USD
facts.value: USD 50/user/month paid monthly; USD 40/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Express INR
facts.value: INR 540/user/month paid monthly; INR 420/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Standard INR
facts.value: INR 1,300/user/month paid monthly; INR 800/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Professional INR
facts.value: INR 2,100/user/month paid monthly; INR 1,400/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Enterprise INR
facts.value: INR 3,200/user/month paid monthly; INR 2,400/user/month billed annually.

facts.label: Currency and tax
facts.value: Pricing has several currency/region price books. Taxes such as GST, VAT and sales tax are charged in addition when applicable.

facts.label: Older Enterprise price
facts.value: Older Enterprise explainer says USD-symbol 45/month and unlimited departments/email aliases; current USD data says 50/month and matrix says 50 included departments/100 email channels.

facts.label: Payment methods
facts.value: Desk purchase guide permits credit card or PayPal; general terms restrict subscriptions shorter than one year to credit card.

facts.label: Full licences
facts.value: One purchased user licence admits one active agent. All full agents in an account use the same plan; mixed Professional/Enterprise full licences are not supported.

facts.label: Light agents
facts.value: Internal collaborators can view permitted records and add private comments; cannot reply publicly, edit ticket fields or own tickets.

facts.label: Light-agent price and eligibility
facts.value: Public pricing data lists USD 6 or INR 345/light agent/month. Docs disagree on the first eligible plan: agent guide says all paid; matrix starts Standard; pricing FAQ says Professional.

facts.label: Other billing units
facts.value: API credits, WhatsApp IM credits and external AI tokens are separate meters. They are not agent seats or customer conversations.

facts.label: Plan seat ceilings
facts.value: Free: 3; Express: 5; matrix explicitly says unlimited users for Standard, Professional and Enterprise.

facts.label: Standard seat inconsistency
facts.value: Pricing FAQ says Standard increases the user limit to five; current matrix assigns five to Express and unlimited to Standard.

facts.label: Purchase floor and setup fee
facts.value: No separate base-plan minimum seat quantity, minimum spend or mandatory setup fee found. Per-user self-service ordering is documented.

facts.label: Term and renewal
facts.value: Monthly and upfront annual choices; automatic renewal. General terms require notice at least seven days before renewal or downgrade to Free.

facts.label: Desk generative AI cost
facts.value: Zoho-hosted Zia generation is described as no charge; external ChatGPT/DeepSeek uses the buyer's API key and provider token bill. Azure OpenAI bills through Azure.

facts.label: Native digital-agent credits
facts.value: One section says 3,000 organization credits on enablement; another says 8,000 during Enterprise trial and 25,000 on Enterprise purchase.

facts.label: Native digital-agent dependency
facts.value: Native Desk digital agents require a paid Zoho Directory edition; rollout is selected US/India users and Enterprise/trial credits are described.

facts.label: Digital-agent extra price
facts.value: Exact extra Directory charge, native-agent top-up price, expiry/reset and credits-per-operation schedule not established.

facts.label: Agent Studio hosted models
facts.value: Separate Zia Agents platform: Standard model tier includes 30 million tokens/month, then USD 1/1M; Pro model tier includes 20 million, then USD 3/1M.

facts.label: Agent Studio credit counting
facts.value: USD 1 = 1,000 AI credits. Standard hosted tier consumes 1 credit/1,000 tokens; Pro 3 credits/1,000 tokens after its allowance. Purchased credits roll over; free allowance resets on the first and does not roll over.

facts.label: Native AI answer examples
facts.value: Exact total for 100 or 500 automated answers cannot be calculated: Desk-specific digital-agent credits conflict, and token/credit usage per answer is not specified.

facts.label: Optional token illustration
facts.value: Agent Studio Standard tier: 100 or 500 blocks of 1,000 tokens cost USD 0 inside an unused allowance; after exhaustion, USD 0.10 or USD 0.50.

facts.label: Removing seats
facts.value: Deleting/deactivating an agent does not cancel its purchased licence. Reduce subscription seats separately to stop that licence's billing. Added seats are prorated.

facts.label: WhatsApp wallet
facts.value: IM credits are prepaid, USD 2/credit plus a 3% value-added fee. WhatsApp charges per delivered template message from July 1, 2025, varying by category and recipient country.

facts.label: WhatsApp free windows
facts.value: Customer-service window lasts 24 hours after the customer's last message: non-template and utility-template replies inside it are free. Qualified entry-point windows last 72 hours.

facts.label: IM recharge and stops
facts.value: Positive wallet balance required for chargeable messages. Optional auto-recharge requires a valid saved payment source; partner-billed organizations buy through their partner.

facts.label: Refund and cancellation
facts.value: First-month monthly dissatisfaction refund and first-45-days annual refund policy; renewal requests within five business days monthly or 15 days annual.

facts.label: Free inactivity
facts.value: Unpaid accounts inactive for 120 continuous days may be terminated after notice and a backup opportunity. Another Zoho service's activity does not keep Desk active.

facts.label: Other resource overages
facts.value: No unified ticket/contact/storage overage price or automatic upgrade rule found for standalone Desk.

facts.label: ASAP branding
facts.value: ASAP appearance settings explicitly let admins disable the Powered by Zoho Desk ASAP tag.

facts.label: Business Messaging branding
facts.value: BM appearance guide describes an optional Powered by Zoho Desk tag toggle alongside company logo, color, theme and launcher settings.

facts.label: Guided Conversations branding
facts.value: GC widget customization explicitly permits displaying or removing Powered by branding.

facts.label: Help Center identity
facts.value: Default Help Center and agent interface support replacing the Zoho Desk logo, favicon and logo link.

facts.label: Help Center full attribution removal
facts.value: Exact first plan and complete removal rule for Help Center vendor footer attribution remain unresolved.

facts.label: Desk-linked SalesIQ branding
facts.value: Exact entitlement and price for removing all vendor attribution from the Desk-linked SalesIQ widget not established.

facts.label: Outgoing email attribution
facts.value: Own SMTP removes the “via Zoho Desk” sender snippet for replies; automated notifications need Zoho support to switch their sending route.

facts.label: Public and solo access
facts.value: Public self-service trial/signup; Express is sold for teams of five or fewer. A sole working agent fits that stated audience.

facts.label: Subscription administration
facts.value: Primary contact/Super Admin manages purchases; select monthly or yearly billing and the agent quantity in Zoho Store.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: hosted help desk with a shared ticket inbox, help articles, website messaging, automation and optional AI. Fits solo support and teams; overlaps knowledge bases, messaging and community feedback.

facts.label: Email
facts.value: Native email-to-ticket channel in every plan; forward an external support mailbox to Desk's default address/alias.

facts.label: Website human messaging
facts.value: Native Business Messaging widget, Standard and above. Standalone embed or embed inside ASAP; associated agents answer through the IM module.

facts.label: SalesIQ live chat
facts.value: Desk-powered SalesIQ live-chat channel is Enterprise; a separate SalesIQ integration row starts Standard.

facts.label: In-app customer chat
facts.value: BM SDKs support iOS and Android; ASAP modules also expose customer help/chat services on iOS, Android and Flutter.

facts.label: WhatsApp
facts.value: Native Desk IM integration with a WhatsApp Business Account, Facebook Business setup and registered phone number; Standard and above.

facts.label: Instagram
facts.value: Instagram Business account linked to a Facebook Page can send/receive DMs through Desk IM; Standard and above.

facts.label: Messenger
facts.value: Native IM integration with authenticated Facebook business pages; Standard and above.

facts.label: Meta reply-window inconsistency
facts.value: Instagram/Messenger setup explains a 24-hour reply flow, but limitations in the same guides describe a seven-day composer cutoff.

facts.label: SMS
facts.value: SMS add-on for outbound customer/agent notifications, Standard/Professional/Enterprise, through SMS-Magic or Clickatell credits.

facts.label: Two-way SMS
facts.value: Native inbound SMS-to-ticket behavior and its plan/rate not established in the checked SMS docs.

facts.label: Voice
facts.value: Twilio integration provides incoming/outgoing browser calls and call-ticket association; Professional/Enterprise only.

facts.label: Slack
facts.value: Integration can create tickets, comment, retrieve details and respond from Slack; also sends internal ticket notifications.

facts.label: Discord
facts.value: A named native Discord support channel and its permissions, plan and transcript flow not found.

facts.label: Ticket forms
facts.value: Feedback widget can be popup, embedded or iframe; advanced web form uses generated HTML and becomes a ticket.

facts.label: Public social support
facts.value: Matrix includes one social brand for Express/Standard/Professional and two for Enterprise across X, Facebook and Instagram; Free is excluded.

facts.label: Other IM channels
facts.value: Telegram, WeChat and LINE appear in the current IM matrix; LINE supports agent association and automatic ticket conversion.

facts.label: Assignment
facts.value: Agents can be assigned manually; paid direct-assignment rules and Professional+ round-robin automate routing.

facts.label: Private collaboration
facts.value: Tickets support private and public comments; administrators can control comment permissions.

facts.label: Saved replies
facts.value: Standard+ snippets provide reusable text, placeholders and sharing. Guide permits up to 200 created snippets and 25,600 characters per snippet; no inserted images.

facts.label: Collision warnings
facts.value: Presence/activity alerts, draft/reply warnings and collision chats are Professional/Enterprise only.

facts.label: Automation tiers
facts.value: Matrix: Express 1 ticket workflow; Standard 5/module; Professional 15/department/module; Enterprise 30/department/module. Free has no workflow rules.

facts.label: Business hours
facts.value: Express, Standard and Professional each have one business-hour schedule and holiday list; Enterprise 100; Free has neither in the matrix.

facts.label: Support email counts
facts.value: Free 1, Express 2, Standard 5, Professional 10, Enterprise 100 support email channels.

facts.label: Sites and widget counts
facts.value: ASAP: Standard 10, Professional 10, Enterprise 50 widgets. BM channels: Standard 1, Professional 10, Enterprise 50.

facts.label: Departments and add-on
facts.value: Professional includes 10 departments; Enterprise 50, with up to 450 additional departments. Enterprise add-on USD 7/department/month monthly or USD 6/month billed annually.

facts.label: Multibrand separation
facts.value: Enterprise multibrand Help Centers map to departments, each with its own support channels, SLAs, articles/community and appearance. Common or unique customer user bases can be selected.

facts.label: Domains
facts.value: One mapped domain unless multibranding is enabled. Custom mapping starts Express in the matrix; Zoho provisions SSL at no cost.

facts.label: Public versus private knowledge
facts.value: Private agent KB in all plans; public KB and community begin Standard. Article visibility can be agents, all users or registered users.

facts.label: Article workflow and feedback
facts.value: Articles support draft/review/publication, expiry, tags and attachments. Help Center users can search, rate, comment and follow content depending on access settings.

facts.label: Public article capacity
facts.value: A numeric total article allowance by edition was not established. Matrix documents category/section hierarchy, not an unlimited article promise.

facts.label: Help Center translation tiers
facts.value: Multilingual KB starts Professional; automatic article translation is Enterprise in the matrix.

facts.label: Agent assistance and intelligence
facts.value: Express+ can use BYOK generation; Standard+ adds Answer Bot and intelligence; Professional+ adds native hosted generation, anomaly detection and field prediction.

facts.label: Answer Bot role
facts.value: Answers customer and agent questions from Desk KB; bot can be enabled for agents, customers or both. Desk and SalesIQ Answer Bots are distinct features.

facts.label: Digital-agent roles
facts.value: Support Specialist drafts/sends knowledge-based replies for email tickets. Resolution Expert documents resolutions across channels after closure.

facts.label: Fixed flows
facts.value: Enterprise Guided Conversations builds predefined response/action flows and supports chat transfer.

facts.label: Knowledge inputs and refresh
facts.value: Answer Bot trains on Desk KB articles, automatically every 30 minutes; manual retraining is supported. Deleted/unpublished articles are removed on retraining.

facts.label: Knowledge limits and citations
facts.value: Trainable article text must be 100–200,000 characters; attachments/images are skipped. Responses can link relevant articles; agents can see article permissions.

facts.label: Restricted knowledge
facts.value: Customer bot normally uses All Users articles; on an authenticated BM channel it can also use Registered Users articles according to the user's access rights.

facts.label: Approval and thresholds
facts.value: Admins choose Exact, Confident or Possible response thresholds and no-answer/thumbs-down messages. KB articles can be sent for editorial review before publication.

facts.label: Answer Bot fallback
facts.value: Main setup guide shows Chat with Agent when Answer Bot cannot answer, only if live chat is enabled in ASAP.

facts.label: Guided Conversations handoff
facts.value: Enterprise Chat Transfer block sends the full conversation context to live agents; website deployment needs BM enabled.

facts.label: Digital-agent fallback
facts.value: Missing suitable KB information makes Support Specialist leave a private comment, unassign itself and return the existing ticket to routing for a human.

facts.label: After-hours behavior
facts.value: IM business-hour schedules hold routing outside working hours and can show offline messages or collect/create tickets. Bots continue unless their flows include schedule conditions.

facts.label: AI workflow actions
facts.value: Enterprise Zia Actions can extract/predict ticket fields, generate content and send the first knowledge-based email reply, with configurable success/failure field updates.

facts.label: Customer identity and consequential actions
facts.value: No documented universal identity verification or approval process for an AI-issued refund/account change established in the checked Desk action sources.

facts.label: Shopify
facts.value: Desk extension displays order/customer details and can create tickets based on order criteria. Shopify Basic is documented as restricting PII access.

facts.label: WooCommerce
facts.value: Desk extension synchronizes order/customer context and creates tickets; supports editing shipping address and the first order note in the documented widget.

facts.label: Stripe
facts.value: Third-party Stripe 360 marketplace extension by Supporto360; Standard+ compatibility. Public USD selector shows USD 29/org/month or USD 348/org/year, before local tax.

facts.label: GitHub
facts.value: GitHub extension creates/links repository issues from Desk tickets; multiple issues can link to one ticket.

facts.label: Slack connection
facts.value: Map departments to public/private Slack channels, send event notifications, create/comment/respond to tickets using Slack.

facts.label: Automation connections
facts.value: Zapier integration supports new ticket/message/status/contact/comment triggers and actions such as create ticket/comment/contact and send email reply.

facts.label: Linear and Discord integrations
facts.value: Specific Linear integration and complete Discord support workflow not established.

facts.label: API access
facts.value: Public REST documentation includes OAuth authentication, organization binding, tickets/threads, contacts, articles and feedback resources.

facts.label: Daily API credits
facts.value: Free 5,000; Express 25,000 + 100/full agent; Standard 50,000 + 250; Professional 75,000 + 500; Enterprise 100,000 + 1,000.

facts.label: API example discrepancy
facts.value: API guide's Professional example uses 50,000 + 250/agent, while its table and current plan matrix use 75,000 + 500/agent.

facts.label: API concurrency and stop
facts.value: Maximum concurrent OAuth requests: Free/trial 5, Express/Standard 10, Professional 15, Enterprise/bundles 25. Exhausted daily credits deny new calls until reset or top-up.

facts.label: API top-up rate
facts.value: Currency price for additional API credits not found in the public guide.

facts.label: Webhooks
facts.value: Professional 5 active, Enterprise 10 active, organization maximum 20 active/inactive total. Free/Standard unavailable; matrix also excludes Express.

facts.label: Client libraries
facts.value: ASAP customer SDK modules, BM iOS/Android SDKs and web installation snippets are public; custom extensions/connections use edition permissions.

facts.label: Self-host operations
facts.value: Not applicable to the vendor-hosted Desk edition researched; no licensed Desk server installation/upgrade path established.

facts.label: Agent interface languages
facts.value: Preferences guide lists 27 languages, including English, Chinese variants, French, Spanish, Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Arabic, Hebrew and Odia. Accessibility-controls guide says 24.

facts.label: Help Center languages
facts.value: Published list has 52 language options including regional variants; Professional+ multilingual KB, Enterprise automatic translation.

facts.label: AI language disagreement
facts.value: Matrix advertises Answer Bot in 30 languages and summary in 35; detailed Answer Bot guide says 29 bot/33 GenAI languages.

facts.label: Agent mobile apps
facts.value: Zoho Desk app for iOS/Android supports ticket work; Radar for iOS/Android focuses on monitoring with lightweight ticket handling.

facts.label: Customer app libraries
facts.value: ASAP iOS/Android/Flutter and BM iOS/Android expose customer help or messaging within an existing app.

facts.label: On-demand apps
facts.value: Enterprise add-on builds custom iOS/Android apps, quoted by development effort; customer publishes with own app-store accounts.

facts.label: Standard reporting tiers
facts.value: Express+ has predefined reports and ticket/satisfaction dashboards; Standard has 50 custom reports/10 custom dashboards; Professional/Enterprise state unlimited custom reports/dashboards.

facts.label: Response and service analytics
facts.value: Standard+ includes response/resolution/FCR and KB/community dashboards; Professional+ adds SLA, call and all-department analytics.

facts.label: AI failure review
facts.value: Answer Bot exposes training failures; Zia auto-email can update fields for success/failure and use views for review. BM's apparent thumbs icons do not establish captured rating data.

facts.label: Module export
facts.value: CSV export of standard/custom modules, department-specific, selectable fields/views/criteria. Current export guide says up to 50,000 records in one export.

facts.label: Export-count disagreement
facts.value: Current export guide says 50,000/export; administration FAQ says 3,000; matrix specifies 1,000/batch for Free/Express.

facts.label: Conversation export versus CSV
facts.value: Ordinary module CSV is distinct from a full backup containing threads/comments/time entries. FAQ directs email-thread export requests to support.

facts.label: Full backup contents
facts.value: ZIP containing module CSVs: tickets with threads/comments/time entries, contacts/accounts, activities, products, KB articles, agents, teams and departments.

facts.label: Attachments
facts.value: Backup contains secure attachment download links, not a complete bundle of attachment bytes; API retrieval is needed to fetch the files.

facts.label: Backup plan/activation disagreement
facts.value: Matrix starts backup at Standard, one full backup/month. FAQ calls backup a request-enabled beta for all paid editions, which would include Express.

facts.label: Backup frequency disagreement
facts.value: Detailed guide allows repeated custom backups within 30 days, each at most 31 days of data; FAQ blocks both full and custom backup for 30 days after initiation.

facts.label: Community and feedback portability
facts.value: Forum topics are excluded from full backups. Public API documentation has topic/comment and customer-feedback resources, but no single complete forum/vote migration export was established.

facts.label: Additional portability route
facts.value: Older Desk GDPR guide offers a free one-time backend bulk export on request.

facts.label: Regional hosting
facts.value: Desk GDPR guide maps US/EU/India/Australia/China registration domains to their respective hosting regions. General terms map signup IP to a region and may require migration.

facts.label: Region changes
facts.value: Desk guide documents customer-requested migration between data centers; newer feature availability varies by region.

facts.label: Native generation and training
facts.value: Desk's Zoho-hosted GenAI setup says processing remains in the designated Zoho data center; ticket/customer data is not used to train that model; KB articles train its support knowledge.

facts.label: General AI policy
facts.value: Privacy policy permits anonymized portions of service data for algorithm accuracy and organization data for organization-specific models.

facts.label: External AI processing
facts.value: BYOK ChatGPT sends data outside Zoho for generation; Desk docs say it is not used for provider training. Azure and DeepSeek configurations use their respective external accounts.

facts.label: Subprocessor directory
facts.value: Official directory distinguishes subprocessors, third-party services and AI providers, but the provider table stayed at Loading data in the fetched view.

facts.label: DPA route
facts.value: Privacy policy offers a Data Processing Addendum on request through an account-linked form. Complete unsigned Desk-specific DPA text was not obtained.

facts.label: Account termination retention
facts.value: Privacy policy says active data deleted within six months after account termination, then backups within three further months. Desk retention table describes normal closure as 180 days plus 90 backup days.

facts.label: Deletion and recovery
facts.value: Deleted module records remain in Recycle Bin for 60 days unless cleared sooner; emptying it schedules active deletion within 24 hours. Backup copies can persist 90 days.

facts.label: Immediate closure and audit data
facts.value: Immediate portal-deletion requests: 30 days in the table, plus 90 backup days. Audit logs: two years, plus 90 backup days; generated backup files: seven days.

facts.label: Active conversation history/export window
facts.value: Numeric active-history cap by plan and guaranteed post-cancellation interactive export grace period not established.

facts.label: Identity and operation
facts.value: Zoho Desk; active Zoho customer support service.

facts.label: Product boundary
facts.value: Desk Business Messaging is native ticket-oriented messaging. SalesIQ is a separate visitor-engagement product that can connect to Desk.

facts.label: Legal entity and countries
facts.value: Contracting entity depends on the customer's region: India and Russia use Zoho Corporation Private Limited, India; US uses Zoho Corporation, US; Canada uses Zoho Canada Corporation.

facts.label: Other contracting regions
facts.value: Much of Europe uses Zoho Corporation B.V., Netherlands; Germany, Austria and Switzerland use Zoho Corporation GmbH; unspecified regions generally use Zoho Corporation Pte. Ltd., Singapore.

facts.label: Buying restrictions
facts.value: Exhaustive Desk purchase-country restrictions not established. AI and phone channels have separate region/provider conditions.

facts.label: Hosting and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary subscription service. Free, Express, Standard, Professional and Enterprise are the current standalone plans.

facts.label: Suite editions
facts.value: Zoho One, CRM Plus and Service Plus receive Desk Enterprise AI entitlements; CRM Plus Starter receives Standard AI entitlements; CRM Flex follows the selected edition.

facts.label: Free support
facts.value: Email/portal requests, docs and community; vendor quotes one to two business days for Free responses.

facts.label: Included paid support
facts.value: Classic included in paid Desk: email 24/7, phone 8×5; Professional/Enterprise chat 8×5. Published initial response eight hours.

facts.label: Paid support upgrades
facts.value: Premium: 20% of subscription, email 24/7 and phone/chat/remote 24×5, initial response three hours. Enterprise Support: 25% annual subscription, minimum 25 user licences, 24/7 channels, one hour.

facts.label: Freshness and next review
facts.value: Checked November 4, 2026. July 7, 2026 AI expansion and current digital-agent rollout are live evidence; no shutdown or Desk rename found in checked official sources.

facts.label: Billing units

facts.label: Session definition and reset
facts.value: A chat session runs from visitor initiation/resumption to browser closure, logout or configured idle closure; one conversation can have multiple sessions. Visitor tracking uses daily unique visitors and resets on the billing cycle.

facts.label: Minimum purchase and renewal
facts.value: Current paid entry is one operator licence; monthly or annual subscription. Auto-renewal applies; general terms require notice at least seven days before renewal to cancel or downgrade.

facts.label: Bot and agent allocations
facts.value: Basic: 1 bot, 25,000 bot sessions/month, 1 Zia Agent. Professional: 5 bots, 50,000 sessions, 3 Zia Agents. Enterprise: 10 bots, 200,000 sessions, 10 Zia Agents.

facts.label: Native Zia versus external AI
facts.value: Native Zia LLM is described as available at no extra cost; native Answer Bot/hybrid entitlement is Enterprise in current matrix. BYOAI accepts provider keys or custom LLM webhooks.

facts.label: Zia Agents / Zoho-hosted models
facts.value: Standard tier: 30 million free tokens/month, then USD 1/million tokens. Pro tier: 20 million free tokens/month, then USD 3/million tokens; Pro requires request.

facts.label: Zia Agents / keys and credit units
facts.value: USD 1 buys 1,000 AI Credits. Standard consumes 1 credit/1,000 tokens; Pro 3 credits/1,000 tokens beyond allowance. BYOK is billed directly by the chosen provider.

facts.label: Native Answer Bot examples
facts.value: For 100 or 500 bot chat sessions, Enterprise base with native Zia remains USD 25/month for one human or USD 75/month for three; India INR 1,500 or INR 4,500/month, before taxes.

facts.label: Zia Agents / total example gap
facts.value: No exact total for 100 or 500 autonomous Zia Agent conversations: token consumption and provider/model choice are not specified.

facts.label: Extra bots and bot sessions
facts.value: Standard USD: extra chatbot USD 10/month or USD 8/month annual equivalent; 5,000 extra bot sessions at the same rate. India: INR 500/month or INR 400/month annual equivalent for each add-on.

facts.label: Extra visitor tracking
facts.value: Additional 100,000 tracked visitors: USD 100/month or USD 90/month annual equivalent; India INR 6,000/month or INR 5,400/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: Quota-stop and recharge gaps
facts.value: Exact handling of exhausted human/bot sessions, automatic purchase of extra blocks, and a SalesIQ-specific AI auto-recharge setting not established.

facts.label: Credits and inactivity
facts.value: Purchased Zia Agents credits roll over; free token allowance resets on the first of each month without rollover. Unpaid Zoho accounts inactive for 120 continuous days may be terminated after notice.

facts.label: Third-party charges
facts.value: External AI, translation, messaging and telephony providers can add their own service charges; exact complete channel-provider bill not priced here.

facts.label: Branding removal
facts.value: Exact removal rights/first plan for Zoho branding on the widget, help-content surface and chat-follow-up email not established.

facts.label: Buying access
facts.value: Self-service Free and paid-plan trial routes; common Zoho account required. One working operator can buy a paid licence.

facts.label: Type and fit
facts.value: Our classification: website/in-app live chat and visitor engagement, with human inbox, bots, AI agents, messaging channels and sales lead tools.

facts.label: Website and in-app chat
facts.value: Native website chat and mobile-app SDK channels on all current plans.

facts.label: Messaging channels
facts.value: Basic and above: WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, LINE and WeChat integrations.

facts.label: Voice and video
facts.value: Basic and above: native in-chat audio, screen sharing and video calls. Enterprise lists PBX outbound-call integration.

facts.label: Email and other inbox channels
facts.value: Smart Reply sends follow-up email from a conversation; visitor replies must preserve the Smart Reply CC to append as comments. General support-mailbox, SMS, Slack or Discord customer intake not established.

facts.label: Core human workflow
facts.value: Canned replies, file sharing and default operator role profiles; Basic and above add chat transfer, group chat and routing/department controls.

facts.label: Private notes and supervision
facts.value: Conversation/visitor notes and operator collaboration are documented; Professional and Enterprise add chat monitoring.

facts.label: Hours and offline handling
facts.value: Paid plans include business hours; widget setup includes offline messaging controls and forms.

facts.label: Collision warning
facts.value: A dedicated simultaneous-reply warning and its plan gate not established.

facts.label: Brands and sites
facts.value: All current plans include 1 brand. Extra brand: USD 20/month or USD 16/month annual equivalent; India INR 1,000/month or INR 800/month annual equivalent.

facts.label: Unpublished separation limits
facts.value: Exact websites/domains per brand and separate mailbox/phone-number limits not established.

facts.label: Help content / Basic
facts.value: 100 articles and 50 FAQs; customer access through the widget resources experience.

facts.label: Help content / higher plans
facts.value: Professional: 1,000 articles and 1,000 FAQs. Enterprise: 2,000 articles, 2,000 FAQs and 2,000 webpages as resources; AI self-help included there.

facts.label: Standalone help center boundary
facts.value: Public custom-domain portal, portal article-voting rules and standalone site limits not established for SalesIQ itself.

facts.label: AI roles and gates
facts.value: Basic and above have custom bots and Zia Agents; Professional and above add native Zia operator productivity features; Enterprise includes native Answer Bot/hybrid automation and smart reply suggestions.

facts.label: Agent deployment
facts.value: Zia Agents built in Agent Studio can be deployed as digital operators without an extra human operator licence for each digital agent.

facts.label: Knowledge sources and citations
facts.value: Answer Bot uses SalesIQ articles, FAQs and webpages, or an integrated Zoho Desk knowledge base. Reference-source links can be shown with answers.

facts.label: BYOAI grounding
facts.value: Native/external models can use retrieved resources; SalesIQ passes up to five relevant resources. Custom LLMs can connect through synchronous or asynchronous webhooks.

facts.label: Knowledge freshness and approval gap
facts.value: No single guaranteed recrawl/sync interval, aggregate knowledge-byte limit or universal approval-before-every-AI-answer control established.

facts.label: Human fallback
facts.value: Zia Agent instructions must explicitly configure human handoff; operators can take over active chats. Answer Bot also provides answer-found/not-found follow-up paths.

facts.label: Outside hours
facts.value: Bots can assist while operators are busy or outside business hours; hours/offline message settings govern human availability.

facts.label: Customer actions
facts.value: Zia Agents can retrieve records through tools/webhooks/files/databases and perform configured tasks such as booking appointments and pushing leads into Zoho CRM.

facts.label: Sensitive-action controls
facts.value: Universal customer-identity verification and mandatory human approval for refunds/account changes not established.

facts.label: Site and ecommerce connections
facts.value: WordPress, WooCommerce and Shopify integrations are listed across current plans; WordPress has a Zoho-published embedding connector.

facts.label: Zoho and payment connections
facts.value: Zoho CRM, Desk and Assist integrations are documented. Matrix lists Stripe via Zoho Checkout on Professional/Enterprise.

facts.label: Agent tools and missing connections
facts.value: Zia Agents announcement names Shopify, Stripe, Slack and Salesforce tools. Native Linear, GitHub and Discord connections not established in checked SalesIQ integration sources.

facts.label: JavaScript and mobile libraries
facts.value: Public web JavaScript API and mobile SDKs support application integration and visitor/chat controls.

facts.label: REST API and regional endpoints
facts.value: Public OAuth-based REST API v2. Documented endpoint regions include US, EU, India, Australia, China and Japan.

facts.label: Webhooks and workflows
facts.value: Admin/data events can trigger webhooks or Deluge workflows; current plan matrix gives paid-plan workflow allocations.

facts.label: Numerical rate limits
facts.value: A complete current requests-per-minute allowance and rate-limit behaviour by plan not established.

facts.value: No SalesIQ server deployment offered in the checked service terms and product installation routes. Site operator installs the widget/connector; Zoho runs SalesIQ.

facts.label: WordPress connector maintenance

facts.value: Resources guide supports 30 languages for articles/FAQs; translated variants are saved as drafts for review. Bot setup documents 30 configurable conversation languages.

facts.label: Widget and translation coverage

facts.label: Devices and host platform

facts.label: Reporting and ratings

facts.label: Conversation list and messages
facts.value: Conversation-list export supports CSV/XLSX. Separate paginated message API returns message content, timestamps and sender details.

facts.label: Transcript and conversation export
facts.value: Documented conversation export provides PDF or JSON for messages, information and notes; password may be required for GDPR-protected data. Operator UI also offers PDF/email transcripts.

facts.label: Bot portability
facts.value: Published codeless bots can be exported/imported as ZIP; imported bots begin as drafts and account-specific connections/resources need manual work.

facts.label: Whole-account archive gap
facts.value: Complete portable contacts, article/FAQ history and attachment binaries in a single full-account export not established.

facts.label: Data location / priced markets
facts.value: SalesIQ API docs distinguish US and India datacenters. Zoho infrastructure lists US Quincy/Dallas and India Mumbai/Chennai locations.

facts.value: SalesIQ states that customer data is not used to train its AI models or sold for advertising; AI can use published resource content for answers.

facts.label: Subprocessors and DPA
facts.value: Zoho publishes a subprocessor page and describes a DPA request route in its privacy policy; exact current SalesIQ-specific processor list not verified.

facts.label: History by plan
facts.value: Free chat history: 30 days. Paid Basic/Professional/Enterprise: unlimited chat history while service remains in use.

facts.label: Termination deletion
facts.value: Zoho privacy policy: service data removed from active databases within six months of account termination; backups within three months after that.

facts.label: Selective deletion and downgrade gap
facts.value: FAQ describes historical-data deletion; exact SalesIQ trash recovery window, per-record backup purge and paid-to-Free preservation of older transcripts not established.

facts.label: Identity and operating state
facts.value: Zoho SalesIQ; active hosted customer engagement product in the Zoho suite.

facts.value: Old SalesIQ live-chat widget deprecated from May 15, 2026; no further fixes or compatibility updates. New Desk widget rollout began May 18, 2026.

facts.label: Editions and licence
facts.value: Vendor-hosted proprietary SalesIQ, embedded web widget and mobile libraries; subscription/embed-code use rights under Zoho terms.

facts.label: Support routes
facts.value: SalesIQ publishes support@zohosalesiq.com and offers official docs and community forums.

facts.value: Checked November 5, 2026. Summer 2026 release and July 2026 Zia Agents/BYOAI updates show current development. Old-widget sunset is May 15, 2026. Next review proposed December 5, 2026.

facts.value: Displayed INR estimates/month: Starter ₹4,736.32; Plus ₹7,578.69; Elite ₹13,263.41. Charges billed every 30 days, in the store billing currency at the exchange rate on the charge date.

facts.value: Monthly or yearly payment is allowed; no fixed annual invoice found. Annual commitments of at least 250,000 conversations/month can receive quoted discounts. Enterprise is contact sales.

facts.value: An agent is a team member invited by email; agents share an official WhatsApp number. Starter has unlimited agents; Plus and Elite charge only above their included counts.

facts.value: The pricing calculator says every ten service messages count as one conversation, while the FAQ defines a 24-hour session. A dependable conversion from 100 customer support conversations is unresolved.

facts.value: Starter USD 49.99/month plus conversation usage and applicable external charges; no extra human-agent purchase is needed for either one or three workers.

facts.value: Each AI agent costs USD 24.99/month plus USD 0.09/resolution; first 100 resolutions free. Available as add-ons on any paid plan.

facts.label: Sello AI rate
facts.value: USD 24.99/month plus 3% of order value; first 100 orders free.

facts.label: Separate AI provider bill
facts.value: The AI setup guide requires the buyer's own funded OpenAI account and API key. OpenAI computing fees are separate from Zoko's AI base and outcome fees.

facts.label: Resolution definition and allowance reset
facts.value: No precise billable-resolution success criteria, re-open rule, or reset period for the first 100 free outcomes found. No public Zoko model multiplier table found.

facts.label: Premium flow fees

facts.label: Flow execution usage
facts.value: 500,000 steps/account/month included; USD 0.0002 per additional step; unused steps do not roll over.

facts.label: Overages and stopping
facts.value: Live pricing says messages and flows continue above limits and published overages apply. Subscription is upfront; usage is calculated and charged after month end.
